To add more questions, click Add Question .
Set up a poll
Set the anonymity level. In the Anonymity section, select the poll type:
- Normal — Each employee decides whether to make their vote anonymous or public.
- Public — All votes are visible.
- Anonymous — Votes are anonymous. Other employees cannot see who voted for each option.
Allow employees to change their answers. Enable Allow changing opinion to let employees change their votes. This is useful if they change their mind or select an option by mistake.
When the poll is ready, click Send .
Once published, the poll appears in the Feed. Employees select an answer and click Vote .
View poll results
Once the poll is published, the number of votes appears next to each answer option. In a public poll, you can see who voted for each option by clicking the number next to it.
Click Stop to close the poll. Employees can no longer vote or change their answers.
To download the results in Excel format, click Results (XLS) . This lets you keep a copy of the results even if you later delete the poll post.
In brief
- A poll helps you quickly collect employee opinions directly in the Feed.
- Create a poll from Feed > Poll .
- Select recipients, then add questions and answer options.
- Set the anonymity level: regular, public, or anonymous.
- Allow employees to change their answers if needed.
- When voting is complete, stop the poll and download the results in XLS format.

titre: Kanban view in CRM
sections: Kanban view in CRM

Kanban is a board with columns and cards that helps you move clients through the sales funnel. Cards represent CRM items like leads, deals, and invoices. Columns show the steps in your workflow with a client. In Bitrix24, these steps are called stages.
In the deals, you can track the number and total value of deals at each stage, monitor manager workload, and see which deals have not been assigned yet.
Configure Kanban for deals
Go to CRM > Deals > Kanban .
Configure stages

Stages are the steps in your workflow with clients. They help you track the sales process from first contact to closing the deal. You can set up stages directly in Kanban or in CRM directories. Statuses and dropdowns in CRM
By default, deals include several stages. You can keep them, rename, or create new ones.
- Initial stage: the first step in working with a client. New deals appear here. You cannot delete the initial stage, but you can rename it.
- Additional stages: steps like preparing documents, sending an invoice, or signing a contract. You can create as many of these stages as you need.
- Final stages: successful or unsuccessful outcomes. You can create several unsuccessful stages to track why deals were lost.
Click Pencil to change a stage's name, description, or color, or to delete it.
To add a new stage, click Plus (+) .
Configure the deal creation form

Deals can be created automatically, for example from a client's incoming email, or manually in Kanban. To help managers create deals faster, choose only the fields they need to fill out. They can fill in the other fields later.
1. Click Settings (⚙️) > Kanban settings > Configure create form fields .
2. Select fields.
3. Save the changes.
To quickly create a deal, click Plus (+) in the stage you need. Fill in the fields and click Save . Deals overview

Configure the deal view form. If you want to show only key information in Kanban, set up the view form. Each employee can configure it for themselves. For example, a manager may want to see the client name, deal amount, and payment status. To see the rest of the details, open the deal.
1. Click Settings (⚙️) > Kanban settings > Configure view form fields .
2. Select fields.
3. Save the changes.

Employees' photos on deal forms. By default, Kanban shows a photo of the employee responsible for the deal. As work on the deal continues, the photo may switch automatically to another one if that employee:
- left a comment in the Timeline
- is responsible for an incoming or missed call, incoming email, or chat
- is responsible for an activity whose automatic reminder was triggered.
Work with deals in Kanban

Move deals between stages. Move deals through stages as work with a client moves forward. For example, when you start working on a deal, move it from New deal to In progress . When the product is sold, move it to Deal won . To do this, drag the deal to another column.
Plan activities
To avoid missing a follow-up, schedule an activity: a call, a meeting, or contract preparation.
1. Click + Activity .
2. Fill out the form.
3. Click Save .
Universal activity in CRM

The deal form includes an activity counter. The number shows how many incoming and planned activities the deal has. The color shows their status. By default, the counter turns red 15 minutes before the activity deadline. You can change this time. How counters work in CRM
To view activity details, click the counter.
Contact a client. Hover over the client's name to quickly view contact details. A mini CRM item form opens with key details.
Bulk actions available in Kanban

Bulk actions let you work with multiple CRM items at once. For example, you can change the responsible manager for two deals or restart automation rules. Select the deals you need, and an action bar will appear at the top. Group actions in CRM
Delete. Deleted items stay in the recycle bin for 30 days. They are not included in analytics reports.

Add to stop list. Contacts from the selected items are added to the exclusion list. New leads and deals will no longer be created automatically for them. This is useful when unwanted data keeps appearing in CRM, such as advertising emails, non-targeted calls, or spam. Exceptions in CRM
Change stage. This action moves items to a different stage, for example, from In progress to Final invoice .
Assign responsible person. Lets you change the responsible employee for multiple items at once. This is useful when redistributing workload. Change a responsible person

Create task. This action creates a task linked to the selected CRM items. It helps coordinate work across departments. For example, a sales manager can assign an accountant a task Prepare invoice for two deals.
Create call list. Lets you schedule a call list for multiple deals. You can set a topic, instructions, time, and responsible employee. Automatic dialer in CRM

Merge. This action merges the selected items into one. Choose the main form that will receive all the data. If field values differ between forms, check the ones you want to keep in the main form. Merge duplicates in CRM
Restart automation rules. Automation rules will run again in the selected items, and a record of it will appear in the form. Automation rules in CRM
In brief
- Kanban is a board with columns and cards that helps you move clients through the sales funnel.
- Cards represent CRM items: leads, deals, invoices, quotes, and SPAs. Columns represent the steps in your workflow with a client. In Bitrix24, these steps are called stages.
- In Kanban, you can track the number of deals and their total amount at each stage, monitor each manager's workload, and see which deals have not been assigned yet.
- Kanban is available for leads, deals, invoices, quotes, and SPAs.
- Set up stages in Kanban and move cards through them until you close the deal.
- To help employees create a deal faster in Kanban, set up the creation form.
- To show only the most important details instead of all fields, set up the deal view form.

- To perform an action on multiple items, select them with the checkbox. A panel with available actions will appear at the top. For example, you can change the assignee for two deals or restart automation rules for them.

titre: My activities in CRM
sections: My activities in CRM
In Bitrix24 CRM, activities are customer-related tasks, such as calls, meetings, or document approval. You can view planned and completed activities under My activities .
In this article:
- Create an activity
- Edit, complete, or delete an activity
- Use group actions
- Configure the activity list
- Filter activities
- Set access permissions
Go to CRM > More > My activities .

Create an activity . Use this option to plan and track customer interactions. For example, an auto service manager can create an activity with a reminder for a maintenance appointment and link it to the contact form.
To add a universal activity A universal activity is a form for recording any client-related tasks. , open the CRM item form. Universal activity in CRM
Click Create and select the activity type, such as Task or Call . You can find the scheduled activity in the timeline of the CRM item form.
1. Tap More .
2. Select My Activities .
3. Choose the activity type, such as New call .
You can find the planned activity in the timeline of the linked CRM item form.
Edit, complete, or delete an activity. To avoid opening an activity form, click Menu (≡) next to the activity name and select an action.
Only CRM administrators can delete call activities that are created automatically.
Use group actions . You can quickly edit multiple activities at once using group actions. Select the activities in the list and choose an action:
- Delete
- Edit
- Assign responsible person
- Mark as completed
- Mark as not completed
Configure the activity list . To adjust the fields in the activity list:
1. Click Settings (⚙️).
2. Select the required fields.
3. Click Apply

Filter activities . There are some standard filters in the My activities section. For example, the My current activities filter helps supervisors find all pending activities of their subordinates. If the standard filters don't suit your needs, create a custom one.

Set access permissions. Only users with access to edit the linked CRM item can edit or complete a CRM activity. For example, if an employee has permission to edit a deal form, they can also edit linked activities. Role-based access permissions in CRM
1. Go to CRM > More > Settings > CRM access permissions .
2. Select the required CRM item.

3. Configure permissions for the desired role: Enable the Read permission to allow the employee only view activities. Enable the Add , Edit , and Delete permissions to let the employee modify and complete activities.
4. Save the changes.
In brief
- In Bitrix24 CRM, activities are customer-related tasks, such as calls, meetings, or document approval.
- To view planned activities or create new ones, go to CRM > More > My activities .
- To edit, complete, or delete an activity, click Menu (≡) next to the activity name and select an action.
- Use group actions to quickly edit multiple activities at once.

- The My activities section includes standard filters. Supervisors can use the My current activities filter to find all planned activities of their subordinates. If standard filters don’t fit your needs, create a custom one.
- To configure the activity list, click Settings (⚙️) , select the needed fields, and click Apply .
- Only users with access to edit the linked CRM item can modify or complete a CRM activity.

titre: New two-factor authentication in Bitrix24
sections: New two-factor authentication in Bitrix24

Two-factor authentication adds an extra layer of security to your Bitrix24 account. In addition to your login and password, you must confirm your identity using a second method. Without this step, no one can access your account, even if they know your password.

We updated the two-factor authentication process to make it simpler and more secure. Previously, verification required codes from third-party authenticator apps. Now you can confirm sign-in using the Bitrix24 mobile app or a one-time SMS code.

Each user enables two-factor authentication individually. Administrators can require two-factor authentication for the entire company. When required, employees must set it up within the specified time frame.
If you enabled two-factor authentication but cannot access the mobile app, use an alternative login method.
Log in to Bitrix24 without the mobile app
If you currently use the older method with special applications , we recommend switching to the new version.
Set up two-factor authentication
Enable two-factor authentication. The setup process is the same for employees and administrators. To begin, install the Bitrix24 mobile app and sign in. Bitrix24 mobile app

1. Click your photo in the top-right corner. 2. Select Security. 3. Click Enable . 4. Point your smartphone camera at the QR code and follow the link on the screen. If the QR code doesn't scan, use a dedicated QR code scanner app.

5. In the mobile app, tap Done to finish setup. 6. On your computer, click Continue . 7. Enter your phone number. You can use it to sign in via SMS if you lose access to the mobile app. 8. Click Continue . 9. Enter the SMS verification code. After setup, save your recovery codes. You will need them if you cannot confirm sign-in through the mobile app. Where to find recovery codes 10. Confirm your email address. You'll need it if you can't access the app. If you want to use a different email address, tap Change . 11. Tap Confirm .
From now on, when you sign in to Bitrix24, enter your login and password, then confirm the sign-in request in the mobile app.
1. Click your photo in the top-right corner. 2. Select Security. 3. Click Two-factor authentication . 4. Click the arrow in the Recovery codes section. 5. Print or save the codes.
Make two-factor authentication obligatory for all employees
To make two-factor authentication mandatory, the administrator must first enable it for their own account. Set up two-factor authentication for your account
To enforce protection:

1. Go to Settings (⚙️) Bitrix24 . 2. Select Security > Two-factor authentication . 3. Turn on Enable for the entire company . 4. Set the time frame within which users must enable two-factor authentication for their accounts.
5. Save the changes.
If you currently use codes from third-party authenticator apps:
1. Go to Bitrix24 Settings (⚙️). 2. Select Security > Two-factor authentication . 3. Click Enable .
You can then set up the new two-factor authentication method and require two-factor authentication for your company.
In brief:
- Two-factor authentication protects your Bitrix24 account with an additional verification step. Along with your login and password, you confirm sign-in using the Bitrix24 mobile app or an SMS code.
- Previously, login verification worked through codes from special applications. Now, you can use the Bitrix24 mobile app or a one-time SMS code.
- Each user enables two-factor authentication individually.
- Administrators can require two-factor authentication for the entire company and set a deadline for setup.
- To set up two-factor authentication, install the Bitrix24 mobile app and log in. On your computer, go to your profile and select Security > Enable .
- After enabling two-factor authentication, download and store your recovery codes. They allow access to your account if you lose your mobile device or cannot receive verification codes.

titre: Add the Facebook pixel to your website
sections: Add the Facebook pixel to your website
The Facebook pixel helps you track visitor actions on your website. Use it to measure ad performance, build custom audiences, and improve conversion rates.
How the Facebook pixel works
The Facebook pixel collects data about actions people take on your website. Facebook uses this data to:
- Measure ad performance
- Optimize ad delivery
- Create advertising audiences
- Increase conversions
Set up the Facebook pixel
First, create a Business Manager account and a Facebook pixel. For instructions, see the Facebook guide: Create a pixel in Business Manager .
After you create the pixel, copy the Facebook pixel ID.
Add the Pixel ID in Bitrix24
1. Go to Sites and Stores > Sites .
2. Select your website.
3. Click Configure site .
4. In the Site settings page, scroll down to Tracking pixels .
5. Paste the Facebook pixel ID into the field.
6. Save the changes.

titre: Deadline calculation for activities in CRM
sections: Deadline calculation for activities in CRM
When you create a new activity, CRM automatically sets a deadline. The deadline depends on the view you use and where you create the activity.
CRM sets the deadline to 3 working days after the activity creation date if you create the activity in one of these places:
- A CRM entity card in the Kanban or List view
- A smart activity after you close a lead or deal form
- The CRM entity timeline

For example, your company's working days are from Monday to Friday. If you create an activity on Monday, October 23, the deadline will be set for Thursday, October 26. If you create an activity on Friday, October 20, the deadline will be set for Wednesday, October 25.
If you create an activity in the Activities view, the column settings affect the deadline. CRM uses a different calculation in these cases:
- You create an activity in a quick lead or deal form.
- You move a CRM entity card to another column.
Refer to the table below for details about each column in this view.

titre: Emoji in Bitrix24
sections: Emoji in Bitrix24
Emoji are ideograms used in electronic messages and web pages to express ideas or emotions. Unlike emoticons, which are symbols, emoji are actual pictures.

Emoji are supported by most operating systems, office suites, social networks, and messengers. Bitrix24 also supports emoji in Feed posts and comments, chats in Messenger, and the Bitrix24 Messenger app.
Emoji on Windows
There are two ways to use emoji on Windows 11:
1. Shortcut : Press Windows logo + . (period) and select an emoji.
2. Chat icon : Use the smiley icon in a chat to find smileys.
Emoji on Mac
There are different ways to use emoji on macOS:
1. Shortcut : Press Command (⌘) + Control (⌃) + Space and select a smiley.
2. Menu option : Click Edit , choose Emoji & Symbols , and select an emoji.
3. Chat icon : Use the smiley icon in a chat to find smileys.
Emoji on iOS and Android
iOS and Android devices have an emoji button on the keyboard.
If there is no emoji keyboard on your iOS device by default, follow these steps:
1. Go to Settings > General > Keyboard .
2. Open Keyboards , tap Add New Keyboard , and find Emoji in the list.
Emoji on Linux
The display of emoji on Linux depends on the shell and distribution. You may need:
- Emoji keyboard
- Emoji Selector (for GNOME Shell)
- Browser extensions for Chrome , Firefox , or Opera

titre: Process customer calls in CRM
sections: Process customer calls in CRM

After every incoming and missed call from a client, Bitrix24 automatically creates a new CRM activity. The call status helps you quickly identify CRM items with a missed call. It is displayed in the Kanban and Activities views. CRM items with an incoming call don’t have a special status, but they do have an active green counter.
Missed calls
The Missed call status reminds you to follow up with the customer whose call you missed. Also, CRM items with this status will be marked with the green Inbound counter.
Counter colors

The activity of a missed call will appear in the timeline. Call the customer back right away or schedule another activity to call them later. If you call the customer back, the activity will be closed automatically.
Inbound calls
CRM items with an incoming call don’t have a status, but they’re marked with a green counter. To view all deals with incoming inquiries, click the Inbound counter.
Counters in CRM

Counters help you keep track of planned activities after a call. For example, you are out of the office, and your client calls you and requests a document. The document is on your computer, and you accept the call in the Bitrix24 mobile app. You can assure the client you will send it later, and the counter will remind you to do that.

In the CRM item timeline, you'll find an incoming call activity. Listen to a recording of the call or schedule a new activity. Click Processed or check the box when you've finished working with the call to complete the activity.
You can also complete an incoming call activity directly from the Kanban view without opening the item form.
1. Click the green counter.
2. Check the box next to the activity.
3. The counter will reset, and the activity will be marked complete.
In brief
- Bitrix24 automatically adds a new CRM activity for every incoming or missed call from clients.
- Call statuses are displayed in the Kanban and Activities views.
- CRM items with a missed call have the Missed call status and an active green counter. Those with an incoming call have no special status but an active green counter.
- You can complete an incoming call activity directly from the Kanban view without opening the item form. Just click the green counter and check the box next to the activity.

titre: Manage customer chats in CRM
sections: Manage customer chats in CRM

When you reply to customers, fast response times matter. Use customer chat statuses in CRM to prioritize incoming messages. You can see chat statuses on CRM item cards in the Activities and Kanban views.
The chat status also appears in the CRM item timeline.

Once you open the conversation, the chat is marked as read and the Unread status disappears. However, the CRM item still shows a green counter because the chat remains an inbound activity. If the customer sends another message, the status updates automatically.
Green counters show inbound activities without deadlines. They help you keep track of leads and deals while working with customers. Counters in CRM
When you close a conversation, the related activity is automatically marked as completed. The same works in reverse: if you complete the activity, the conversation closes automatically.
Completed activities change from yellow to white in the CRM item timeline.
In brief
- Use chat statuses to prioritize incoming customer messages.
- Chat statuses appear on CRM items in the Activities or Kanban view.
- When you close a customer conversation, the related activity is completed automatically, and vice versa.

titre: Connect Instagram Business account
sections: Connect Instagram Business account
Connect your Facebook Page to Bitrix24 Open Channels to receive and manage Instagram comments directly in Bitrix24.
What you can do after connecting Instagram:
- Receive Instagram comments in real time
- Automatically assign conversations based on your distribution settings
- Reply to comments from Bitrix24 Messenger
- Automatically create leads in CRM
To connect Instagram to Bitrix24, you need:
- A Facebook Page
- An Instagram Business account
Step 1. Create a Facebook Page
You need a Facebook Page before connecting Instagram.
Create a page from your Facebook profile. For instructions, see the Facebook Help Center .
Step 2. Link your Instagram account to the Facebook Page

Make sure your Instagram account is personal before linking it. During the connection process, it will be converted to a Business account automatically. If you're not sure about the type of your Instagram account, see the article How to convert personal Instagram account to Instagram Business account .
1. Open your Facebook Page.
2. Go to Settings > Instagram .
3. Click Connect Account .
4. Log in to Instagram and complete the setup.
After setup, your Instagram Business account will be linked to the Facebook Page.
Step 3. Connect the Instagram Business account to Bitrix24
1. Log in as a Facebook Page administrator.
2. Go to Contact Center .
3. Select Instagram Business .
4. Choose an Open Channel.
5. Add users to the queue.
6. Click Connect .
7. Log in to Facebook.
8. Select the Facebook Page linked to your Instagram Business account.
9. Click Connect .
Your Instagram Business account is now connected to Bitrix24.
How it works
When a customer comments on your Instagram post:
- The message appears in Bitrix24 Messenger.
- A user from the queue responds to the comment.
- The conversation is saved in CRM.
- If the customer is new, Bitrix24 automatically creates a lead.
Important notes
- Each Instagram post comment creates a separate chat and is saved in CRM.
- Comments on ads are not sent to Open Channels.
- This integration works only with post comments. To process direct messages, connect the Instagram Direct channel.
- Bitrix24 receives comments in real time.
- Only new comments are added to CRM.
- You can send up to 60 replies per hour.
- Instagram limits comments to 300 characters. Longer replies are split into several messages.
- Replies can include up to four hashtags (#). Comments with a larger number of hashtags won't appear on Instagram.
- Only one link is allowed per reply.
- Avoid writing replies in all capital letters.
- You can mention Instagram users in replies.
- Messages from Instagram Direct are not processed due to API limitations.
- You can delete messages in this Open Channel.
- Automatic actions configured for Open Channels do not apply to this channel.

titre: FAQ: AI Projects
sections: FAQ: AI Projects

We combined groups, collabs, and projects into one format: AI Projects. Your workflows stay the same. You can collaborate with your team, communicate in one place, and give access to external participants in a single workspace.
Chat is now at the center of every project. The main chat is the shared space for team coordination. Group chats inside a project help teams discuss specific topics. Projects
In this article:
- Where can we find groups and collabs
- Why Tasks and Projects was renamed to Tasks
- Why some tools are missing in new projects
- Publishing to Bitrix24 Sites in new projects
- Why a project opens in chat
- Why not all project chats appear in Messenger
- How to check for new messages in project chats
- How to set up project system notifications
- How to open a project in full-page view
- How to create multiple CoPilot chats in one project
- What access users get when you add them to a project chat
- How to invite a new member to a project
- How to add an existing group chat to a project
- How to share a project link
- Whether you can return to old groups and collabs
Where can we find groups and collabs
We combined groups, collabs, and projects into one format: AI Projects.

Before, when you created a workspace, you had to choose between a workgroup, a collab, or a project. Now all of these use cases are available in one format with the same core features. You can manage tasks, communicate with your team, and invite guests.
All data and tools from your groups, collabs, and older projects are still available.
You can find projects in these places:
- Left menu > Projects — shows all projects available to you
- Tasks > Projects — shows projects you participate in by default
- Messenger > Projects .
Why the Tasks and Projects section was renamed to Tasks
We simplified navigation so key sections are easier to reach.
The Tasks section now shows all tasks from projects, flows, and Scrums. Projects moved to a separate tab so work levels are easier to understand.
Why some tools are missing in new projects

Some tools are no longer available when you create a new project: photo gallery, wiki, knowledge base, lists. New projects include only the main tools teams use most — Tasks, Files, Calendar, Feed, Flows, and apps.

If you used the removed tools in older projects, they are still there. Open the project and click Three dots (...) . You can't create new items in these tools, but you can still view, edit, and delete existing ones.
Publishing to Bitrix24 Sites in new projects
The Publish to Bitrix24 Sites option is no longer available in new projects.
Why a project opens in chat
Chat is now the starting point for every project:
- Main chat for team coordination and status updates
- Group chats for focused discussions with selected members
- CoPilot in chat for quick status checks, risk review, and task search.
This keeps communication, tasks, meetings, and files in one place.
If your team prefers to start with the Feed or tasks, you can change the default starting tool.
1. Open the sidebar in the project's main chat. 2. Click Three dots (...) > Set default tool . 3. Select the option.
Why not all project chats appear in Messenger
Messenger shows only the main project chat.

This chat is the main entry point to the project and the place for team-wide communication. Other chats — such as task chats, meeting chats, and topic-based chats — stay inside the project. This helps preserve context and keeps your main chat list from getting crowded.
How to check for new messages in project chats
In Messenger, new project messages are marked with a red counter that shows the total number of unread messages.
Each project in the chat list can also show color counters:
- If there are new messages only in the main project chat — the counter is blue
- If there are new messages only in group chats, task chats, or meeting chats — the counter is green
- If there are messages in both — the counter is double: blue and green.
How to set up notifications for system messages in a project
You can choose which events send messages to the main project chat.
1. Open the sidebar in the project's main chat and click Three dots (...) > Edit . 2. Find the Project notifications section and toggle the events you want. 3. Click Save .
How to open a project in full-page view
By default, a project opens over the general chat list. This lets you monitor updates in other chats and quickly switch between the project and your conversations.
To open the project in a separate full-size tab, click the button in the project header.
How to create multiple CoPilot chats in one project
Yes, you can create multiple CoPilot chats in one project. Click Plus (+) above the project's chat list, next to the search bar, and select CoPilot chat .
What access users get when you add them to a project chat
If any of the people you add to a project's group chat are not yet project members, Bitrix24 will warn you that after confirming, they will get access to the entire project.
If you add someone only to a task chat within the project, they will get access to that task only, not to the entire project.
How to invite a new member to a project
You can add a member when creating a project or later in an existing one.
When creating a project.
1. Go to the Projects section and click Create . 2. In the creation form, find the Project members section and click Add . Select the users, department, or workgroup you want.
In an existing project.
1. Go to the project and open the main chat. 2. Click the button in the upper right corner, click on the Employees tab, select your colleagues. 3. Click Add .
How to add an existing group chat to a project
Only an employee who meets both conditions can add an existing chat to a project:
- Project owner or employee with permission to invite members
- Owner of the chat.
There are two ways to add a chat:
In the project . Go to the project and click Plus (+) > Move chat to project . Select the chat you want to add.
From the group chat . Open the chat, go to the sidebar, and click Three dots (...) > Add chat to project . Select the project you want to add the chat to.
Share a link to a project
Open the project's main chat and open the sidebar. Click Three dots (...) and select Copy link .
What happens next depends on the project type:
- Public project: users can open the project and join it on their own
- Private project: users will not see the project until you add them manually.
Return to old workgroups and collabs
You cannot switch back to workgroups and collabs. This format is no longer supported.
Your data and tools from workgroups, collabs, and legacy projects are still preserved and available.

titre: Create a detailed product page
sections: Create a detailed product page
The Catalog item block in Bitrix24 allows you to create detailed product pages for your online store.
Click Add block > Online store > Catalog item .
Configure the block
Click Edit on the left to adjust settings.
Here, you can adjust the following settings:
- Element ID : Select the product to display.
- Show "Add to Cart" and "Buy Now" buttons : Select the buttons to place in the block.
- "Buy" button text , "Add to Cart" button text , "Notify when back in stock" button text : If needed, enter custom text for these buttons.
- Item not available message : Specify the message for when the product is unavailable.
- Block anchor : Add anchor text for linking to the block.
Configure design and view settings
Click the Design button to adjust style and view settings.
- Product label position and Discount percent position : Specify where the product label and discount percent will be displayed.
- Product information block display order : Arrange the order of product information blocks.
Once configured, your detailed product page will be ready to use.
Select product properties to display on the detailed page

Choose which properties to show on the product page in your online store. For example, you can display details like the manufacturer, material, or delivery date. Just enter this information in the product form and enable the fields for display.
1. Find the product in the catalog.
2. Click Settings (⚙️) next to the field you want to show in your online store.
3. Select Configure .
4. Turn on the Show in online store option.
5. Save your changes.
After that, the information will appear on the detailed product page.
In brief
- The Catalog item block in Bitrix24 allows you to create detailed product pages for your online store.
- Customize settings like product selection, button text, and design elements.
- Once configured, your detailed product page will be ready to use.

titre: Fix errors when sending SMS messages
sections: Fix errors when sending SMS messages

Sometimes, SMS messages sent from Bitrix24 may fail to reach your clients. Most errors come from your SMS provider. If the issue is caused by incorrect data in a CRM item form, Bitrix24 shows an error.
Hover over Error to view the description and see what caused the issue.

Bitrix24 sends the phone number from the contact form to your SMS provider. The only error that can occur on the Bitrix24 side is Incorrect recipient . Check that the phone number has the correct number of digits and the correct country code. Then try sending the SMS again.
Errors from your SMS provider
All other errors come from your SMS provider. The most common error is Insufficient balance . Add funds to your account to continue using the service.
If no error description appears when you hover over the error, contact your SMS provider’s support team.

titre: Example of using a business process for document approval
sections: Example of using a business process for document approval
Suppose you want to upload a new version of a sample agreement to the Company Drive or Workgroup Drive. Employees will use this agreement when working with clients, suppliers, and other partners.
Because agreements and contracts contain sensitive information, you need to make sure the document structure and wording are correct before publication.

You want the Legal Department or company executives to approve the document before it becomes available in Bitrix24. The same approval process can also apply to documents that employees modify after upload.
You can create a custom business process template for document approval and configure it to match your workflow. The example below shows how the approval process works.
1. Go to Drive > Company Drive .
2. Click the gear icon.
3. Select Business Processes .
1. Click the gear icon.
2. Select Configure business processes .
3. Enable the option for business processes .
First, choose the business process type.
For document approval, use a sequential business process. This type works best for workflows with a fixed sequence of steps, for example:
Uploaded → Submitted for approval → Approved → Published
To create the process:
1. Click Create .
2. Select Create a sequential business process .
Select the autorun options for the business process:
- When added: the process starts every time a user uploads a document.
- When changed: the process starts every time a user edits an existing document.
In this example, enable both options.
After you create the template, the Business Process Editor opens.
The editor works like a flowchart builder. Drag function blocks into the workspace and configure their settings.
Start with the Approve Element block.
After you add the block, click the gear icon to open its settings.
Here you can:
- Select users who approve the document
- Require approval from all reviewers or only one reviewer
- Add text for the business process log
To insert document data, such as the author, creation date, or file name, use the three-dot button next to a field.
After the approval step, the document can follow two paths:
- Approved
- Rejected
If the document is approved, publish it in the Drive.
If the document is rejected, remove it so other employees cannot access it.
To do this, add two more function blocks:
- Publish Element
- Delete Element
These blocks perform the actions described in their names.
Click Save and return to the Company Drive.
After the upload, a spinning arrows icon appears next to the file name. This icon means the business process is running.
The approver sees a notification counter in the Automation section in the left menu.
To review the document:
1. Open the workflow.
2. Review the document details.
3. Choose one of the following actions:
1. Accept
2. Refuse
3. Delegate
The approver can also leave comments or open the document before making a decision.
If the approver clicks Accept , the document moves to the next stage and becomes published.
Each document processed through a business process has its own log.
To open the log:
1. Go to Automation > Workflows > Drive > Completed .
2. Open Details .
3. Click Business Process Log .
If the document is approved successfully, it appears in the Document Library. You can also click the spinning arrows icon next to the file name to see the Completed status.
You can improve the workflow by notifying the document author when a document is rejected.
To do this:
1. Go to Company Drive > gear icon > Business Processes .
2. Open the business process template.
3. Add the User Notification block to the rejection path.
Click the gear icon to configure the notification.
In the settings, select:
- Senders
- Recipients
- Notification text
- Notification type
For the recipient field, use the three-dot button and select the document author from the Users category. The author appears as Created by .
You can choose one of these notification types:
- Personalized notification
- System notification
Save the block settings after configuration.

Upload another document and reject it during approval. The document author receives a notification that the document was not approved. The rejected document does not appear in the Company Drive because the business process deletes it automatically.

titre: Bitrix24 Helpdesk: new interface and AI search
sections: Bitrix24 Helpdesk: new interface and AI search
Bitrix24 Helpdesk is a knowledge base that helps you use Bitrix24. Here, you can find step-by-step instructions, ask AI for help, and contact support.
In this article:
- Open Bitrix24 Helpdesk
- Search for answers with AI
- Use knowledge base articles
- Contact support
Open Bitrix24 Helpdesk

To open the knowledge base, click Helpdesk in the top-right corner of Bitrix24. By default, Helpdesk opens an article about the tool you're currently using. For example, if you're in Tasks, an article about tasks opens.

To explore articles about other tools, select the section you need from the menu on the left. The section order matches your Bitrix24 main menu and may vary from employee to employee depending on their settings and access permissions.
You can also use the breadcrumbs at the top of the page to quickly navigate to a section or a list of articles.
Search for answers with AI

AI search helps you quickly find an answer to a specific question. Ask your question in your own words, just as you would ask a coworker. There's no need to use specific wording. AI understands your question and gives you a direct answer, so you don't have to read through an entire article to find what you need.
Click the search field at the top of the page and enter your question. Press Enter or click the send button.
In the AI response, you'll see:
- A solution to your problem or an answer to your question.
- Links to related articles.
- Keyword search results showing knowledge base articles that contain the terms from your question.
AI search works like chatting with an assistant. Your conversation history is saved, so you can ask follow-up questions and continue the conversation without having to explain the situation again.
To return from the chat to the article, click the X in the top-right corner.
Use knowledge base articles
Knowledge base articles help you quickly find the information you need and share it with coworkers.

If an article is long, use the table of contents to jump to the section you need. You can find it at the beginning of the article and in the sidebar on the right. The section you're currently reading is highlighted.
To share a link to the article, click the icon in the top-right corner.
Contact support
You can contact support from any knowledge base page. Click Support in the top-right corner or in the left menu.

Before contacting support, check the status of Bitrix24. If you see a message about a widespread issue, we're already working on it. You don't need to contact support. The service should be back to normal soon. If your question is about something else, click That's not my issue .
If there are no messages about widespread issues, click Contact Support at the bottom of the page. AI support agent in Bitrix24 Support chat Contact Bitrix24 Support
In brief
- Bitrix24 Helpdesk is a knowledge base that helps you use Bitrix24. Here, you can find instructions, ask AI for help, and contact support.
- To open Bitrix24 Helpdesk, click Helpdesk in the top-right corner of Bitrix24.
- Use AI search to get direct answers to questions asked in your own words. Your conversation history is saved, so you can ask follow-up questions.
- In long articles, use the table of contents to quickly find the information you need. To share a link to an article, click the link icon in the top-right corner.
- You can contact support from any knowledge base page. Click Support in the top-right corner or in the left menu.

titre: Getting started with Bitrix24: Video tutorials for a quick start
sections: Getting started with Bitrix24: Video tutorials for a quick start
Bitrix24 is a collaborative workspace for teams: Chats, Calendar, Tasks, CRM, etc.
This article includes video tutorials to help you get started with Bitrix24:
- Personal profile
- Messenger
- Tasks
- CRM
- Email
- Calendar
- Drive
- AI assistant
Personal profile
A user profile in Bitrix24 is a personal page with contact information. For example, it helps coworkers quickly see which department a person belongs to.
Profile page
Messenger
Bitrix24 Messenger is a communication tool for your team. Employees can discuss work, share files, and create tasks and meetings from a chat.
Messenger includes public and private chats, channels, projects, chats with CoPilot, and video conferencing. You can choose the format that fits your team best.
Bitrix24 Chat: new interface and features
Tasks
Bitrix24 Tasks help you organize team work from simple to-dos to large projects. You can track progress, manage deadlines, and assign responsibility.
Tasks in Bitrix24 New task form
CRM
Bitrix24 CRM helps you manage customer relationships and move sales faster.
- Capture leads from multiple channels, including your website, email, social networks, and messengers
- Store customer data, including contacts, communication history, documents, and unlimited deals
- Automate routine work, such as creating tasks, sending emails, generating documents, and tracking deadlines
- Analyze performance with built-in reports and key metrics
CRM overview
Email
In Bitrix24, you can send and receive email through connected services like Yahoo, Gmail, and others.
Email works across different Bitrix24 tools. You can link messages to tasks, Calendar, and CRM.
Bitrix24 Mail features
Calendar
Bitrix24 Calendar helps you plan personal and company events. You can find open time slots, invite coworkers, book meeting rooms, set reminders, and follow your company schedule.
Bitrix24 Calendar: Getting started
Drive
Bitrix24 Drive lets you store company files and employees' personal documents.
With Drive, you can:
- Store call recordings, email attachments, documents, and images
- Edit documents in real time, leave comments, and view version history
- Set access permissions for files and folders
- Sync Bitrix24 Drive with your computer
Bitrix24 Drive
AI assistant in Bitrix24
The AI assistant helps you save time on everyday work. It can:
- Write texts
- Summarize conversations
- Transcribe CRM calls
- Create tasks and generate checklists in tasks
CoPilot, your personal AI assistant

titre: My plan widget features
sections: My plan widget features
The My plan widget can be accessed from any Bitrix24 page. Here, you can:
- Manage your subscription: renew, upgrade, or activate a trial.
- Check and add funds to your telephony balance.
- Learn about the new Bitrix24 features.
- Submit an implementation request and contact support.
To open the widget, click on My plan or Upgrade at the top right corner. The name of the button changes based on your current subscription.
Trial mode . Activate the free trial mode to explore Bitrix24 tools and choose a suitable plan. The widget button will turn red and display Trial the day after activation.
The widget also shows how many days you have left in your trial. Free 15-day trial
Performance upgrade . The performance of Bitrix24 depends on the data size and employee count: greater amounts of both lead to increased load. To speed up your account, upgrade to a higher plan.

Plan compatibility check . If your plan has expired or your account is incompatible with the free plan, this icon will turn red. This is to remind you to renew or change your plan. Plan compatibility check

Orders and invoices . This section leads you to your purchase history, where you can upgrade or renew your subscription. If there is an unpaid order, a red counter appears. Once you pay or cancel it, the counter resets. After paying, you can view your purchase documents. Invoices and payment confirmations
Telephony . From the widget, you can go to the Telephony section to connect a number or top up your balance.
What's new . Find out about the latest Bitrix24 updates here.
Implementation request . If you need help setting up Bitrix24, our partners can assist with CRM sales automation, workflow setup, and employee training. Submit your Bitrix24 implementation request
Support . If you have any questions about Bitrix24, message our support chat for help. This is available to account administrators and invited Bitrix24 partners. How to activate Bitrix24 Support

titre: Bitrix24 interface overview
sections: Bitrix24 interface overview

Bitrix24 is a collaborative workspace for your team. It’s not just a set of tools but a unified interface with seamlessly integrated features like chats, calendars, tasks, CRM, and more. The intuitive navigation helps you quickly find the necessary sections, while smart counters ensure you stay updated on new events.
- Start page — opens when you log in to Bitrix24.
- Main menu — access to all sections.
- Toolbar — settings for the current section and your profile.
- Sidebar — quick access to chats and notifications.
- Notification counters — help you stay on top of important events.
Start page

When you log in to Bitrix24, the start page opens first. What you see depends on the primary tool selected for your company. For example, if it’s CRM, you’ll land in the Deals section, and if it’s Collaboration, you’ll see the Messenger.
Each employee can choose their primary tool, which will open first, while the menu will only display the necessary sections.
Main menu

The left menu contains the main tools and sections of Bitrix24: Messenger, Feed, Drive, Tasks, CRM, Webmail, and more. You can customize the menu to suit your needs: hide unnecessary items, change their order, or add a link to any Bitrix24 tool or site.
Click Settings at the bottom of the main menu. Left menu in Bitrix24 Main features of Bitrix24

Messenger . Chats with colleagues, group discussions, video calls, and channels. You can quickly discuss work matters, share files, create tasks, and schedule meetings directly from the chat. Bitrix24 Chat: new interface and features
Feed . It is your company social network. Share news, express gratitude, create polls, or launch workflows like access requests, vacation approvals, business trips, and more. Feed in Bitrix24
Tasks and Projects . View tasks, assign them to colleagues, and track progress. Working with tasks

CRM . It is a tool for managing customer relationships. It stores contacts, deals, communication history, and purchase records. It helps you stay connected with customers and boost sales. CRM overview
Toolbar
It is located at the top of the screen.
Current section . You can quickly switch to the desired tab. Customize the menu to hide unnecessary items or change their order.
Click More > Configure menu.
Search bar. Click the magnifying glass, enter keywords to find an employee, a document, or a deal. Search in Bitrix24 account
Company logo or name can be changed by employees with admin rights. Change Bitrix24 name and logo
Bitrix24 settings . The widget is available to employees with admin rights. Bitrix24 Settings: New single section
Invite new employees to Bitrix24. Any user can do this, but admins can restrict this option if needed. Invite new users to Bitrix24
Helpdesk . It is a section with a knowledge base about Bitrix24. It contains answers to many questions about tools and settings.
Click Helpdesk to open an article about the tool you are currently using. How to use the Bitrix24 Knowledge Base

Employee widget . It is a menu for managing your account. Quickly access important data and settings: start your workday, change your password, check remaining vacation days, send electronic HR documents, and more.
To open the widget, click your photo in the top right corner. Employee widget: New interface and features
Sidebar
The sidebar provides quick access to notifications and chats.
1. Click any icon to open it.
2. To collapse, click the cross in the top left corner of the slider.
Notifications . It is a list of new events like comments, meetings, task updates, and more. Notification settings in Bitrix24

CoPilot . This is an AI assistant to help with daily tasks: writing campaign texts, suggesting video ideas, creating slogans, and more. The CoPilot chat is available in the general chat list and on a separate tab. Chat with CoPilot
Contact Center . A list of active conversations with customers from various sources like online chat, social media, and more. Conversations: How to find Open Channel chats

Chat bar . A list of your chats. Scroll to the end to see all conversations. Pinned chats are always at the top and highlighted in gray. Click the icon of the desired chat to expand the slider and open the conversation. Chats in Bitrix24: Design and features
Notification counters
Counters are numbers on a red or green background. They indicate what requires your attention, such as new messages, tasks, or comments.
How to work with notifications:
- Click the bell in the sidebar to view the list of new events.
- Click a counter in the main menu or toolbar to open the section with the new event.
- Click a counter in the workspace to open a specific item: a chat, a task, or a deal.
In brief
- Bitrix24 is a collaborative workspace with all the necessary tools: chats, CRM, tasks, and more.
- When you log in to Bitrix24, the start page opens. What you see depends on the primary tool selected for your company: CRM, Tasks and projects, Collaboration, Sites.

- The left menu contains the primary tools and sections of Bitrix24: Messenger, Feed, Drive, CRM, etc. The account administrator can customize the main menu for the entire company, while each employee can adjust it for themselves.
- The toolbar at the top of the screen allows you to customize the current section, access the Bitrix24 knowledge base, invite new users, and more.
- The sidebar on the right provides quick access to notifications and chats.
- Notification counters are highlighted in red and green. They indicate what requires your attention.

titre: Getting started with Bitrix24
sections: Getting started with Bitrix24
Bitrix24 is an online service that offers useful tools for your company. This includes chats and calls, tasks and projects, CRM, and AI-powered assistant. Main features of Bitrix24
Follow the steps below to set up your Bitrix24 before you get to work.
Sign up for Bitrix24
Go to the Bitrix24 website and click Start for free . Create Bitrix24
Enter your email or use your social network accounts to sign up. Then, click Continue . Register a Bitrix24 account
You can't create more than seven accounts in one Bitrix24 Network profile. But there's no limit on how many accounts you can join by invitation. Bitrix24 Network profile
After creating an account, you'll get an email. Follow the link from that email to confirm your email address and set up a password.
Invite employees
To organize the teamwork within a company, invite employees to Bitrix24. There are several ways to do that:
- Invite via link : Copy the link and send it to your colleagues. When the person follows the link, they can sign in.
- Invite via email : Register a new user by email.
- Invite via phone number : Register a new user by phone number.
- Bulk invitation : Choose this option to invite many employees at once.
- Invite to department or workgroup : Use this option after creating departments and workgroups in Bitrix24.
- Add new user : Enter the employee's details and add them to your Bitrix24 yourself.
Invite new users to Bitrix24
Install Bitrix24 apps

Bitrix24 Messenger . The desktop app has some extra features you won't find on the web. These include audio and video call recording. You can also change your video call background and use a 3D avatar. Plus, it lets you sync Bitrix24 Drive with your computer. Download and install Bitrix24 Messenger on macOS and Windows
Mobile app . Stay in touch with colleagues and customers. Communicate via chats, make calls, set tasks, and work in CRM. Download and install Bitrix24 mobile app
Choose your main tools
Select the most-used Bitrix24 tools. To discuss work issues in chats and schedule meetings in the calendar, select Collaboration and confirm.
The selected tool will appear at the top of the main menu for easy access. Main menu in Bitrix24
Adjust account settings
All Bitrix24 settings are in one place, and you can access them via the intuitive widget. To open the settings, click the toggles icon next to your company name and select Settings .
Here, you can do the following:
- Enable the tools that employees need for work
- Set up work schedules for your company and departments
- Create a landing page with your company details
- Track the login history of employees and allow them to work in your Bitrix24 only from certain IP addresses
Fill out your profile

Each Bitrix24 user has a page with their personal details. To help your colleagues get to know you better, add a photo to your profile, provide contact information, and share your hobbies. Profile page
Customize your workspace
To make your account reflect your brand, set the background, specify your company name, and change your Bitrix24 URL. Click the toggles icon at the top menu and select My Bitrix24 .
Name . Specify the name of your company or add a logo. Change Bitrix24 name and logo

Bitrix24 address . When you create your Bitrix24 account, it is assigned an address, for example, b24-aokwy2.bitrix24.com. Such an address is hard to remember and pronounce, so it's better to change it. You can specify your company name in your Bitrix24 address or use your own domain name. Change Bitrix24 address and connect your domain
Default theme . You can set the same design theme for all employees of your company. Select a ready-made theme or add your own image. Set account theme for all users
Organize your company structure

The company structure is a chart showing your company's departments, employees, and supervisors. Access permissions to some Bitrix24 tools depend on the company structure. For example, supervisors can see their subordinates' work reports and tasks, while regular users can see only their own. Company structure: New interface and features Company structure and Bitrix24 tools connection
Choose a plan
In the Bitrix24 lineup, there are five main plans:
- Free
- Basic
- Standard
- Professional
- Enterprise
Select a subscription plan according to your company's size and needs. Bitrix24 plans and pricing Bitrix24 Cloud plans
Try the free 15-day trial to explore more features and find the right plan. Free 15-day trial

- Collaboration

Feed in Bitrix24 My calendar Bitrix24 Drive

Tasks in Bitrix24 Bitrix24 Flows: Get started

titre: Left menu in Bitrix24
sections: Left menu in Bitrix24
The left menu is where you access the main Bitrix24 tools. You can customize it to match your workflow. Only an administrator can apply menu settings for all employees.
What you can do
- Reorder menu items
- Add a custom link
- Set a primary tool
- Reset the menu
What administrators can do
- Apply menu settings for all users
- Hide tools
By default, the menu is collapsed. To expand it, click the icon next to the Bitrix24 logo or your company name. Then go to Settings > Left menu > Configure menu items .
Then click Settings > Left menu > Configure menu items .
Change the sorting . Click on the menu item and hold it down to move it to the new location.
You can hide tools you don’t use:
1. Click the settings icon next to the item.
2. Select Hide menu item .
3. Save your changes.
The item moves to the Hidden section.
To add it back, click the icon next to the tool name.
To see available actions for an item, click the pencil icon.
Add a link . You can add a link to any Bitrix24 tool to have quick access to it.
1. Go to Settings > Left menu > Add custom menu item .
2. Enter a name and paste the link.
3. Save your changes.
Change the primary tool . The order of menu items depends on the primary Bitrix24 tool. The Collaboration section is selected as primary tool by default.
To change the primary tool:
1. Open the left menu settings.
2. Select Change primary tool .
3. Choose a tool and click Confirm .
Reset menu . You can reset the menu to default. The sort order and custom menu items will be deleted.
1. Open menu settings.
2. Go to Left menu > Reset menu .
Set menu for everyone . The account administrator can choose whether to set the menu for all users or for new ones.
If the administrator added his/her own items to the menu, they will also appear in the menu of other employees. Tools that users have added on their own will remain in their menu.
1. Open the menu settings.
2. Select Set my menu for everyone .
3. Set the menu for all users or for new users only .
Hide tools .The administrator can hide tools that are not used in the company. Hidden sections and tools will be completely disabled in your Bitrix24.
Configure sections in the Bitrix24 main menu
In brief:
- The left menu is a panel where the main tools of Bitrix24 are located. Each user can customize it. Only the administrator can configure the menu for all employees.
- You can add a link to any Bitrix24 tool to have quick access to it.

- The order of menu items depends on the primary Bitrix24 tool. The Collaboration section is selected as primary tool by default. You can change it in the menu settings. The selected section will be located at the top.
- If you want to reset the menu, click Settings > Left menu > Reset menu . The sorting will be changed, added items and links will be removed.
- Bitrix24 administrator can set the menu to all employees or hide tools that are not used in your company.

titre: Migration to Bitrix24
sections: Migration to Bitrix24

Bitrix24 Market includes ready-made migration apps that can move your existing database to CRM without manual data entry. By default, only administrators can install apps. An administrator can also give this permission to other employees.
There are two ways to open the migration apps section:
1. On the Bitrix24 website .
2. In Bitrix24 account
1. Go to the Market section. 2. Click Catalog . 3. Select Import and export . 4. Open Migration to Bitrix24 . 5. Choose an app from the list. 6. Click Install .

By default, only administrators can install apps from the Market. Regular users can browse apps and read their descriptions. Administrators can adjust permissions to allow any user to install apps. Here's how:
1. Go to Bitrix24 settings .
2. Open the Other settings tab.
3. Expand the Miscellaneous section.
4. Enable the All employees can install apps from Market option.
5. Save the changes.
Bitrix24 Settings: New single section
Migration apps are especially helpful for new users. They let you keep your customer base intact while making the most of Bitrix24 CRM features.
In brief
1. Bitrix24 Market includes ready-made apps for database migration.
2. You can find migration apps in two places: on the Bitrix24 website and in the Market section inside your Bitrix24 account.
3. By default, only administrators can install apps.

titre: Request assistance from Bitrix24 Partner
sections: Request assistance from Bitrix24 Partner

Bitrix24 is an online platform providing various tools for your entire team. You can customize it to fit your company’s needs, but this may take time and specific skills. To make things easier, contact Bitrix24 partners. They’ll help you choose the best plan and set up the tools you need.
Implementing Bitrix24 involves several steps:
- Analysis: The partner reviews your company’s structure, assesses each department's needs, and creates a technical plan.
- Setup: The partner configures workflows and integrates external solutions.
- Training: The partner prepares materials and teaches your employees how to use Bitrix24.
- Support: The partner monitors how Bitrix24 is being used and provides ongoing assistance.

Bitrix24 itself doesn’t provide implementation services. Certified Bitrix24 partners take care of all customizations and adjustments. Read more information in the guide created in collaboration with Bitrix24 Partners: How to Work with a Bitrix24 Partner
Choose a Bitrix24 partner
Partners are certified companies with experience in implementing Bitrix24. They complete training courses and work with businesses in different industries.
Here’s how Bitrix24 partners can assist you:
- Help you choose the best Bitrix24 plan for your needs.
- Explain how the tools work.
- Train your team.
- Provide consultations in a format that suits you.
You can find a partner on the Bitrix24 website in two ways.

Select a partner from our directory. Go to the Partner Directory page and filter partners by specialization, Bitrix24 version, and location. You can contact them directly or request a price estimate for your implementation project.
Submit a request. Go to the Request implementation page, click Get a price estimate , and fill out the form. We will suggest several partners. After talking to them, you can select one to work with.
If you have any questions about Bitrix24 partners, email us at partners@bitrix24.com .
In brief
- Bitrix24 partners are certified companies that help quickly set up Bitrix24 tools.
- Bitrix24 itself doesn’t provide implementation services. Certified Bitrix24 partners take care of all customizations and adjustments.
- You can choose a partner on the Bitrix24 website: either from the list or by submitting a request.

titre: Bitrix24 Mobile app
sections: Bitrix24 Mobile app
We have updated the Bitrix24 mobile app. Now it works faster and has a new interface. You can customize the menu, notifications, and theme to work in a way that suits your workflow.
The mobile app can be used anywhere — in the office, during meetings, etc. Everything you need is at your fingertips:
- Messenger and calls
- Tasks and CRM
- Webmail, calendar, and files
- Documents, workflows, e-Signature for HR
- Bitrix CoPilot to help you complete tasks faster
Installing the mobile app
The Bitrix24 mobile app is free and available on the App Store, Google Play, Huawei AppGallery. Download the mobile app
Keep your smartphone’s OS and the Bitrix24 app updated for stability and security.
The Bitrix24 mobile app is not currently available in China. You can try changing the region on your phone or account to download and install the app.
Customizing the mobile app

All additional tools are now grouped in a menu that opens when you tap your photo at the bottom of the screen. Here, you can manage work hours, access your profile, documents, settings, and quickly switch to another account.
This makes work easier: fewer clicks and searches — essential tools are immediately available. Tap Menu > Settings .
Main settings . Here, you can configure the Bitrix24 mobile app: change the theme, customize chats, sync contacts and calendars, and select the app language.
Bottom navigation. Customize the bottom menu to put your most-used tools front and center.
You can choose a preset menu or create your own. For example, if you frequently discuss work in chats and follow updates in the Feed, select the Collaboration menu.
To create your own menu, tap Edit . Choose which tools to hide or add to the bottom menu. Save your changes.

Notifications. Customize which notifications you want to receive in the mobile app. For example, enable Smart Mode to avoid receiving notifications on your phone while working on Bitrix24 from your computer.
You can also set notifications for specific tools. For instance, enable event reminders in the calendar.
Switch accounts. If you work in multiple Bitrix24 accounts, you can quickly switch between them.
In the Switch account section, you can:
- Switch to another Bitrix24. Tap Switch .
- Create or add a new Bitrix24. Tap Three dots (...) > Add Bitrix24 .
- Log out of Bitrix24. Tap Three dots (...) > Log out .
Log in from a computer. You can quickly switch from the mobile version to Bitrix24 on your computer. No need to manually enter your login and password—authorization happens instantly.
Tap Log in from a computer and scan the QR code.
In brief
- We have updated the Bitrix24 mobile app. Now it works faster and has a new interface.
- The Bitrix24 mobile app is free and available on the App Store, Google Play, Huawei AppGallery.
- Additional tools are grouped in a menu that opens when you tap your photo at the bottom of the screen.
- In the app, you can manage work hours, check-in, access your profile, documents, settings, and quickly switch to another account.

titre: New Bitrix24 Space+ interface
sections: New Bitrix24 Space+ interface
We've completely redesigned the Bitrix24 interface to make it lighter, clearer, and easier to use. Here’s what’s new:
- Collaborative workspace. Tasks, chats, calls, calendars, and other tools are now seamlessly connected. No need to switch between multiple apps—everything you need is in one place.
- Messenger at the center of your processes. Your journey with Bitrix24 now starts with chat, making it simple and accessible for everyone.
- Focus and clarity. Counters and notifications keep you updated on new events. The minimalist design and intuitive navigation ensure all tools are easy to find.
- Customizable interface. Personalize the account to match your business needs and user preferences. Add your company name or logo and adjust the side and top menus.
- Improved Bitrix24 Messenger. Whether you’re using the app or browser, enjoy a familiar and user-friendly interface.
Collaborative workspace

Bitrix24 is an all-in-one platform where all tools work together as one system. No need to install or set up multiple apps—Bitrix24 has everything you need: chats, tasks, calendars, documents, and more.

In the calendar, you can schedule a meeting and start a video call, then jump into a chat and create a task. From the task, you can schedule a meeting for everyone involved or call them directly. Switching between tools is smooth and effortless, with no extra clicks or windows. This helps teams save time and stay productive on any device, from anywhere.
Messenger at the center of processes
For companies that rely on collaboration, the messenger becomes the central section. Bitrix24 M1 chat
When users log into Bitrix24, they get in chats to start communicating with colleagues and dive into tasks right away. New users can get started without needing to learn the entire interface.
From the chat, you can start a video call, create a task, or schedule a calendar event. All tools are connected, making it easy for new employees to adapt and for teams to stay productive.
Focus and clarity
Stay focused on your work without missing anything important.
- The main menu on the left gives you access to all sections, like Collaboration, Tasks and Projects, CRM, Calendar, and more.
- The toolbar at the top keeps all tools, filters, and settings for the current section right in front of you, so you don't need to switch between windows.
- Counters in the side menu, toolbar, and workspace show what needs your attention and help you stay on top of your tasks and events.
Customizable interface
Adjust the Bitrix24 interface to fit your business needs and user preferences.
For administrators:
- Set a corporate style: Add your company name or logo and choose a unified background.
- Configure the main menu: Keep only the tools your team uses and hide the rest.
For regular employees:
- Customize the background: Choose from the available themes or upload your own.
- Adjust the main menu and toolbar: Rearrange sections or hide items you don’t use.
Bitrix24 Settings: New single section Change Bitrix24 name and logo Set account theme for all users
Updated Bitrix24 Messenger app

The new Bitrix24 Space+ interface looks and works the same across the browser and the apps for Windows, macOS, and Linux. You can easily switch between devices, and all your settings and data will be saved.
All your favorite tools are still here, and you can open them in different tabs and quickly switch between tasks.
In brief
- We've completely redesigned the Bitrix24 interface to make it lighter, clearer, and easier to use.
- Bitrix24 is a collaborative workspace. Tasks, chats, calls, calendars, and other tools are now seamlessly connected. No need to switch between multiple apps—everything you need is in one place.
- For companies that rely on collaboration, the messenger becomes the central section. New employees can start communicating with colleagues and adapt to workflows right away.
- Focus on what matters. Essential tools are always accessible in the left and top menus. Counters notify you of new events.

- Customize the Bitrix24 interface to fit your business needs and employee preferences. Set the corporate style and keep only the needed tools in the menu. Employees can choose a background and adjust the main menu to their liking.
- Easily switch between devices. The Bitrix24 Messenger interface looks the same across the browser and apps.

titre: Transfer data between different accounts
sections: Transfer data between different accounts
You can transfer data between different Bitrix24 accounts. This may be helpful if you want to move your client base and settings to another account.
Export and import data
To transfer data, you need to export it from your old account, then upload it to the new one. The file format may vary, and in some cases, you’ll need to convert the files before importing.
How to convert a file from XLS to CSV
- Open your Excel file, click File , select Save as , then choose CSV .
- Alternatively, use any online file converter.
Learn how to save an Excel file in a different format
Transfer CRM data
CRM stores customer information, reports, system, and user settings. CRM items, products, reports, and settings can all be moved to another Bitrix24 account.
CRM items
Leads, deals, contacts, and companies are transferred using CSV import and export.
To export CRM data:
1. Go to CRM and select the needed tab.
2. Switch to the List view (in leads or deals).
3. Click Settings (⚙️) and select Export to CSV .
To import CRM data:
1. Go to CRM and select the needed tab.
2. Click Settings (⚙️) and select Import .
Export CRM data Import contact and company details Import to Bitrix24 CRM
Products
The product catalog can also be moved to another account. Data is exported as an XLS file, which you’ll need to convert to CSV before importing.
To export data:
1. Go to CRM > Inventory > Product catalog .
2. Click Settings (⚙️) and select Excel .
To import data:
1. Go to CRM > Inventory > Product catalog .
2. Click Settings (⚙️) and select Import products .
Product import
CRM reports
You can transfer CRM reports between accounts by exporting and importing CSV files.
To export data:
1. Go to CRM > Analytics > Real-time analytics > Reports .
2. Under the actions menu, select Export .
To import data:
1. Go to CRM > Analytics > Real-time analytics > Reports .
2. Click Import and upload your file.
CRM settings
Custom fields, stages, pipelines, CRM form settings, automation rules, workflows, and applications can all be migrated. These settings are exported and imported as a folder with JSON files.
Note: Leads and deals are deleted from CRM after importing settings. Export them before you start the solution preset import.
To export data:
1. Go to CRM .
2. Click Settings (⚙️) and select Solution presets .
3. Click Export and download a file.
To import data:
1. Go to CRM .
2. Click Settings (⚙️) and select Solution presets .
3. Click Migrate and upload your file.
Transfer CRM settings to another account
Transfer tasks
You can transfer tasks to another account. Note that only task fields are exported—comments are not included.
Tasks
Task data is exported as an XLS file, which you’ll need to convert to CSV before importing.
To export data:
1. Go to Tasks and Projects > Tasks .
2. Click Settings (⚙️) and select Export list .
To import data:
1. Go to Tasks and Projects > Tasks .
2. Click Settings (⚙️) and select Import list .
Export tasks Import tasks
Task reports
Task reports are transferred using CSV files for both export and import.
To export data:
1. Go to Tasks and Projects > Reports .
2. Under the actions menu, select Export .
To import data:
1. Go to Tasks and Projects > Reports .
2. Click the Import button and upload your file.
Transfer knowledge bases, sites, and online stores
Knowledge bases, sites, and online stores are exported and imported as folders with JSON files.
To export data:
1. Go to Sites and stores or Knowledge bases .
2. Under the actions menu, select Export .
To import data:
1. Go to Sites and stores or Knowledge bases .
2. Click Settings (⚙️) and select Import .
Transfer knowledge bases Transfer sites Transfer online stores
Transfer workflows
You can transfer business process templates. The data is exported and imported in BPT format.
To export data:
1. Go to the Automation section.
2. Under the Workflows tab, select Workflows in Feed , Workflows in CRM , or Workflows on Company drive .
3. Open the needed business process template in edit mode.
4. Click Export .
To import data:
1. Go to the Automation section.
