titre: Difference between Cloud and On-Premise versions
sections: Difference between Cloud and On-Premise versions

Bitrix24 comes in two versions: Cloud and On-premise. The Cloud version allows you to start working immediately, while the On-premise version needs to be installed on your company's servers. Each version has its own unique features and limitations.
Bitrix24 Cloud version
The Cloud version doesn't need to be installed on your servers. Start using Bitrix24 right after you sign up and create an account. Choose the tools for your team and invite colleagues.
No complex setup required . You can set up Bitrix24 on your own by creating sales pipelines in CRM and handling site requests. No programming skills are needed to create a site in Bitrix24.

Accessible worldwide . All you need is internet connection. For the best performance, use browsers like Chrome, Firefox, and Safari (released within the past year). The mobile version of Safari needs versions 15.4 and later.
Scalable to fit any business size . As your team grows, add new employees and select an appropriate plan to continue working without extra setup.
Automatic updates . There's no need to track or manage version updates. Bitrix24 accounts automatically receive updates and new tools.
Data security . Your data is stored in secure data centers, ensuring a high level of protection.
Bitrix24 On-premise version
The On-premise version requires a license. It needs to be installed on your server, keeping your data in-house. You can configure the system through the control panel.
Confidentiality . Take full control of the system: set user and group access permissions, encrypt your data, and manage backups.

Customization flexibility . With open-source code, you can adjust Bitrix24 to your needs, like modifying the interface. Apply the changes using modules or through PHP and JavaScript — no extra apps needed.
Integration . Easily integrate with internal company systems, third-party products, and modules. It also supports AD/LDAP integration.
Comparison of Cloud and On-premise versions
Bitrix24 Cloud | Bitrix24 On-premise
Renewal terms | Subscription options for 1 or 12 months | Subscription license with renewal
Free version | The Free plan is available with no time limits but limited features | Free 30-day trial version

Number of users | Free plan: unlimited users. Commercial plans: range from 5 to 10,000 users, depending on the plan. | Business edition: for 50, 100, 250, or 500 users. Enterprise edition: expandable for every 1,000 users.
Installation | No installation required; use Bitrix24 directly in a browser | Requires installation on a server
Bitrix24 Support | Available with commercial plans | Available
Data storage | Depends on your plan | Unlimited, depending on the server capacity
Custom logo and domain name | Depends on your plan | No limits
Code and API | REST API | REST API, Bitrix API, D7 API
Access permissions | Depends on your plan | Flexible user settings
Security | SSL, WAF | Customizable security; full back-end access
Multiple divisions | Branch network available with the Enterprise plan | Available in the Enterprise edition
How to choose the right version

Bitrix24 Cloud version is ideal for companies that prioritize easy setup and low IT costs, such as startups and small businesses that need to get started quickly. A subscription is required to renew the plan.

Bitrix24 On-premise version is best for large companies that need a secure environment for data storage and integration with internal systems. This version requires costs for equipment, license purchase, and IT support.
The cost of the Cloud version depends on the tools you choose — the more tools, the higher the price. For the On-premise version, the price is based on the number of users.
If you have any questions, you can contact our partners. Bitrix24 Partners
In brief
- Bitrix24 comes in two versions: Cloud and On-premise. The Cloud version allows you to start working immediately, while the On-premise version needs to be installed on your company's servers.
- With the Cloud version, you can work from anywhere, set it up yourself, and your data is stored in secure data centers.
- With the On-premise version, you manage and configure it through the control panel, and your data is stored on your company's servers.
- Bitrix24 Cloud version is ideal for companies that prioritize easy setup and low IT costs. A subscription is required to renew the plan.
- Bitrix24 On-premise version is best for large companies that need a closed environment. A license must be purchased and renewed annually to receive updates and technical support.
- The cost of the Cloud version depends on the tools you choose — the more tools, the higher the price. For the On-premise version, the price is based on the number of users.

- How it works
How to create an appreciation post
Go to Feed > More > Appreciation .
Enter your message . Describe why the employee is being recognized.
1. Create a title.
2. Enter the text. Type it manually or use CoPilot. Format it with the visual editor or BBCode for text styling.
3. Select the employees who will see the post.
Add messages to Feed
Select a badge . It will appear in the post and be saved on the profiles of the employees you’re recognizing.

titre: Create an announcement in Feed
sections: Create an announcement in Feed

An announcement is a special type of Feed post that helps you share information with employees and track who has confirmed reading it. For example, if your company updates a work policy, you may need all employees to read the new rules and confirm they've read them.
Check whether this feature is available on your plan. Pricing
Write a post

1–3. Go to the Feed section and tap More > Announcement . 4. Enter a title and write your message so employees can quickly understand what the announcement is about. 5. If needed, attach additional materials, add a tag, or mention an employee. Add messages to Feed

Date | Select a date or date range to find posts created on a specific date or during a specific period.
Type | Filter messages by type: posts, announcements, appreciations, or polls.
To | Select a user to filter messages by recipient.
Favorites | Find all posts you added to favorites.
Tag | Enter a tag added to messages.
Extranet | Choose whether to show messages addressed to external users.
Create custom filters
In addition to standard filters, you can create a custom filter with your own settings.
1. Set field values on the right.
2. Click + Save Filter under the list of filters.
3. Enter the filter name on the left.
4. Click Save at the bottom of the section.
To manage filters, click the gear (⚙️) under the filter list. Then, pin, edit, or delete filters using the corresponding buttons.
You can always use Reset to default to restore the default filter settings.
Account administrators can save configured filters for all account users. To do this, turn on Apply for all users .
In brief
The Search and filter section in Feed helps you find the messages you need. You can:
- Search Feed by keyword.
- Apply standard filters on the left.
- Enter values in the fields on the right.
- Create a custom filter with your own settings.

titre: Send a Feed message to an external user
sections: Send a Feed message to an external user

In the Bitrix24 Feed, you can share news not only with employees but also with external participants like customers, partners, freelancers, and others. This is convenient when you need to share important information, such as details about an event or a new project.
External users will receive the message via email and can participate in the discussion. Their comments will appear in the Feed, just like regular communication with employees.
Create a message
1. Go to the Feed section and create a message.
2. In the "To" field, click Add more > Invite guest .
3. Enter the external user's email, first name, and last name. You can add multiple guests.
4. Click Invite . The external user will be added to the recipient list.
5. Click Send .
Once the message is sent, the external user will receive it via email.
How external users see the message
The external user will receive an email with the message from the Feed. The email will include:
- The subject and text of the message
- Attachments
- The option to leave a comment and react with a Like
When the external user leaves a comment, you will receive a notification in Bitrix24. If employees comment on the message, the external user will receive an email notification.
In brief
- You can share news in the Bitrix24 Feed not only with employees but also with external participants like customers, partners, freelancers, and others.
- Create a new message in the Feed. In the "To" field, click Add more > Invite guest . Enter the guest's email, first name, and last name. You can invite multiple people.
- Invited guests are not added to the company employee list and do not gain access to Bitrix24.
- The external user will receive an email with the message, can react to it, and leave a comment.
- When the external user comments on the message, you will receive a notification in Bitrix24.

titre: Convert a Feed post into a task
sections: Convert a Feed post into a task
Feed is a great place to discuss ideas with your team. You can turn any Feed post into a task.
1. Open the Feed post.
2. Click More and select Create task .
The task form opens in a side panel. The post content is added to the task automatically.
3. Assign a responsible person and configure the task settings. 4. Click Add task .
A comment with a link to the new task appears under the Feed post. Task participants also get a notification that the task was created.
To open the task, click View in the notification in the top-right corner.
You can also convert a comment into a task the same way.

titre: Create events in Feed
sections: Create events in Feed
Use Feed events to involve specific employees in planning important company events.
To create an event:
1. Go to Feed .
2. In the top menu, click Event .
Enter the event details:
- Date
- Start and end time
- Location
- Participants
You can also open the More section to add:
- A description
- Event color
- Availability status
- Reminders
When you're done, click Save .
The event will appear in Feed and in the Upcoming events widget on the right side of the page.
To edit the event, click its name in Feed or open it in the Calendar section.

titre: How an external user can add a post to Feed
sections: How an external user can add a post to Feed
External users can post messages to your Feed in Bitrix24 by email.
1. Click on your photo in the top right corner.
2. Open your profile page, click the Security button > Forwarding addresses tab.
3. Copy the address in the To create Feed posts field and send it to an external user.
How it works
The external user sends an email to this address. They can include attachments up to 14 MB. Once sent, the message appears in your Feed as a post.
The post is created on your behalf. You can invite other employees to view and discuss it.
External users can also create tasks in your Bitrix24 account. Create a task for an external user

titre: Virtual presence indicator
sections: Virtual presence indicator

Remote work makes it important to stay connected with your team. Company pulse shows how many coworkers are online at any moment. Supervisors can use it to monitor employee availability and support a structured workday.
You can find this tool in the upper-right corner of the Feed section.
- The circle shows how many employees are currently online.
- Click Clocked in to see who has started their workday.
- Click Clocked out to see who has finished work.
Extranet employees do not appear in the widget.

titre: CoPilot in Feed
sections: CoPilot in Feed
CoPilot is your AI assistant in Feed. It helps you create posts and write comments faster. Enter a short prompt, and CoPilot generates text in one click.
Without CoPilot, you need to:
- Spend time writing posts manually
- Review text for spelling and grammar mistakes
CoPilot helps you:
- Create Feed posts
- Read posts and suggest comments
You can start CoPilot in three ways:
- Open the text field and press the space bar
- Click CoPilot in a message
- Select text and click the pop-up CoPilot button
Create posts with CoPilot
Bitrix24 includes ready-made prompts to help you work faster.
Analyze text
CoPilot can summarize posts and keep the key points. You can:
- Shorten text
- Highlight the main idea
- Add a title and conclusion
- Show pros and cons
Modify text
After CoPilot generates text, you can continue editing it. For example, you can:
- Make text shorter or more detailed
- Check spelling and punctuation
- Generate ideas
- Translate text into another language
Change the tone
CoPilot can rewrite text in a more polite or formal style.
Create text
Enter a few details, and CoPilot can generate:
- News posts
- Greeting messages
- Press releases
- Job descriptions with responsibilities and requirements
Some of these prompts are also available when you add comments to Feed posts.
Add comments with CoPilot
Use CoPilot to quickly improve comments in Feed.
CoPilot can:
- Compliment or criticize the author
- Agree or disagree with an opinion
- Thank colleagues
- Confirm that you are working on a request
Use CoPilot to work with information
CoPilot helps you quickly understand long posts.
Available pre-prompts:
- Explain it
- Summarize text
- Highlight the pros and cons
To use them:
1. Open a Feed post.
2. Click CoPilot under the post.
3. Select a prompt.
Explain it
Use this prompt to clarify unfamiliar words and complex terms. CoPilot can simplify text and keep the important details.
Summarize text
Feed posts can be long. Use this prompt to extract the main points without losing important information.
Highlight the pros and cons
CoPilot analyzes the text and lists positive and negative points mentioned by the author.
CoPilot responses are not published automatically. You can copy them and add them as comments.
Important things to know about AI
CoPilot is trained on a large database of texts, but it is not a search engine.
For example, it cannot answer questions like “What is the weather now?” However, it can generate clear text in a specific tone based on the information you provide.
FAQ: CoPilot
To get better results, clearly describe what you want in your prompt. The more details you provide, the more accurate the result will be.
Example
Manager’s message:
Example prompt 1:
This prompt generates only basic event information.
Example prompt 2:
This prompt generates a more detailed and informative post because it includes additional instructions.
Be as specific as possible to get better results.
In brief
- CoPilot is an AI assistant available in Feed.
- It helps create posts and comments.
- Enter a few details, and CoPilot generates text for you.
- CoPilot can analyze Feed posts and suggest comments.
- Clear prompts help CoPilot generate more accurate results.

titre: Smart follow mode
sections: Smart follow mode
Smart Follow mode helps you stay focused when you work with many tasks and projects. It limits the number of Feed updates so you only see what matters to you.
Turn Smart follow mode on or off
1. Open Feed .
2. Click the Settings (gear) icon.
3. Select Smart follow mode .
How it works
When Smart follow mode is on, the Feed highlights only the conversations that involve you. A message appears at the top of your Feed when:
- You created the message
- You commented on it
- You were added as a recipient
- Someone mentioned you in a message or comment
By default, you follow all Feed posts. To stop following a conversation, click Unfollow . New comments in that thread will no longer move it to the top of your Feed.

titre: Feed in Bitrix24
sections: Feed in Bitrix24
Feed is a place for the sharing of information and internal communication in your company. It includes:
- Posts from employees
- Updates from workgroups and projects you’re part of
- Upcoming events
- Work reports
- Active workflows
Feed keeps everyone informed about their activities, like messages, comments, files, task notifications, and more. Learn more about each type below.

Messages. This is the most common way to communicate in the Feed. You can write a text or record a video. Choose who should receive your message: everyone, a group, or a specific person. Record video in Feed Add messages to Feed

Tasks. Create tasks for yourself and your team directly from the Feed. For example, notify employees about an important event and add a task to remind them to prepare for it. You can also quickly create a task from any Feed post. Create a task Convert Feed post into a task

Events. If your company has a big event coming up and you need certain employees to help organize it, you can create an event in the Feed. A form will open in a slider where you can add the date, time, location, and participants. Add events to calendar
Polls . To make critical decisions, it’s helpful to know what employees think. Post a poll in the Feed and share it with all employees or specific departments to collect their votes. Create a poll

Files. You can attach and share files of any type in the Feed. Upload them from Bitrix24 Drive or your computer, share them with colleagues, and discuss details in the comments. File preview in Bitrix24: quick access and possible actions
Appreciations . These are special badges shown on each employee's profile page. Use them to compliment or congratulate an employee. Create an appreciation message in Feed

Announcements. When you need to share critical information with your colleagues, you can create an announcement. It will have a unique background and a "read" status indicator. If someone misses it in the Feed, it will also appear as a widget on the right side. Create announcements in Feed
Workflows. Start a workflow to request a vacation or forward a document to your colleague for approval. You will get system messages updating you on its status right in the Feed. Workflows in Feed
Workflows in Feed are not linked to the workflows in CRM and Company Drive.
Feed settings. Focus on important details by enabling special modes in the Feed settings.

Smart follow mode . When this mode is enabled, the most valuable posts for you appear at the top of the Feed. For example, posts where you're the author, recipient, or mentioned in a comment. Smart follow mode
In brief
- Feed is a place for the sharing of information and internal communication in your company.
- In Feed, you can add messages, create tasks or events, run a poll, or publish work reports.

titre: FAQ: Feed
sections: FAQ: Feed

The Feed in Bitrix24 is a workspace where employees share news, discuss topics, and quickly access important information. Here, you can write posts and comment on them, conduct polls, launch workflows, and more. This article answers frequently asked questions about the Feed in Bitrix24.
- Who is a hidden recipient
- If you can send a message to all employees at once
- How to create a message draft
- How to find a draft and publish a message
- How to find a post in the Feed
- How to change your response in a poll
- How to pin a message
- Why an employee cannot see a message in the Feed
Who is a hidden recipient in messages

A hidden recipient is a group with the special privacy setting. This group is not visible in the general list and can only be accessed by invitation. In a message, its name is visible only to participants, while for others, it appears as "Hidden recipient".
Can you send a message to all employees at once
In the Bitrix24 Feed, you can send messages to all employees at once. You don’t need to select each user manually. Select the "All employees" option.
The Bitrix24 administrator manages this option: they can disable it entirely or allow only specific employees to use it.
1. Go to the Settings > Bitrix24 Settings > Communications .
2. Open the Feed tab.
3. Enable the Allow publishing messages to all employees option and specify who can use it, everyone or selected employees.
Bitrix24 Settings: New single section
How to create a message draft in the Feed
If you need to prepare a message in advance but don’t want to publish it yet, you can create a draft. This allows you to refine the text and publish it at the right time.
1. Create a message in the Feed and set yourself as the recipient. This way, colleagues won’t see it prematurely.
2. Send the message.
3. Click Three dots (…) on the published message and select Edit .
4. Click Save as draft .
Add messages to Feed Create a draft message in Feed
How to find a draft and publish a message in the Feed
All your message drafts are stored in your profile. You can edit and publish them anytime.
1. Go to your profile and open the Feed tab.
2. In the top menu, select All > Drafts .
3. Find the draft you need and click Three dots (...) > Edit .
4. Edit the message if necessary and click Publish .
How to find a post in the Feed
You can quickly find the message you need in the Feed using:
Search . Enter a word or part of it in the search bar, and the Feed will display all messages with matches in the title, text, description, or comments.
Filters . You can use ready-made ones:
- Work — notifications about work reports, changes in work hours, and task activities.
- Favorites — messages you’ve added to this category.
- My activity— messages where you are the author.
- Announcements— only important messages.
- Workflows — launched workflows you participate in.
- Extranet — messages involving external users.
If the ready-made filters don’t suit your needs, create your own:
1. Select the necessary fields and specify their values, such as messages from a specific author this month.
2. Click Save filter .
3. Enter a filter name and click Save .
Search and filter messages in Feed Create announcements in Feed
Can employees change their response in a poll

Users can change their vote in a poll if the "Allow employees to change their opinion" option was enabled when creating the poll. Contact the post author if you need to change your response. Polls in the Feed
How to pin a message
To keep a post always visible, pin it at the top of the Feed. Click a special icon next to the message you want to pin.
Why can’t I see some messages in the Feed
Messages are visible only to employees or departments listed as recipients. If an employee is not listed, they won’t see the post.

titre: Bitrix24 Messenger 3.0
sections: Bitrix24 Messenger 3.0

The messenger has become the central hub for collaboration. When users log in to Bitrix24, they land directly in chats, making it easy to start communicating with colleagues and quickly dive into ongoing tasks. New users don’t need to navigate the interface to begin working. Bitrix24 Chat: new interface and features
In this article:
- A collaborative workspace
- Secure chats
- Polls in chats
- Quick access to information
- CoPilot — your work assistant
A collaborative workspace

Messenger 3.0 is a unified workspace where tools are interconnected. There’s no need to install and configure multiple apps — Bitrix24 has everything you need for work: chats, tasks, calendars, documents, etc.

You can create tasks and meetings directly from chat messages or independently. Switch between a chat and a task form. This eliminates unnecessary clicks and windows, helping teams save time and work efficiently on any device. Create a task or an event from a message
In chats, you can forward messages, pin, or add them to favorites. Stay connected with colleagues even remotely: share emotions in chats and react to messages.
Secure chats
Chats are limited to company employees only. New employees are automatically added to their department’s chats and channels, while former employees lose access to Bitrix24.
External users cannot send messages, make calls, impersonate colleagues, or access conversations. This protects against phishing attacks, spam, and data leaks. Bitrix24 chat types

Automatic message deletion. Set a retention period for conversations, after which messages will automatically disappear. This is useful for discussing confidential topics, personal data, or temporary tasks that quickly become irrelevant. Auto delete messages option in Bitrix24 chats Auto delete messages option in Bitrix24 mobile app
Polls in chats

Polls in Bitrix24 allow you to quickly gather employee opinions, collect feedback, and make data-driven decisions. For example, you can choose a corporate event date, gather feedback on a new process, or decide on the best logo. Polls in Bitrix24 chats
Polls can be created in:
- Group chats
- Channels
- Projects
Quick access to information
Messages, files, and video call recordings remain in the chat and can be accessed anytime via the sidebar. The sidebar is the chat’s side panel, where you can find:
- Favorite messages
- Media and files
- Links from messages
- Tasks
- Meetings
From the sidebar, you can switch to the context of a discussion via favorite messages and links. To view the message that created a task, click on the task. Bitrix24 Chat: new interface and features
Voice messages can be fast-forwarded or played at different speeds to quickly revisit key moments.
CoPilot — your work assistant

CoPilot is integrated into daily workflows and can act as an expert in specific fields. We have added over 30 roles, such as sales department supervisor, lawyer, HR, and more. You can use these roles or create your own.
CoPilot can assist with various tasks:
- Formulating goals and breaking them into steps
- Preparing a presentation or report structure
- Highlighting key points from lengthy texts
- Analyzing complex situations
In brief

- The messenger has become the central hub for collaboration. When users log in to Bitrix24, they land directly in chats, making it easy to start communicating with colleagues and quickly dive into ongoing tasks.

- Messenger 3.0 is a unified workspace where tools are interconnected. There’s no need to install and configure multiple apps — Bitrix24 has everything you need for work: chats, tasks, calendars, documents, etc.
- New employees are automatically added to their department’s chats, while former employees lose access to Bitrix24.
- Chats now offer automatic message deletion. Set a retention period for conversations, after which messages will automatically disappear.
- Polls in chats allow you to quickly gather employee opinions and make decisions.
- Messages, files, and video call recordings remain in the chat and can be accessed anytime via the sidebar.
- CoPilot is integrated into chats and can act as an expert in specific fields.

titre: Create and configure Bitrix24 Channels
sections: Create and configure Bitrix24 Channels
Bitrix24 Channels is a tool you can use to share updates and keep your team informed.
Create a channel
You can create channels in the Bitrix24 web version or mobile app.
1. Open Messenger > Chats .
2. Click the pencil icon.
3. Select Channel .
Enter a channel name and description. Then choose the channel type:
- Public: The channel appears in the channel list. Anyone can join and view posts.
- Private: Only subscribers can see the channel. The channel owner controls who can add members.
The Channels section shows all public channels. You can manage notifications in the sidebar and turn sound on or off.
Assign a channel owner and administrators. Set permissions and choose who can:
- Add subscribers (specific employees, departments, or the whole company)
- Remove subscribers
- Post messages in the channel
After setup, add employees and start sharing updates.
Channels include two counters:
- Green — comments
- Blue — posts
In the Channels tab, you can find: Public channels you have not joined Channels you are subscribed to Channels you follow also appear under Chats .
- Public channels you have not joined
- Channels you are subscribed to
If you mention someone with @ in a public channel they have not joined, they receive a notification with a link to the comment. They can open and reply.
If you mention someone in a private channel they are not part of, they do not receive a notification.
1. Open the Messenger section.
2. Tap the plus (+) icon.
3. Select Channel .
Enter a channel name and description. Tap Next , then choose the channel type:
- Public: The channel appears in the channel list. Anyone can join and view posts.
- Private: Only subscribers can see the channel. The channel owner can allow members to invite others.
Add employees to the channel and tap Create Channel .
Sidebar and customization
The sidebar shows all the basic channel information: subscribers, channel type, files, and meetings.
To open the sidebar, click the sidebar icon. Then click the three dots (...) to manage the channel:
- Pin the channel to the chat list
- Edit the channel name, permissions, and subscribers
- Add subscribers
- Hide the channel from the chat list (use search to find it later)
- Unsubscribe (you can rejoin public channels anytime; private channels require an invite)
- Delete the channel (owner only)
To view subscribers, click the user icons. You can also copy the channel link and share it.
Click the three dots (...) next to a user to:
- Mention the user in channel
- Send a direct message
- Make them a channel administrator
- Start a one-on-one video call
- Open their profile or calendar
- Remove them from the channel
The sidebar also includes:
- Favorite messages
- All links
- Files and media
1. Open the channel.
2. Tap the channel name at the top.
3. Tap the three dots (...).
4. Select Edit or Delete .
Edit a channel . You can:
- Change the channel name and description.
- Configure access permissions.
- Add departments to subscribers.
To add a department:
1. Tap Subscribers .
2. Open the Departments tab.
3. Select a department.
4. Tap Save .
To remove a department, tap the X next to its name.
Delete a channel . Only the channel owner can delete the channel.
In brief
- Bitrix24 Channels help you share information with your team.
- Find public channels you have not joined in the Channels tab.
- Find channels you follow under Chats .
- Create channels in the web version or mobile app.
- Choose between public and private channels. Public channels are open to everyone. Private channels require an invite or link.
- Use the sidebar to view subscribers, channel type, files, and meetings.

titre: Bitrix24 Chat: new interface and features
sections: Bitrix24 Chat: new interface and features
Bitrix24 Chat helps teams communicate in one place. Employees can discuss work, share files, create tasks, and schedule meetings right from a chat. Types of Bitrix24 chats
In this article:
- Create and configure a chat
- Create a message
- Read messages
- Use additional chat features
- Sort chats into folders
- Open the sidebar
- View related messages
Create and configure a chat
Open Settings and customize the chat. Bitrix24 saves all changes automatically.
Design and layout. Choose the chat background and message alignment.
Notifications. Turn notification sounds on or off, set automatic read status, and choose how you receive notifications. Use advanced mode for more detailed settings.
Hotkeys. Choose the shortcut for sending messages: Enter or Ctrl + Enter. On Mac, use Cmd + Enter.
Recent chats. Choose whether to show birthdays, invited users, or message text.
Open your profile and go to Settings (⚙️) > Messenger . Turn on the options you need.
- Show message history when inviting to chat : New participants can view all messages in the chat.
- Cache messages : Messages and files you open are saved on your device. You can view them offline. Unread messages and attachments are not available offline.
- Autoplay videos
Create a message
Go to Chats and select a chat from the list.
Adjust the text input field. The field height adjusts automatically, but you can also set it manually. Drag the top border to the height you need.
Mention an employee or a chat. Press + or @ , then start typing a user name or chat title.
Mention all chat participants. Type @ and select All to address everyone in the chat. Use this for announcements or reminders.
Mention CoPilot. Type @ and select CoPilot to ask a question or discuss an idea in the chat or channel. CoPilot can summarize the conversation, highlight key points, and provide the main idea.
Add an attachment. Click the paperclip icon to:
- Upload a file from your computer or Bitrix24 Drive. Files are added in the order you select them.
- Create a task or calendar event. A message with a link to the item appears in the chat.
- Add a poll.
Polls in Bitrix24 chats
You can insert images directly from the clipboard. Copy the image from your gallery or a website, paste it into the text box, and submit.
Send a voice message. Hold the microphone icon to start recording. Swipe up to keep recording, or swipe left to cancel. You can send the message right away or listen to it first.
Save a draft. An unsent message stays in the chat so you can return to it later.
Adjust the text input field. The field height adjusts automatically, but you can also set it manually. Drag the top border to the height you need.
Mention an employee or a chat. Tap + or @ , then start typing a user name or chat title.
Mention all chat participants. Type @ and select All to address everyone in the chat. Use this for announcements or reminders.
Mention CoPilot. Type @ and select CoPilot to ask a question or discuss an idea in the chat or channel. CoPilot can summarize the conversation, highlight key points, and provide the main idea.
Add an attachment. Tap the paperclip icon to:
- Upload a file from your device or Bitrix24 Drive. Files are added in the order you select them.
- Create a task or calendar event. A message with a link to the item appears in the chat.
- Add a poll.
Polls in Bitrix24 chats
Send a voice message. Hold the microphone icon to start recording. Swipe up to keep recording, or swipe left to cancel. You can send the message right away or listen to it first.
Send a video message. Tap the microphone icon, then hold the camera icon to record a video. The maximum recording time is one minute.
After recording the message:
- Release the button to send it.
- Swipe left to cancel the recording.
Save a draft. An unsent message stays in the chat so you can return to it later.
Read messages
Gradual conversation reading. When you re-enter the chat, you will automatically return to the last read message, and unread messages will be grouped under a dividing line.
Read status is displayed in the bottom-right corner of the message.
View unread messages
To make sure you do not miss anything important, use the Unread filter. It shows only chats with new messages.
1. Click the filter icon in the upper-left corner. 2. Select Unread .
You will see only chats with unread messages and notifications turned on.
Mark all messages as read
If unread messages have built up across several chats and you do not have time to open each one, you can mark them all as read at once.
1. Click the filter icon in the upper-left corner. 2. Select Mark all as read .
The unread message counter will reset.

Message reactions. The messenger now features new emojis, allowing you to express emotions more precisely. Hover over the gray emoji icon and select one to react. To view likes, mentions, or replies to your messages, click the counter. The chat will automatically scroll to the relevant message.
The appearance of emojis depends on the operating system. They may look different on different devices.
Actions with messages. Hover over a message and click the dots to select an action:
- Reply — quote the selected message.
- Copy
- Copy link — share it with colleagues. The recipients can view the message if they are chat participants or if the chat is public.
- Pin — the message will appear at the top of the chat for all participants. You can pin up to 50 messages.
- Forward — send the selected message to another chat. You can search by name or select from recent conversations.
- Ask CoPilot. A quoted message and a mention of CoPilot will appear in the text input field. Add your question, and the AI assistant will respond directly in the chat.
- View later — mark the chat with this message as unread. This helps you remember to respond to important messages.
- Add to Favorites — save the message in the corresponding section in the chat sidebar. This allows you to revisit important messages anytime.
- Create a task or a meeting
- Save to Drive — add files to the Bitrix24 Drive Saved Files folder.
- Edit

- Delete — if no participants have read the message, no deletion notification will remain in the chat. Chat owners and administrators can delete messages from other employees and system notifications.
- Select — delete or forward up to 20 messages simultaneously.
Read conversations gradually. When you reopen a chat, Bitrix24 takes you back to the last message you read. Unread messages are grouped under a divider.
Read status appears in the bottom-right corner of the message.
View only unread messages. To make sure you do not miss anything important, use the Unread filter. It shows only chats with new messages.
1. Click the filter icon in the upper-right corner. 2. Select Unread . You will see only chats with unread messages and notifications turned on.
Mark all messages as read. If unread messages have built up in several chats and you do not have time to review them, you can mark them all as read at once.
1. Click the filter icon in the upper-right corner. 2. Select Mark all as read . The unread message counter will reset.

Message reactions. Messenger includes emojis that help you show reactions more precisely. Tap the gray emoji icon and select a reaction. To view likes, mentions, or replies to your messages, tap the counter. The chat scrolls to the related message automatically.
Message actions. Tap and hold a message to select an action:
- Reply : Quote the selected message.
- Copy
- Copy link : Share the message with colleagues. Recipients can view it if they are chat participants or if the chat is public.
- Edit
- Pin : Show the message at the top of the chat for all participants. You can pin up to 50 messages.
- Forward : Send the message to another chat. Search by name or select a recent conversation.
- Ask CoPilot : Bitrix24 adds the quoted message and a CoPilot mention to the text input field. Add your question, and CoPilot replies in the chat.
- Create a task or meeting
- Save to Bitrix24 : Add files to the Bitrix24 Drive folder. Find them in Menu > Files > My Files > Saved Files .
- Open the message sender’s profile.
- Delete : If no participants have read the message, no deletion notification remains in the chat. Chat owners and administrators can delete messages from other employees and system notifications.
- Select : Delete or forward up to 20 messages at the same time.
Sort chats into folders in the mobile app
If you have a lot of chats, you can sort them into folders in the mobile app. For example, you can create a separate folder for each project. This helps you find the right chat faster.
Create a folder.

1. Tap Plus (+) in the bottom-right corner. 2. Select Folder . 3. Enter a folder name and tap Add to choose chats from the list. 4. Select the chats you want and tap Add . 5. If you added a chat by mistake, tap the X icon to remove it from the folder. 6. Tap Create . The folder will appear with the selected chats inside.
Add a chat to a folder. In the chat list, swipe right on a chat and tap Add to folder . Select a folder from the list, then tap Save .
Switch between folders using the tabs at the top of the chat list. Tap a folder to open the chats inside it.
Manage folders. Tap Three dots (...) in the row with folder names to open the folder list.
Tap Three dots (...) next to a folder and choose an action:
- Configure — rename the folder, or add and remove chats.
- Delete — remove the folder if you no longer need it.
To change the folder order, press and hold a folder, then drag it up or down. Save your changes.
Use additional chat features
Audio and video calls. You can launch Bitrix24 Sync or create a Zoom meeting to discuss work-related topics. Bitrix24 Sync Create Zoom meetings from CRM and chats
Add chat members — this option may be limited by the chat access settings. You can add members in two ways.
Click Add chat members , then select Show chat history so the new user can see the full message history.
Type @ or + in the text field, then start typing the employee's name. If the employee is not in the chat yet, you'll see the Not in chat label. Click it, then click Add to chat .
Copy the link . To share a link to the chat with colleagues, copy the chat link.
Search the chat. Enter a word or a phrase to find messages containing it. Select a message from the list to open it in the chat.

To add someone to a chat, type @ in the message field and start entering the employee's name. If the employee is not in the chat yet, the Add chat member icon will appear. Click the icon, then click Add to chat .
You can start an audio or a video call directly from the chat. Participants will receive a notification and can join the meeting. Bitrix24 Sync
Open the sidebar
The chat sidebar contains key information: settings, list of participants, files, and more.
1. Click the sidebar icon to expand the panel.
2. Click Three dots (...) to open the context menu and select an action:
- Pin the chat in the chat list.
- Edit : Participants can change the chat name and image if permissions allow it. The chat owner can change settings such as type, description, access permissions, and more.
- Add participants : Invite one or more colleagues.
- Hide the chat from the chat list. To find it later, enter its name in the search bar. If a participant sends a message, the chat appears again.
- Leave : To rejoin a private chat, you need an invitation. For public chats, search by name and join.
- Delete : Only the chat owner can delete the chat.
- Open the profile, calendar, or shared chats. These options are available only in one-to-one chats.

- Clear a chat, for example if you no longer need the conversation. You can delete the chat history only for yourself or for all participants. Only a chat administrator can clear the chat for everyone.
Group chats have an invite link. Copy the link and send it to your teammates so they can join the conversation.
To turn off access through the current link, click Three dots (...) > Change. Bitrix24 creates a new link, and the old link no longer works.
The chat creator and administrators appear first. Their avatars have special icons. Click Three dots (...) next to a participant to:
- Mention the user in the chat
- Send a private message
- Make the user a chat administrator. This option is available only to the chat owner.
- Start a one-to-one video call with the user
- View the user’s profile or calendar
- Remove the user from the chat. This option is available only to the chat owner.
In the sidebar, you can:
- Turn group chat notifications on or off
- Create a new group chat
- Set up automatic message deletion after an hour, day, week, or month
Auto delete messages option in Bitrix24 chats
The sidebar includes:
- Chat type and description
- Favorite messages
- Links from messages
- Shared chats with a user, only in one-to-one chats
- Media and files
- Tasks and meetings created in this chat
Tap the chat name to open the sidebar.
Tap Three dots (...) and select an action:
- Edit : Participants can change the chat name and image if permissions allow it. The chat owner can change settings such as type, description, and access permissions.
- Copy the chat link to share it with colleagues.
- Add participants : Invite one or more colleagues.
- Copy the chat link to share the chat with colleagues.
- Leave : To rejoin a private chat, you need an invitation. For public chats, search by name and join.
- Delete : Only the chat owner can delete the chat.
- Open the profile or calendar. These options are available only in one-to-one chats.

- Clear a chat, for example if you no longer need the conversation. You can delete the chat history only for yourself or for all participants. Only a chat administrator can clear the chat for everyone.
In the sidebar, you can:
- View the chat type and description
- Start a voice or video call
- Search the chat by keyword. Select a message from the list to open it in the chat.
- Turn group chat notifications on or off
- Set up automatic message deletion after an hour, day, week, or month. The chat shows a notification about the change.
- View media, files, links, and voice messages
- Add users to the chat
The creator and administrators appear first.
Tap a participant’s name to open their profile. Tap Three dots (...) to open the context menu and select an action:
- Mention
- Start a one-to-one chat
- Assign as administrator or remove from the chat. These options are available only to chat owners.
View related messages
1. You can navigate to the original discussion through sidebar elements like links, files, tasks, meetings, etc.
2. Open the context menu of the element: click Three dots (...) > View context . This feature also works with quotes: click the quoted message to navigate to it in the chat.
1. You can navigate to the original discussion through sidebar elements like links, files, tasks, meetings, etc.
2. Open the context menu of the element: click Three dots (...) > View context . This feature also works with quotes: click the quoted message to navigate to it in the chat.
In brief
- Bitrix24 Chat helps teams communicate. Employees can discuss work, share files, and create tasks and meetings from a conversation.
- The sidebar shows detailed chat information, including the description, participant list, files, media, links, and favorite messages.
- The chat creator and administrators appear first in the participant list.
- You can call colleagues from a chat using Bitrix24 Sync.
- You can pin up to 50 messages in a chat and delete or forward up to 20 messages at the same time.
- To open the message related to a task or shared file, open the item context menu.

titre: Chat with CoPilot
sections: Chat with CoPilot
In Bitrix24, you can chat with CoPilot in a dedicated chat or mention it in any conversation. It helps with a wide range of tasks, from writing emails to generating business ideas.
Here’s what you can do with CoPilot:
- Choose a specific CoPilot role
- Invite colleagues to join the chat
- Use AI tools in the mobile app
- Chat with CoPilot in chats, collabs, or in comments on a channel post
How to open a chat with CoPilot
Find the chat with CoPilot in a separate tab on the chat panel. CoPilot saves the chat history and remembers your questions. Anytime, you can return to the chats you started earlier to proceed.
Click on the CoPilot icon in the chat sidebar.
To start a chat, click Plus (+) or Ask a question .
Enter your question or use the mic icon to ask by voice.
For speech recognition, the CoPilot Agent uses the language packs installed in your operating system. Language packs for Windows Change Language & Region settings on Mac
Change the chat name manually or wait for it to update automatically based on your question. Thus, you can quickly find it in the chat list.
Go to Messenger , open the CoPilot tab, then tap Plus (+) . Enter your question or use the mic icon to ask by voice.
CoPilot roles
CoPilot can act as an expert in over 30 roles, like sales manager, lawyer, HR, poet, and more.
To choose a role, open the chat sidebar and click CoPilot . Roles are grouped by activity area. For example, as a lawyer, CoPilot can help with legal risks or regulations.
Start a chat and see how CoPilot responds in different roles using preset prompts.
You can also create your own prompts. Specify the response format, set limits, and give examples. Try out various formulas to get the most accurate response. How to write detailed prompts for CoPilot
To choose a role, tap the chat name in the top, then tap Role .
Roles are grouped by activity area. Select the one you need and see how CoPilot responds in different roles using preset prompts.
You can also create your own prompts. Specify the response format, set limits, and give examples. Try out various formulas to get the most accurate response. How to write detailed prompts for CoPilot
How to add colleagues to a chat with CoPilot
Invite colleagues to chat with CoPilot to ask questions and discuss ideas together. All chat members can see CoPilot's responses.
You can add members when starting a chat or later.
Click the Add members icon and select employees to invite.
To mention a colleague in a chat with CoPilot, press + or @ and enter their name. CoPilot responds to messages without user mention.
Tap the Add members icon, select employees to invite, and tap Done .
To mention a colleague in a chat with CoPilot, tap + or @ and enter their name. CoPilot responds to messages without user mention.
How to mention CoPilot in a chat

Reach out to CoPilot in any chat, collab, or in the comments on a channel post. Ask questions, discuss ideas, or request a summary of the conversation. CoPilot helps you quickly understand the context, suggests ideas, and supports the discussion right in the chat.
To mention CoPilot, either start a new message or use the context menu on an existing one.
In a new message . This is useful for summarizing or analyzing the entire conversation.
1. In the message field, type @ and select CoPilot .
2. Enter your request, such as “summarize the meeting” or “suggest ideas for a slogan.”
3. CoPilot replies directly in the chat.
Using the context menu of a sent message. This is helpful when you need feedback on a specific part of the conversation.
1. Right-click on the message or click on the three dots (...).
2. Select Ask CoPilot .
3. The quoted message and CoPilot mention appear in the message field. Add your question, and the AI assistant will reply directly in the chat.
To mention CoPilot, either start a new message or use the context menu on an existing one.
In a new message. This is useful for summarizing or analyzing the entire conversation.
1. In the message field, type @ and select CoPilot .
2. Enter your request, such as “summarize the meeting” or “suggest ideas for a slogan.”
3. CoPilot replies directly in the chat.
Using the context menu of a sent message. This is helpful when you need feedback on a specific part of the conversation.
1. Tap and hold the message.
2. Select Ask CoPilot .
3. The quoted message and CoPilot mention will appear in the message field. Add your question, and the AI assistant will reply directly in the chat.
In brief
- Use CoPilot in a special chat to help with tasks like writing email texts or finding business ideas.
- The chat is available on the web and in the mobile app.
- To ask a question, open the chat in a separate tab on the chat panel.
- CoPilot can act as an expert in over 30 roles.
- Invite colleagues to join the chat and discuss ideas together.
- Reach out to CoPilot in any chat, collab, or in the comments on a channel post.

titre: Types of Bitrix24 chats
sections: Types of Bitrix24 chats
Bitrix24 offers five chat types. Each one supports a different use case. Choose the option that fits your workflow:
- Group chat — team collaboration
- Channels — company-wide announcements
- Chat with CoPilot — AI-assisted work
- Projects — work with external participants
- Video conferences — online meetings
Group chats
Use group chats to handle day-to-day team communication. They work well for:
- Project discussions
- Deadline updates
- File sharing
- Task coordination
A team discusses a landing page. They agree on the structure, review designs, and assign a development task—all in one chat. Group chat
Channels
Channels work best for important updates that everyone should see. Messages stay visible and don’t get buried in conversations.
Key features:
- Quick setup — add a whole department or company at once
- Auto subscription — new employees join automatically; former employees lose access
- Access permissions — control who can post and manage participants
- Statistics — track likes and comments
For example, a manager posts a project plan. The team reviews key dates and tasks, then asks questions in the comments.
Chats with CoPilot
CoPilot is an AI assistant inside Bitrix24 chats. Use it to handle tasks faster.
CoPilot can:
- Define goals and break them into steps
- Create presentations or reports
- Summarize text
For example, during a product launch discussion, CoPilot helps define goals, build a plan, and draft a landing page structure.
Additional capabilities:
- Choose from 30+ expert roles
- Create custom roles
- Invite colleagues to collaborate in the same AI chat
CoPilot chats stay available in a separate tab and in your recent chats list.
Projects
Projects are shared workspaces for external users, such as partners or clients. You don’t need separate tools—everything is in one place:
- Chats
- Files
- Tasks
- Calendar
For example, you run a training program. Invite an external expert to a project. Participants access materials, join calls, and complete tasks in one space.
Projects: Getting started Use a project chat Work in a project calendar Work with project tasks
Video conferences
Use video conferences to meet with people outside your company.
To join a video conference, participants need to follow a link and enter a password. They don’t need to register in Bitrix24 or download an app. They can join from a phone or computer.
For example, a manager presents a website layout to a client, shares their screen, and answers questions in real time.
In brief
- Bitrix24 offers five types of chats, each designed for specific tasks. Choose the one that suits your needs.
- Group chats help quickly resolve work-related questions within a team.
- Channels are ideal for important announcements to the entire team. Information is always visible and doesn’t get lost in conversations.
- Chats with CoPilot are great for solving various tasks with AI. You can brainstorm ideas and involve colleagues.
- Projects are spaces for collaboration with contractors and customers.
- Video conferences allow you to quickly organize meetings with people outside your company. Participants only need to follow a link and enter a password to join.

titre: Notifications in Bitrix24: interface and features
sections: Notifications in Bitrix24: interface and features

Notifications in Bitrix24 help you stay on top of important events like new tasks, comments, meetings, or CRM updates. Managing them is now easier with an updated interface and structure, plus the ability to quickly unsubscribe from unnecessary notifications.

You can customize notifications to suit your needs by selecting which events to receive and where to see them: in the messenger, via email, or in the mobile app. For example, you can enable CRM notifications and disable task alerts.
- Customize notifications
- Work with them
Customize notifications
To receive only the notifications you need, customize them to your preferences. Go to the Messenger section > More > Settings > Notifications .
Working with notifications
- Enable notification sound — uncheck the box to receive notifications without sound. Ideal for staying focused during work or meetings.

- Auto mark notifications as read — enable this setting to mark notifications as read as soon as you open the section. If disabled, new notifications can only be marked as read manually, which is useful if you want to revisit them later.
- Disable notifications — temporarily disables notifications in the messenger. Use this during calls, meetings, or client work to avoid sound alerts.
Modes:
- Simple — notifications are configured for all tools at once.
- Advanced — notifications can be customized for each Bitrix24 tool individually.
Advanced notification settings
Tasks. Specify which task notifications you want to receive: comments, reminders, creation and changes, task assignment, and approaching deadlines.
Event calendar . Specify which calendar event notifications to receive.

Chats and calls. Configure notifications for new messages in personal and group chats, likes, and mentions. Other notifications include all remaining alerts, such as chat removals and REST notifications.
Feed posts. Configure notifications for Feed posts, such as mentions in comments or direct messages.
Polls and Surveys. Configure notifications for voting in Feed polls.
Ratings and Likes. Enable notifications for likes on posts and comments in the Feed.
Workgroups and projects. Configure notifications for changes in group ownership or requests to join a group or project.
Workflows. Enable notifications for automation rules and workflows.
Webmail. Enable notifications for new emails and mailbox connection limit warnings.
CRM. Configure CRM notifications, such as for activities and comments.
Email marketing. Enable notifications for segment readiness for sending.
Telephony. Enable telephony notifications for balance top-ups, rented number disconnections, and SIP connection status changes.
Open channels. Configure notifications for customer and supervisor conversation assessments.
Worktime time management. Configure notifications for adding, editing work reports, and comments.
Drive. Configure notifications for file deletions by other users from your personal Drive. Employees can delete files from another's Drive only if they have access.
Configure access permissions to personal drive
Bitrix24. Configure notifications for low storage space on the Drive.
e-Signature for HR. Enable reminders for new documents awaiting signature.
Market. Enable notifications for new app installations, installation requests, and data access permissions.
Intranet. Enable notifications with a confirmation code for two-step authentication.
Enable two-step authentication for Bitrix24 login
Wiki. Enable notifications for new comments on Wiki articles.
Where to send notifications.
- Web version and desktop app — notifications will appear in the Bitrix24 Notifications section.
- Email — notifications will be sent to your email within 5–10 minutes, but only if they haven't been read in Bitrix24. Receive email notifications from Bitrix24
- Mobile devices (push notifications) — to display notifications on your mobile device, enable them in the mobile app settings. Bitrix24 mobile app
Work with notifications
After customizing notifications, you can manage them — view, search, snooze, or delete. Here's how to work with notifications when the Automatically mark notifications as read setting is disabled.
Open the notification list. Click the bell icon in the sidebar or go to Messenger > Notifications .
Reply to a notification. If it requires action, click the button directly in the notification.
Mark all notifications as read. If you don't want to review each notification, mark them all at once. This is convenient when you handle events directly in Bitrix24 tools.
Click Three dots (...) > Mark all as read.
Search for a notification. To quickly find a specific notification, click the magnifying glass icon.
You can search notifications:
- By sections — select the section and notification type you want to view. For example, new comments on a task.

- By keywords — enter a keyword or part of it, and Bitrix24 will show matching results. This is useful if you remember the gist of the message but not the details — for instance, finding a discount approval request.
- By date — select the date for which you want to view notifications.
You can select one or multiple parameters — for example, search notifications in a specific section and on a particular date.
Actions with notifications:
- Mark to read later — the notification will remain unread, allowing you to return to it at a convenient time.

- Unsubscribe — if you don't want to receive notifications of a certain type. For example, you can disable reminders for activities if you track them directly in CRM. Unsubscribing applies to all notifications of this type, not just one event.
- Delete — remove the notification from the list by clicking the cross icon.
Click Three dots (...) and select the desired action.
If you have unread notifications, a counter will appear at the bottom of the page. Click it to open new notifications.
In brief
- Notifications in Bitrix24 help you stay on top of important events like new tasks, comments, meetings, or CRM updates.
- You can customize notifications to suit your needs by selecting which events to receive and where to see them: in the messenger, via email, or in the mobile app.
- Notifications are stored for 60 days and are automatically deleted afterward.
- To receive only the notifications you need, customize them to your preferences. Go to Messenger > More > Settings > Notifications .
- There are two modes for managing notifications: Simple and Advanced.
- You can mark all notifications as read at once or find specific ones using filters.
- You can unsubscribe from unnecessary notifications.

titre: General chat
sections: General chat
The General chat is available to all users in your Bitrix24 account. New employees join the chat automatically. Dismissed employees are removed from it automatically.
Use the General chat to share company-wide updates and discuss topics that matter to everyone in your organization.
You cannot leave the General chat, but you can turn off notifications for it in the sidebar.
General chat settings for Bitrix24 administrators
Only Bitrix24 administrators can manage General chat settings.
To open the settings:
1. Click the toggles icon at the top.
2. Select Settings in the widget.
3. Open the Communications tab.
4. Expand the Chats section.
5. Use the toggle switch to enable or disable the following options:
Allow to post messages to the General chat : Select which employees can send messages in the chat.
Post employee dismissal notification to the General chat : Enable this option to notify employees when a user is dismissed. After you dismiss a user, a system message appears in the chat.

Post administrator change notification to the General chat : Enable this option to notify employees when new administrators are assigned. After you grant administrator permissions to a user, a system message appears in the chat.
In brief
- The General chat is a group chat for all employees in your company.
- New employees join the chat automatically. Dismissed employees are removed automatically.
- Use the General chat for company-wide discussions and announcements.
- Administrators can manage chat settings, restrict who can post messages, and enable notifications about administrator changes and employee dismissals.

titre: Bitrix24 Channels: a new format for company communications
sections: Bitrix24 Channels: a new format for company communications

We introduced a new feature — Bitrix24 Channels . Use channels to share updates, exchange knowledge, and connect employees across a department or the entire company. Channels are available to all employees.
Channel features
Bitrix24 Channels are built into company workflows. This makes them different from standard messengers.
- Add participants quickly. Add an entire department or the whole company at once. You don’t need to invite employees one by one.

- Automatic subscription and removal. When you add a department, new employees join automatically. When users leave the company, the system removes them from all channels and revokes access to Bitrix24.
- Access permissions. Control who can manage participants and publish posts.
- Centralized discussions. Each post has its own comment thread. You can easily return to discussions and find information.
- Statistics. Track likes and comments on posts.
Channels help keep everyone informed. To support this, a company-wide channel is available by default.
Company News
Channels provide a simple way to share company updates. Bitrix24 includes a default Company News channel.
- Employees cannot leave this channel.
- New employees join automatically.
This is a system channel with limited settings. A Bitrix24 administrator can define who can publish Feed posts.
To configure permissions:
1. Click the settings icon next to your Bitrix24 name.
2. Open Settings (⚙️) in the widget.
3. Go to Communications .
4. Select General channels .
5. Choose who can add posts.
6. Save your changes.
Channels: use cases
Employees can join open channels on their own.
Use channels to:
- Celebrate colleagues. Create a channel for поздравления, reactions, and comments.
- Support learning. Share courses and feedback.
- Run a personal blog. Share insights and exchange experience with colleagues.
In brief
- Use channels to share updates, onboard employees, and discuss work topics. All employees can access channels.
- Channels are part of company workflows. This sets them apart from traditional messengers.
- Company News is a mandatory channel for all employees. Users join automatically and cannot leave.
- Channels are useful for news, reports, recognition, and knowledge sharing.

titre: Group chat
sections: Group chat
A group chat in Bitrix24 is a space for quick team coordination. It's convenient for discussing tasks, planning work, and resolving issues.
You can create a group chat in both web and mobile versions of Bitrix24.
1. Open the Messenger section.
2. Click the Create button and select Group chat .
3. Specify the chat name.

4. Add an icon and chat participants. You can choose specific employees or an entire department. New department employees will be added to the chat automatically, while those who leave will be removed.
5. Configure the chat privacy. A private chat is visible for the chat members only. A public one can be found in the general list and anyone can join it.
6. Enter a description. Specify the chat purpose and topics for discussion.
7. Click Create chat .
1. Go to the Messenger section and tap the plus button.
2. Select Group chat .
3. Add a chat participants. You can choose specific employees or an entire department. New department employees will be added to the chat automatically, while those who leave will be removed.
4. Tap Continue .
5. Add a chat icon, enter a name, and tap Create .
You can configure privacy and access permissions after creating the chat.
Edit or delete a chat
1. Open the chat sidebar.
2. Click Three dots (...)
3. Select Edit or Delete in the drop-down menu.
You can:
- Change the chat icon and name
- Add or remove participants
- Change the chat type
- Edit the description
- Change access permissions
1. Tap the chat name.
2. Tap Three dots (...) and select Edit or Delete in the drop-down menu.
You can:
- Change the chat icon and name
- Add or remove participants
- Change the chat type
- Edit the description
- Change access permissions
In brief
- A group chat in Bitrix24 is a space for quick team coordination. It's convenient for discussing tasks, planning work, and resolving issues.
- You can create a group chat in both web and mobile versions of Bitrix24.
- Add and remove participants, configure access permissions, and set privacy type in the group chat settings.
- You can change chat settings at any time. If the chat is no longer needed, you can delete it.

titre: Use message reactions
sections: Use message reactions
Reactions let you respond to messages quickly without typing a reply: show that you've read a message, support an idea, or express an emotion.
In this article:
- Set up a default reaction
- Add or remove a reaction
- See who reacted
Set up a default reaction
Choose which emoji to use as your default reaction.

1. Open the Messenger section in the left menu. 2–3. Below the folder list, click Three dots (...) and select Settings . 4. Go to the Appearance section. 5–6. In the Default reaction block, click the current emoji and select a new one.
Your default reaction appears first in the list, so you can add it with one click.

1–2. Go to Messenger and open any chat. 3. Press and hold any message to open the reaction panel. 4. Tap the down arrow on the right side of the panel to open the full list of reactions. 5. Press and hold the emoji you want to use as your default reaction. 6. Tap Set as default reaction .
Add or remove a reaction
You can add several different reactions to one message. Emojis may look different depending on your operating system and device.
Add your default reaction.
1. Hover over a message. Your default reaction icon appears in the bottom-right corner. 2. Click the icon.
The reaction appears below the message.
Choose a reaction.

1. Hover over a message. Your default reaction icon appears in the bottom-right corner. 2. Hover over the reaction icon. 3–5. In the panel that opens, click the down arrow next to All reactions and select an emoji.
The reaction appears below the message.
Add the same reaction. If a message already has reactions, click the one you want. Your reaction is added to the message.
Remove a reaction. If you made a mistake or changed your mind, you can remove your reaction. Reactions you've added are highlighted in blue. Click the reaction you want to remove, and it disappears.
Add your default reaction. Double-tap a message to add your default reaction.
Choose a reaction.
1. Press and hold a message to open the reaction panel at the top. 2–3. Tap the All reactions down arrow and select an emoji.
Add the same reaction. If a message already has reactions, tap the one you want. Your reaction is added to the message.
Remove a reaction. If you made a mistake or changed your mind, you can remove your reaction. Reactions you've added are highlighted in blue. Tap the reaction you want to remove, and it disappears.
See who reacted
Reactions appear below the message. Depending on the number of reactions, you may see the avatars of users who reacted next to the emoji, or the total number of reactions.
You can always check how your colleagues reacted to a message.
Hover over a reaction emoji to open the list of users who added it.
Press and hold any reaction emoji below a message. This opens a list of users: the All tab shows all reactions, and the other tabs show who reacted with each emoji.
In brief
- Reactions let you respond to messages without typing a reply.
- Set your default reaction in Messenger settings in the web version, or from the full list of reactions in the mobile app.

- In the web version, hover over a message to see your default reaction icon in the bottom-right corner. Click it to add the reaction. To use a different emoji, hover over the icon and choose another reaction.
- In the mobile app, press and hold a message to choose a reaction. Double-tap a message to add your default reaction.
- To remove your reaction, click or tap it again.
- To see who added a specific reaction, hover over the emoji below a message in the web version, or press and hold it in the mobile app.

titre: Work with unread chats in Bitrix24
sections: Work with unread chats in Bitrix24

When you have many personal and group chats, it's easy to miss an important message in the chat list. For example, while you're in a meeting, colleagues may send messages in several chats and wait for your decision. You can see all chats with new messages in one list, quickly mark those that don't need a reply as read, and set aside chats you want to return to later.
In this article:
- Find chats with new messages
- Set a chat aside to return to later
- Mark all chats as read
Find chats with new messages

View all chats with new messages in a separate list so you don't miss a conversation where someone is waiting for your reply. The counter next to each chat shows how many new messages it contains. A blue counter means sound notifications are enabled for the chat, while a gray counter means they're disabled.
1. Open Messenger from the left menu in Bitrix24. 2. Select the All section in the Messenger menu. 3. Below the search bar, select the Unread tab.

The list will show only chats with new messages. The counter on the tab shows the total number of new messages in chats with sound notifications enabled. You can see this counter even when you're viewing all chats. To view all conversations again, return to the All tab.
Only chats with sound notifications enabled appear on the Unread tab. Chats with a gray counter remain on the All tab. To make a chat appear on the Unread tab, right-click it and select Unmute .
1. Open Messenger in the app's bottom menu. 2. Above the chat list, select the All section. 3. Tap the filter icon in the upper-right corner. 4. Select Unread .

The list will show only chats with new messages, and the filter icon will turn blue. The counter next to Unread shows the total number of new messages in chats with sound notifications enabled. You'll see the same number next to the All section and next to Messenger in the bottom menu, even when the filter menu is closed. To view all conversations again, tap the filter icon.
Only chats with sound notifications enabled appear in the unread list. Chats with a gray counter won't appear there. To make a chat appear in the list, press and hold it, then select Unmute .
Set a chat aside to return to later

Set a chat aside when it contains an important message but you can't reply right away. When you open a chat, its counter disappears, making it easy to lose track of the conversation. Marking the chat helps you remember to return to it.

You can only set aside a chat you've already read. On a computer, the command is called Mark to read later ; in the mobile app, it's Unread . The marked status syncs across devices: if you set a chat aside on a computer, it will also appear in the mobile app, and vice versa.
Right-click a chat in the list and select Mark to read later .

A dot will appear next to the chat. If sound notifications are enabled for the chat, the dot will be blue. The chat will appear on the Unread tab, and the counters on that tab and next to Messenger in the left menu of Bitrix24 will each increase by one. This lets you see that a chat needs your attention, even when you're working in another section.
If sound notifications are disabled, the dot will be gray, and the chat will remain only on the All tab. The counters won't change.
When you open a chat you've marked for later, the dot will disappear. If sound notifications are enabled for the chat, it will disappear from the Unread tab, and the counters will decrease by one.
Press and hold a chat in the list, then select Unread .

A dot will appear next to the chat. If sound notifications are enabled for the chat, the dot will be blue, and the chat will appear in the unread list. The counters next to All , Unread in the filter menu, and Messenger in the bottom menu will each increase by one. If sound notifications are disabled, the dot will be gray, and the chat won't appear in the unread list. The counters won't change.
When you open a chat you've marked for later, the dot will disappear. If sound notifications are enabled for the chat, it will disappear from the unread list, and the counters will decrease by one.
Mark all chats as read

Mark all chats as read at once if you have a lot of unread messages and none of them need an immediate response. This makes it easier to notice new messages that arrive afterward. The messages will stay in the chats, so you can read them later.
Right-click the Unread tab and select Mark all as read . The unread message counters will reset for all chats, whether sound notifications are enabled or disabled.
To reset the counter in just one chat, right-click it and select Mark all as read . Other chats won't be affected.

1. Above the chat list, select the All section. 2. Tap the filter icon in the upper-right corner. 3. Select Mark all as read . The unread message counters will reset for all chats, whether sound notifications are enabled or disabled.
To reset the counter in just one chat, press and hold it, then select Read . Other chats won't be affected.
In brief
- The counter next to each chat shows how many new messages it contains. Blue means sound notifications are enabled for the chat, while gray means they're disabled.

- To see all chats with new messages in one list, select Unread in Messenger: on a computer, use the tab below the search bar; in the mobile app, select it from the filter menu. Only chats with sound notifications enabled appear in the list.

- To return to a chat later, mark it for later: select Mark to read later on a computer or Unread in the mobile app from the chat menu. A dot will appear next to the chat. If sound notifications are enabled, the chat will also appear in the unread list. The dot will disappear when you open the chat.

- To reset the counters for all chats, select Mark all as read : on a computer, in the Unread tab menu; in the mobile app, in the filter menu of the All section. This also removes any marks you've added to chats to return to later.

titre: Use voice and video messages in chat
sections: Use voice and video messages in chat

Bitrix24 Messenger supports voice and video messages. Choose the format that works best for you. If you don't have time to type, you can record a message instead. Recipients can watch the video, listen to the audio, or read the transcript.
In this article:
- Record a voice or video message
- Add and edit a caption
- Listen to or watch a message
- View a text transcript
- Set up transcription
Record a voice or video message
You can record voice and video messages in the Bitrix24 mobile app. You can play them in the mobile app or in Bitrix24 on your computer.
To record a message, open Messenger and select a chat.

Voice message. 1. Press and hold the microphone icon next to the input field to start recording a voice message. Release it to send the message to the chat immediately. 2–3. Swipe up to continue recording hands-free, or swipe left to cancel the recording. 4. Tap the Pause icon to pause the recording. 5. Tap the Play icon to resume recording, or Stop to finish. 6. Tap the Play icon to listen to the recording before sending it. Use the recording timeline to rewind. 7–8. Tap the Recycle bin icon to delete the message, or the Up arrow icon to send it.
Video message. You can record up to one minute of video.

1. Tap the microphone icon in the bottom-right corner. It changes to a camera icon. 2. Press and hold the camera icon to start recording a video. Release it to send the message to the chat immediately. 3–4. Swipe up to continue recording hands-free, or swipe left to cancel the recording. 5. Tap the camera icon in the bottom-left corner to switch between the front and rear cameras. 6. When recording with the rear camera, tap the lightning icon in the bottom-left corner to turn the light on or off. 7. Spread two fingers apart on the screen to zoom in on the subject. 8. Tap the Pause icon to pause the recording, or Stop to finish recording. 9. Tap the Play icon to preview the recording before sending it. Use the recording timeline to rewind. 10–11. Tap the Recycle bin icon to delete the message, or the Up arrow icon to send it.
Add and edit a caption
Add a caption to a voice or video message. This helps colleagues understand what the message is about and find it later using chat search.
1–2. Hover over the message and click Three dots (...) > Edit . 3–4. Enter text in the input field and click the check mark to save it. The caption appears below the voice or video message.
1. Press and hold the message to open the context menu. 2. Tap Edit . 3. Enter text in the input field and tap the check mark to save it. The caption appears below the voice or video message.
Listen to or watch a message
Play a voice or video message and adjust the playback speed as needed.
Listen to a voice message.
