1. Click the Play icon to start playback. 2. Use the rewind control to return to a specific moment. 3. Click the current playback speed in the top-right corner of the message to change it. The speed cycles through 1.0x, 1.5x, and 2.0x. 4. Click the Pause icon to pause playback.
Watch a video message.

1. Click the video message to start playback with sound. 2. Click the current playback speed at the top of the message to change it. The speed cycles through 1.0x, 1.5x, and 2.0x. 3. Click the video message again to pause playback.
Listen to a voice message.

1. Tap the Play icon to start playback. 2. Use the rewind control to return to a specific moment. 3. Tap the current playback speed in the top-right corner of the message to change it. The speed cycles through 1.0x, 1.5x, and 2.0x. 4. Tap the Pause icon to pause playback.
Watch a video message.

1. Tap the video message to start playback with sound. 2. Tap the current playback speed at the top of the message to change it. The speed cycles through 1.0x, 1.5x, and 2.0x. 3. Tap the video message again to pause playback.
View a text transcript
If listening to or watching a message isn't convenient, transcribe it. Bitrix24 displays the message text.
Transcribe a voice message.
1–2. Click the → A icon in the top-right corner of the message. The transcript appears below the message. 3. Click the check mark above the text to collapse it.
Transcribe a video message.
1–2. Click the → A icon to the right of the message. The transcript appears below the message. 3. Click the check mark above the text to collapse it.
Transcribe a voice message.
1–2. Tap the → A icon in the top-right corner of the message. The transcript appears below the message. 3. Tap the check mark above the text to collapse it.
Transcribe a video message.
1–2. Tap the → A icon to the right of the message. The transcript appears below the message. 3. Tap the check mark above the text to collapse it.
Set up transcription
By default, speech transcription is enabled for voice and video messages. Administrators can turn off speech transcription.

1. In the top bar, click the icon next to your Bitrix24 name or logo. 2. Open Settings . 3–4. Go to the CoPilot preferences tab and expand the Chat with CoPilot block. 5. Turn Speech transcription on or off as needed. 6. Click Save .
In brief
- Bitrix24 Messenger supports voice and video messages.
- You can record a voice or video message only in the mobile app: press and hold the microphone icon, or the camera icon for video.
- You can add a caption to a recorded message using Edit in the message menu in both the web version and the mobile app.
- You can play messages at 1.0x, 1.5x, or 2.0x speed and view a text transcript.
- Transcription is enabled by default. Administrators can turn off the feature in CoPilot preferences .

titre: Stickers in the Bitrix24 Messenger
sections: Stickers in the Bitrix24 Messenger
In the Bitrix24 Messenger, you can use stickers to react to messages and add emotions to the chat.
Bitrix24 offers ready-made sticker packs. You can use them or add your own.
Stickers can be used in:
- Personal and group chats
- Comments on Feed posts
- Projects
- Task chats
- Send stickers
- Create your own pack
- Add stickers from colleagues
- Manage sticker packs
Send stickers
By default, all employees have access to standard sticker packs. You can use them in Bitrix24 on both desktop and mobile apps.
To send a sticker:
1. Open the chat, channel, or project.
2. Click the Emoji icon in the text input field.
3. Go to the Stickers tab.
4. Click the desired sticker. It will immediately appear in the chat.
Before you send a sticker, you can preview it. This helps when the sticker has text or small details.
Click and hold the left mouse button on the sticker. Preview mode opens. While you keep holding the button, move the cursor over nearby stickers to preview them too.
To leave preview mode, release the mouse button.
Sent stickers are saved in the Recent section. The system keeps the last 12. You can:
- Send a sticker — click on it.
- Delete a specific sticker — right-click it and select Remove from recent .
- Clear all stickers — click Three dots (...) > Clear all recently used stickers.
1. Open the chat, channel, or project. 2. Tap the Stickers icon in the input field. 3. Select a sticker. 4. Tap it to send it to the chat.
Sent stickers are saved in the Recent section. The system keeps the last 12. You can:
- Send a sticker — click on it.
- Delete a specific sticker — right-click it and select Remove from recent .
- Clear all stickers — click Three dots (...) > Clear all recently used stickers.
Create your own sticker pack
In Bitrix24, you can create custom sticker packs. Once created, send a sticker to a chat, and participants can add the entire pack to their collection.
1. Open a chat, channel, or project.
2. Click the Emoji icon in the text input field.
3. Go to the Stickers tab.
4. Click Plus (+) .
5. In the pop-up window, click Add images and select files from your computer.
6. Enter a name for your pack. If you don't, a name will be generated automatically.
7. Click Create .
8. The pack is now created, and you can send stickers from it in chats.
1. Open a chat, channel, or project.
2. Tap the Stickers icon.
3. Tap Plus (+) .
4. Select images from your phone's gallery—mark them with checkmarks.
5. Tap Send files .
6. Enter a name for the pack and tap Continue . If you don't, a name will be generated automatically.
The first uploaded sticker becomes the pack's avatar.
Add stickers from colleagues
If a colleague sends a sticker to the chat, you can add the entire pack to your collection.
1. Click on the sticker—the entire pack will open.
2. Click Add pack .
3. The pack will appear in the Stickers tab.
1. Click on the sticker—the entire pack will open.
2. Click Add pack .
3. The pack will appear in the Stickers tab.
Manage sticker packs
Your packs. You can edit, rename, or delete sticker packs you created for all users.
Edit a sticker pack:
- Add new stickers—click Plus (+) .
- Delete a specific sticker—right-click it and select Remove from pack .
Rename or delete a pack:
1. Click Three dots (...) next to the pack's name. 2. Choose an action:
- Edit —change the pack's name. It will be visible to all users.
- Delete for all —completely remove the pack for all users.
Colleagues' packs. If you added sticker packs from colleagues, you can remove them from your collection—click Three dots (...) > Remove from my collection.
Your packs. You can edit, rename, or delete sticker packs you created for all users.
To edit a pack, tap Three dots (...) > Edit and choose an action:
- Add new stickers—tap Plus (+) .
- Delete a specific sticker—tap and hold it, then select Remove from pack.
- Rename the pack—tap Three dots (...) > Rename and change the name. It will be visible to all users.
To delete a pack, tap Three dots (...) > Delete for all. The stickers will disappear for all users.
Colleagues' packs. If you added sticker packs from colleagues, you can remove them from your collection—tap Three dots (...) > Remove from my collection.
In brief
- By default, all employees have access to standard sticker packs. You can use them in Bitrix24 on both desktop and mobile apps.
- Stickers can be sent in any chat, channel, or project. Select a sticker and click on it.
- Sent stickers are saved in the Recent section—always keeping the last 12 at hand.
- In Bitrix24, you can create custom sticker packs. Once a sticker is sent to a chat, participants can add the entire pack to their collection.
- You can edit, rename, or delete your sticker packs for all users.
- If you added sticker packs from colleagues, you can remove them from your collection. Tap Three dots (...) > Remove from my collection.
- Pre-installed packs cannot be deleted.

titre: Use folders in Messenger
sections: Use folders in Messenger

Bitrix24 organizes chats into system folders. You can also create personal folders to group conversations by topic. For example, add channels, personal chats, group chats, and other conversations related to a department’s work to a "Production" folder. This makes it easier to find the conversations you need and notice new messages about a selected topic.
In this article:
- Use the folder panel
- Configure the All folder
- Create a personal folder
- Configure a personal folder
Use the folder panel
By default, chats are organized into system folders:
- All — combines conversations from selected sources. Create the All folder
- Tasks — includes chats for tasks you participate in.
- CoPilot — includes chats with AI.
- Channels — includes company channels you follow or create, including private channels.
- Projects — includes chats for projects you participate in.
- Open Channels — includes chats with clients.
- Alaio Vibecode — includes chats from apps you can access.
Personal folders you create are added to the list and appear on the panel. Create a personal folder
Open a folder. 1. Open the Messenger section from the main menu. Folders appear in the panel to the left of the chat list. 2. Click a folder to open the list of conversations added to it.

Change the folder order. 1. Click the three dots (...) at the bottom of the folder panel. 2. Select Folders. 3. Hold the dotted icon to the left of the folder name and drag the folder to the desired position. 4. Click Save .
Open a folder. 1. Open the Messenger section. Folders appear in a row above the chat list. 2. Tap a folder to open the list of conversations added to it.
Change the folder order.
1. Tap the three dots (...) at the end of the folder list. 2. Hold a folder and move it to the desired position. 3. Tap Save .
Configure the All folder

The system All folder combines conversations from selected sources. Personal chats, group chats, and meeting chats always appear in this folder. You can turn task chats, CoPilot, channels, and projects on or off.
Configure the folder from its context menu, the folder panel menu, or the folder list.
Use the All folder context menu.
1. Right-click the All folder in the folder panel. 2. Select Edit . 3. Turn the required sources on or off. 4. Click Save .
Use the folder panel menu. 1. Click the three dots (...) at the bottom of the folder panel. 2. Click Configure "All" folder. 4. Turn sources on or off. 5. Click Save .
Use the folder list.

1. Click the three dots (...) at the bottom of the folder panel. 2. Select Folders . 3. Click the three dots (...) to the right of the All folder. 4. Select Configure . 5. Turn sources on or off. 6. Click Save .
Configure the folder from its context menu or the folder list.
Use the folder context menu.
1. Press and hold the All folder. 2. Select Set up . 3. Turn sources on or off. 4. Tap Save .
Use the folder list. 1. Tap the three dots (...) at the end of the folder list. 2. To the right of the All folder, tap the three dots (...) and select Edit. 3. Turn sources on or off. 4. Tap Save .
Create a personal folder
Create a new folder from the folder panel menu, the folder list, or the chat list. The folder opens automatically after you create it.
Use the folder panel menu.
1. In Messenger, click the three dots (...) at the bottom of the folder panel. 2. Select Create folder . 3. Enter a folder name. 4. Click Add and select the conversations you need. 5. Click Create .
Use the folder list.

1. Right-click any folder to open the context menu. 2. Select Folders . 3. In the upper-right corner of the folder list, click Create folder . 4. Enter a folder name. 5. Click Add and select the conversations you need. 6. Click Create .
Use the chat list. This method is available only if you do not have any personal folders yet.
1. Right-click the chat you want to add to a personal folder. 2. Select Add to folder > Create folder . 3. Enter a folder name. 4. Click Add and select the conversations you need. 5. Click Create .
Create a new folder from the folder panel menu or the folder list. The folder opens automatically after you create it.

Use the chat list. 1. In Messenger, tap Plus (+) in the lower-right corner. 2. Select Folder . 3. Enter a folder name. 4. Tap Add and select the conversations you need. 5. Tap Add . 6. Review the folder contents. To remove a chat from the selection, tap the X next to it. 7. Tap Create .

Use the folder list. 1. Tap the three dots (...) at the end of the folder list. 2. Tap Plus (+) in the lower-right corner. 3. Enter a folder name. 4–5. Tap Add and select the conversations you need. 6. Tap Add . 7. Review the folder contents. To remove a chat from the selection, tap the X next to it. 8. Tap Create .
Configure a personal folder
Add a chat to a folder.
1. Right-click a chat in the chat list. 2. Select Add to folder . 3. Select one or more personal folders.

Edit a personal folder — change its name or contents. 1. Right-click the folder. 2. Select Edit . 3. Enter a new name. 4. Click the X next to a conversation name to remove it from the folder. 5. Click Add and select the conversations you want to add to the folder. 6. Click Save .

Delete a personal folder — conversations remain in Bitrix24 and in any other folders they belong to. 1. Right-click the folder to open the context menu. 2. Select Delete . 3. Click Delete in the confirmation window.
Add a chat to a folder.
1. Press and hold the chat to open the context menu. 2. Tap Add to folder . 3. Select one or more personal folders. 4. Tap Save .

Set up a personal folder — change its name or chat contents. 1. Press and hold the folder to open the context menu. 2. Select Set up . 3. Enter a new name. 4. Tap the X next to a conversation name to remove it from the folder. 5. Tap Add and select the conversations you need. 6. Review the list, tap Add , and save your changes.
Delete a personal folder — conversations remain in Bitrix24 and in any other folders they belong to.
1. Press and hold the folder to open the context menu. 2. Select Delete. 3. Tap Yes, delete in the confirmation window.
In brief
- You can group chats into folders on a computer and in the Bitrix24 mobile app. By default, chats are organized into system folders, but you can create personal folders and add chats by topic.

- The All folder displays conversations from selected sources. Personal chats, group chats, and meeting chats always appear, while task chats, CoPilot, channels, and projects appear only if you choose to include them. To turn a source on or off, right-click the All folder, select Set up , and select the sources you need.
- To create a personal folder, click the three dots (...) at the bottom of the folder panel, select Create folder , enter a name, and add chats.
- To add a chat to a folder, right-click it, select Add to folder , and choose the folder you need.
- You can set up a personal folder at any time by changing its name or chat contents. Right-click the folder and select Set up .

titre: Invite guests to a chat in Bitrix24
sections: Invite guests to a chat in Bitrix24
Invite clients, contractors, or partners to a Bitrix24 chat when you need to discuss work with them. Messages and files stay in one place. Guests can join the chat without registering in Bitrix24.
Guests can send text, audio, and video messages, as well as files. They only have access to the chat they were invited to. When the discussion ends, you can keep or remove their access.
In this article:
- Configure a chat for guest invitations
- Invite a guest to a chat
- View the chat as a guest
- Remove guest access from a chat
Configure a chat for guest invitations
To invite guests, enable guest invitations in the chat. By default, only the chat owner and moderators can invite guests.
You can enable guest invitations when you create a chat or change the settings later. Group chat
When creating a chat
1. Go to Messenger .
2. Click the pencil icon next to the search bar and select Group chat .
3. Open Access permissions .
4. In Permission to invite guests , choose one option:
1. All members — any chat member can invite a guest.
2. Owner and moderators — only the chat owner and assigned moderators can invite guests.
3. Owner only — only the chat creator can invite guests.
5. Click Create chat to save your changes.
In an existing chat
The chat owner or moderators can change the access settings.
1. Open the sidebar.
2. In the top-right corner, click More (...) > Edit .
3. Open Access permissions .
4. In Permission to invite guests , choose one option:
1. All members
2. Owner and moderators
3. Owner only
5. Save your changes.
Invite a guest to a chat
Open the chat and click the Add members icon in the top-right corner. Then open the Guests tab.
You can invite a guest in three ways:
By link. Click Copy link and send the link to the guest. They can open it and join the chat right away. They do not need to register or install an app.
By email. Enter the guest's email address in the Enter guest email or phone number field and click Add . The guest receives an email with a link to the chat.
By SMS. This option is available only in the cloud version of Bitrix24. Enter the guest's phone number and click Add . The guest receives an SMS with a link to the chat.
In Messenger , open the chat and tap the chat name in the header to open the sidebar. From there, copy the invitation link or invite a guest by SMS, email, or QR code.
Copy the invitation link. In the chat sidebar, tap Chat invite link and select Guest link . The link is copied to your clipboard. Send it to the guest using any app.
Choose an invitation method
1. Open the Members tab and tap Add .
2. Open the Guests tab. To copy the invitation link from here, tap Invite via link .
3. To invite a guest by SMS, email, or QR code, tap Other ways to invite and select an option.
By SMS.
1. Enter the guest's phone number and tap Continue .
2. Enter the name to display for the guest in the chat and tap Invite . The guest receives an SMS with a link to the chat.
By email.
1. Enter the guest's email address and tap Invite . To invite several people, enter their addresses separated by spaces.
2. For each address, enter the name to display in the chat and confirm the invitation. The guest receives an email with a link to the chat.
By QR code. Show the QR code to the guest, for example, during an in-person meeting. The guest scans the code with their phone camera and opens the invitation.
View the chat as a guest
When guests open the invitation link, they can join the chat without registering in Bitrix24 or installing an app. Before joining, they can enter a name or skip this step.

Guests can access only this chat and nothing else in your Bitrix24. The chat header shows how many guests have joined. Guests can send messages in the group chat and message chat members directly. They can only see messages sent after they join the chat.
A guest can leave the chat when the discussion ends:
1. Open the sidebar.
2. Click More (...) in the top-right corner.
3. Click Leave .
After the guest taps the link, the Bitrix24 mobile app launches. Before joining the chat, they can enter a name.
Guests can send messages in the group chat and message chat members directly. They can only see messages sent after they join the chat.
Remove guest access from a chat
You can remove guests when they no longer need access, for example, after the discussion ends.

Reset the invitation link. Use this option to revoke access for all guests who joined with the current link. For example, reset the link when a project ends or external participants no longer need access.
Anyone who can invite guests can also reset the link. By default, this includes the chat owner and moderators.
1. Click the Add members icon in the top-right corner.
2. In the panel, click the arrows icon to reset the link.
All guests who joined with the current link are removed, and the old link stops working.
You can also reset the link from the chat sidebar:
1. Click the sidebar icon.
2. Click Three dots (...) next to the invitation link.
3. In the Guest link section, click Create new link .
Remove a specific guest. Use this option to remove one guest without affecting the others. For example, you can remove a contractor who has finished their work while keeping the client in the chat.
After you remove a guest, they lose access to the chat. If the invitation link is still active, they can use it to join again. To block their access, reset the link after removing them.
Anyone who can invite guests can also remove them. By default, this includes the chat owner and moderators.
1. Click the sidebar icon.
2. Click the member avatars below the chat name.
3. Click Three dots (...) next to the guest's name.
4. Select Remove from chat.

Disable guest invitations in Bitrix24. A Bitrix24 administrator can disable guest invitations for the entire account. For example, you may want to do this after a temporary project ends. All guests will lose access to all chats.
1. Go to Settings > Bitrix24 settings.
2. Open Communications > Chats.
3. Turn off the option to add guests to chats and click Save .
Reset the invitation link.
1. Open the Members tab and tap Add .
2. Open the Guests tab, tap Change link , and confirm the action.
All guests who joined with the current link are removed, and the old link stops working.
Remove a specific guest.
1. Open the Members tab and tap Add .
2. Open the Guests tab, tap Three dots (...) next to the guest's name, select Remove from chat , and confirm the action.
After you remove a guest, they lose access to the chat. If the invitation link is still active, they can use it to join again. To block their access, reset the link after removing them.
In brief
- Invite external participants, such as clients, contractors, and partners, directly to Bitrix24 chats. Guests can join through a link without registering in Bitrix24.
- To invite guests, enable this option in the chat. By default, the chat owner and moderators can invite guests.
- You can enable guest invitations when you create a chat or change the settings later.
- Guests can access only the chat they were invited to and nothing else in Bitrix24.
- When guests no longer need access, remove them individually or reset the invitation link.

titre: Chats in Bitrix24: Design and features
sections: Chats in Bitrix24: Design and features

Bitrix24 offers direct and group chats for team communication. Use direct chats for private conversations and group chats for department or company-wide discussions. Direct chats are confidential and not accessible to administrators.
You can mute, pin, hide, or mark chats to read later.
In this article, you'll learn how to:
- Find and open a chat
- Check message delivery status
- Pin a chat
- Mute or hide a chat
- Find chats with a specific employee
- Access message history
- Mark messages to read later
- Find a chat with a dismissed employee
Find and open a chat . Chats are sorted by the date of the last message. Here are two ways to open a chat:
1. Chat sidebar on the right. Find and click the chat icon. If you don't see the needed one, click the magnifying glass icon and type your colleague's name or the group chat name.
2. Messenger section in the left menu. To open a chat,
1. Go to Messenger .
2. Select Chats .
3. Click on the search bar.
Bitrix24 will show recent conversations first, then the chats you were looking for. If you don't see the needed chat, type your colleague's name or the group chat name.
Direct chats are available to all employees by default. You can create unlimited group chats. Create and configure group chats

Check message delivery status . You can see the delivery status in the upper right corner of the chat. A gray tick (1) means the message was delivered, and a blue double tick (2) means the message was read.
In group chats, a message is considered read if it is viewed by at least one member.
Pin a chat . Keep important chats visible by pinning them.
1. Right-click the chat in the list and click Pin chat .
2. A pin icon will appear next to the pinned chat.
You can unpin chats in the same way.

Mute a chat . You can disable sound notifications only in group chats. This option is useful if you receive a lot of messages that do not require your immediate reaction. You will still get notifications if mentioned.
1. Right-click the group chat in the list.
2. Select Mute .
Hide a chat . You can hide direct and group chats if messages rarely come, but it is important not to miss them. The chat won't be deleted and will reappear when a new message is received.
1. Right-click the chat in the list.
2. Click Hide chat .

Find chats with a specific employee . You can find chats with a specific employee, including group chats and video conferences you both belong to. This helps supervisors check if new employees are in all important chats.
1. Right-click the chat in the list.
2. Click Find chats with this user .
3. A slider with a chat list will open on the right, and you can choose the needed chat.
Access message history . To find a specific message,
1. Open the chat and click the magnifying glass icon.
2. Enter the keyword, and Bitrix24 will display all messages containing this word.
Mark a chat to read later . To keep track of important messages,
1. Right-click the chat in the list.
2. Click Mark to read later .
3. A blue dot will appear next to the chat.
4. A counter in the left menu will show the number of chats with unread messages.
Find a chat with a dismissed employee .
1. Go to Company .
2. Select the Employees tab.
3. Click on the search bar and select the Dismissed persons filter.
4. Open the Menu (☰) next to the desired employee.
5. Click Send message .
You can also open the dismissed employee's profile and click Message log .
If you can't find the dismissed employee, ask your Bitrix24 administrator to enable this option. Here's how:
1. Go to the account settings and select Employees .
2. Expand Invitations .
3. Enable the Show dismissed employees option.

Bitrix24 chats are a convenient tool for team communication. You can mute, pin, hide, or mark chats to read later. Only company employees can access chats, while dismissed users lose access automatically.
Read also:
- Bitrix24 M1 chat
- Bitrix24 Chat: new messenger and AI

titre: Auto delete messages option in Bitrix24 chats
sections: Auto delete messages option in Bitrix24 chats

Bitrix24 now offers the option to automatically delete messages in chats. You can set a retention period after which messages are automatically deleted. This is useful for discussing temporary issues or handling confidential information, such as coordinating vacation schedules or storing personal data.
Enable auto delete messages option
You can enable auto delete messages option in:
- one-to-one chats
- group chats
- projects
Auto delete messages option can be enabled in new and existing chats.
In a new chat . When creating a new chat, enable the Auto delete messages option in the settings and select the period after which messages will be deleted. Types of Bitrix24 chats
In an existing chat .
1. Open the chat sidebar.
2. Enable the Auto delete messages option.
3. Specify the time after which messages in the chat will be deleted.
4. All chat participants will receive a notification that the auto delete messages option is activated. The chat will be marked with a special icon.
Edit settings or disable auto delete messages option
The settings can be edited by:
- Any participant in one-to-one chats
- Creators and administrators in group chats and projects, as well as Bitrix24 administrators
1. Open the chat sidebar.
2. Disable the Auto delete messages option or change the deletion period.
When changing the auto delete period:
- new messages are deleted according to the new rules
- old messages retain the previous deletion period
When disabling auto delete option:
- new messages are not deleted
- old messages continue to be deleted according to the previously set rules
When you change the settings, all chat participants will receive a notification.
In brief
- Bitrix24 allows you to set up automatic message deletion in chats after a specified time. This is useful for discussing temporary issues or handling confidential data.
- Auto delete messages option can be enabled in one-to-one chats, in group chats, and in projects.
- When changing auto delete settings, new rules apply only to messages sent after the change. Previously sent messages continue to be deleted under the old conditions.

titre: Notification center: How to get activity reminders
sections: Notification center: How to get activity reminders

CRM Counters help you stay on top of your activities and complete them on time. Use the Activity Reminder feature to get more notifications about upcoming activities. By default, it is enabled for the site, Bitrix24 Messenger, and mobile app, but you can also enable email notifications. Reminders are sent 15 minutes before the deadline and at the start of each activity. This time period can be adjusted. Personalize activity reminders in CRM
How to enable notifications
Click on your profile and select Notifications .
Switch to Advanced mode . In the CRM section, select the way you want to get notifications:
- Site and applications
- E-mail
- Push notifications
How it works
If you are online, you'll see a pop-up notification reminding you about an upcoming activity in the top-right corner.
If you are offline, you can find these notifications later by clicking the bell icon on the right panel.
A notification includes the activity and deal name, as well as the deadline.
In brief
- Activity reminders are enabled by default.
- You can configure activity reminders under Notifications . Switch to Advanced mode and select the method of receiving such notifications.
- If you miss an activity reminder, you can find it among other notifications by clicking the bell icon on the right panel.

titre: Hotkeys and message formatting in Bitrix24 Messenger
sections: Hotkeys and message formatting in Bitrix24 Messenger
Bitrix24 Messenger brings together personal chats, public and private chats, client chats, channels, CoPilot, and video calls.
Text formatting helps make messages clear and easy to read. For example, you can highlight important text or add a link.
You can format messages in three ways:
- Use BB codes
- Use keyboard shortcuts
- Use the built-in menu in the mobile app
Keyboard shortcuts also help you quickly perform actions in chats and during calls.
In this article:
- Use BBCode
- Format messages
- Use hotkeys
Use BBCode
BBCode is a simple markup language. It uses tags in square brackets to format text.
Basic examples
Make text bold Use [B][/B] . Place your text between the tags. Example: [B]Greetings, colleagues![/B] → Greetings, colleagues!
Add a link to text Use [URL=][/URL] . Add the link after = and place the clickable text between the tags. Example: [URL=https://www.bitrix24.com/prices/]our site[/URL] → our site (with link)
Combine styles You can combine tags. Example: [B][I]Text[/I][/B] → Text
Supported BBCode tags
Description | Tag | Result
Bold | [B]Text[/B] | Text
Italic | [I]Text[/I] | Text
Underline | [U]Text[/U] | Text
Strikethrough | [S]Text[/S] | Text
Link | [URL=link]Text[/URL] | Clickable text
Quote | >>Text | Quoted text
Combined styles | [B][I][U][S]Text[/S][/U][/I][/B] | Multiple styles
Emoji | :D , ;-) | Emoji
User mention | [USER=111]Name[/USER] | Mentioned user
Icon | [ICON=url title=Text] | Image icon
Text color | [COLOR=#ff0000]Text[/COLOR] | Colored text
Font size | [SIZE=16]Text[/SIZE] | Larger text
You can try other BBCode variations found online. Some may work in Bitrix24 chats.
Format messages
Use the built-in formatting menu in the message field to make text bold or italic, add links, and more.
1. Enter your text in the message field. Select the text you want to format and click it.
2. In the menu that appears, choose one of these options:
- Bold
- Italic
- Underline
- Strikethrough — adds a line through the text
- Link — turns the text into a clickable link
- Code — formats the text as a code snippet.
To add a link:
1. Select the text you want to turn into a link and click it.
2. Click the chain icon.
3. Enter the link address and confirm the change.
Use the built-in menu in the Bitrix24 mobile app to format text, add links, and more.
1. Enter your text in the message field. Select the text you want to format and tap it. 2. In the menu that appears, tap Format . 3. Choose one of these options:
- Bold
- Italic
- Underline
- Strikethrough — adds a line through the text
- Link — turns the text into a clickable link
- Code — formats the text as a code snippet
To add a link:
1. Select the text you want to turn into a link. 2. Tap Format > Link. 3. In the window that opens, enter the link address and tap Done .
Use hotkeys
Hotkeys are keyboard shortcuts that help you perform actions faster without using a mouse.
In the web version of Bitrix24, hotkeys work only in chats and channels. In the Bitrix24 Messenger app, they work in chats, calls, and channels. You cannot create custom hotkeys.
View available hotkeys
Go to Settings (⚙️) > Messenger settings > Hotkeys .
Chat and text formatting shortcuts
Action | Windows | macOS
Edit last message | ↑ | ↑
Select all text | Ctrl + A | Cmd + A
Bold text | Ctrl + B | Cmd + B
Italic text | Ctrl + I | Cmd + I
Underline text | Ctrl + U | Cmd + U
Strikethrough | Ctrl + S | Cmd + S
Video call shortcuts
Action | Windows | macOS
Turn microphone on/off | Ctrl + Shift + A | Cmd + Shift + A
Push-to-talk | Hold Space | Hold Space
Start/stop screen sharing | Ctrl + Shift + S | Cmd + Shift + S
Turn camera on/off | Ctrl + Shift + V | Cmd + Shift + V
Start/stop recording | Ctrl + Shift + R | Cmd + Shift + R
Raise/lower hand | Ctrl + Shift + H | Cmd + Shift + H
Collapse/expand call | Ctrl + Shift + C | Cmd + Shift + C
Switch view mode | Ctrl + Shift + W | Cmd + Shift + W
Mute/unmute participants | Ctrl + Shift + M | Cmd + Shift + M
Open/close participants list | Ctrl + Shift + U | Cmd + Shift + U

Using BBCodes and hotkeys in Bitrix24 Messenger simplifies and speeds up your work. BBCodes let you format text, making messages more readable and structured. Hotkeys enable you to act quickly without needing to use the mouse or navigate menus.
In brief
- You can format a message in three ways: with BB codes, keyboard shortcuts, or the built-in menu in the mobile app. Keyboard shortcuts also help you act faster in chats and during calls.
- BB code is a markup language for message formatting. It uses tags in square brackets. For example, to make text bold, use the BB code . Put the text between the [B] and [/B] tags.
- In the mobile app, to make part of a message bold or italic, add a link, or apply other formatting, select the text and tap it.
- Keyboard shortcuts are key combinations that let you perform actions without using a mouse or menu. For example, you can cut, copy, paste, mute or unmute your microphone, and more.

- In Bitrix24 in a browser, keyboard shortcuts are available only in chats and channels. In the Bitrix24 desktop app, they are available in chats, calls, and channels. Custom keyboard shortcuts are not supported yet.

titre: Polls in Bitrix24 chats
sections: Polls in Bitrix24 chats

Polls in Bitrix24 help quickly gather employee opinions, collect feedback, and make decisions based on real data. For example, you can choose a date for a corporate event, collect feedback on a new process, or decide which logo is better.
You can create polls:
- In chats
- In channels
- In projects
This article explains how to create and configure polls in Bitrix24 on web and mobile.
Create and configure a poll.
1. Open the chat, channel, or project you want.
2. Click the paperclip icon and select Poll .
3. Enter your question and answer options.
4. Click Add option if you need more. You can add unlimited options.
5. Enable the Allow multiple choices option to let participants choose more than one option.
6. Adjust the poll settings:
- Anonymous poll: You'll see the number of votes for each option, but participant names will be hidden. If the option is disabled, names are visible.
- Allow revoting: Participants can change their choice.
Once a poll is created, you can't edit the question or answer options.
View poll results. The results are displayed in the chat. To see how each person voted, click on the number of votes. Participant names are shown only in public polls.
Polls are only available to members of the chat where they were created.
To download the poll results in Excel, click the corresponding button. The file will be saved to your computer.
Apply other actions to a poll. Click the three dots (...) and select an action:
- Reply: Leave a comment on the poll. The poll message will appear as a quote.
- Revote: Change your choice if the poll settings allow it.
- Pin: Pin the poll to keep it from getting lost in the chat.
- Add to Favorites: Save the poll to come back to it later.
- End poll: Only the poll creator can do this. Once ended, no one can vote anymore, and the poll can't be resumed.
- Delete: Only the poll creator can delete it.
Create and configure a poll.
1. Open the chat, channel, or project you want.
2. Tap the paperclip icon and select Poll .
3. Enter your question and answer options. Tap Add option if you need more. You can add unlimited options.
4. Enable the Allow multiple choices option to let participants choose more than one option.
5. Enable Anonymous poll , and you'll see the number of votes for each option, but participant names will be hidden. If the option is disabled, names are visible.
6. Enable Allow revoting to let participants change their choice.
7. Tap Create poll .
Once a poll is created, you can't edit the question or answer options.
View poll results. To see how each person voted, click on the number of votes. Participant names are shown only in public polls.
Apply other actions to a poll. Tap and hold the poll message, then select an action:
- Add a reaction.
- Reply: Leave a comment on the poll. The poll message will appear as a quote.
- Revote: Change your choice if the poll settings allow it.
- Copy link: Share the poll with colleagues. Polls are only available to members of the chat where they were created.
- Pin: Pin the poll to keep it from getting lost in the chat.
- End poll: Only the poll creator can do this. Once ended, no one can vote anymore, and the poll can't be resumed.
- Delete: Only the poll creator can delete it.
In brief
- Polls in Bitrix24 help quickly gather employee opinions, collect feedback, and make decisions based on real data.
- You can create polls in chats, channels, and projects in Bitrix24 on web and mobile.
- To create a poll, click the paperclip icon in a chat, channel, or project.
- You can create anonymous and public polls.
- Polls can be copied, pinned in a chat, deleted, and more.
- Only the poll creator can end the poll.

titre: Notes in Bitrix24 chats
sections: Notes in Bitrix24 chats

Notes is a personal chat in Bitrix24 that only you can see. Use it to store important information, save messages, and keep files in one place. This helps you quickly find what you need without searching through work chats.
Find notes
Notes are available in both the desktop and mobile apps.
To open Notes:
1. Open Messenger.
2. Enter "Notes" in the search bar.
3. Select the chat from the results.
To keep Notes easy to access, right-click the chat name and select Pin .
To open Notes:
1. Open Messenger and tap the magnifying glass.
2. Type "Notes" in the search bar.
Pin notes to keep them from getting lost in the chat list:
1. Find Notes manually in the chat list.
2. Swipe the chat to the right and tap Pin .
Save and manage information
You can store different types of content in Notes:
- Text – type messages just like in any chat
- Files – upload documents, images, or videos
- Messages – forward messages from other chats
To find a message:
1. Click the magnifying glass.
2. Enter a word or a phrase from the message in the search bar.
3. Click the fragment that appears in the sidebar to go to the message.
To quickly find documents, media files, and links, use the chat sidebar.
- Favorite messages
- Links from messages
- Media and files
If a note is no longer needed:
1. Click the three dots next to it.
2. Select Delete .
Tap the chat name to open the sidebar and view:
- Documents
- Links
To delete an unnecessary message from Notes, press and hold it, then select Delete .
In brief:
- Notes are a personal chat in Bitrix24 visible only to you. Use it to jot down important information, save messages, or store files.
- Notes are available on both desktop and mobile apps.
- Enter "Notes" or your last name in the search bar to open the chat. Pin the chat to keep it easily accessible.
- Search in Notes works for text, files, and links.
- Unnecessary messages can be deleted.

titre: Install and use chatbots in Bitrix24
sections: Install and use chatbots in Bitrix24
A chatbot is a virtual assistant that handles simple tasks. For example, it can send reminders, answer questions, or find information on request.
You can browse available chatbots in the Bitrix24 Market. Use the search bar to explore options.
In this article:
- Install a chatbot from the Market
- Create your own chatbot
Install a chatbot from the Market
Follow these steps:
1. Open the left menu and click Applications .
2. Select Market .
3. Use the search bar to find a chatbot.
4. Open the app page.
5. Click Install .
6. Review and accept the terms and conditions.
To start using the chatbot:
1. Go to Messenger .
2. Open the Chats section.
3. Find your new chatbot in the list.
Create your own chatbot

You can build a custom chatbot and connect it to Bitrix24 using the REST API. If you prefer not to build it yourself, contact a certified Bitrix24 partner for help. Bitrix24 REST API: Create a chatbot Bitrix24 Partners
In brief
- A chatbot is a virtual assistant that handles simple tasks like reminders, answers, and search.
- You can find many chatbots in the Bitrix24 Market.
- Only Bitrix24 administrators can install or remove chatbots.

titre: Allow multiple downloads in Google Chrome
sections: Allow multiple downloads in Google Chrome
By default, Google Chrome blocks the automatic downloads of multiple files at once. To save several files from Bitrix24 chats, you'll need to change this setting in your browser.
If you've blocked multiple file downloads before, here's how to fix it:
1. In the Bitrix24 chat, open the three-dot menu (...) next to the desired message.
2. Select Download all files .
3. Click Download blocked in the browser.
4. Select Always allow xxxxx.bitrix24.com to download multiple files .
5. Click Done .
You only need to give download permission once. After that, files will be saved without limitations.
To re-enable the blocking, select Continue blocking automatic downloads of multiple files when saving files.

titre: Copy a link to a group chat
sections: Quick answer
Open the chat. Click Subscribers > Copy chat link . Send the link to your colleagues or add it to the knowledge base.
Detailed answer
In Bitrix24, you can share a link to a group chat. This helps you avoid adding each new employee manually. For example, place chat links in your knowledge base so new employees can join on their own.
Private chats do not support links. Add participants to those chats manually.
Copy a chat link
1. Open the chat.
2. Click Subscribers .
3. Click Copy chat link .
Copy the link from the chat sidebar
1. Open the chat.
2. Click the sidebar icon.
3. Click subscribers' images.
4. Click Copy chat link .
Use chat links to speed up onboarding and give new employees quick access to team conversations.

titre: Create a task or an event from a message
sections: Create a task or an event from a message
You can quickly turn a chat message into a task or a meeting. This helps you capture decisions and next steps without leaving the conversation. Everyone in the chat is added automatically.
Create a task
Select a message, post, or comment. Right-click it or open the menu (three dots), then click More > Create task .
A task panel will open. The selected message is added to the task description. You can edit it if needed. The original message stays unchanged.
Enter a task name, fill in the required fields, and click Set task.
When you create a task from a chat:
- You become the task creator and assignee.
- In a private chat, the other person is added as an observer.
- In a group chat, all participants become observers.
- In channels, add observers manually.
The chat will show a system message, such as “{Name} created a task from message.” You can click the highlighted text to open the task or return to the original message.
Create a meeting
Select a message, post, or comment. Right-click it or open the menu (three dots), then click More > Create meeting .
In the panel:
- Enter a meeting name.
- Set the date and time.
- Choose a calendar (personal or company).
The message text is added to the meeting description. You can edit or remove it. The original message will not change.
Click Save to create the meeting.
All participants will see a system notification, such as “{Name} created an event from message.” They can accept or decline the invitation.
To track responses, enable Notify when attendees confirm or decline invitation.
Viewing the list of appointments and tasks
To see a list of all appointments and tasks that have been created in the chat room, click Sidebar.
Click on the name of a task or an event to get details or to edit them. Each item has a menu. Tap dots to:
- view the message on the basis of which a task or an event was created in the chat,
- copy the link to a task or an event,
- delete a task or an event link to the chat.
To view a list of all appointments and tasks that have been created in the chat, click the Sidebar.
In brief:
- To instantly record agreements and plans with colleagues, create a task or a a meeting directly from a message in a chat.

- All chat participants will be added automatically. When you create a task based on a message in a private chat, you are the task creator and executor, and your conversation partner is the observer. In a group chat, all chat participants will be observers.
- You can view a list of all appointments and tasks in the Sidebar.

titre: Bitrix24 Sync: Meeting brief and document creation during a call
sections: Bitrix24 Sync: Meeting brief and document creation during a call
In Bitrix24, you can create briefs and edit documents during a call. After the call, share the files with clients or colleagues who are not in the meeting chat.
In this article:
- Create a meeting brief
- Create a document
- Open recent briefs
- Edit a document or meeting brief
- Set up document access permissions
Create a meeting brief
Click Document , select Meeting brief , and choose a template. The templates vary in design but function the same.
The meeting brief template includes:
- Chat name or calendar event name
- Attendees' names
- Meeting date and time
Any call attendee can create and view a meeting brief. The file is sent to the chat and saved on Bitrix24 Drive once a template is selected.
Use meeting briefs to quickly record questions and define tasks with deadlines. In the next call, you can discuss your progress with colleagues.
Create a document
Click Document and select Create document . Decide whether you want to create a text document, spreadsheet, or presentation. The file is sent to the chat and saved on Bitrix24 Drive once created.
Use this option to draft a document and finalize it later.
Open recent briefs
Click Document , select Open recent briefs , and choose a file from the list. Any call attendee can open and view a brief.
Edit a document or meeting brief

Open a file in the chat and click Edit . Select Bitrix24.Docs to view and edit with colleagues in real time. To save the changes, click File and select Save . An updated file version will appear in the chat.
You can collaborate on a document with your colleagues at any time. The allowed number of collaborators depends on the Bitrix24 plan.
Set up document access permissions
By default, all call attendees can edit the files. After the call, you can also share the files with clients or colleagues who are not in the meeting chat.
Invite colleagues to collaborate . Click Edit permissions > Collaborate > Add more . Select the access level: read, add, edit, or full access. Save the changes.
Your colleague will receive a notification to attach the file to their Drive. They can do this or refuse. If attached, the original document will be saved on their Drive.
Set up public access . Click Edit permissions > Public access . Turn on the toggle switch to activate this option. By default, users have read permissions.
Click Settings (⚙️) to edit extra options:
- Set an expiration date and time
- Set a password to view the document
- Allow editing
In brief
- In Bitrix24, you can create briefs and edit documents during a call. Any call attendee can do this.
- Use a meeting brief to record questions and define tasks with deadlines. Create documents, spreadsheets, and presentations as drafts and finalize them later.
- The file is sent to the chat and saved on Bitrix24 Drive.
- Collaborate on a document with your colleagues at any time. The allowed number of collaborators depends on the Bitrix24 plan. An updated file version will appear in the chat.
- After the call, you can share the files with clients or colleagues who are not in the meeting chat. To do this, invite colleagues to collaborate or set up public access for clients.

titre: Create Zoom meetings from CRM and chats
sections: Create Zoom meetings from CRM and chats
Schedule Zoom meetings and join them directly from the client form in CRM and from the chat. To invite a client, send them a link from Bitrix24 by email, SMS, or WhatsApp.
In this article:
- Connect and disconnect your Zoom account in Bitrix24
- Create Zoom meetings in CRM
- Create Zoom meetings in Bitrix24 chat
- Where Zoom meeting recordings are stored
Check if Zoom integration is available on your plan. Bitrix24 pricing page
This option is not provided in the Bitrix24 On-premise version. You can take advantage of video conferencing in Bitrix24. Video Conferencing in Bitrix24
Connect and disconnect your Zoom account in Bitrix24
To connect Zoom to Bitrix24:
1. Open your Bitrix24 profile and click Security .
2. Go to the Social Platforms tab and click Connect .
3. If you don't have a Zoom account, click Sign Up Free . Sign in with your email and password, or via social networks and services.
The Zoom account is connected to Bitrix24, and you can create Zoom conferences from CRM or chats.
To disconnect Zoom from Bitrix24:
1. Open your Bitrix24 profile and click Security .
2. Go to the Social Platforms tab and click Disconnect .
3. Click OK to confirm.
The number of participants and meeting duration depend on the Zoom subscription plan of the meeting host. Zoom pricing page
Create Zoom meetings in CRM
To create a Zoom meeting:
1. Go to CRM and open the client form.
2. In the timeline, click More and select Zoom .
3. Enter the name and select the meeting time and duration.
4. Click Create .
The meeting appears under My activities in CRM. This activity can be viewed by the meeting host and all employees with permissions to access this person's CRM entities.

The meeting will also be added to the calendar of the employee who scheduled it. It will have a default name, not the one you specified in CRM. To change it, click on the event block and select Edit in the pop-up window.
In edit mode, change the event name, invite colleagues, and add the Zoom meeting link to the description. Save the changes.
Copy the meeting details and send the link to your client by email, SMS, or WhatsApp. Manage emails with CRM Using SMS in Bitrix24 Send WhatsApp messages from CRM
Join the Zoom meeting . To join a meeting, click Start meeting . The Zoom website or app will open automatically.
Create Zoom meetings in Bitrix24 chat
Create a Zoom meeting from a chat to discuss work issues with colleagues. Zoom meetings are available for both direct and group chats. You can't invite external guests.
To create a Zoom meeting:
1. Open a chat.
2. Expand the Video call menu.
3. Select Zoom meeting room .

A message will appear in the chat informing users that a conference is scheduled. Discuss the meeting time with colleagues in the chat. To join, click Join call . The Zoom website or app will open automatically.
Where Zoom meeting recordings are stored
If you create a Zoom meeting in a CRM item form and record it in the web version of Zoom, the recording will be stored in your Zoom account and CRM item form. You can listen to it and download it.
If you create a meeting from a CRM item form or in a chat and record it from the desktop version of Zoom, the recording will be saved to your computer.
In brief
- Schedule Zoom meetings and join them directly from the client's form in CRM and from the chat.
- The number of participants and meeting duration depend on the Zoom subscription plan of the meeting host.
- The link to the Zoom meeting appears automatically in the CRM item form and in Zoom.
- The meeting appears under My activities in CRM. This activity can be viewed by the meeting host and all employees with permissions to access this person's CRM entities.
- The meeting is also added to the calendar of the employee who scheduled it.
- If you create a Zoom meeting in a CRM item form and record it in the web version of Zoom, the recording will be stored in your Zoom account and CRM item form. You can listen to it and download it.
- If you create a meeting from a CRM item form or in a chat and record it from the desktop version of Zoom, the recording will be saved to your computer.

titre: Video conferencing in Bitrix24
sections: Video conferencing in Bitrix24

Video conferences are group calls between employees and external users, like customers and partners. When you create a video conference, a link is automatically generated. Invited guests don’t need to register in Bitrix24 or download any apps—they can just click the link and join the call from their phone or computer.
Group calls in Bitrix24 Cloud and On-Premise versions are limited to 100 attendees. Bitrix24 plans and pricing
In this article:
- Create a video conference
- Join a video conference
- Use the video conference menu
Create a video conference
You can create a video conference in the Employees and Messenger sections.
In the Employees section.
1. Go to Employees .
2. Open the Video Conferencing tab.
3. Click Create .
4. Enter a name for the conference.
5. Invite colleagues: To add specific employees, type their names. To add an entire department, go to the Departments tab and select the one you need.
6. Set a password to control access.
7. Customize the invitation message for external guests by clicking the pencil icon.

8. The invitation message automatically includes the following fields: #CREATOR#: The name of the person who created the conference. #TITLE#: The conference name. #LINK#: The link to join the conference.
9. Click Create .
Once the video conference is created, it will show up in the list. Here’s what you can do:
- Click the conference name (1) to copy the invitation text (2).
- Start the video conference by clicking Start (3).
- Copy just the link by clicking Link (4).
- Edit, open the chat, or delete the conference using the menu under the three dots (...) button (5).
Bitrix24 automatically creates a chat for the video conference. You can use it to welcome participants before the call begins and share information after it ends.
In the Messenger section.
1. Go to Messenger .
2. Click the button to create a new chat.
3. Select Video conference .
4. Enter a name for the conference.
5. Upload an icon.
6. Add participants: To add specific employees, type their names. To add an entire department, go to the Departments tab and select the needed one.
7. Set privacy by creating a password to prevent unauthorized users from joining.
8. Provide a description, including the purpose of the conference and discussion topics.
9. Configure access permissions: Assign an owner and administrators. Specify who can add or remove participants, change the icon, and send messages.
10. Click Create conference .
Once the conference is created, it will show up in your chat list. You can edit or delete it anytime.
To edit a conference:
1. Open the sidebar.
2. Click the three dots (...).
3. Select Edit .
Here’s what you can do:
- Change the conference name and icon.
- Add or remove participants.
- Update the description.
- Adjust access permissions.
To delete a conference:
1. Open the sidebar.
2. Click the three dots (...).
3. Select Delete .
Join a video conference

The host sends an invitation with the access password to all external guests. To join, just click the link and enter the password. There’s no need to register in Bitrix24 or download any apps—guests can join from their phone or computer.
When the host starts the video conference, your account users will see a call form and can join by entering the password.
Use the video conference menu
During the conference, you can:
- Open the chat: Click Chat to communicate with others. External attendees not registered in Bitrix24 can also join the chat.
- Raise your hand: Click Raise hand to let others know you want to speak.
- Record the call: Click Record to start recording. This option becomes available once two or more attendees join.
- View attendees: Click the button in the top-right corner that shows the number of attendees to see the full list.
- Invite more people: Click the three dots (...) and select Copy conference link .
- Restrict external access: Click the three dots (...) and select Edit conference link .
In brief
- Video conferences are group calls for employees and external users, such as customers and partners.
- When you create a video conference, a link is automatically generated. Guests can join without registering in Bitrix24 or downloading an app—just follow the link from a phone or computer.
- When the host starts the video conference, your account users will see a call form and can join by entering the password.
- You can create a video conference in the Employees and Messenger sections.
- Bitrix24 automatically creates a chat for the video conference, allowing participants to share details before, during, and after the call.
- During the video conference, you can open the chat, raise your hand to speak, share your screen, record the call, view the list of attendees, and manage the conference link.

titre: Fix video conferencing issues
sections: Fix video conferencing issues
This article covers common issues you may encounter when using video conferencing in Bitrix24 and how to resolve them.
Unsupported browser
Video conferencing works best in supported browsers.
For stable performance, use:
- Google Chrome, version 80 or later.
Unsupported browser
Video conferencing works best in supported browsers.
For stable performance, use:
- Google Chrome, version 80 or later.
Missing SSL certificate
Your site must use an SSL certificate signed by a trusted certificate authority (CA). Self-signed certificates are not supported.
Push&Pull server configuration issues
Check that the Push&Pull server is configured correctly. Incorrect settings can prevent video conferencing from working properly.
For setup details, see the Push&Pull server configuration guide .

titre: Technical requirements for video calls
sections: Technical requirements for video calls
To ensure stable call quality, check your network and device settings.
Equipment and connection requirements
Devices and apps . You can join video calls in a browser, Bitrix24 Messenger, or the mobile app. Always use the latest version. Older versions may cause connection issues.
Recommended browsers:
- Safari for macOS
- Google Chrome for other systems
Connection speed . Plan for at least 10 Mbps per 20 participants.
Recommended speeds by video quality:
- 720p (30 fps): 1–2 Mbps
Video quality adjusts automatically based on your connection.
Use this formula to estimate bandwidth: 0.1–2 Mbps × number of participants × 2
Microphone . You need a working microphone for audio or video calls. Turn on the built-in or external microphone on your device.
Local network settings
Check your network configuration. Make sure these ports are open:
Technical requirements for Bitrix24 On-Premise
Video calls are available only with an active Bitrix24 On-Premise license.
Check the following settings:
- Install these modules: Video calls (call), Mobile video calls (callmobile), and Telephony (voximplant).
- Enable Use Bitrix24 SFU cloud servers for video calls in the Video calls (call) module settings.
- Make sure /bitrix/services/main/ajax.php is accessible from outside your network. If you restrict access by IP, contact Bitrix24 Support.
- Verify your domain and set up an SSL certificate. You can use your own certificate or a free one from Let’s Encrypt. Configure certificates

titre: Record audio and video calls
sections: Record audio and video calls
To record calls, use the Bitrix24 desktop app. Recording is not available in the web version. Reconnect to the call from the desktop app to start recording.
Download and install the desktop app
If you don’t have the app, download and install it:
- Windows
- Mac
- Mac M1 M2
- MSI distribution
- Linux DEB
- Linux RPM
After installation:
1. Sign in to your Bitrix24 account.
2. Rejoin the call from the desktop app.
3. Click Record .
Recording behavior

Recording format and storage
- Format: WebM
If Bitrix24 Drive sync is enabled:

If sync is disabled:

Desktop app features
