For full functionality, use the desktop app.

titre: Bitrix24 Sync: Test video call quality
sections: Bitrix24 Sync: Test video call quality
Bitrix24 Sync is a new video call that keeps your team connected, no matter where they are. Bitrix24 Sync
We've introduced a service to check video call quality. Use it to ensure everything is working before a call, or to fix any issues during a call.
How to run the check
Before a call . Go to the video call test page. Video call test page
1. Click Start check .
2. Select your camera and microphone, then click Save .
3. Say something to test the microphone.
4. Wait for the service to receive your data.
5. Wait for the test call to complete.
6. Review the check results. More details are in the next section.
During a call . If an error occurs, run the check. The service will find the issue and suggest a solution.
Click the Run test button, or click the Camera or Microphone icon, then select Run test . The process is the same as before a call.
Check results
After the check, the service will display the results. If there are issues, it will suggest solutions.
Everything works correctly : The service didn't detect any issues, and you can make and receive calls.
Minor issues : You can still make and receive calls, but it's best to follow the service's recommendations, like using a different microphone.
Critical issues : You can't make calls until you resolve the errors.
In brief
- Bitrix24 Sync is a new video call that keeps your team connected, no matter where they are.
- We've introduced a service to check video call quality. Use it to ensure everything is working before a call, or to fix any issues during a call.
- After the check, the service will display the results. If there are issues, it will suggest solutions.

titre: FAQ: Chats
sections: FAQ: Chats

Bitrix24 Chats are a convenient tool for communication, discussing work-related issues, and collaboration. You can create group chats, channels, share files, and track message statuses. We have compiled answers to frequently asked questions about chats in Bitrix24.
In this article:
- How administrators can view and delete messages in chats
- How to join a private chat if the owner has left
- How to delete message history in public chats
- Disabling the General chat: possible or not
- How to delete a chat
- What notifications appear in the Messenger section
- Why images may not load or load slowly in chats
- How message statuses are displayed
How administrators can view and delete messages in chats
Bitrix24 administrators can only view chats they participate in and delete only their own messages.
How to join a private chat if the owner has left
The rules for joining a private chat depend on access permission settings:
- If all participants can invite new users, contact any of them and ask to be invited to the chat.

- If only the owner can invite, but they have left the chat, the rights are automatically transferred to another participant at random. The new owner is marked with a special icon. Contact them and ask to be invited to the chat.
- If the owner and chat administrator can invite, find out who among the participants has these rights and contact them.
How to delete message history in the General chat
You cannot delete all messages at once. Each user can only delete their own messages one by one.
General chat
Disabling the General chat: possible or not
You cannot completely disable the General chat, but you can prohibit employees from sending messages to it in Bitrix24 settings.
1. Go to your Bitrix24 account settings.
2. Open the Communications tab > Chats .
3. Enable/disable the Allow to post messages to the General chat option.
How to delete a chat
The ability to delete a chat depends on its type:
- General chats cannot be deleted.
- One-on-one chats cannot be deleted.
- Group chats can be deleted by the creator.
To delete a group chat:
1. Open the chat.
2. Go to the sidebar.
3. Open the three-dot menu (...).
4. Select Delete .
What notifications appear in the Messenger section
Notifications from personal and group chats are displayed in the Messenger section of the main menu.
Notification settings in Bitrix24
Why images may not load or load slowly in chats

If an image larger than 7000×7000 pixels is uploaded to a chat, it will not be shown as a preview. To view the image, click on it to open the full version. This limitation ensures the stable work of Bitrix24 chats.
How message statuses are displayed
In Bitrix24 chat, there are different symbols next to sent messages:
- One gray checkmark: The message was delivered to the recipient.
- Two blue checkmarks: The recipient opened and read the message.
- Clock icon: The message is still sending.
- Exclamation mark: There was an error sending the message, such as an internet issue.

titre: Wiki overview
sections: Wiki overview

Bitrix24 includes a built-in wiki called Knowledge Base . It's a dedicated section in the workgroup menu where you can create and store documents such as reference materials, technical specs, contract templates, and more.
You can also create shared workgroup documents, publish them, and collaborate with your team.

Each page includes comments and version history. Comments let you discuss content without leaving the page. Version history helps you see who changed the page, what they changed, and restore an earlier version if needed.
Knowledge Base features
With the wiki, you can:
- Edit wiki pages with multiple users using wiki markup or the visual editor
- Generate a table of contents automatically
- Add images to a page
- Assign categories and tags to pages
- Search by category
- Comment on wiki pages
- Track page history
- Compare different versions of wiki pages
- Restore a wiki page to an earlier version

titre: Bitrix24 Projects
sections: Bitrix24 Projects
Teams increasingly build project work around communication. They discuss plans, align on decisions, and track progress in chat.

AI Projects in Bitrix24 support this way of working. A project is now a single workspace that brings team communication together. Employees keep context, new members get up to speed faster, and supervisors get a full view without collecting information manually. Each project includes everything a team needs: chats, tasks, files, meetings, and an AI assistant that keeps everyone informed.
This article explains how the new projects work and what has changed.
All project chats in one place
A single project can include many topics: overall status, tasks, meetings, and discussions for specific groups. Each topic has its own chat.
All chats are gathered in one place, so you do not need to search through separate conversations. Your team can quickly see where work is happening, open the right discussion, and stay in context.
The project chat list includes:
- The primary project chat
- Project group chats
- Task chats
- Meeting chats
Users only see chats they are part of:
- Project chats — only if they were added
- Task chats — for tasks they participate in
- Event chats — after a meeting is created in the project
The primary project chat: the starting point of the project
Every project has a primary chat. Bitrix24 creates it automatically. It opens first when you enter the project. This chat stays pinned at the top and has a color highlight, so it is easy to find.
Use the primary chat to:
- Discuss project progress and coordinate the team
- Capture agreements and decisions
- Add new members quickly. When you add users to this chat, they automatically become a project member.
Project group chats
The primary chat brings the whole team together, but some topics are easier to discuss in a smaller group. For that, you can create group chats inside the project. For example:
- A chat for designers to discuss layouts separately
- A chat for supervisors to review risks without extra participants
Only invited members can see these chats.
Project tools

A project includes the main collaboration tools: chats, tasks, feed, files, and calendar. Everything is available on one page. To switch between tools, click the tool name in the project form, or open Three dots (...) to see more. To create a task, meeting, or group chat without leaving the project, click next to the search bar.
If your company uses Market apps or Flows, they also appear in the menu.
In Bitrix24 accounts created before May 31, 2026, you can change which tool opens first when you enter a project. This helps if your team prefers to start with the feed or tasks instead of chat.
1. Open the sidebar in the primary project chat. 2. Click Three dots (...) > Edit . 3. In the Main tool section, select the tool you need.
Work with external members
You can invite not only employees but also guests, such as contractors or clients. Guests can work only inside the project and cannot access the rest of your company information.

Guests can chat, work with tasks, and join meetings inside the project without switching to external messengers. In the access settings, you can choose which project tools guests can use. Configure access permissions to a collab
Access levels
For each project, you can choose who gets access: all company employees or only invited members.
1. Open the sidebar in the primary project chat. 2. Click Three dots (....) > Edit. 3. In the Privacy section, select one of these options:
- Public — the project and its content are visible to all Bitrix24 employees, and any user can join.
- Private — the project and its content are hidden from employees, and only invited members have access.
How to find projects
You can find projects in three sections of Bitrix24:
- Projects — shows open projects and those you are a member of.
- Tasks and Projects — the My filter is on by default and shows projects you participate in. Remove the filter to see all open projects in the company.

- Messenger > Projects — shows the primary chats of your projects. The counter on the primary chat shows new messages from all project chats. If there are unread messages in group chats, an additional counter appears. The primary project chats also appear in the general messenger chat list.

AI Projects represent a new way for teams to work. Chat is now the center of the project: teams communicate, create tasks, and make decisions without losing context. The AI agent analyzes tasks and messages, captures agreements, and regularly sends a status report — no need to collect information manually.
Changes to existing projects

Unified format . Projects, Groups, and Collabs now use one format: Projects. This format supports different use cases, including team collaboration, internal workgroups, and work with external participants.
All existing Groups and Collabs are converted automatically. They continue to work in the unified section. Your data and settings stay the same. You do not need to migrate anything manually.

Access levels . Before, there were three access types: public, private, and hidden. Now there are two: public and private. Hidden projects become private projects. They do not appear in the general list and are available by invitation only.
Legacy tools . Wiki, Knowledge Bases, Photos, and Lists now work in limited mode. You can no longer create new items. Existing items remain available, and you can still view, edit, and delete them.
AI Projects are a new way to work with your team. The project chat is now the main workspace. Your team can communicate, create tasks, and make decisions without losing context.
The AI agent reviews tasks and conversations, captures agreements, and sends regular status updates. You no longer need to collect this information manually.

titre: Create a project in Bitrix24
sections: Create a project in Bitrix24

A project in Bitrix24 is a shared workspace for your team. It brings chats, tasks, files, and meetings together in one place. You can use projects for internal teamwork, department processes, and collaboration with external users such as contractors, clients, and vendors.
In this article:
- How to create a project
- Configure project settings
How to create a project
You can create a project in three areas of Bitrix24:
- Projects. Go to Projects and click Create .
- Tasks. Open Tasks > Projects and click Create .
- Messenger. Open Messenger , go to the Projects tab, and click the plus icon.
Configure project settings
Enter the main project details.
- Name . Choose a name that clearly describes the project goal or content.
- Project avatar . Click the camera icon to upload an image. The avatar appears in the project list and makes the project easier to find.
- Project goal . Describe the result you want to achieve. This helps members understand the purpose of the project.
- Description . Explain what the project is for. All members can see this description.

- Owner . The owner is the main person responsible for the project. The owner has full access, can edit the project, and can assign moderators. If you create a project for another employee, set that person as the owner. They will see the project in their chat list and can edit it.
- Moderators . Moderators help the owner manage the project. Click Add and select the employees you want.

Project members . Project members include colleagues and external users who will work in the project. Click Add and select a user or a subdepartment. You can invite external members after you create the project. Invite employees or guests to projects
Project type . Choose who can view the project and how users can join it.
- Public — the project and its content are visible to all employees. Anyone can join.
- Private — the project and its content are hidden. Users can join by invitation only.
Default tool . Select which section opens first when someone opens the project. By default, the project chat opens first. You can also choose another section, such as Tasks, Files, Calendar, or Feed.

Access permissions . Set which members can invite other users, work with tasks, and post in the Feed. Click the Access permissions block to expand the settings. The default permissions are already set, so you do not need to change them. Configure access permissions to a project
Additional settings . Expand this block to set deadlines, add tags, and turn on auto-delete for messages.
- Project deadlines — enter the project start and end dates.
- Tags — group projects by topic so you can find and filter them faster. Click Add to choose existing tags or create new ones.

- Auto-delete messages — turn on this option to delete chat messages automatically after a set period. This is useful for temporary discussions or when you work with sensitive data. Auto-delete messages option in Bitrix24 chats
After you complete the required fields, click Create project .
In brief
- You can create a project in Projects, Tasks, or Messenger. All three open the same form.
- Add a name, goal, and description, then select an owner, moderators, and members.
- Choose a project type: Public or Private.
- Use the Access permissions block to manage permissions for the project, tasks, and Feed.
- In Additional settings, you can set deadlines, add tags, and turn on auto-delete for messages.

titre: Invite employees or guests to projects
sections: Invite employees or guests to projects

Projects in Bitrix24 help teams work together. You can assign tasks, chat, and share files. Both employees and guests can join a project. Guests are external users who do not have a Bitrix24 account, such as contractors, clients, or vendors.
To let other employees invite members, set up project access permissions first. Configure access permissions to a collab
- Invite an employee
- Invite a guest
Invite an employee
You can add an employee when you create a project or later in an existing project.
When creating a project.
1. Go to Projects and click Create . 2. In the project form, find the Project members section and click Add . Select the users, department, or workgroup you want to add.
In an existing project.
1. Open the project and go to the main chat. 2. Click a special icon and select your coworkers on the Employees tab. 3. Click Invite .
Invite a guest

You can invite guests to a project. Guests are external users who do not have a Bitrix24 account, such as contractors, clients, or partners. Guests can chat, work on tasks, and join meetings. They cannot access other company data. You can invite a guest only after the project is created.
1. Open the project's main chat and click in the top-right corner. 2. Open the Guests tab.
There are two ways to invite a guest.
By link. Click Copy link and send the link to the guest in any convenient way, for example, by email or in a messenger.
To revoke a shared link, click the Refresh icon next to Copy link . Bitrix24 creates a new link, and the previous link stops working.
By phone number or email. Enter the guest's phone number or email address and click Invite . The guest will get an SMS or email invitation.

After you send the invitation, the project and its main chat are marked in green. This helps you quickly spot projects that include guests. All invitations are saved in the project's main chat. You can see who sent the invitation and which method they used.
When the guest accepts the invitation, the chat shows a notification. In the member list, the guest's avatar is highlighted in green.
In brief
- Projects can include employees and guests: clients, contractors, and vendors.
- You can add employees when you create a project or later through the project main chat.
- You can invite guests only to an existing project, by link, phone number, or email.
- After you send an invitation, the project and its main chat are marked in green.
- All invitations appear in the project main chat.
- A guest's avatar is highlighted in green in the member list.

titre: Configure access permissions to a project
sections: Configure access permissions to a project
Project access permissions help you control who can work with tasks, post in the Feed, and invite new members. For example, all members can create tasks, but only the owner can delete them.
This article explains how to set up access permissions for a Bitrix24 project on a computer and in the mobile app.
You can set access permissions when you create a project or update them later in the project settings.
- When creating a project — open the Access permissions section in the project form. Default permissions are already set, so you only need to change them if needed.
- In an existing project — click Three dots next to the project name in the sidebar and select Edit . Scroll to Access permissions and open that section.
Tasks . In this section, you choose who can work with tasks in the project.
- View tasks where the user is an assignee — lets members see tasks they are involved in.
- View project tasks— lets members see all tasks in the project, even if they are not involved in them. If tasks contain sensitive information, limit this permission.
- Sort and move project tasks — lets members change the task order. If the order should stay fixed, give this permission only to the owner and moderators.
- Create new project tasks— to allow everyone to create tasks, select All members .
- Edit project tasks — lets members edit tasks in the project.
- Delete project tasks — to avoid accidental deletion, give this permission only to the owner and moderators.
Feed. In this section, you choose who can post messages and comments in the project feed.
- View Feed posts — determines who can see feed posts.
- Submit premoderated posts — messages appear only after the owner or a moderator approves them.
- Create new posts — determines who can publish messages without approval.
- Hide posts — lets members hide or approve messages from other participants.
- Moderate posts — lets members edit and delete any messages in the feed.
- View comments — determines who can see comments on posts.
- Add comments — comments are reviewed before they are published.
- Hide comments— determines who can leave comments without approval.
- Moderate comments — lets members hide or approve comments from other participants.
To reset all permissions to their original values, click Restore default settings at the bottom of the Access permissions section.

Set up Files and Calendar permissions separately. Open the project's Files or Calendar section and configure access there. Manage files in workgroups and projects Configure access permissions for calendars
You can set access permissions when you create a project or update them later in the project settings. Create a collab
When creating a project — tap the Access permissions section and set the permissions you need.
When editing a project — open the project's main chat and tap the project name.
Tap Three dots > Edit . Open Access permissions and set the permissions you need.
General . In this section, you choose who can change project settings, invite members, and post in the chat.
- Invite new project members — to control team membership and avoid accidental invites, give this permission only to the owner and moderators.
- Send messages to chat — if the chat is only for important updates, give this permission only to the owner and moderators. If everyone should be able to discuss the project, select All members .
- Make chat history available to new members — turn this on so new members can review earlier messages and catch up faster.
Tasks . In this section, you choose who can create, edit, and view tasks in the project.
- View project tasks — lets members see all tasks in the project. If tasks contain sensitive information, limit this permission.
- Sort and move tasks — lets members change the task order. If the order should stay fixed, give this permission only to the owner and moderators.
- Create tasks — lets members add new tasks. To allow everyone to create tasks, select All members .
- Edit tasks — lets members edit tasks in the project.
- Delete tasks — to avoid accidental deletion, give this permission only to the owner and moderators.
In brief
- Access permissions control who can invite participants, work with tasks, and post in the feed.
- Only the project owner can configure permissions.
- You can set permissions when you create a project or change them later in the settings.
- In Bitrix24 on a computer, there are three permission sections: project management, tasks, and feed.
- In the mobile app, the Feed section is not available — to configure it, open Bitrix24 on a computer.
- Files and Calendar access permissions must be configured separately — through the project's Files or Calendar section.
- In the mobile app, Files and Calendar permission settings are not available — open Bitrix24 on a computer.

titre: Use chats in a project
sections: Use chats in a project

In a project, your team can keep all discussions in one place. You can talk about the overall project status, tasks, meetings, and specific workstreams. Each topic has its own chat, and all chats are available inside the project. You do not need to search across different chats, and your team always knows where each discussion belongs.
In this article:
- Chat types in projects
- Find a chat in a project
- Create a chat in a project
- Add or remove a chat from a project
Chat types in projects
Projects include five chat types.
Main project chat . This is the shared chat for the whole team. Use it for project-wide updates and news that affects everyone.
Project group chats . Use these chats for specific topics or workgroups. For example, if designers and developers work on the same project, you can create a separate chat for each team.
Task chats . Use task chats to discuss a specific project task without leaving the task.
Meeting chats . Use meeting chats to discuss a specific project meeting and share related materials.
CoPilot in chat . CoPilot can answer questions about project status and risks. You can create more than one CoPilot chat.
Users only see chats they are part of.
Find a chat in a project
If a project has many chats, you can find the one you need in three ways.
- Enter the chat name in the Find a chat field above the chat list.
- Use a tab — All , Task chats , Project chats , or CoPilot — to see only chats of that type.
- Click the filter icon next to the search field to show only unread chats. You can also mark all chats as read.
Create a chat in a project
Group chat. Select Create group chat and complete these fields:
1. Enter a chat name and upload an avatar.

2. Add members. You can add individual employees, a whole subdepartment, or a cross-functional team. If you add a subdepartment or employees who are not yet in the project, they will automatically join the project.
3. If needed, open Chat settings and Access permissions . There you can:
- Add a chat description
- Turn on auto-delete for messages
- Assign administrators
- Choose who can add or remove members, change the appearance, and send messages
4. Click Create chat .
CoPilot in chat. Select CoPilot in chat — a new chat opens, and you can enter your request right away. You can create multiple CoPilot chats, for example, for different project questions.
Add or remove a chat from a project
If a group chat already exists in Bitrix24 outside the project, you can add it to the project. You do not need to recreate the chat or move the message history.
Only an employee can add an existing chat to a project if both conditions are true:
- They are the project owner or have permission to invite members
- They are the chat owner

When you add a chat to a project, all chat members automatically become project members. Before the chat is added, the system shows a warning. All project members will be able to see the chat history, including users who were not previously in the chat.
From the project . Open the project and click Plus (+) > Move chat to project . Then select the chat you want to add.
From the group chat . Open the chat, go to the sidebar, and click Three dots (...) > Move chat to project . Then select the project.
To remove a chat from a project, open the chat sidebar, click Three dots (...) , and select Remove chat from project .
In brief
- Projects support five chat types: main chat, group chats, task chats, meeting chats, and CoPilot in chat. Users only see chats they participate in.
- You can find a chat by name or by using tabs and filters.
- Any project member can create a chat in the project.
- Only the chat owner can add an existing chat to a project.
- When you add a chat to a project, all chat members automatically become project members.

titre: Bitrix24 project features
sections: Bitrix24 project features

A project brings together the main tools your team needs to work together: chats, tasks, files, a calendar, and a feed. Your team works in one place, so you do not need to switch between Bitrix24 sections to create a task, schedule a meeting, or share a document.
In this article:
- Chats
- Tasks
- Files
- Calendar
- Feed
Chats

Each project includes several chat types: a main chat, public and private chats, and chats for tasks and meetings. Everything stays in one place, so team members can quickly find the conversation and keep the full context.
The main chat is created automatically. It opens first when you enter the project. Use it to discuss work with the whole team and capture decisions.
For separate topics, you can create public or private chats. Only invited participants can see these chats.
Users only see the chats they are part of:
- Public and private chats: if they were added to them
- Task chats: for tasks they participate in
- Meeting chats: after a meeting is created in the project
The main chat also includes extra tools. Click the paperclip in the message field and choose what you want to do:
- Create a task or meeting
- Upload a file
- Run a poll
- Send a document for signing
Bitrix24 Chat: new interface and features Bitrix24 e-Signature: Getting started
Tasks

All project tasks are stored in the Tasks section. You do not need to look for them in the general Bitrix24 task list. Project members only see tasks from that project, which makes it easier to stay focused and find work quickly.

To create a task, open Tasks > Create, or click the button next to the search bar. In the task form, enter the title, description, and deadline, then assign the responsible person. If needed, attach files, add a checklist, or use tags. Create a task
Files

The Files section stores all project attachments, including documents, spreadsheets, images, presentations, and more. Any file attached in the main project chat is automatically saved to the project Drive in the Uploaded files folder. All workgroup members can access this folder. Bitrix24 Drive
Calendar
The project calendar helps you schedule meetings without long back-and-forth. When you create an event and invite attendees, the event appears in their calendars automatically.

To create an event, open the Calendar section or click the button next to the search bar. In the Calendar section, you can also turn on Open slots . This tool helps you schedule meetings with external participants. Share a link to your schedule so the other person can choose a convenient time. Open slots in the Bitrix24 Calendar
Feed
The Feed is useful if you want to run a poll, publish a report, or post an announcement with read confirmation so everyone sees it.
Click Three dots (...) > Feed . Feed in Bitrix24
In brief
- A project includes the main collaboration tools: chats, tasks, files, a calendar, and a feed.
- Project chats help your team discuss work, create tasks and meetings, share files, and run polls.
- The Tasks section shows all tasks for that project, so they are easier to find and manage.
- The Files section stores project documents and other materials. Files from the main chat are saved automatically to the Uploaded files folder.
- The Calendar helps you schedule team meetings and use Open slots for meetings with external participants.
- The Feed works well for important announcements, reports, and polls inside the project.

titre: Sign an electronic document in a project
sections: Sign an electronic document in a project
A project lets you create and sign electronic documents with clients and external teams in one place. Guests can sign documents from their mobile devices.

The e-Signature tool is an electronic signature, not a digital one. Every country has its own laws and requirements for using electronic signatures. In some countries, a special agreement must be signed with the client to use an electronic signature. In addition, this method of signing is not allowed for all types of documents. Therefore, if you are not sure whether e-Signature is suitable for signing your document, consult with lawyers. Trust in these signatures is the responsibility of the individual accepting the document.
If you are a guest, see how to sign electronic documents in a project .
How employees work with electronic documents in a project
1. Go to the Messenger section.
2. Click Projects and select a project.
3. Click the paperclip and select Document for signing .
Prepare the document
Select a template or upload a new file. Then fill in the fields:
- Person to sign as sender — the employee who signs the document on your side.
- Sender — your company details.
- Recipient — the guest’s contact details or a contact from CRM.
Set where stamps and signatures appear in the document. Add extra details if needed, such as a contract number.
Send the document
Check the information and send the document for signing. A notification appears in the project chat.
The document is signed in this order:
1. The responsible employee signs it.
2. The other party signs it.
After all parties sign, the document appears in the project chat and in files. Create and send an electronic document for signing How a first-party director signs an electronic document
How guests sign electronic documents in a project
After the company representative signs the document, you receive a link by SMS or email. Open the link to access the document.
Sign the document
Fill in the required fields and choose a signing method:
- Create from name — enter your last name and initials to generate a signature.
- Hand sign — sign on a mobile device or tablet.
- Upload image — upload a photo of your signature.
After you sign, the document appears in the project chat. How the client signs an electronic document
In brief
- You can create and sign electronic documents in a project.
- The process has three steps: create and send the document, sign it on your side, then get the other party’s signature.
- Signed documents are stored in the project files.

titre: Change project owner
sections: Quick answer
1. Go to Projects and click Menu (≡) next to the project and select Edit . 2. In the Project owner field, click Edit and select a new employee. 3. Click Save changes .
Detailed answer
The project owner is the main person responsible for the project who can edit the project, choose moderators, and use all project tools.
You may need to change the owner if the current owner leaves the company, goes on leave, or the project moves to another team. You can do this in the project settings.
In the project list, click Menu (≡) next to the project and select Edit .

In the Project owner field, select a new employee and click Save changes . The new owner will get full access to the project. If needed, you can also assign moderators in the settings. They help manage the project.

titre: Copy project
sections: Copy project
A project in Bitrix24 is a shared workspace for your team. You can create and complete tasks, share files, and store documents in a shared drive.

If you copy an existing project, you can create a new one faster. You can transfer tasks, automation rules, and project members, then update the settings as needed. This works well for similar projects, such as work for new clients or recurring events.

1. Go to the Projects section and open the project you want to copy. 2. Open the project's main chat. It is pinned in the chat list and marked with a color. 3. Click the sidebar icon, then click Three dots > Clone .

The new project form opens with the source project details already filled in. You can change them if needed. For example, you can update the company name or add employees for a client website project.
In the What to copy to the project section, choose what to transfer:
- Tasks — copies tasks together with checklists, subtasks, and due dates. Dates stay the same as in the original project, so review and update them after you create the project.
- Automation rules — keeps all automation settings from the source project.
- Drive folders — adds copies of the folders to the new project's drive.
Complete the remaining fields the same way you would when creating a new project. When you finish, click Create project . The new project appears in the list.
In brief
- Copying a project helps you launch a new one quickly, for example for a client, a subdepartment, or a one-time event.
- Only the project owner can copy a project.
- To copy a project, open the sidebar in the project's main chat and click Three dots > Clone .
- In the form, choose what to transfer to the new project: tasks, automation rules, or drive folders.
- You can keep the source project settings or set up the new project from scratch.

titre: Bitrix24 Calendar: Getting started
sections: Bitrix24 Calendar: Getting started
The Bitrix24 calendar helps plan meetings, tasks, and events. You can quickly find available time slots, invite colleagues, book meeting rooms, set reminders, and track company activities.
- Use personal and company calendars
- Customize calendars
- Create a meeting room
- Create an event
- Add a colleague's, group, or company calendar
- Synchronize the calendar
Use personal and company calendars
Bitrix24 offers two types of calendars: personal and company.
My calendar . The personal calendar allows you to manage your schedule and invite colleagues to meetings. It displays all events you create and those you are invited to by colleagues.
To schedule a meeting, select a time, add participants, and send invitations. The calendar will instantly show if your colleagues are available. Personal calendar

Company calendar . This is a shared calendar for planning internal events. It is convenient for inviting colleagues, and tracking company activities. For example, you can schedule a New Year party, internal training, or a general meeting. The calendar consolidates all company events in one place, even if you are not participating in them. Company calendar
Customize the calendar
To make the calendar more convenient for collaboration, adjust it to your tasks and company needs. The settings are divided into three sections:
- Personal settings — each employee can customize personal calendar for tasks, such as specifying an email for invitations or selecting a time zone to display the correct event time.
- General settings — Bitrix24 administrators and employees with Full access can configure the company calendar, including work hours, holidays, and weekends.

- Access permissions — Bitrix24 administrators and employees with Full access can manage permissions for personal and company calendars. For example, managers can create events in the company calendar, while employees can only view them. Each employee can also grant colleagues access to the personal calendar.
Calendar settings Access permissions to calendars
Create a meeting room

In the Bitrix24 calendar, you can plan offline meetings by booking meeting rooms in your office, considering their availability and capacity. For example, if your office has two meeting rooms, employees can check their availability, select a date, add participants, and book a room. Create and reserve meeting rooms
Create an event
You can create a meeting in two ways:
- Quick form — suitable for simple meetings without detailed settings.
- Detailed form — ideal for events requiring specifics, like recurrence, reminders, or CRM integration.
1. Go to the Calendar section, click Create , or select any available time slot.
2. Fill out the quick form or click Full editor .
Create a calendar event
Create a new calendar

Add separate calendars for different purposes. For example, create a training calendar to keep courses and training sessions separate from work meetings. Choose which calendars to display in your schedule.
Add a new calendar
Add a colleague's, group, or company calendar

Connect calendars of colleagues and workgroups to view their availability. This helps you find free time slots for meetings without unnecessary discussions. For example, if a manager needs to schedule a meeting with a supervisor and the logistics team, they can check their calendars and choose a suitable time.
Add other users' calendars
Share available time slots

You can share a link to your schedule with external participants, such as clients, partners, or contractors. They can independently choose a convenient date and time for a meeting. The recipient will only see your free and busy time, without event names or participant details.
Open slots in Bitrix24 calendar
Synchronize the calendar
You can synchronize the Bitrix24 calendar with other services. This allows you to view all events in one place and avoid missing important meetings.
The Bitrix24 calendar helps you plan meetings, tasks, and events. Start with these steps to manage your schedule effectively.

titre: Personal calendar
sections: Personal calendar
Bitrix24 Calendar is a tool for planning meetings, tasks, and events. In your personal calendar, you can manage your schedule and invite colleagues to meetings.
Go to the Calendar section > Calendar > My calendar .
In this section, you can:
Create events . Plan personal meetings, invite colleagues and external users to work events. Click Create or select a date in the calendar and fill in the event details. Create a calendar event

In the created event, the Connections section shows which Bitrix24 tools the calendar event is linked to. The connection is established automatically, for example, when a customer books an appointment or when an activity is created in the CRM.
Select viewing mode . Choose how your schedule will be displayed: by days, weeks, or months. The Schedule mode shows a list of upcoming events by day without the full calendar view.
View invitations . See new events you have been invited to but haven’t accepted yet. The counter shows the number of pending invitations.
Search for events . Enter the event name or use filters to find what you need. For example, you can view events with specific participants or only declined meetings.

Sync calendars . Bitrix24 Calendar can be synced with calendars from other services, like Google Calendar. This helps consolidate all events in one place so you don’t miss important meetings. Calendar synchronization in Bitrix24
Show and hide calendars . Add new calendars and choose which calendar events will appear in your schedule. Add a new calendar Add other users' calendars
Customize the calendar to suit your tasks and make it convenient for collaboration. Click Settings (⚙️) and adjust the parameters. Calendar settings
In brief
- In your personal calendar, you can manage your schedule and invite colleagues to meetings.
- Go to the Calendar section > Calendar > My calendar .
- In this section, you can create events and invite participants, sync the calendar with other services, customize it for your tasks, etc.

titre: Company calendar
sections: Company calendar
The company calendar in Bitrix24 is a shared calendar for planning internal events. It is convenient for creating events, inviting colleagues, and tracking company-wide activities.
Go to the Calendar section > Calendar > Company calendar .
In the company calendar, you can:

Create events . Plan activities, invite colleagues and external users. Click Create or select the desired date in the calendar and fill in the event details. Create a calendar event Send event invitation by email
Choose viewing modes . Select how the calendar grid is displayed: by day, week, or month. The Schedule mode shows a list of upcoming events by day.
Search for events . Enter the event name or use filters to find what you need. For example, you can view events with specific participants.

Show and hide calendars . You can add new calendars and choose which calendar events will appear in the schedule. For example, you can create separate calendars for parties and training sessions. Add a new calendar Add other users' calendars

- The company calendar in Bitrix24 is a shared calendar for planning internal events.
- Go to the Calendar > Calendar > Company calendar .
- The calendar displays all company events, even if you are not participating in them.
- By default, all employees can create events in the company calendar. The Bitrix24 administrator can change these permissions in the settings.
- You can create multiple company calendars to separate events, such as training sessions and parties.
- The company calendar can be customized to suit your needs: set working hours, days off, and more.

titre: Create a calendar event
sections: Create a calendar event
Bitrix24 Calendar is a tool for planning meetings, tasks, and events. It helps manage personal schedules and view colleagues' open slots.
In this article:
- Сreate an event in a quick form
- Create an event with detailed settings
- Edit an event
Quickly create an event
The quick event creation form is suitable for simple meetings without detailed settings. Go to the Calendar section and click on any open time slot.
Fill in the event fields in the form:
Event name . It will be displayed in the calendar.
Calendar . Select the calendar the event belongs to. For example, use a work calendar for business meetings. This helps group events and navigate the schedule quickly.
Time . Specify the start and the end date and time for the event. You can choose a specific time or create an all-day event.
Attendees . Click Change and select the employees to invite to the meeting. A planner will show colleagues' open slots.
Location . Specify where the event will take place. For example, if the meeting is at a customer’s office, add the address. For meetings in your office, create a list of meeting rooms.
Reminder . Select when to be reminded about the event, such as a day or an hour before the meeting starts.
Once you have filled in the necessary fields, click Save .
To access additional event settings, click Full editor .
Create an event with detailed settings
Go to the Calendar section and click Create .
Fill in the event fields:
Event name . It will be displayed in the calendar.
This event is important . Enable this option to mark the event as a special one.
Time . Specify the start and the end date and time for the event. You can choose a specific time or create an all-day event.
Calendar . Select the calendar the event belongs to. If you have multiple calendars, this helps separate events, such as personal and work-related ones.
Repeat . Set how often the event will repeat, like daily or weekly. This is useful for regular meetings, such as planning sessions.
Location . Specify where the event will take place. For online meetings, add a conference link. For in-person meetings, you can create a list of meeting rooms. Create and reserve meeting rooms

Attendees . Click Add and select the employees to invite. A planner will show colleagues' open slots. You can choose a time when everyone is free. To invite external participants, click Invite a guest and send an invitation. Send meeting invitations via email
Notify when attendees confirm or decline invitation . Enable this option to receive notifications about participants' decisions. This helps track who accepted or declined the invitation.
Private . Enable this option to make event details visible only to you. Other users will only see the time as busy in the calendar without the event title, description, or participants.
Open the More section to configure event details.
Description . Specify purpose, agenda, or important details.
Reminder . Add one or more reminders. Set the time for Bitrix24 to remind you about the event, such as an hour before the meeting.
Event color . Choose a color to quickly distinguish events in the schedule. For example, red for important meetings and blue for planning sessions.
Availability . Specify how the event will appear in the calendar:
- Busy — the time is marked as busy in the calendar.
- Unsure — the time is marked as busy, but the user might be available for another meeting.
- Available — another meeting can be scheduled during this time.
- Away (add to absence chart) — the employee is not at work. This event will be added to the absence chart.
CRM items . Link the event to a CRM item, such as a contact or a deal. This helps quickly access the form to prepare for the meeting and discuss details.
Click Save .
All meeting participants can invite colleagues and select a location.
Edit an event
Only the event creator can edit its time and title. Open the event in the calendar and click Edit .
When editing an event, you can enable the Ask users to reconfirm attendance option. If the meeting time changes, all participants will receive a notification to confirm their decision again.
In brief
- Bitrix24 Calendar is a tool for planning meetings, tasks, and events. It helps manage personal schedules and view colleagues' availability.
- You can create an event in just a few clicks using the quick form or configure details with the full form.
- The quick form allows you to specify the meeting title, time, participants, location, and reminders.
- In detailed settings, you can add: event description, CRM item links, availability, etc.

titre: Add a new calendar in Bitrix24
sections: Add a new calendar in Bitrix24

In Bitrix24, you can add both personal and company calendars for different types of events, like customer meetings, employee training, sports activities, or personal plans. This helps you keep your schedule organized. Each calendar is color-coded, and flexible settings let you choose which calendars to display. For example, employees in other regions can hide the office events calendar and add one for online courses instead. Personal calendar Company calendar
Only Bitrix24 administrators and employees with Edit calendars and events or Full access permissions can create new calendars. Access permissions to calendars
- Create a new personal or company calendar
- Edit or delete an existing calendar
- Customize event display in the calendar
Create a new personal or company calendar
1. Go to the Calendar section.
2. Click Calendar in the top menu.
3. Select My calendar or Company calendar .
4. Click Calendars at the top right corner.
5. Click Add .
6. Enter a name for your calendar, choose a color, and set access permissions.
7. Click Save .
Your new calendar will appear in the section where you created it, either My calendar or Company calendar .
Edit or delete an existing calendar
1. Go to the Calendar section.
2. Click Calendar in the top menu.
3. Select My calendar or Company calendar .
4. Click Calendars at the top right corner.
5. Open the three-dot menu (...) next to the calendar.
6. Choose Edit to change the calendar name, color, and access permissions.
7. Select Delete to remove the calendar.
Customize event display in the calendar

You can choose which calendars to show in your schedule to focus on what matters most. For example, to review your workload and adjust your day, you might display only work meetings. To see all your plans for the week, include personal or informal events as well.
To customize your view, go to your personal or company calendar and check the boxes for the calendars you want to display.
In brief
- In Bitrix24, you can add both personal and company calendars for different types of events.
- Only Bitrix24 administrators and employees with Edit calendars and events or Full access permissions can create new calendars.
- Each calendar uses color-coding, and flexible settings let you decide which ones to display so you can focus on what matters most.
- Once you add a new calendar, it will appear in the section where you created it, either My calendar or Company calendar .

titre: Add other users' calendars
sections: Add other users' calendars

Bitrix24 calendar helps your team plan meetings, tasks and events. It's important to keep track of your schedule and your colleagues' plans. Instead of messaging everyone and comparing calendars, add your colleagues' calendars to yours.
In this article:
- Add calendars
- Manage calendars
Add other users' calendars
1. Go to the Calendar section > Calendars button.
2. Click the small arrow next to the Add button and select the desired calendar:
- company
- user
- workgroup
- project
Company calendar . Check the boxes next to the company calendars you want to add to your schedule. Click Save.
User calendar. Click Add and select the employees whose calendars you want to add to your schedule. Click Save.
Workgroup calendar. Click Add and select which group calendars you want to display in your schedule. Click Save.
Project calendar. Click Add and select the project calendars you want to display in your schedule. Click Save.
Manage calendars
When you have added a calendar, it will appear in your list. You can edit or remove it from the list.
1. Click the three dots (...) next to the desired calendar.
2. Select an action from the menu.
If you no longer need a colleague's calendar:
1. Click the three dots (...) next to the desired calendar.
2. Select Remove from list from the menu.
In brief
- Use calendars in Bitrix24 to keep track of your schedule and your colleagues' plans. Instead of messaging everyone and comparing calendars, add your colleagues' calendars to yours.
- By default, the employee who added your calendar can only see your planned events. They can't add or edit events in your calendar unless you grant permissions.
- If you no longer need a colleague's calendar, remove it from the list.

titre: Configure access permissions for calendars
sections: Configure access permissions for calendars
In Bitrix24, all calendars are grouped into two sections:
- My calendar — for personal plans and work tasks
- Company calendar — for corporate events
You can set access permissions for each section and its calendars. For example, you might make the Company calendar visible to everyone, but allow only supervisors to add events.

Section permissions always take priority over individual calendar settings. If a user doesn’t have access to a section, they won’t see any calendars in it, even if they have full access to a specific calendar.
In this article:
- Configure access permissions for calendar sections
- Configure access permissions for specific calendars
Configure access permissions for calendar sections
Access permissions for the My calendar and Company calendar sections must be configured separately. Bitrix24 administrators and employees with Full access rights can set them up.
Select a calendar .
1. Go to Calendar .
2. Click Calendar in the top menu.
3. Select My calendar or Company calendar .
4. Click Settings (⚙️) .
Add or remove employees .
1. In the Access permissions section, click Add .
2. Select the users, departments, or workgroups you want to give access to.
3. To remove a user or department from the list, click the cross icon next to their name.
Set permission levels . By default, all users have the Edit calendars and events permission.
To change access:
1. Click the current permission level for a user, department, or workgroup.
2. Select the permission level:
1. Access denied — The calendar section cannot be accessed.
2. View — Users can see events and details, but cannot create, edit, or delete events.
3. Edit calendars and events — Users can create new calendars, add colleagues’ calendars, and create, view, and edit events.
4. Full access — Includes all of the above, plus access to the Calendar section settings.
Calendar settings

If permission levels overlap, the employee will get the permissions that allow the most access. For example, an employee is a member of a workgroup that doesn’t have access to a calendar section. If the employee has individual access, they will still see the calendar.
3. Click Save .
Configure access permissions for specific calendars
You can set individual access permissions for each calendar within a section. For example, in your personal calendar:
- For your colleagues — Select View availability so they can check your availability without seeing event names.
- For your supervisor — Select View so they can see all event details and add comments.
Select a calendar .
1. Go to Calendar .
2. Click Calendar in the top menu.
3. Select My calendar or Company calendar .
4. Click Calendars at the top right.
5. Open the three-dot menu (...) next to the calendar.
6. Select Edit .
7. Click Access permissions .
Add or remove employees .
1. Click Add .
2. Select the users, departments, or workgroups you want to give access to.
3. To remove a user or department from the list, click the cross icon next to their name.

Set permission levels . For each user, department, or workgroup, select the appropriate access level. For example, the head of the events department may need permission to edit all events in the company calendar, while regular employees may only need to view general corporate events without editing rights.
Permission levels:
- Access denied — The employee can only see events they are attending.
- View availability — Events appear in the calendar without names.
- View availability and names — Events and their names are visible.
- View — Events with names, attendees, and comments are visible. Users can add their own comments.
- Edit calendars and events — Users can create, view, and edit events.
- Full access — Includes all of the above, plus access to the Calendar section settings.

If permission levels overlap, the employee will get the permissions that allow the most access. For example, an employee is a member of a workgroup that doesn’t have access to a calendar section. If the employee has individual access, they will still see the calendar.
Click Save .
In brief
- In Bitrix24, personal and corporate calendars are grouped into two sections: My calendar and Company calendar .
- Access permissions for each section and its calendars must be set separately. Section permissions take priority over individual calendar settings.

- Bitrix24 administrators and employees with Full access rights can set access to calendar sections. Employees with Edit calendars and events or Full access rights can configure personal calendar permissions.
- If access levels overlap for a specific calendar, the employee will get the permissions that allow the most access.
- Bitrix24 administrators can see all events, except those marked as Private .

titre: Open slots in the Bitrix24 Calendar
sections: Open slots in the Bitrix24 Calendar

Use open slots in the Bitrix24 Calendar to schedule meetings with customers, partners, and other external contacts. Share a link to your available time slots, and let guests choose a time that works for them.
Share open slots with external guests
Send a link to your available time slots to customers or business partners.
1. Go to Calendar and enable Open slots .
2. Click Copy link . Bitrix24 creates a link and copies it to your clipboard automatically.
3. Send the link to an external contact in any convenient way.
When the contact opens the link, they can choose an available date and time and create a meeting.
1. Tap your profile photo in the upper-left corner.
2. Select Calendar from the tools list.
3. In the upper-right corner, tap the Slots icon.
4. Turn on the toggle to enable open slots. 5. Tap Share slots and send the link to your contact by email or messenger.
What external contacts see
You can preview the booking page before sending the link.
Create a test meeting to see exactly what external guests will see.
Select a date and time to create a test meeting and check how the process works.
Tap What will my contacts see? at the bottom of the screen. Create a test meeting to preview the booking process.
Edit a meeting with an external guest
When a guest books a meeting, Bitrix24 creates a new event in your calendar.
Open the event to:
- Change the default meeting name
- Add a location
- Invite additional attendees
You cannot change the meeting date or time. To reschedule a meeting, decline the event. Bitrix24 will notify the guest by email.

Account administrators can change the date and time of meetings with external guests. However, we do not recommend it because guests may miss the update. To reschedule a meeting, decline the current event and send a new open slots link so the guest can choose another time.
You can also use Bitrix24 Video Conferencing for online meetings. Video Conferencing in Bitrix24
Configure available slots and meeting duration
Set the days, hours, and duration for meetings.

In the Available slots section, choose the days and hours when meetings are available. For example, you can match your company’s business hours, such as Monday through Friday from 10:00 AM to 7:00 PM.
