In the Available slots section, choose the days and hours when meetings are available. For example, you can match your company’s business hours, such as Monday through Friday from 10:00 AM to 7:00 PM.
You can also set the duration for each meeting slot.
Invite colleagues to meetings with external guests
Create shared slots and include colleagues based on their availability.
1. Click the + icon.
2. Select employees from the list.
3. Click Copy link to create a shared slots link. 4. Send the link to the guest.
Shared slots check the availability of all participants. Guests can only choose times when everyone is available.
In the Shared slots section, you can see all generated links for meetings with colleagues and external guests.
Shared slots work well for recurring meetings. For example, HR managers can create a shared link with department managers for candidate interviews and send the same link to new candidates.
By default, Bitrix24 sorts links by frequency of use. You can also sort them by creation date.
1. Tap the + icon under Add users to slots .
2. Select employees who should attend the meetings.
3. Tap Share slots and send the link to the guest.
Shared slots check the availability of all participants. Guests can only choose times when everyone is available.
Open the Shared slots section to see all generated links for meetings with colleagues and external guests.
Shared slots are useful for recurring meetings. For example, HR managers can create a shared link with department managers for candidate interviews and send the same link to new candidates.
By default, Bitrix24 sorts links by frequency of use. You can also sort them by creation date.
Disable open slots access
To disable a shared slots link, click the X icon next to it.
To disable all links, turn off Open slots . If you enable it again later, Bitrix24 creates a new link. Previous links stop working.
To disable all open slots links, turn off the toggle next to Open slots . If you enable it again later, Bitrix24 creates a new link. Previous links stop working.
In brief
- Open slots in the Bitrix24 Calendar help you schedule meetings with external guests. Share a link with clients or partners so they can choose a convenient date and time.
- You can set available days, hours, and meeting duration for upcoming appointments.
- When a guest books a meeting, Bitrix24 automatically creates an event in your calendar.
- You can also create shared slots with colleagues and let guests choose a time when everyone is available.

titre: Invite external users to an event
sections: Invite external users to an event

You can invite not only employees but also external participants to Bitrix24 calendar events, like customers, partners, freelancers, and others. This is convenient for meetings and project discussions. Guests will only see event details without access to other company data.
Create an event
1. Go to the Calendar section and click Create .
2. Enter a title and description so the guest understands the purpose of the meeting.
3. Click Add in the Attendees field and select Invite a guest .
4. Enter aa guest email, first name, and last name.
5. Click Invite . The guest will be added to the list of attendees.
6. Click Save to create the event.
If the email is not connected to Bitrix24, a setup window will automatically open to configure the email address for sending invitations.

Once the event is created, the external participant will receive an invitation. It will include the event title, description, and any attachments. The guest can accept or decline the invitation. When the guest responds, you will receive a notification in Bitrix24.
If the event date, time, or participant list changes, the guest will receive an email notification.
In brief
- You can invite not only employees but also external participants to Bitrix24 calendar events, like customers, partners, freelancers, and others.
- Create a new event in the calendar. Click Add in the Attendees field and select Invite guest . Enter the guest's email, first name, and last name. You can invite several people.
- Invited guests are not added to the list of company employees.
- The guest will receive an email with meeting details and can accept or decline the invitation immediately.
- Once the guest responds, you will receive a notification in Bitrix24.

titre: Calendar settings
sections: Calendar settings

The Bitrix24 Calendar is a tool for planning events, tasks, and meetings. It helps organize your workflow and ensures you don't miss important events. To make the calendar convenient for collaborative work, customize it to fit your tasks and company needs.
Go to Calendar > My Calendar > Settings (⚙️) .
Settings are divided into three sections:
- Personal
- General
- Access permissions
Personal settings
In this section, each employee can customize the calendar for their tasks.
Time zone . Specify your time zone to display the correct time for events. This is important if you work with colleagues and partners from different cities.
Invitation calendar . Events you are invited to by colleagues will be added to this calendar. For example, you can create a separate calendar for meetings with customers.
Add a new calendar
CRM calendar . Specify which calendar to display calls and meetings planned in CRM item forms. This helps ensure you don't miss important events.
Show events you have declined . The calendar saves all events, including those you declined. This is useful if you need to change your decision.
Show tasks . Enable this option to synchronize the calendar with the task calendar and display completed tasks.
Calendar view in Tasks
Don't send invitations if the time is already allocated . Colleagues cannot invite you to a meeting if another event is already scheduled at that time.
Show week number . Each week will be numbered. This is convenient for planning long-term tasks and reporting.
Email for sending invitations . Choose or add an email address from which invitations to meetings will be sent to customers and partners.
Send event invitation by email
General settings
Set parameters for the company calendar. These settings automatically apply in the Company Calendar section.
Worktime settings . Specify the working hours of your company, for example, from 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM.
Weekends . Select the days considered weekends in your company, such as Saturday and Sunday. To select several days, hold Ctrl for Windows ( Cmd for Mac) and highlight the desired days.
Weekends and holidays . Add holiday dates and additional days off separated by commas. For example, to make December 31 a day off, enter 31.12.
Workdays . Specify dates that will be working days. For example, if January 10 is a working day, enter 10.01.
Access permissions

Access permissions for the My Calendar section can be configured by the Bitrix24 administrator and employees with full access. These permissions apply not to a specific employee's calendar but to the calendar type.
My Calendar and Company Calendar sections use the same roles, but permissions need to be set separately for each section.
- View. A user can view events but cannot edit them.
- Edit calendars and events. A user can view and edit events and the calendar.
- Full access. A user has all the above permissions and access to the main calendar settings.
- Access denied. No access to the My Calendar section.
After configuring, click Save .
In brief:
- The Bitrix24 Calendar is a tool for planning events, tasks, and meetings.
- You can customize the calendar in Calendar > My Calendar > Settings .
- Settings are divided into three sections: personal, general, and access permissions.
- In the Personal section, you can customize the calendar for your tasks.
- Set parameters for the company calendar, like working hours, holidays, weekends in the General section.
- Select who and how can work with the calendar type in the Access permissions.

titre: Add a category to meeting rooms
sections: Add a category to meeting rooms

Categories in the Meeting room availability tool help you organize locations for calendar events. For example, if your company has offices in different cities, you can group meeting rooms by location and select the right category when creating an event.
Add a category
1. Go to Calendar and expand the Calendar tab.
2. Open the dropdown menu and select Meeting room availability .
3. Click Meeting rooms .
4. Click Add and choose Add category .
5. Enter a category name.
6. Select the meeting rooms you want to include.
7. Save the changes.
Each meeting room can belong to only one category. If you add a room that already belongs to another category, it moves to the new one.
Edit or delete a category
- To edit a category, click the ⋯ (More) menu and select Edit .
- To delete a category, remove it from the list. All meeting rooms in that category move to the general list.
In brief
- Use categories to group meeting rooms and make scheduling easier.
- Go to Calendar > Meeting room availability > Meeting rooms , then click Add and select Add category .

titre: Create and reserve meeting rooms
sections: Create and reserve meeting rooms
With the Bitrix24 calendar, you can easily reserve meeting rooms for offline meetings. Consider each room's availability and capacity when making reservations.

For example, you have two big meeting rooms in the head office and one small room in the branch office. With the Bitrix24 calendar, your colleagues can check room availability, choose an event date, add attendees, and reserve a meeting room.
To get started with meeting rooms:
- Create each meeting room in Bitrix24 and specify their names and capacity.
- Set up access permissions for the Meeting room availability section.
In this article:
- Create a meeting room
- Hide, edit, or delete a meeting room
- Reserve a meeting room in the Meeting room availability section
- Reserve a meeting room via Bitrix24 calendar
- Check meeting room availability
Create a meeting room
By default, all employees can create meeting rooms.
1. Go to Calendar .
2. Open the Meeting room availability tab.
3. Click Meeting rooms .
4. In the Meeting rooms panel, click Add .

5. Select a color and specify the room parameters - Name - Number of attendees (meeting room capacity) - Category (e.g., head office or branch office). Categories need to be created in advance. Leave the field empty to add it later. Add category to meeting rooms
6. Set up access permissions. Access permissions to meeting rooms
7. Click Save .
Hide, edit, or delete a meeting room
By default, all employees can edit, hide, and delete meeting rooms.
1. Go to Calendar .
2. Open the Meeting room availability tab.
3. Click Meeting rooms .
4. Click the three dots (...) next to the desired room.

5. Select an action to perform: - Show only this room : Hide all rooms from the Meeting room availability section except the selected one. - Edit : Change the name, capacity, and access permissions. - Delete : Remove the meeting room permanently.
Reserve a meeting room in the Meeting room availability section
1. Go to Calendar .
2. Open the Meeting room availability tab.
3. Click Reserve or click on any cell in the grid.
4. Specify the event name.
5. Choose the date and time of the meeting.
6. In the Location field, select a meeting room. You can see the capacity of each meeting room in the list.
7. Add event attendees.
8. Save the changes.
Reserve a meeting room via Bitrix24 calendar
1. Go to Calendar .
2. Open My Calendar .
3. Click Create .
4. Specify the event name.
5. Choose the date and time of the meeting.
6. In the Location field, select a meeting room. You can see the capacity of each meeting room in the list.
7. Add event attendees.
8. Save the changes.
Check meeting room availability
In the Meeting room availability section, you can check the availability of a specific room or multiple rooms at once. There are four views: day, week, month, or schedule.
Availability of a specific meeting room
1. Go to Calendar .
2. Open the Meeting room availability tab.
3. Click Meeting rooms .
4. Select the desired room from the list.
5. Click the three dots (...) and select Show only this room .
The calendar will display the availability of the selected meeting room and the following key details:
- Meeting room name
- Name of the employee who reserved it
- Reservation period
Availability of multiple meeting rooms
1. Go to Calendar .
2. Open the Meeting room availability tab.
3. Click Meeting rooms .
4. Check only the desired meeting rooms, uncheck the others.
In brief
- With the Bitrix24 calendar, you can easily reserve meeting rooms for offline meetings. Consider each room's availability and capacity when making reservations.

- For example, you have two big meeting rooms in the head office and one small room in the branch office. With the Bitrix24 calendar, your colleagues can check room availability, choose an event date, add attendees, and reserve a meeting room.
- In the Meeting room availability section, you can create and reserve meeting rooms, as well as check their availability.
- There are four views: day, week, month, and schedule.
- By default, all employees can create, edit, hide, and delete meeting rooms.

titre: Configure access permissions for meeting rooms
sections: Configure access permissions for meeting rooms
Bitrix24 provides two types of access permissions for meeting rooms:
- Access to all meeting rooms
- Access to a specific meeting room
You can assign permissions to individual employees or groups. How access permissions work

Access permissions control which meeting rooms employees can see and use. For example, branch employees do not need access to meeting rooms in the head office. Management can also have a separate room with restricted access.
Access levels for the section
The Meeting room availability section supports these access levels:
- Edit — View the section, reserve rooms, create meeting rooms, and set access permissions during creation. You cannot change permissions later.
- View and reserve — View the section and reserve meeting rooms.
- Full access — View and edit the section, manage permissions, create and reserve meeting rooms.
- Access denied — No access to the section or meeting rooms.
Set permissions for the section
1. Go to Calendar > Meeting room availability > Settings .
2. Click Add .
3. Select an employee or a group.
4. Choose the access level.
5. Save the changes.
Access levels for a specific meeting room
You can set permissions when you create a meeting room. Available levels:
- Full access — View, edit, reserve the room, and manage permissions.
- Edit — Change the name, capacity, and category, and set permissions during creation. You cannot update permissions later.
- View and reserve — Check availability and reserve the room.
- Access denied — No access to view, edit, or reserve the room.
Set permissions for a new meeting room
1. Go to Calendar > Meeting room availability > Meeting rooms .
2. Click Add > Add meeting room .
3. Open Access permissions and click Add .
4. Select an employee or group and assign a permission level.
5. Save the changes.
Create and reserve meeting rooms
Update permissions for an existing meeting room
1. Go to Calendar > Meeting room availability > Meeting rooms .
2. Select a meeting room.
3. Click the three dots and choose Edit .
4. Update the access permissions.
5. Click Save .
Permission priority
Permissions follow this priority order:
- Edit
- View and reserve
- Access denied

Permissions set for a specific meeting room override section-level permissions. For example, even if a user has limited access to the section, you can grant them full access to a specific meeting room.
Group and employee access permissions. If the All visitors group has no access to the section, you can still grant an individual employee full access.
In brief
- You can set permissions for all meeting rooms or for a specific one.
- Administrators have full access by default.
- You can assign permissions to individual employees or groups.

titre: Calendar synchronization in Bitrix24
sections: Calendar synchronization in Bitrix24

The Bitrix24 Calendar is a tool designed to help individuals and teams organize their schedules, plan events, set reminders, and collaborate efficiently. It integrates seamlessly with other Bitrix24 features, making it a central hub for time management and productivity.
You can synchronize your Bitrix24 calendar with such services as Google , Microsoft or iCloud .
1. Go to the Calendar section
2. Click the Synchronize button
Connect the most popular calendars:
- Google Calendar
- iCloud Calendar
- Office365 Calendar
Mobile and desktop calendars are also available for synchronization. Click Connect other calendars .
In brief
- You can synchronize your Bitrix24 calendar with such services as Google , Microsoft or iCloud .
- Go to the Calendar section. Click the Synchronize button.
- Mobile and desktop calendars are also available for synchronization. Click Connect other calendars .

titre: Synchronize Bitrix24 and Google calendars
sections: Synchronize Bitrix24 and Google calendars
Connect Google Calendar to Bitrix24 to keep all your events in one place: your Bitrix24 account, the Bitrix24 mobile app, and Google Calendar.
Connect Google Calendar
1. Go to Calendar .
2. Click Connect calendar .
3. Select Google Calendar and click Connect .
4. Sign in to your Google account.
5. Allow the Bitrix24 Connector app to access your Google Calendar.
6. After the connection is set up, click Continue .
7. Once the connection is set up, click Continue .
How it works

Bitrix24 creates a separate calendar in Google Calendar and copies your employees’ Bitrix24 events to it. Sync works in real time and in both directions: from Google Calendar to Bitrix24 and from Bitrix24 to Google Calendar.
When you create an event in Google Calendar, select the employee’s Bitrix24 calendar.
How it works in the mobile app
If you use Google Calendar on your phone, your phone calendar can sync with Bitrix24. You can create events on your phone and see them in Bitrix24, and the other way around.
Disable sync with Google Calendar
1. In Bitrix24 Calendar, click Synchronize .
2. In the Google Calendar block, click the settings icon.
3. Select Disconnect calendar on the next page.
In brief
- Open Calendar and click Connect calendar .
- Select Google Calendar , then click Connect .
- Sign in to your Google account and allow the Bitrix24 Connector app to access your Google Calendar.

titre: Synchronize Bitrix24 calendar with Office365
sections: Synchronize Bitrix24 calendar with Office365
Synchronize the Office365 calendar with your Bitrix24 to have all your events collected in one place.
Connect Office365 calendar
1. Go to the Calendar section.
2. Click the Connect calendar button. If you already have external calendars connected, this button will say Synchronize .
3. In the Office365 Calendar block, click Connect .
4. Sign in to your Microsoft account by entering your username and password.
5. Allow the Bitrix24 Connector app to access your calendar.
6. Once the connection is set up, click Continue .
Make sure the synchronization works as expected. Create a test event in the Office365 calendar.
The event will automatically appear in the special field. Click Continue to complete the process.
Disconnect Office365 calendar
1. Go to the Calendar section and click the Synchronize button.
2. Click the gear button (⚙️) next to Office365 Calendar.
3. Click Disconnect calendar to stop the synchronization.

titre: Synchronize Bitrix24 calendar with iCloud
sections: Synchronize Bitrix24 calendar with iCloud
Set up iCloud Calendar synchronization with your Bitrix24 to have all your events collected in one place.
Connect iCloud calendar
1. Go to the Calendar section.
2. Click the Connect calendar button. If you already have external calendars connected, this button will say Synchronize .
3. In the iCloud Calendar block, click Connect .
4. Log in to your Apple account using your email address and app password, then click Connect .
Note that the Application Password is different from the Apple account password . Add application password for iCloud calendar
Check how the connection works
Once the connection is set up, click Continue . Then create a test event in your iCloud calendar to ensure the synchronization is working properly.
To ensure that the time of events is displayed correctly, check the time zones in the calendar settings. They must be the same.
The event will automatically appear in the special field. Click Continue to complete the process.

When you connect your iCloud calendar in Bitrix24, events on your device may be duplicated. This is due to the fact that you have an active sync with macOS or iPhone. To avoid unwanted duplications, disable these synchronizations. Disable calendar synchronization with iPhone and macOS
Disconnect iCloud Calendar
1. Go to the Calendar section and click the Synchronize button.
2. Click the gear button (⚙️) next to iCloud Calendar.
3. Click Disconnect calendar to stop the synchronization.

titre: Get an application password for your iCloud calendar
sections: Get an application password for your iCloud calendar
To sync your iCloud calendar with Bitrix24, you need to create an app-specific password in your Apple account. Apple requires this password when you connect third-party apps.
Create an application password
1. Sign in to your Apple account at account.apple.com .
2. Open the Sign-In and Security section. 3. Click App-Specific Passwords .
4. Click Generate an app-specific password .
5. Enter a name for the app, for example, Bitrix24 Calendar. 6. Click Create .
7. Copy the generated password and click Done .
Use the application password in Bitrix24
1. Return to your Bitrix24 account.
2. Paste the generated password into the Application password field.
3. Connect your iCloud calendar.
Synchronize Bitrix24 calendar with iCloud

titre: Synchronize Bitrix24 calendar with macOS calendar
sections: Synchronize Bitrix24 calendar with macOS calendar
Connect your Mac calendar to Bitrix24 in just a few clicks.
Synchronize Bitrix24 calendar with Mac calendar
1. Open Mac calendar and click Calendar in the top menu.
2. Select Add account to add a new calendar.
3. Choose Other CalDAV Account as the calendar account provider.
4. Provide your account details to sign in.
- Account Type : Set the account type to Manual
- User Name : Specify your login (email address)
- Password : Enter your password
- Server Address : Enter your Bitrix24 account address (e.g., mycompany.bitrix24.com )
Your events are now synchronized. When you create an event in one calendar, it will appear in the other.
Disable Bitrix24 synchronization with Mac calendar
1. Click Calendar in the top menu.
2. Select Settings .
3. Open the Accounts tab.
4. Select the account on the left.
5. Click the minus (-) icon below.

titre: Synchronize Bitrix24 calendar with Microsoft Outlook
sections: Synchronize Bitrix24 calendar with Microsoft Outlook
Keep track of all important meetings and events by synchronizing your Bitrix24 calendar with Microsoft Outlook.
How to connect Microsoft Outlook calendar
Go to the Calendar section and click the Connect calendar button.
Click Connect other calendars .
Click on the Outlook Calendar block and select the Bitrix24 calendar you want to sync.
The browser will request to open the MS Outlook app. In Outlook, confirm the connection by clicking Yes .
The Bitrix24 calendar will appear in the list of calendars on the left, and all synchronized events will be automatically added to your MS Outlook calendar.
On the Bitrix24 Calendar page, the Outlook Calendar block will turn orange. It means that the synchronization was successful.
How to pause or disconnect synchronization
Synchronization with MS Outlook calendar can be paused or disabled on the Outlook side.
To pause synchronization, remove the check mark from the Bitrix24 calendar.
To disconnect synchronization, right-click the Bitrix24 calendar and choose Delete calendar .

titre: Synchronize Bitrix24 calendar with iPhone
sections: Synchronize Bitrix24 calendar with iPhone
Sync your Bitrix24 calendar with your iPhone calendar to keep all events in one place. Events created in Bitrix24 appear on your iPhone, and events from your iPhone appear in Bitrix24.
1. Go to Calendar .
2. Click Connect calendar .
3. Select Connect other calendars .
4. In the Mobile calendars section, select iPhone Calendar .
5. Click Connect your phone .
On your iPhone, follow these steps:
1. Scan the QR code to open the setup instructions.
2. Tap Download profile .
3. Select Download to save the file to the Files folder.
4. Find the file, tap and hold it, then select Get info .
5. Tap Open .
6. Go to Settings and open the Profile Downloaded section.
7. Tap Install .
8. Enter your device passcode.
9. Tap Install again to confirm.
After you install the profile, the calendars start syncing. The connection status updates in Bitrix24.
For a smoother experience across all Apple devices, connect your iCloud calendar. Synchronize Bitrix24 calendar with iCloud
You can turn off sync in your iPhone settings. Bitrix24 events will stop appearing. The sync status remains visible for 24 hours. Disable synchronization with iPhone
In brief
- Sync your Bitrix24 and iPhone calendars to keep all events in one place.
- Scan the QR code, download the profile, and install it on your iPhone.
- Use iCloud to sync your calendar across all Apple devices.
- Turn off sync anytime in your iPhone settings.

titre: Sync Bitrix24 Calendar with an Android device
sections: Sync Bitrix24 Calendar with an Android device
Sync your Bitrix24 calendar with your Android device to keep all meetings and events in one place.
Sync using a QR code
1. Open Calendar in Bitrix24.
2. Click Synchronize .
3. Select Connect other calendars .
4. Choose Android Calendar > Connect your phone .
5. Scan the QR code with your phone camera.
6. Allow the Bitrix24 app to access your device calendar.
Your calendars sync automatically. The status updates in Bitrix24.
Some Android devices require a QR scanner app. You can download one from Google Play.
Fix sync issues on Xiaomi devices
If sync does not work on a Xiaomi device:
1. Go to Settings > Apps > Manage apps > Bitrix24 .
2. Turn on Autostart .
3. Open App permissions and allow access to Calendar and Contacts .
4. Go to Settings > Accounts > Sync > Bitrix24 .
5. Tap More > Sync now .
Sync manually
1. Open Settings > Cloud and Accounts .
2. Go to Accounts .
3. Tap Add account .
4. Select Bitrix24 .
5. Enter your Bitrix24 account URL, login, and password.
After you sign in:
1. Open the Bitrix24 account in the list.
2. Tap Sync is off .
3. Under Sync settings , select Calendars .
To view your calendar:
1. Open your phone’s Calendar app.
2. Go to Manage calendars .
3. Turn on the Bitrix24 calendar .
Disable calendar sync
1. Open Settings > Accounts .
2. Select your Bitrix24 account.
3. Delete the account.
Events will stop appearing on your device. The sync status in Bitrix24 may remain unchanged for up to 7 days.
In brief
- Sync your Bitrix24 calendar to view all events in one place.
- Use a QR code or connect the account manually.
- Turn off sync anytime in your device settings.

titre: Disable calendar synchronization with iPhone and macOS
sections: Disable calendar synchronization with iPhone and macOS
If you connect your iCloud calendar to Bitrix24, you may see duplicate events on your devices. This usually happens because calendar sync is already enabled on your iPhone or macOS device.
To prevent duplicate events, turn off the existing sync settings.
Disable synchronization on macOS
1. Open the Calendar app on your Mac.
2. In the top menu bar, go to Calendar > Accounts .
3. Select your Bitrix24 calendar account.
4. Click the – icon to remove the account.
5. Confirm the action.
After you disable sync, calendar events will stop appearing on your device. The synchronization status in Bitrix24 may still display for up to 24 hours.
Disable synchronization on iPhone
1. Open Settings on your iPhone.
2. Go to General > VPN & Device Management .
3. In the Configuration Profile section, select the calendar account.
4. Tap Remove Profile .
5. Enter your passcode and confirm the action.
You can also disable sync another way:
1. Open Settings > Calendar > Accounts .
2. Select the calendar account.
3. Remove the account from your iPhone.
4. Confirm the action.
After you disable sync, calendar events will stop appearing on your device. The synchronization status in Bitrix24 may still display for up to 24 hours.

titre: Fix Bitrix24 Android app sync issues
sections: Fix Bitrix24 Android app sync issues
There may be two main reasons for Bitrix24 Android app sync issues: battery saver is turned on or Bitrix24 mobile app doesn't have certain access permissions.
Battery saver
Change Battery and performance settings to let Bitrix24 mobile app sync even when battery saver is on:
1. Go to Settings > Battery and performance .
2. Tap Manage app' battery usage > Select apps .
3. Find Bitrix24 mobile app on the list and select No restrictions .
Permissions
Some phones have additional settings that may cause Bitrix24 mobile app sync problems (Xiaomi, ZTE, Huawei, etc.).
1. Open Settings > Permissions .
2. Allow Bitrix24 mobile app to Autostart .
3. Give Bitrix24 mobile app access in the Permissions section. For example, if you want to sync calendars, give Bitrix24 mobile app permission to access calendar.
4. Open Other permissions and make sure Bitrix24 mobile app is allowed to start in background.

titre: Export calendars via iCal
sections: Export calendars via iCal
Bitrix24 calendars can be exported and viewed in third-party applications.
To get the export link, go to the Calendar section and click the Calendars button.
Click the menu button next to the calendar name and select Export (iCal) .
Copy the export link.

Go to the settings of the third-party application and paste this link. After connecting the Bitrix24 calendar to the third-party application, all existing events from your calendar will be exported to the third-party application.
Read more about calendar synchronization:
- Synchronize Bitrix24 calendar with iPhone
- Synchronize Bitrix24 calendar with Google Calendar
- Connect external calendar via CalDav
- Synchronize Bitrix24 calendar with Android device
- Synchronize Bitrix24 calendar with Mac Calendar

titre: Configure CardDAV synchronization
sections: Configure CardDAV synchronization
Use the CardDAV protocol to sync Bitrix24 contacts with your mobile device. Apple devices (iPhone, iPad, and Mac) support CardDAV by default. Synchronize users' contacts with iOS Contacts app
Enable CardDAV sync in Bitrix24
1. Open your Profile page.
2. Click Security .
3. Click Synchronize .
4. Select the contact types you want to sync.
5. Click Save .
Contact types
- System Users : Your coworkers and internal employees. To select multiple departments, hold Ctrl (Windows) or Command (Mac).
- Extranet Users : External users invited to your Extranet workgroups. Extranet users in Bitrix24
- CRM Contacts : Choose which CRM contacts to sync: All or Personal . You can also set a limit on the number of contacts.
- CRM Companies : Choose which company contact details to sync: All or Personal . You can also set a limit on the number of companies.
- Limit : Define how many contacts or companies to sync.
- Synchronize by default : Use this option for devices that request contacts without specifying a contact type.
Set up sync on your Apple device
Follow the instructions shown at the top of the page or in the Employees section to complete setup on your device.
Important
- These settings apply only to synchronization via the CardDAV protocol.
- Most Android devices require a third-party CardDAV app from Google Play.
- CardDAV sync is one-way: contacts sync from Bitrix24 to your device only.

titre: Synchronize Bitrix24 with external calendar via CalDAV protocol
sections: Synchronize Bitrix24 with external calendar via CalDAV protocol

You can sync Bitrix24 with external calendars using CalDAV CalDAV is a protocol for calendar synchronization. It allows sharing event data between different calendar applications or services. . This helps consolidate all events in one place, ensuring you don't miss important meetings.
1. Go to the Calendar section > Synchronize .
2. Click Connect other calendars .
3. Select External calendar .
Fill in the settings fields.
Name . It is displayed in the calendar list. This helps distinguish them.
Calendar server address . Go to the external calendar page and copy the CalDAV link from the settings.
Login . Enter the login for the external calendar account. This is usually an email address.
Password . Enter the password for the external calendar account.
Then click Connect . After synchronization, all events created in the external calendar will appear in Bitrix24.
If an error occurs during connection, create an application password in the external calendar settings and enter it in the Password field in Bitrix24.
Disable an external calendar
1. Go to the Calendars section. Select the connected external calendar in the list.
2. Open the three-dot menu (...) and click Disable and hide .
After disabling the calendar, all previously synchronized events will be deleted.
In brief:
- You can sync the Bitrix24 calendar with external calendars using the CalDAV protocol.
- Go to the Calendar section > Synchronize > Connect other calendars > External calendar .
- Specify the calendar name, CalDAV server address, login, and password for the external calendar account.
- Synchronization with external calendars works one-way: events created in the external calendar appear in Bitrix24, but events from Bitrix24 are not visible in the external calendar.
- To disable an external calendar, select the desired calendar from the list and click Three dots (...) > Disable and hide .

titre: Synchronize Google Calendar with Bitrix24 on mobile devices
sections: Synchronize Google Calendar with Bitrix24 on mobile devices
If you've already synchronized Google Calendar with your Bitrix24, you can view events on your mobile device. Learn how to synchronize Bitrix24 calendar with Google Calendar
You can access Google Calendar through your mobile browser or by installing the app:
- Google Calendar for Android
- Google Calendar for iOS
To start using the app:
1. Open the mobile app and tap Sign in .
2. Add your Google account if you don't see it in the list.
3. Toggle the Google account synced with Bitrix24.
4. Tap Done in the left upper corner.
After that, all events from your Bitrix24 calendar will automatically sync with the Google Calendar app on your mobile device.
For more detailed instructions on connecting Google Calendar, visit the official website. Sync Calendar with a phone or tablet

titre: Calendar in Bitrix24 mobile app
sections: Calendar in Bitrix24 mobile app
Use the calendar in the Bitrix24 mobile app to plan personal events and company meetings.
1. Tap More in the bottom menu.
2. Select the Calendar section.
3. Tap the plus (+) icon in the lower right corner.
Create an event . Specify a meeting name and description, set time and location, then tap Create event .
Search events . Use the quick search and filters. Tap on the search bar and start typing the name of the event.
Select a filter by role and actions on events.
Synchronize calendars . Configure synchronization of your Bitrix24 calendar with Google, Microsoft, and iCloud services. Select a service, tap Connect , and sign in to your account.
If synchronization fails, you'll receive a notification that it needs to be resumed.
Open slots . Share your open slots with meeting attendees to let them choose the day and time.
Open slots in Bitrix24 calendar
In brief
- The updated calendar will help you plan events on your mobile phone.
- Bitrix24 calendar can be synchronized with Google, Microsoft, or iCloud services.
- You can share your open slots with external users to let them select the meeting day and time.

titre: FAQ: Calendars
sections: FAQ: Calendars

The Bitrix24 Calendar is designed to support your company and individual employees in planning work efficiently. It allows you to manage schedules and organize collaborative events with ease. With seamless synchronization with other services, it ensures that all your events are in one place. In this article, we provide clear answers to common questions about using the calendar.
In this article:
- What calendars are available in Bitrix24
- Why other people's events appear in your calendar
- How to synchronize the calendar with other services
- Why synchronization is temporarily suspended
- Why synchronization with the mobile calendar on Android isn't working
- Why a time slot is marked as occupied when no events are scheduled
- Why an event doesn't appear in search
- Why an employee can't see the workgroup calendar they have access to
- Why an employee can't create an event
- How calendar access permissions work
- Which time zone is used for events
What calendars are available in Bitrix24
There are several calendars in Bitrix24:
- My Calendar — events you created or were invited to by colleagues.
- Company Calendar — events planned within the company, such as corporate holidays.
- Workgroup and Project Calendars — events created in workgroups and projects you participate in.
You can add additional calendars:
- Employee Calendar — events of colleagues whose calendars you've added.
- Calendars from other services — events from calendars of other services you've synchronized, such as Google, Office365, and others.
Personal calendar Company calendar Add other users' calendars Calendar synchronization in Bitrix24
Why other people's events appear in your calendar

If you see events from other employees in your calendar, it means you’ve added a user, department, company, or shared calendar. To keep your personal schedule clean and organized, you can hide or remove any calendars you don’t need.
Go to the Calendar section and click Calendars . Add other users' calendars
Hide a calendar . Find the calendar you want to hide and clear the checkbox next to it. Its events will no longer appear in your calendar. To show it again, just check the box.
Remove a calendar . Open the three-dot menu (...) next to the calendar and select Remove from list . To see that colleague's events again, you’ll need to reconnect their calendar.
Synchronize the calendar with other services
You can synchronize calendars to track events in one place.
1. Go to the My Calendar tab.
2. Click Synchronize .
3. Select the calendar you want to connect. All events from this calendar will appear in the Bitrix24 calendar.

Synchronize Bitrix24 calendar with iPhone Synchronize Bitrix24 calendar with Android device Connect external calendar via CalDav Synchronize Bitrix24 calendar with macOS calendar Synchronize Bitrix24 calendar with Microsoft Outlook Synchronize Bitrix24 calendar with Google Calendar
Why synchronization is temporarily suspended
Calendar synchronization errors may occur due to a service failure or a password change.
To resume synchronization:
1. Go to My Calendar > Synchronize .
2. Click Resume and refresh the page.
3. If this doesn't help, reconnect the calendar.
Why synchronization with the mobile calendar on Android isn't working
Some smartphone manufacturers add settings that may interfere with synchronization. Ensure that the Bitrix24 calendar has access to the device. Fix Bitrix24 Android app sync issues
Why a time slot is marked as occupied when no events are scheduled

Reason . Events may remain from previously synchronized calendars, even if synchronization is already disabled. If you disabled synchronization but didn't delete the calendar in Bitrix24, the added events will remain.
Solution .
1. Go to the My Calendar tab.
2. Click on the Calendars section.
3. Check the box next to the calendar with disabled synchronization. All events will appear in the calendar.
4. Delete these events or the entire calendar from the schedule.
Why an event doesn't appear in search
Reason . The search only works for the type of calendar you are in. For example, if you are in the company calendar, the search will only show corporate events.
Solution .
1. If you are searching for a corporate event, go to the Company Calendar. If the event is created in a personal calendar, go to My Calendar.
2. Repeat the search.
Why an employee can't see the workgroup calendar

For an employee to have access to the workgroup calendar, they must be a member of the group. If the user is not part of the group, the calendar will be unavailable, even if the group settings allow "Authorized users."
1. Go to the workgroup.
2. Click About the group > Members .
3. Click Invite and add the colleague.
Why an employee can't create an event

If an employee doesn’t see the Create event button in the My calendar or Company calendar sections, it means they don’t have permission to add events to those calendars. Bitrix24 administrators can adjust the permissions:
1. Go to Calendar .
2. Click Calendar .
3. Select My calendar or Company calendar .
4. Click Settings (⚙️).
5. Choose the employee and grant them the Edit calendars and events or Full access permission.
How calendar access permissions work
Bitrix24 calendars include two levels of access permissions:

- Section permissions—for the My calendar and Company calendar sections, configured by the Bitrix24 administrator. If access to these sections is restricted, employees won’t be able to open calendars or create events.
- Calendar permissions—for individual calendars, configured by the calendar owner. The owner decides who can view their schedule, see event details, and edit entries.

Section permissions take priority over individual calendar permissions. For example, if the administrator restricts access to the My calendar section, employees won’t be able to open their personal calendars. Configure access permissions for calendars
Which time zone is used for events

Bitrix24 calendar automatically adjusts event times to each employee’s time zone. For example, if a meeting is scheduled for 12:00 PM Eastern Time, it will show as 11:00 AM for a colleague in Chicago and 9:00 AM in Los Angeles. Everyone sees the event in their own local time, so there’s no need to calculate it manually.
To check your time zone:
1. Go to Calendar .
2. Click Calendar .
3. Select My calendar or Company calendar .
4. Click Settings (⚙️).
5. Check the Your time zone field.

titre: Bitrix24 Drive
sections: Bitrix24 Drive
Bitrix24 Drive is a file storage tool. You can use it to manage both personal and company files.
What you can do with Bitrix24 Drive
- Store company documents and personal files, such as call recordings, email attachments, and images from comments
- Edit documents in real time, leave comments, and track version history
- Set access permissions for files, folders, or the entire drive
- Sync files between Bitrix24 and your computer
Personal and company drive
Each employee gets a personal storage space. Files you work with automatically appear there.
You can also store company files in the cloud, including email attachments and call records. Share individual files or folders, or grant access to the entire drive.
Access permissions for the personal drive and the company drive are managed separately.
Company Drive overview
My Drive overview
Configure access permissions to personal drive
Recycle bin on Bitrix24 drive
Drive Cleanup tool
Files and folders
You can manage files directly in the drive:
- Move, edit, download, or delete files
- Work with documents, spreadsheets, and presentations
- Choose how to edit files: locally, in the cloud, or inside Bitrix24
Online Documents: Getting Started
Work with Bitrix24 Drive documents
File version storage
Work with documents using Google Docs
Document locking
Sharing files
- Internal links for your team
- Public links for external users
You can preview documents (text, audio, video, images, presentations) without downloading them. This helps you quickly review content.
Add files from cloud storage to Bitrix24
Disconnect external drives from Bitrix24
Edit documents in Office 365
File preview in Bitrix24: quick access and possible actions
Business processes on Bitrix24 Drive
Sync with your computer
You can sync Bitrix24 Drive with your computer.
- Changes sync both ways
- Updates made on your computer appear in Bitrix24, and vice versa
- To enable sync, install Bitrix24 Messenger
Synchronize Bitrix24 Drive with your computer via Bitrix24 Messenger
Connect Bitrix24 Drive as a network drive in Windows
In brief
- Store files in your personal drive or the company drive

titre: Company Drive overview
sections: Company Drive overview
You can store shared files in the Company Drive. By default, Bitrix24 account administrators have full access to all company files.
You can access the Company Drive in the Bitrix24 web version and mobile app.
Configure the Company Drive
You can configure the Company Drive only in the Bitrix24 web version. To open the settings, click the gear icon on the Company Drive page.
Assign permissions . Choose a permission level for employees or departments. Users can download files from the Company Drive regardless of their permission level.
Configure business processes . Use business processes to automate file handling in the Drive. For example, you can upload an invoice and automatically send it to a manager for approval.
You can use standard business processes or create your own.
Business processes for document approval
Standard Business Processes for Document Approval

Connect a network drive . To work with Drive files on your computer, connect the storage or a specific folder as a network drive. All changes sync automatically, so you always work with the latest file versions.
Connect Bitrix24 Drive as a network drive in Windows
Configure document editing . Choose how you want to work with documents: locally, in the cloud, or directly in Bitrix24.
Work with files in the Drive
You can upload, move, and organize files and folders in the Company Drive.
In brief
- Use the Company Drive to store shared files.
- By default, account administrators have full access to Company Drive files.
- Available Drive space depends on your Bitrix24 plan.
- You can use the Company Drive in the Bitrix24 web version and mobile app.

titre: My Drive overview
sections: My Drive overview
My Drive is your personal file storage in Bitrix24. Files you work with automatically appear on the My Drive page.

You can manage your files in one place. Move, download, edit, or delete files and folders. You can also share them with teammates and set access permissions. By default, only you and account administrators can access your Drive files. Configure access permissions to personal drive
By default, only you and users with admin permissions have access to the drive files.
Folder types
When you upload, create, or save files, they are organized into these folders:
- Uploaded files: Files you add to tasks, the Feed, or comments.
- Created files: Files you create inside Bitrix24.
- Stored files: Files you save from chats or the Feed.
Standard folders appear only after you add at least one file to them.
Create and upload files
Click Add to create a file, folder, or online document. You can also upload files from your computer. Work with Bitrix24 Drive documents
You can create documents using Google Docs, Microsoft Office Online, Office365, or desktop apps. To do this, you need an account in the selected service.
Shared files are marked with special icons so you can quickly identify them.
Work with files
Use the menu or select a file to see available actions. You can:
- Move files and folders
- Manage sharing
To remove access to a shared file, open it and click Disconnect.
To delete a file, click Delete. Choose whether to move it to the recycle bin or delete it permanently. Files in the recycle bin are stored for 30 days.
If you delete a file from the Uploaded files folder, it is also removed from its original location, such as a task or comment.
Sort files and folders
To organize your Drive, choose a sorting option:
- Sort by date modified, ID, name, or size
- Switch between list, tile, or large tile views
In brief
- My Drive is a personal storage for files.
- Files and folders can be moved, downloaded, edited, and deleted.
- You can work not only with saved files, but also create new ones.
- You and an account administrator have access to Drive files.
- You can configure access permissions to your files and folders.

titre: Configure access permissions for your personal Drive
sections: Configure access permissions for your personal Drive

You can share files from your personal Drive with colleagues. Set permissions for individual users, departments, or groups. If you don’t want to share your entire Drive, grant access to specific files or folders. Use advanced permissions for more control.
Set access permissions
1. Go to Drive > My Drive .
2. Click Settings (⚙️) and select Assign permissions .
3. Click + Add more to choose who can access your Drive.
By default, you, your superviser and the account administrator have full access.
You can assign access to these groups:
- Users : Select any employee. Search by name or login.
- Employees and departments : Grant access to teams or subdepartments.
- Social network groups : Share with groups, their owners, or moderators.
- Other : Grant access to external users or all authorized users. Extranet users in Bitrix24
Share specific files or folders
If you want to keep your Drive private, share only selected items.
1. Select a folder.
2. Click Share > Share with other users .
3. Click + Add more to select users and set permissions.
4. Save the changes.
The shared folder appears in the selected users’ personal Drives.
If you grant access using Access permissions the file does not appear in their Drive. They need to open your profile and go to Drive to view it.
If you change access permissions on a Trial or Professional plan and later downgrade, users may lose access to files. You cannot restore previous settings because:
- You can’t reconfigure or review Drive permissions on lower plans.
- Default permissions cannot be restored. Bitrix24 plans and pricing
Permission levels
You can assign different levels of access:
- Read . View files only.
- Add . View and upload files.
- Edit . Manage files, but not settings or permissions.
- Full access . Full control over files and settings.
Employees with any permission level can download files.
Extended permissions
Use extended permissions to control access to specific files or folders.
1. Open access settings.
2. Activate Enable extended permission control for individual files and folders .
3. Save the changes.
To set permissions for a specific item:
1. Select a folder.
2. Click Access permissions in the top menu.
3. Choose users and set their access level.
In brief
- You can set access permissions for your personal Drive.
- Users with any permission level can download files.
- You can assign permissions to users, departments, and groups.
- Extended permissions for files and folders are not available on some plans.

titre: Recycle bin in Bitrix24 Drive
sections: Recycle bin in Bitrix24 Drive
When you delete a file in Drive, you can either remove it permanently or move it to the Recycle Bin. Files in the Recycle Bin stay there for 30 days. You can restore them during this time.
Access and permissions
Each user has a personal Drive and access to the company Drive.
- You manage your personal Drive on your own.
- You can add, edit, and delete your own files in the company Drive.
- To delete files created by others, you need the right permissions.
Manage deleted files
1. Go to Drive > Recycle Bin .
2. Select a file.
3. Check the box next to it to see available actions.
To permanently delete all files in the Recycle Bin, click Empty Recycle Bin .
You can also remove files using the Drive Cleanup tool. It scans your Drive and suggests files you can safely delete.
Drive Cleanup tool
Restore files
To restore a file or folder, select it and click Restore .
In brief
- When you delete a file, you can move it to the Recycle Bin or delete it permanently.
- Files stay in the Recycle Bin for 30 days and can be restored.
- You can manage your own files in the company Drive. To delete other files, you need permission from an administrator.

titre: Drive Cleanup tool
sections: Drive Cleanup tool
When your Bitrix24 Drive runs out of space, you can’t upload new files. To free up space, use the Drive cleanup tool. It scans your files and helps you remove items you no longer need.
Free up drive space
1. Go to the Drive section.
2. Open the Drive Cleanup tab.
3. Click the button to start scanning.
After the scan, the system reviews your Drive and suggests files you can safely delete without losing data.
- Recycle bin — Empty it if you no longer need the files.
- Unused — These are backup files.
Recycle bin on Bitrix24 Drive
Check the boxes and click the Run Cleanup button.
Check what is stored on the drive
To review files before deleting them, turn on Expert Mode .
Employees can only see their own Drive. The Bitrix24 account administrator can access files from all employees and workgroups.
To manage files and folders:
1. Click the menu icon.
2. Select the checkbox next to an employee’s name.
You can then:
- View file details
- Send a notification to the employee
- Open the Drive
After you review the content, you can delete files without affecting system or personal data.
In brief:
- Drive storage depends on your Bitrix24 plan.
- Use the Drive cleanup tool to free up space.
- The system suggests files you can safely delete.
- Turn on Expert Mode to review files before deleting.
- Employees see only their own Drive. Administrators can access all Drives.

titre: Online Documents: Getting Started
sections: Online Documents: Getting Started

The Online Documents section stores all documents you work with, including files shared in Bitrix24 chat. You can create and edit text documents, spreadsheets, and presentations together with your colleagues.
Each employee can only access their own documents.
In this article:
- Work with documents
- Sort documents
- Limits on collaborative document editing
Open the Online Documents section from the left menu.
Work with documents
Use the built-in editor to work with text documents, spreadsheets, and presentations in different formats. Changes appear in real time and save automatically when you close the file.
To manage a document:
1. Click the menu icon next to the file name.
2. Choose an action:
3. Rename
4. View revision history
5. Delete
You can also configure access permissions for documents and boards in Bitrix24.
Deleted files move to the Recycle Bin in Bitrix24 Drive.
Recycle bin on Bitrix24 Drive
Sort documents
Choose how to display documents:
- List
- Grid

Documents are sorted by recent activity.
Use the List view to see more details about each document.
To customize the list view:

titre: Work with documents using Google Docs
sections: Work with documents using Google Docs
Use Google Docs to create, view, and edit documents in Bitrix24. Work with your team in Drive, Feed, and tasks.
Create documents
1. Go to the My drive page.
2. Click Add > Google Docs .
3. Select a document type.
View documents
Bitrix24 administrators set the service used to open documents.
1. Go to the account settings.
2. Open Communications > Drive .
3. Enable View documents using Google Docs .
4. Save the changes.
After that, all documents open in Google Docs by default.
Bitrix24 Settings
View documents
Each employee can choose how to edit documents.
1. Open the My Drive page.
2. Click on the settings icon.
3. Select Settings for working with documents .
4. Choose In the cloud .
5. Save the changes.
To edit a document:
1. Open the file and click Edit .
2. Sign in to your Google account.
3. Allow access to the Bitrix24 Connector app.
4. Make your changes and save the document.
In brief
- You can use Google Docs to work with documents in Bitrix24.
