titre: Work with Bitrix24 Drive documents
sections: Work with Bitrix24 Drive documents
You can work with text documents, spreadsheets, and presentations in the My Drive section. Each Bitrix24 user can choose how to work with documents:
- Locally : Use desktop applications installed on your computer. To view and edit documents, install Bitrix24 Messenger.
- In the cloud : Work with documents through cloud services such as Google Docs.
- Bitrix24 : Use the built-in online editor to create, edit, and share documents directly in Bitrix24.
This article explains how to manage documents with Bitrix24.Docs.
1. Go to Drive and click Settings (⚙️).
2. Select Settings for working with documents .
3. Choose Bitrix24 .
4. Click Save .
Create and edit documents
You can create and edit text documents, spreadsheets, and presentations in supported formats.
Create a document
1. Click Add .
2. Select Bitrix24.Docs .
3. Choose a document type.
Edit a document
1. Open the document.
2. Click Edit .
3. Close the document when you finish working.
Changes save automatically.
To upload a new document in the Bitrix24 mobile app:

Tap Menu > Files. Open the My Files tab to upload a document to your personal drive, or open Company Files to upload it to the Company Drive. Tap the Plus button and select a document from your device storage.
1. Tap Menu > Files.
2. Open the My Files tab to upload a document to your personal drive, or open Company Files to upload it to the Company Drive.
3. Tap the Plus button and select a document from your device storage.
Configure access to documents
In Bitrix24, you can work on documents together with colleagues or external users. Use access permissions to control who can view or edit documents.
You can configure access permissions from the document list or while viewing or editing a document.
Configure access from the document list
1. Select files and click Share > Share with other users .
2. Add employees.
3. Set access permissions.
4. Save the changes.
Configure access permissions to personal drive
Use a public link to share a document with external users.
Configure access while viewing or editing a document
1. Click Share .
2. Select Get public link or Share with users .
3. Configure access permissions.
To work on a document together with colleagues:
1. Select Collaborate .
2. Add employees or departments.
3. Configure permissions.
Save documents and manage versions
To save a document, click Save or close the document. Bitrix24.Docs saves changes automatically.
Version history works differently depending on how users edit the document:
- If multiple users edit a document at the same time and save changes within five minutes, Bitrix24 creates one shared version.
- If users edit the document one after another, Bitrix24 creates a separate version for each user.
- Renaming a file does not create a new version.
- When users edit documents through Google Docs or MS Office, Bitrix24 creates a separate version for each user after saving.
View document versions
1. Click Menu (≡) next to the document.
2. Select Revision history .
3. Click Menu (≡) next to a version.
4. Choose an action:
2. Restore
3. Delete
Delete a document
1. Select a document.
2. Click Delete .
You can permanently delete the document or move it to the recycle bin. Deleted files stay in the recycle bin for 30 days and can be restored during that time.
Recycle bin on Bitrix24 drive
When you delete a file, Bitrix24 moves it to the Recycle Bin for 30 days. During this time, you can restore the file in Bitrix24 on your computer.
1. Press and hold the file, then in the menu, tap Delete.
2. Confirm the action.
In brief
- You can work with text documents, spreadsheets, and presentations in the My Drive section.
- Users can work with documents locally, in the cloud, or in Bitrix24.
- You can create, edit, share, and delete documents in Drive.
- Use access permissions to control who can view or edit documents.
- Use public links to share documents with external users.

titre: Lock documents while editing
sections: Lock documents while editing
Learn how to prevent coworkers from editing the same document at the same time.
- Enable document locking in settings
- Lock a specific document
- See how a locked document appears to others
Before you start
Document locking works only if:
- The Allow to lock document while editing option is enabled
- You edit documents in cloud services like Google Docs or Microsoft Office Work with Bitrix24 Drive documents
Enable document locking
Only an account administrator can enable this option.
1. Go to Settings .
2. Open Communications > Drive .
3. Enable Lock document while editing .
4. Save the changes.
Lock a document
Go to Drive , click the file, and select Lock on the menu panel.
A locked file is marked with a special icon. Only the person who locked the file can edit it.
How the locked document is displayed
Employees with access to the locked file can open, view, and download it.
File preview in Bitrix24: quick access and possible actions
When another user tries to edit the document, they will see a notification that the file is locked.
If the document is locked while another employee is editing it, that user will see a notification that the document was not saved.
The changes will be saved as a new file. The file will be available in their personal Drive in the Stored Files folder.
In brief
- Use document locking to prevent simultaneous edits.
- Document locking works only when the option is enabled.
- It applies only to documents in cloud editors.
- Only the user who locks the file can edit it.
- Other users can view and download the file.

titre: File version storage
sections: File version storage

When you work on a document in Bitrix24, you can restore an earlier version if someone deletes content by mistake. Bitrix24 creates a new version each time you save the document and keeps previous versions. How long versions are stored in Drive depends on your plan.
To restore a previous file version:
1. Go to Drive and find the file.
2. Open the menu (≡) and select Revision history .
3. Review the saved document versions. You can see who made each change and when. Open the menu (≡) next to the version you need and choose an action:
- Restore the version
- Delete it permanently

titre: Work with files and folders on Drive
sections: Work with files and folders on Drive
Bitrix24 Drive stores company documents and personal employee files and enables collaboration. Employees can upload files, edit documents online, and share them with colleagues.
For example, an employee can create a document, share it with the team, and edit the same file together with colleagues.
In this article:
- Add a folder or file to Drive
- Manage folders and files
- Work with the list of folders and files
Add a folder or file to Drive
Create a folder or document, create a board, or upload a file from your computer.
1. Open the Drive section and go to the Drive tab.
2. Choose where to add the file: My Drive or Company Drive .
3. Click Add and select an action.
File. Upload files from your computer, such as documents, images, or archives. Keep important materials accessible.
Select one or more files and click Open . After upload finishes, click Upload more to add more files or Close to return to Drive.
Folder. Create a folder to organize files. Enter a name and click Create .
Bitrix24 Docs, Board. Create a text document, spreadsheet, presentation, or board and continue working in the built-in Bitrix24 editor.
Rename and edit the document or board, then close it — changes save automatically.
Google Docs, MS Office Online, Office365. If your company uses one of these services, continue working in a familiar editor.
1. Choose the service and document type.
2. Sign in to the external service.
3. Edit the document and close it.
4. Click Save as , enter a document name, and save changes — the file will be added to Bitrix24.
Work with documents using Google Docs
Create folders and upload files from your device in the Bitrix24 mobile app.
1. Tap Menu in the bottom right corner.
2. Tap Files and open the My files tab to add a file to your personal Drive, or Company files to add it to the Company Drive .
3. Tap the Plus (+) in the bottom right corner to add a file.
4. Take a photo or video, or select files stored on the device, then tap Done or Open .
5. To create a folder, tap Three dots (...) > Create folder in the top right corner, enter a name, and confirm.
Manage folders and files on Drive
Open, edit, and perform other actions with files depending on access permissions. For example, without edit permission, an employee cannot rename, move, or delete a file.
Select a file or click Menu (≡) . Available actions appear in the top panel and the file menu.
Details. Opens the file card where you can:
- Add a link to the file card to the main menu
- View file details — size, last modified date, owner
- Open, edit, or download the file
- Upload a new file version and view version history
- Configure access: create an internal or public link and set permissions
- See where the file is used — for example in tasks
- Delete the file
Open. View the file.
Lock. Temporarily prevent other employees from editing the file. Useful to avoid version conflicts while making changes. Lock documents while editing

Access permissions. Available if you activate the option Enable extended permission control for individual files and folders in Drive settings. View who has access and configure permissions for employees or departments. Employees with access can find the file in its original location on the Company Drive or personal Drive.
Rename. Change the file name.
Copy. Create a copy of the file in a selected folder on the current Drive.
Move. Move the file to another folder on the current Drive. Moving between Drives is not supported.
Connect to Drive. Available only for files on the Company Drive — adds the file to an employee’s personal Drive without copying.

Useful when a team frequently works with a shared file. For example, a quarterly duty schedule is stored on the Company Drive. The manager updates it there, and employees access the latest version from their own Drive.
Revision history. Shows who changed the file and when. View previous versions. File version storage
Business processes. Available only for files on the Company Drive — automate processes such as document approval or request handling. Workflows on Bitrix24 Drive
Delete. Move the file to the Recycle bin or delete permanently. Recycle bin on Bitrix24 Drive
Tap and hold a file to open the menu. Select an action:
- Move. Move the file to another folder on the current Drive.
- Public link. Enable link access, configure permissions, and copy the link to send via message, SMS, or email.
- Copy. Create a file copy.
- Rename.
- Delete. Move the file to the Recycle bin. Recycle bin on Bitrix24 Drive
Work with the list of folders and files
Configure sorting and view. Adjust the list to make large collections of files easier to navigate.

Choose the sorting criteria and order. For example, select By size and Reverse to show the largest file first. The Mixed sorting option controls the order of folders and files. When disabled, folders appear first and files after them — each group is sorted separately.
Choose how files appear on Drive: list view, small icons, or large icons.
Find a file by name or using filters.
1. Enter the full or partial file name in the Filter and search field. Click the field again to add filters.
2. Specify conditions, for example file location.
3. Click Add field to include more parameters.
4. Select the fields you need.
5. Click Save filter to reuse search settings.
6. Use preset filters for quick search.
1. Tap the search icon in the top right corner to find a file.
2. Tap Three dots (...) in the top right corner to configure sorting and display.
3. Select sorting criteria and order. For example, choose By date modified and tap the Up arrow to show the most recently edited file first.
4. Enable Show file extension to display file format such as doc or mp4.
Share a folder or file
Attach a file to a message, task, Feed post, and other items. Useful for sending files to colleagues and working on them. For example, you can discuss a document in chat or attach it to a task.
Access to documents and boards attached to chats, tasks, and other items expands automatically. All participants can edit them even if access was originally restricted.
If you do not want to give access to everyone, send a link instead — existing permissions remain unchanged. Add files from cloud storage to Bitrix24
Send a link to a folder or file in Bitrix24 chat, an external messenger, SMS, or email. Use internal links for colleagues and public links for people outside your company.
Copy internal or public links from the file list, file details card, or while working with the file. Share files and folders using public and internal links
Use a universal file link to control access for both employees and external users. Set different permission levels based on who needs access. Configure access to Bitrix24 Boards
Configure shared access. Add a file or folder to another employee’s personal Drive. Useful for collaborative work with documents — employees can quickly find and open required files.
1. Select a folder or file and click Menu (≡) > Share > Share with other users .
2. Click Add more and choose employees or departments.
3. Set permission level and save changes.
Configure access permissions to personal drive
You can also set up custom access permissions and share the file with a link. Configure access to Bitrix24 Boards
The employee receives a notification. Depending on the file type, they will have an option to add the board to the board list or connect the file or folder to Drive. If the employee:
- Confirms — the file or folder appears in the list and becomes accessible.
- Declines — the file or folder does not appear on the employee’s Drive. Only the owner or a user with full access can share it again.
Configure access permissions for all Drive content or specific folders and files. Share materials without connecting them to another employee’s Drive. Extended access permissions
Employees do not receive notifications after configuration. To find accessible files, open the employee profile and go to the Drive tab — it displays items available to them.
Attach a file to a message, task, Feed post, and other items. Useful for sending files to colleagues and working on them. For example, you can discuss a document in chat or attach it to a task.
Access to documents and boards attached to chats, tasks, and other items expands automatically. All participants can edit them even if access was originally restricted.
If you do not want to give access to everyone, send a link instead — existing permissions remain unchanged. Add files from cloud storage to Bitrix24
Send a file. Send a file to an external service without downloading it first. Useful for quickly sharing a document with a client or printing it.
Tap and hold a file to open the menu. Select Share and choose where and to whom to send the file.
Send a public link. Enable link access, copy the link, and send it via message, SMS, or email to an external user such as a client or contractor.
Tap and hold a file to open the menu. Select Public link , enable link access, configure settings, and click Copy . Public links in Bitrix24
In brief
- Bitrix24 Drive stores files and supports individual and collaborative work on desktop and mobile.
- In the web version, create or upload files. In the mobile app, only file upload is available.
- To manage a file or folder in the web version, select it and choose an action. In the mobile app, tap and hold the file.
- If Drive contains many files, configure sorting and display options. Find folders and documents by name or filters.
- Configure shared access to add files or folders to another employee’s Drive. Access permissions allow colleagues to work with files on personal or Company Drive.

titre: Restore deleted files
sections: Restore deleted files
When you delete a file from My Drive , you can:
- Move it to the Recycle Bin (default option)
- Delete it permanently
Files moved to the Recycle Bin can be restored by the file owner or a Bitrix24 administrator.
If you are the file owner:
1. Go to Drive > My Drive > Recycle Bin .
2. Open the file menu ( ☰ ).
3. Select Restore .
Administrators can also restore files deleted by other users.
1. Open the user's profile.
2. Click Drive in the top menu.
3. Open Recycle Bin .
4. Restore the required files.
You can also restore multiple files at once:
1. Select the files.
2. Click Restore in the top menu.
Delete files from Company Drive
Shared files in Company Drive are protected from accidental deletion through local computer folders.
If a user deletes a shared file from their local Bitrix24 folder:
- The file remains available to other users.
- The file stops syncing for the user who deleted it.
Files remain in the Recycle Bin for 30 days. After that, Bitrix24 permanently deletes them. Recycle bin in CRM and Bitrix24 Drive: files are stored for 30 days

titre: Bitrix24 Boards
sections: Bitrix24 Boards
Bitrix24 Boards are a virtual workspace for project collaboration. With Boards, you can:
- Visualize ideas and strategies
- Create diagrams and plans
- Discuss tasks and make real-time changes
For example, marketers can use a board to plan advertising campaigns by capturing ideas and leaving comments. The shared workspace allows the team to make decisions faster and avoid delays.
In this article:
- Getting started with Bitrix24 Boards
- Features of Bitrix24 Boards
- Create a board
- Copy a board
Getting started with Bitrix24 Boards

You can find Boards in the Collaboration block. Create boards, work on existing ones, and share them with colleagues or external guests. Each employee can only access the boards they’ve created or those shared with them. If an employee leaves, their access to boards is automatically revoked, keeping your company data secure.
To use boards in the Bitrix24 On-Premise version, you need to enable them.
1. Go to Settings .
2. Expand System settings .
3. Open Module settings .
4. In the dropdown menu, select Drive .
5. Click Connect next to Bitrix24 Boards .
6. Save the changes.
Features of Bitrix24 Boards

Unlimited boards and participants. Invite colleagues and create as many boards as you need for your projects. Everyone can join and contribute. For example, the marketing team may use boards to plan content, while the sales team can create one for proposals or presentations. Employees collaborate in a shared space, track changes, and make updates in real time.

Ready-made templates for any task. We’ve created board templates for different workflows, such as meeting notes, kanban, strategic planning, and more. You can easily customize them to fit your needs. For example, managers can use a strategic planning template to set goals and break them into stages. This helps the team see the big picture and track progress. If the templates don’t work for you, start with a blank board and design it to match your tasks.
Working with objects on the board. Objects are shapes you can use to create notes, diagrams, or task descriptions. Here are the key features for managing objects on the board:

- Layers and overlays : Organize objects into layers to keep your board structured. For example, when designing an interface, you can place buttons, forms, and images on separate layers. This makes editing easier and prevents accidental changes to other objects.

- Object grouping : Combine multiple objects into groups to move or edit them all at once. For instance, when creating a company structure diagram, you can group departments or teams. This helps you make updates while keeping the overall structure clear.
- Object locking : Lock objects to prevent accidental edits or deletions. For example, you can lock approved design elements or important notes to ensure they stay unchanged.

Access control and security. Set access permissions for board users who have a link and decide who can view, add users, edit, or have full access. If an employee leaves, their access is automatically removed, keeping your confidential data secure.
Integration with other Bitrix24 tools. Boards work seamlessly with other Bitrix24 tools:
- Tasks : Attach boards to tasks to visualize workflows. For example, add a board showing project stages and deadlines to a task, helping the team track progress and see what’s still pending.
- Chats and video calls : Collaborate on boards while discussing tasks. For instance, during a video call, open a project plan board, make updates, or add ideas in real time with your team.

- Drive : Store boards with other documents and files for better organization. For example, save a project plan board and related files to one folder, making it easier for the team to find everything they need.
Create a board
You can create a board in Bitrix24 on your computer or in the Bitrix24 mobile app.
In the Boards section.
1. Open Boards from the left menu.
2. Click Create .
3. Choose a suitable template or start with a blank board.
4. Customize it by adding objects to fit your team’s needs.
In the Drive section. You can create boards on your personal or company drive:
1. Open Drive from the left menu.
2. Click Add .
3. Select Board .
In the Online documents section.
1. Open Online documents from the left menu.
2. Click Board .
3. Customize it to match your tasks and start working.
In the Feed and Tasks sections.
1. When creating a task or message, click Create document .
2. Select Board .
3. Customize it to match your tasks and start working.
1. In the lower-right corner, tap Menu . 2. Go to the Files section. 3. In the lower-right corner, tap Plus (+) . 4. Tap New board .
Copy a board
1. Open the Boards or Drive section. 2. Find the board in the list and click Menu (☰) next to the board name > Clone .
1. Tap Menu in the bottom-right corner > Files . 2. Press and hold the board to open the menu and tap Copy. 3. Choose where you want to save the copy and tap Copy here.
Share a board with your team and external guests

Attach a board as a file. You can add boards to tasks, Feed posts, or other elements that support file uploads. Just click File , select a board from Drive, or upload it from your computer. Everyone involved in the task or post will automatically have editing access.
Send a board link in a chat. Share a board link in a chat so your colleagues can join and collaborate:
1. Click Menu (≡) next to the board you need to share.
2. Expand Share .
3. Select Share with other users .
4. Configure access for employees and save the changes.
5. Click Copy internal link and send it to a chat.
1. Go to the Boards section.
2. Click Menu (≡) next to the board you need to share.
3. Expand Share .
4. Select Get public link .
5. Turn on the option in the window that opens.

Depending on the access level, external users can view and edit the board by the link. All boards shared with external guests are marked as "published" in the list. To keep your data secure, disable public access when the work is done.

Attach a board as a file. Add a board to any tool that supports file uploads. For example, you can attach it to a task or a post in the activity stream. Tap Attach files > Drive and select the board you need. Everyone in the task or post gets edit access automatically.
Set the access permissions you need to keep control of the board content.
1. Press and hold the board, then tap Public link in the menu.
2. Turn on link access.
3. Set the access permissions and copy the link.

Based on the access settings, external users can view or edit the board after you publish the link. Boards shared with external users have a link icon in the list. To protect your data, turn off public access when you finish working.
Send a board as a file without downloading it first. Press and hold the board, tap Share in the menu, and select a messenger.
In brief
- Bitrix24 Boards are a virtual space for visualizing ideas and collaborating on projects.
- Create unlimited boards, invite participants, and work together seamlessly.
- Start with ready-made templates like kanban or strategic planning, or create a custom board to fit your needs.
- Organize and protect data using layers, grouping, and locking features on the board.
- Boards integrate with other Bitrix24 tools, such as Feed, Tasks, Chats, and Drive, for enhanced collaboration.
- Set access permissions for each board user to ensure data security.

titre: Bitrix24 Boards: Interface and features
sections: Bitrix24 Boards: Interface and features
Bitrix24 Boards is a collaborative workspace. On one board, your team can collect ideas, discuss layouts, plan presentations, and visualize processes without switching to third-party tools.

Bitrix24 saves every change automatically. Everyone sees updates in real time and can leave comments right on the board. You do not need to download and send files. The latest board version is always available.
In this article:
- Open a board
- Configure board access
- Manage a board
- Use the toolbar
- Work with board elements
Open a board
The Boards section shows all boards available to you. Here, you can open, copy, or create boards. Bitrix24 Boards
In the mobile app, you can work with boards created in Bitrix24 on a computer. These can be your own boards or shared.
1. Tap Menu in the bottom-right corner > Files.
2. Open or copy the board.
You can also find and open a board from the item it is attached to: a task, a chat, or a Feed post.
Configure board access
Team members need access to collaborate on a board. The board owner and employees with full access can set this up in Bitrix24 on a computer.
Click Share and choose one of these options:
- Authorized users
- Public access
Configure access to Bitrix24 Boards
Manage a board

The top and bottom panels contain board management tools. Use them to rename the board, change its appearance, adjust zoom, download the board, start a timer, and see what other participants are doing.

Name field. Click the board name to rename it for everyone working on the board. You cannot use the characters \ / : * ? " ' < > | ~ # & ; in a board name. If the name contains any of these characters, you cannot save the new name.
Search . Click the magnifying glass icon to find objects on the board by keyword or element type.
Upload . Click the paperclip icon to add files to the board in these formats:
- JPEG and PNG up to 20 MB, on computer and mobile.
- PDF, PPT/PPTX, DOC/DOCX, XLS/XLSX up to 35 MB and up to 50 pages, on computer only.
Export . Click the download icon to save the board to your computer in PDF, JPEG, PNG, or CSV format. You can choose the background, board area, file format, and resolution.
More options . Click the three-dot icon to open additional settings:
- Background and grid: choose a background color and grid type: dots, lines, or no grid.
- Collapse panels: hide tools to free up screen space.
Undo and redo . Use the arrow icons to undo your last action or redo it.
Timer helps your team stay on schedule and focused. For example, you can use it during a presentation or brainstorming session. Everyone currently on the board can see the running timer.
To start the timer, click the clock icon in the top-right corner — a panel opens next to it. From there, you can:
- Add 1 or 5 minutes
- Restart the timer
- Turn the sound on or off
- Hide the timer on your screen
- Check the remaining time
- Pause or stop the timer.
Show or hide cursors . Click the double-pointer icon to choose whether you want to see other participants' cursors on your screen. For example:
- Turn them on during brainstorming to see what your teammates are pointing at
- Turn them off during a presentation to avoid distractions.
User icons show who is currently working on the board with you.
Click the icon with the number of users to open the participant list. Next to a user's name, click the three-dot icon to choose an action:
- Follow: your view moves to the area where that user is working and adjusts the zoom automatically.
- Pull to me: move one user's view or all participants' views to your area and adjust their zoom.
Hover over a user icon to see the person's name and turn following on or off.
Mini-map is useful on large boards. Click the map icon to open a scaled view of the board and jump to any area quickly.

Zoom changes with the mouse wheel. On large boards, zoom levels below 1% are available. To switch display modes quickly, click the current zoom value and choose one of these options: 200%, 100%, 50% , Fit to width , or Full screen.
Keyboard shortcuts make it easier to work on the board. Click the keyboard icon to view all shortcuts.
In the mobile app, you can manage the board the same way as in Bitrix24 on desktop. For example, you can rename it, change the design, download it, or start a timer.
Use the toolbar

The toolbar on the left side of the screen includes tools for working on the board. Use them to create flowcharts, draw, add text, align elements, highlight important details, and more. To reorder tools, hold the left mouse button and drag a tool where you want it.
The active tool is highlighted.
Edit . Click the cursor icon to select objects on the board. You can move elements and select them for editing.

Click the cursor icon again to switch to the Hand tool. Use it to move around the board and navigate to different areas. This is helpful when the board has many elements and you need to view another part of a diagram or image.
Templates . Click the layout icon and select a template to add a ready-made set of elements for plans, diagrams, analytics, and more.

Frame . Click the grid icon to group several objects into one block. You can move and scale everything inside together. You can also align elements inside the frame and give the frame a name to make navigation easier.
For example, you can combine an image, text, and a button into a frame named Banner. Then you can quickly find and move the whole block instead of separate elements.
Sticker . Use them to leave feedback directly on the board. Place a sticker next to the element you want to discuss and enter a comment. Other team members will see the note on a bright background.
Click the sticker icon, then choose a color and a way to add stickers:
- Single sticker — useful when you move around the board and leave comments in different places.
- Sticker stack — adds an unlimited set of stickers. Use this when you need many notes in one area.
- Pack of nine stickers — lets you fill in stickers first and place them later.
Shape . Use shapes to build flowcharts, for example to show project stages or steps in a guide. Click the shape icon, select a shape, add it to the board, and enter text.
Text . Click the T icon to add a text block to the board, such as a label, comment, or heading. Use it to describe an idea, leave a note on a layout, number steps in a screenshot, and more.
You can use different formatting options in one text block. For example, you can make a heading bold and underline key ideas.

Draw . Click the drawing icon to draw freehand and erase sketches. This is useful when you need to quickly highlight something important. For example, you can circle an element or underline text to draw a colleague's attention. Drawing tools include a marker, highlighter, and eraser. You can also choose the color and line thickness.
Arrow . Use arrows to connect objects on the board. Different arrow types help you show relationships between elements or visualize a sequence of steps.
Mind map . Click the diagram icon to quickly create a multi-level map with branches you can collapse and expand.
Emoji . Add GIFs, emoji, and stickers to the board. This is a quick way to react without writing a long comment. For example, you can show that you like an idea or react to unexpected edits.
Table . Add a table to the board. The default size is 3 × 3 cells, but you can change it. The maximum size is 10 × 10 cells.
Virtual dice . Add a dice with a custom number of sides to the board. This is useful when you need a random choice, for example to select a participant, an idea, or decide turn order.

Code block . Add a code snippet with syntax highlighting to the board. This is useful when you need to show an example, discuss edits, or leave a technical comment directly on the board. For example, you can paste a SQL query, CSS rule, or part of a script.
More tools . The plus icon appears when there is not enough space on the screen to show all tools. Click it to view the full list.

In the mobile app, you can work on a board much like you do on desktop. You can create flowcharts, add text, emoji, stickers, and more. The toolbar is at the bottom of the screen. Tap Plus (+) to open it.
The controls are optimized for touch devices. Select the Hand tool to use gestures for these actions:
- Move around the board and find the area you need
- Move an element by tapping and dragging it
- Select multiple elements by pressing and holding an empty area of the board, then dragging the selection box
- Zoom in and out
To fit the board to the screen width, tap the double-arrow icon.
Work with board elements
You can edit elements, move them, and set up connections between them. Select the Edit tool and left-click an element to open the editing panel. The available actions depend on the element type.
Frame . You can:
- Change the frame size, background color, and transparency
- Add a hyperlink or a link to another board element
- Hide or show the frame content
- Hide or show parts of elements that go beyond the frame border
- Lock or unlock the frame to prevent or allow moving it and editing the objects inside it
Sticker. You can:
- Change the element type by choosing a different sticker shape or replacing it with a shape
- Edit the text, including font, alignment, emoji, and links to external pages or other board elements
- Choose a background color
- Add or remove the sticker author's signature
- Lock or unlock the element
Shape — a shape supports the same editing options as a sticker. You can also:
- Change the text color and size
- Add a bulleted list, numbered list, or checklist
- Highlight selected text or individual words with color
- Choose a background color and set its transparency
- Set border style, color, transparency, and corner rounding
Drawing. For freehand lines and shapes, you can add a link and change the thickness, color, and lock status.
Arrows connect to elements at any point along their edges. To reconnect an arrow, drag its endpoint and drop it on the center of another side.
You can:
- Change the start and end style by adding or removing an arrowhead
- Change the direction, shape, and line type: solid or dashed
- Choose the line thickness and color
- Add a shape or text that automatically attaches to the arrow
- Lock or unlock the arrow
Emoji can be locked or unlocked.
File. To resize a file on the board, drag any side. The aspect ratio stays the same. You can also:
- Change the name, color, style, and border thickness
- Crop the file
- Add a link to an external file or another board element
For multi-page files, you can choose a display mode:
- Form: shows the file name, format, and size
- Document: lets you view pages directly on the board without downloading the file
In Document mode, you can:
- Browse pages
- Extract all pages or selected page ranges. The selected pages appear on the board as separate files.
- Turn on presentation mode to open the document full screen, browse slides, and use a pointer
Virtual dice . Click Roll to get a random value. You can also change the number of sides, change the color, and lock or unlock the element.
Code block . You can:
- Choose a programming language
- Resize the block
- Turn line numbers on or off
- Add a hyperlink or a link to another board element
- Lock or unlock the object
Table . You can:
- Add rows and columns
- Merge or hide cells
- Turn automatic cell resizing on or off
- Change the text direction
- Change the font, style, size, formatting, alignment, and text color
- Choose a background color and set its transparency
- Set border colors
- Lock or unlock the table
Additional actions are available for all elements, but the list depends on the element type. To open it, click the Three dots (...) in the editing panel or right-click the element.
- Create task — allows you to create a task directly from the board and automatically adds a link to the selected item in the description.

- Save: export the frame in a selected format, such as PNG. This is useful when you want to share one part of the board instead of the entire board. For example, you can discuss a specific part of a layout in a group chat.
- Copy
- Cut
- Duplicate: create a copy of the selected element next to the original
- Paste
- Bring forward: move the element higher in the stack order
- Send backward: move the element lower in the stack order
- Group: combine several selected elements into one block so you can move and edit them together
- Ungroup: split a previously grouped block back into separate elements
- Lock: fix the element in place so it cannot be moved or edited until unlocked
- Unlock: remove the lock from the element so it can be moved and edited again
- Copy link to object
- Add link to object: link one board object to another for quick navigation between them
- Delete

The same features are available as in the Bitrix24 desktop version. Select the Hand tool and tap an element to open the editing panel. Press and hold an element to open the list of additional actions.
In brief
- Bitrix24 boards are a shared workspace. Your team can gather ideas, review layouts, plan presentations, and visualize processes — all without switching to third-party tools.
- All changes are saved automatically. Participants see updates in real time and can leave comments directly on the board.
- Team members must have access to the board. The board owner and employees with full access can manage permissions — this can only be done in the Bitrix24 desktop version.
- In the Bitrix24 mobile app, you can work with the board just as you would on desktop.
- The top and bottom of the board contain tools for managing the board. For example, you can rename it, download it, or customize its appearance.
- To organize collaboration, use the timer, colleague cursor visibility settings, and other options.
- The panel on the left side of the screen includes tools for working on the board. Use them to build flowcharts, draw, add text, align elements, highlight important details, and more.

titre: Add files from cloud storage to Bitrix24
sections: Add files from cloud storage to Bitrix24

You can attach files from external storage, such as Google Drive, Office 365, and Dropbox. You do not need to upload the files first. Bitrix24 saves attached files to the Uploaded files folder on your personal drive.
To attach a file to a task:
1. Go to Tasks and Projects .
2. Click Create .
3. Add a file from your computer or Bitrix24 Drive.
To attach a file from external storage, open the detailed task form. Then select Google Docs , Office 365 , or Dropbox .
1. Select the storage service.
2. Click the service name and sign in to your account.
3. Choose a file and click Select .
When you update a document in external storage, update it in Bitrix24 as well.
1. Open the task form.
2. Click More next to the file name.
3. Select an action from the menu.
In brief
- You can work with files stored in external storage, such as Box, Dropbox, Google Drive, Office 365, OneDrive, and Yandex Drive.
- Bitrix24 saves files to your personal drive.
- Sign in to the cloud storage service before you attach a file.
- Select the document and click the button. The file will be added to the task.

titre: File preview in Bitrix24
sections: File preview in Bitrix24
You can preview text, audio, and video files, images, and presentations in Bitrix24 without downloading them. This helps you quickly check file content.
To use the Bitrix24 viewer:
1. Go to the account settings.
2. Open the Communications tab and go to Drive.
3. In the View documents using field, select Bitrix24.
4. Save the changes.
Preview mode features
In preview mode, you can download files to your computer or save them to Bitrix24 Drive in the Stored files folder.
My Drive overview
You can upload and view videos in any format. Bitrix24 automatically converts video files to MP4. To edit a document, click Edit or More.
Possible errors
File conversion errors can happen for different reasons. Try these solutions.
Reason. Internet connection issue. Solution. Check your network connection.
Reason. The file has an error. Solution. Open the file on your computer. If it does not open locally, Bitrix24 cannot convert it.
Reason. The license key is not activated in Bitrix24 On-Premise. Solution. Contact your administrator to check whether the key is active.
Reason. The file exceeds the conversion size limit. Solution. Make sure the file size is within the limit for your Bitrix24 plan.
If the issue continues, contact Bitrix24 Support and attach a copy of the file.
File conversion limits
- Up to 2,000 files per day.
- 10 videos every five minutes.
- 100 file previews every five minutes.
- Video files sent within five minutes must not exceed 3 GB total.
- One document must not exceed 100 MB.
- No more than 300 documents per hour in CRM.
Check the limits for your Bitrix24 plan .
In brief:
- You can preview files in the same tab where you are working.
- In preview mode, you can download files to your computer or save them to Drive.
- All files are saved to the employee’s personal Drive.
- You can edit text files while viewing them.

titre: Connect project drive to personal one
sections: Connect project drive to personal one

When people work together on a project, they need quick access to shared files. In Bitrix24, you can automatically connect a project Drive to the personal Drive of every new project member. The shared folder appears in the employee’s personal Drive right away. This makes collaboration faster and easier.
Only the account administrator can enable this option.
To turn on automatic connection of project Drives:
1. Click the icon next to your account name.
2. Click Settings .
3. Open the Communications tab and expand the Drive section.
4. Enable the Auto connect project Drive for new project members option.
5. Save your changes.
After a new employee joins a project, they receive a notification. They can then choose whether to connect the project folder to their personal Drive.
Drive Cleanup tool
If the employee connects the project folder, the folder appears in the personal Drive with a special icon.
In brief
- You can automatically connect a project Drive to the personal Drive of new project members.
- Only the administrator can enable this option.
- Employees receive a notification and can decide whether to connect the project folder to their personal Drive.

titre: Edit documents in Office 365
sections: Edit documents in Office 365
If your team uses Office 365 and each employee has a business account, you can use this service to view and edit documents in Bitrix24.
Edit documents with Office 365 business account
To edit a document in Office 365,
1. Open the document in Bitrix24, click Edit , and select Office 365 .
2. Use your Office 365 business account (e.g., xxxx@xxxx.onmicrosoft.com ) and grant access to Bitrix24.
3. Proceed with document editing in Office 365.
4. Remember to save the file in Bitrix24 when you finish.
Edit documents with Office 365 personal account
If you have a personal account with Office 365 for Home subscription, select MS Office Online to edit documents in the cloud.
View Bitrix24 documents in Office 365
You can set Office 365 as the default option to view Bitrix24 documents. Follow these steps:
1. Open the account settings.
2. Select the Communications tab.
3. Expand the Drive section.
4. Under View documents using , select Office 365 .
In brief
- If your team uses Office 365 with business accounts, you can easily view and edit documents in Bitrix24 by selecting Office 365 as the editing option.
- For personal Office 365 accounts, use MS Office Online.
- You can also set Office 365 as the default viewer in your Bitrix24 account settings.

titre: Disconnect external drives from Bitrix24
sections: Disconnect external drives from Bitrix24
Disconnect external drives from Bitrix24 if you no longer need to use them. Any files you've already synced will remain in your Bitrix24 Drive, inside the Uploaded files folder.
Explore how to disconnect these cloud storage services:
- Google Drive
- Dropbox
- Box
- Office 365 / OneDrive
Google Drive
1. Open your Google Account settings and select the Security tab.
2. Scroll down to the Your connections to third-party apps & services block and select Bitrix24 Connector .
3. Then click Delete all connections you have with Bitrix24 Connector and confirm the action.
Even after you disconnect, the files you added will stay on your personal Drive in Bitrix24.
Dropbox
1. Go to your account at Dropbox and open the Apps tab.
2. In the View Dropbox content block, select Bitrix24 Connector .
3. Click Disconnect to remove the connection.
This will stop Bitrix24 Connector from accessing your Dropbox.
Box
1. Open your Box account page and click on the profile photo in the top right corner.
2. In the drop-down menu, select Account Settings , and then open the Security tab.
3. Find Bitrix24 Connector and remove it by clicking the cross icon (X).
Office 365 / OneDrive
1. Go to your Microsoft account and open the Privacy section.
2. Scroll down and select View apps access details .
3. Find Bitrix24 Connector and click Edit > Remove these permissions .
Remember, you can always link your external drives back to Bitrix24 if needed.

titre: Configure access to Bitrix24 Boards
sections: Configure access to Bitrix24 Boards

Boards in Bitrix24 help teams collaborate by organizing tasks, projects, and ideas. You can control who can access a board and what they can do. For example, you can allow employees to edit the board while giving clients or external experts view-only access. This helps you work together without risking unwanted changes.
In this article:
- Configure board access settings
- Grant access to an employee
- Grant access to an external user
Configure board access settings
You can manage access either from the board list or inside a board.
From the board list
1. Go to Boards and select a board.
2. Click Menu (≡) next to the board name and select Share .
3. Choose one of the following options:
- Shared access — for employees
- Get public link — for external users such as clients or contractors
From the board editor
If you are already working on a board, click Permissions and Sharing and choose an option:
- Get public link — for employees
Configure access for an employee
Add or remove employees
You can grant access to individual employees, departments, or groups.
1. Click Add more .
2. Enter a name, department, or group in the search bar. You can also switch tabs to select users. Added users appear in the list immediately.
3. To remove a user, group, or department, click the cross icon.
Set access level
By default, employees can edit the board. To change this, click the current access level and select another option:
- Read — users can view the board and see who else is working on it. They can show or hide other users’ cursors.
- Edit — users can view and edit the board. They can rename it, change the design, and manage elements.
- Full access — users can do everything above and manage access permissions.
Click Save .
When you grant access, the employee receives a notification. They can:
- Add — the board appears in their list, and they can start working
- Decline — they lose access. Only the owner or a user with full access can restore it
If you work with confidential data, set a default access level for internal links. A Bitrix24 administrator can configure this:
1. Click the icon next to your account name.
2. Go to Settings (⚙️) > Communications > Drive .
3. Select an option in Default file link permission .
4. Save the changes.
The new setting applies to all new documents and those without custom access settings. Existing custom permissions remain unchanged.
How to configure access for an external user

To share a board with a client or someone outside your Bitrix24, use a public link. Send it by email, chat, or SMS. By default, the board opens in view-only mode without a password or expiration date.
To change access settings, go to Settings (⚙️) :
- Set time limit — define when the link expires
- Set password — require a password to open the board
- Allow board editing — let external users edit the board
Click Save .
In brief
- Boards help teams collaborate by organizing tasks, projects, and ideas. You can control access to keep information secure.
- Employees can edit boards by default. External users can view them without restrictions.
- To configure access from the list, go to Boards , select a board, and click Menu (≡) > Share .
- To configure access inside a board, click Permissions and Sharing .
- If a user has multiple access levels, the highest one applies.
- Users must add the board to their list to start working on it.

titre: Collaborative document editing
sections: Collaborative document editing

In Bitrix24, multiple users can edit the same file simultaneously. There are several options for working on documents with your colleagues. Open a file and click the small arrow next to the Edit button to view all of them.
Bitrix24.Docs : Use the built-in editor to collaborate without additional services. Online Documents: Getting Started
Google Docs , MS Office Online , or Office 365 : Edit documents using these external services. Work with documents using Google Docs Edit documents in Office 365
Set default document handling
Decide which document handling option to use by default.
1. Go to Drive .
2. Click the gear button (⚙️).
3. Select Settings for working with documents .
4. Select In the cloud or Bitrix24 for co-editing.
Manage file access permissions

Users may have different access to the file you need to collaborate on. In this case, users with full access (e.g., file owners) can edit file permissions to share them with others. Open the file menu (☰), select Access permissions , and adjust settings in the pop-up window. Configure access permissions to personal drive
If you give employees access to the file this way, they won't see it on their personal drives. They should go to your profile, click Drive , and find the file.
Lock documents while editing
If you don't want to allow several users to edit the same file, enable the Allow to lock document while editing option under account settings. Lock document while editing
Once enabled, you can apply it to selected files. They will be shown with the Locked icon.

After editing, unlock the file for further modifications. The file versions will be available in the Revision history section, where you can see who and when edited the file and restore its previous versions. File version storage
In brief
- In Bitrix24, multiple users can edit the same file simultaneously using options like Bitrix24.Docs, Google Docs, MS Office Online, or Office 365.
- You can set default editing options, manage file permissions, and enable document locking. These features make collaboration easy and secure.

titre: Configure file access
sections: Configure file access
Bitrix24 supports several file types, including text documents, boards, spreadsheets, and presentations. These files help teams work together, plan projects, organize ideas, and present results.

You can set access by user type. The same link can give different permissions to different people. For example, employees can edit a document, while clients and external experts can only view it. This helps you work with external participants without risking unwanted changes or data loss.
In this article:
- Access settings location
- Grant access to an external user
- Grant access to an employee
- Access to attached documents
Access settings location
You can set file access from the file list or while working in a file.
From the file list.
1. Open Drive , Documents , or Boards and find the file. 2–4. Next to the file name, click Menu (≡) > Share > More sharing options.
In the document or board editor. If you are already working in a document, board, spreadsheet, or presentation, click Share in the upper-right corner.
Grant access to an external user

To share a document with a client or invite a specialist who does not have access to your Bitrix24, turn on public access. Copy the link and send it by SMS, chat, or email. Anyone with the link can open the file in a browser. Both external users and employees can use the link.
Allow public access. Whether you can turn on public access depends on your Drive settings. This option is enabled by default, but a Bitrix24 administrator can restrict it.
1–2. Click the icon next to your Bitrix24 name or logo and go to Settings (⚙️) . 3–6. Click Communications > Drive and configure these settings:
- Allow public file links — turn this on so users can share files with a public link.
- View document using — select Bitrix24 Docs. Only this service lets you enable editing in public access settings.
7. Save your changes.
Configure public access. By default, the link opens the document in view-only mode, with no password and no expiration date. You can change these settings.

1–2. Open the Public access tab and turn on Public access . 3. Click Change to change the settings. 4. Choose what users with the link can do: View or Edit and delete . If you allow editing, turn it off after the work is done to protect the final version. 5. Set the link expiration: permanent or time-limited. Set the date and time when the link will stop working automatically. The user gets temporary access to the document or board, and you do not need to close it manually. 6–7. Set a password — users must enter it to open the document or board, then save the changes. Change the password when the contractor finishes work to protect the final result from accidental edits. 8. Copy the link and share it.
Changes are saved automatically.
1–2. Press and hold the file, then select Public link from the menu. 3–4. Turn on link access and copy the link. 5–7. If needed, tap Access settings , change the settings, and save the changes.
Grant access to an employee
Open the Authorized users tab to see the current access level. Click Change to open the settings.
Configure shared access. By default, all employees who have an internal document link can edit the file. To change this, click the current access level and select one of these options:
- View — the user can open the document and use tools that do not change its content. For example, on a board, they can show or hide other participants' cursors on their screen.
- Edit and delete — the user can view and edit the document.
- Deny access — only the owner can access the document.
To protect confidential documents, you can set the default shared access level for internal links. Only a Bitrix24 administrator can do this.

1. Click the the icon next to your Bitrix24 name. 2–4. Go to Settings (⚙️) > Communications > Drive. 5. In the Default file link permission field, select the access level you need. 6. Save the changes.
Configure personal access. You can give a higher access level to specific employees, subdepartments, or workgroups.

1–2. Click Extended parameters > Select . 3–4. Enter the name of an employee, subdepartment, or workgroup in the search field. You can also switch to the needed tab and add users there. Selected users appear in the list right away. 5. To remove an employee, workgroup, or subdepartment from the list, click the X in the selection field. 6–7. Set the access level — by default, the document is open for editing. To change this, click the current access level and select the one you need.

- View and View and create — the user can open the document and use tools that do not change its content. For example, in a spreadsheet, they can change the display theme or zoom level on their screen.
- Edit and delete — the user can view and edit the document: change the name, add or remove elements, and so on.
- Full access and edit permissions — the user can do everything above and configure document access for other participants.
8. Select Allow users with the View permission to create public links to expand personal permissions for all selected employees. 9. Copy the link to send it to your colleagues.

When you set up personal access to a document, the employee receives a notification. Depending on the document type, they are prompted to add the board to their board list or connect the file to their drive. If the employee:
- Confirm — the document appears in their list with expanded access.
- Decline — the employee keeps the shared access level. Only the document owner or a user with full access can restore the expanded access.
Access to attached documents

In Bitrix24 on desktop and in the Bitrix24 mobile app, you can share a document with colleagues by attaching it to a message, task, news feed post, and so on. Everyone who has access to those items can edit the file.

For example, if you add a spreadsheet with restricted access to a group chat, all chat members can edit it. This is useful when you need to quickly open a document for collaborative editing without setting up access manually.
If you want to keep the document's access settings unchanged, share a link instead of attaching the file.
In brief

- Bitrix24 supports several file types. For example, you can collaboratively edit text documents, boards, spreadsheets, and presentations. The same link can give different access levels to different users.
- By default, all employees with a document link can edit it. If public access is enabled, the link opens the document in view-only mode with no password and no expiration, but you can change this.
- To set access from the file list, go to Drive or Documents , find the file, and click Menu (=) > Share > More sharing options . Select a tab: Company employees or Public access .
- To set access while working in a document, click Share . Select a tab: Authorized users or Public access .
- You can set access for company employees and expand it for specific users — the colleague will need to connect the document to their drive.
- If an employee has multiple access levels, the one that gives more permissions applies.
- If you attach a document to a task, chat message, or news feed post, everyone who can access that item can edit the document.

titre: Synchronize Bitrix24 Drive with your computer via Bitrix24 Messenger
sections: Synchronize Bitrix24 Drive with your computer via Bitrix24 Messenger

Synchronize Bitrix24 Drive files and folders with your computer. Synchronization works both ways. After you edit files on your computer, the changes will be automatically applied to files stored on your Bitrix24 Drive, and vice versa.
How to enable synchronization
To synchronize Bitrix24 Drive with your computer, install the Bitrix24 Messenger app. Bitrix24 for Windows, Mac and Linux
There are two ways to sync your files:
- Classic sync : Files are stored directly on your computer's hard drive.
- Elastic drive : Files appear as shortcuts and download only when you open them.
If you're using an MSI distribution to set up the app, install the Dokan driver for the elastic drive to work. If you're using a Mac, install macFUSE. Download the Dokan driver Download macFUSE
To set up the sync:
1. Open Bitrix24 Messenger and click the cloud icon in the top-right corner.
2. In the pop-up window, click the three-dot menu (...).
3. Select your profile.
4. Click Bitrix24 Drive settings .
5. In the Main settings tab, specify the folder where you want your files to be saved. This must be a local folder, for example, on the C:\ or D:\ drive.
6. Select which action to perform after you click on a file. Decide whether to open the file or a folder containing it. Here you can also enable the elastic drive option.
7. In the Synchronization settings tab, specify folders that will be synchronized with your computer. You can sync both private and shared folders.
The Uploaded files folder is not synced because it contains files uploaded from your computer.
8. Click Apply .
In the sync window, you will see a list of files and the approximate time it will take to sync.
Synchronization features

Deleted file recovery . If you delete a file from your Bitrix24 Drive, it may reappear there. For example, user A deleted a file. At the same time or shortly thereafter, user B starts full synchronization. The Synchronize all option starts the full reconciliation of the local sync folder with Bitrix24 Drive. Thus, the deleted file will be restored in Bitrix24 Drive.

File version conflict . Conflict happens when two users simultaneously edit the same file with Drive synchronization enabled. The app syncs the latest version of the file. Another version will be kept locally on another user's computer. Such a local copy includes the user name in the file name, for example, Contract (Stacy Smith) .
To delete a local file copy and get the latest version:
1. Delete all local copies of conflicting files. If needed, move them to another folder that is not synchronized with your Bitrix24 Drive.
2. Disable synchronization.
3. Delete the files from your Bitrix24 Drive.
4. Re-enable synchronization.
How to disable synchronization
1. Open Bitrix24 Messenger and click the cloud icon in the top-right corner.
2. In the pop-up window, click the three-dot menu (...).
3. Select your profile.
4. Click Bitrix24 Drive settings .
5. Click Disconnect . The files will remain on your computer even after you disable synchronization.
To disconnect a specific folder:
1. Switch to the Synchronization settings tab.
2. Uncheck the box next to the folder name.
3. Click Apply .
4. Specify whether you want to delete the folder from your computer or not.
If you disable synchronization for some time and then re-enable it:
- The files you deleted from Bitrix24 Drive will be uploaded to Bitrix24 again.
- The files you deleted from your computer will be restored in the same folder.
- The files you deleted from both Bitrix24 Drive and your computer will be deleted forever.
In brief
- Synchronize Bitrix24 Drive files and folders with your computer.
- Synchronization works both ways. After you edit files on your computer, the changes will be automatically applied to files stored on your Bitrix24 Drive, and vice versa.
- To synchronize Bitrix24 Drive with your computer, install the Bitrix24 Messenger app.

- To enable synchronization, open Bitrix24 Messenger and click on the cloud icon in the top-right corner. In the pop-up window, click the three-dot menu (...), select your profile, and click Bitrix24 Drive settings .
- The app does not support .lnk, .tmp, .ini, .pl. file formats. Also, files or folders containing symbols / \ : * ? " ' | { } % ; & ~ # < > in their names cannot be synchronized.
- To disable synchronization, click the three-dot menu (...), select your profile, and click Bitrix24 Drive settings > Disconnect .

titre: Connect Bitrix24 Drive as a network drive in Windows
sections: Connect Bitrix24 Drive as a network drive in Windows
To work with Bitrix24 Drive files on your computer, you can connect it as a network drive in Windows. This setup allows you to:
- Keep all your files organized in one place
- Edit documents directly on your computer with automatic syncing to Bitrix24
- Work offline with files, syncing changes once you're back online
Choose one of these methods to connect a network drive:
- Map a network drive via Command Prompt
- Map a network drive using File Explorer
- Map a network drive with the Add Network Location Wizard
Features of connecting a network drive
If you use two-step authentication for logging into Bitrix24, you need to create a special application password to connect a network drive. Enable two-step authentication for Bitrix24 login
1. Go to your profile and click Security in the top right corner.
2. Select the Application passwords tab.
3. Expand Documents and click Get password .
Map a network drive via Command Prompt
1. Go to Drive .
2. Select My Drive .
3. Click Settings (⚙️).
4. Select Network Drive .
5. Copy the connection address.
6. Open Command Prompt in Windows by pressing Win+R and typing cmd in the Open field.
7. Click OK .
8. Enter the command net use o: [copied address] . You can replace o with any letter to name the network drive. Press Enter .
9. Enter your Bitrix24 login and press Enter .
10. Enter your Bitrix24 password. Note that characters won't show as you type. If two-step authentication is enabled, use the application password.
11. You'll see a confirmation message once the network drive is connected.
Map a network drive using File Explorer
1. Open File Explorer on your computer.
2. Right-click Network and select Map network drive .
3. Go to Bitrix24 > Drive > My Drive > Settings (⚙️) > Network Drive and copy the connection address.

4. Paste the copied address in the Folder field and choose your connection preferences: Reconnect at sign-in : Automatically connect each time you log into Windows. Connect using different credentials : Use another Windows account if needed.
5. Click Finish .
6. Enter your Bitrix24 login and password, then click OK .
Map a network drive with the Add Network Location Wizard
1. Open File Explorer on your computer.
2. Right-click Network and select Map network drive .
3. Click Connect to a Web site that you can use to store your documents and pictures .
4. Click Next .
5. Go to Bitrix24 > Drive > My Drive > Settings (⚙️) > Network Drive and copy the connection address.
6. Paste the copied address under Internet or network address and click Finish .
7. Enter your Bitrix24 login and password, then click OK .
8. Click Next > Finish .
Disconnect the network drive
You can disconnect the network drive in Windows using Explorer or the Add Network Location Wizard.
File Explorer.
1. Open File Explorer on your computer.
2. Right-click Network and select Disconnect network drive .
3. Select the drive you want to disconnect.
4. Click OK .
Add Network Location Wizard.
1. Open File Explorer > This PC .
2. Right-click the network folder you want to disconnect.
3. Click Delete .
In brief
- Connect Bitrix24 Drive as a network drive in Windows to manage files on your computer.
- After connecting, you can store files in one location, edit them on your computer and in Bitrix24. Changes sync automatically.
- Use the Command Prompt, File Explorer, or Add Network Location Wizard to map a network drive.
- If you use two-step authentication, you need to create a special application password to connect a network drive.

titre: How to use spreadsheets in Bitrix24 Docs
sections: How to use spreadsheets in Bitrix24 Docs
Spreadsheets are great for storing, organizing, and analyzing data. You can use the built-in Bitrix24.Docs editor to work with them.
In this article:
- Create a spreadsheet
- Set spreadsheet access
- Fill in a spreadsheet
- Change the spreadsheet layout
- Add formulas and functions
- Add data visualization
- Create a pivot table
Create a spreadsheet
In Bitrix24.Docs, you can create a new spreadsheet or upload an existing one. To create a new spreadsheet:
1. Go to the Drive section.
2. Click Add .
3. Expand Bitrix24.Docs .
4. Select Spreadsheet .
5. To name your spreadsheet, check the file and select Rename .
Set spreadsheet access
Decide who can view and edit your spreadsheet. For example, grant access to specific employees and departments.
To configure this, check the file, select Access permissions , and click Add more . Configure access to documents
Fill in a spreadsheet
Enter your data by adding rows, columns, and the table header. You can add new rows and columns whenever needed.
Change the spreadsheet layout
To make your spreadsheet easier to read, organize the cells. You can highlight key cells (1) or adjust column widths (2).
Also, manage line breaks (3) and use bold for important information (4).
Add formulas and functions
In spreadsheets, you can apply functions for rounding and formulas to calculate averages, totals, and more.
For example, use formulas to quickly calculate the total cost of items sold.

Add data visualization

titre: Collaborate on documents in Bitrix24 Docs
sections: Collaborate on documents in Bitrix24 Docs
Bitrix24.Docs is a built-in online editor for working with documents. You can create and collaboratively edit documents with your colleagues directly in Bitrix24.
Check if Collaborative document editing is available on your plan. Bitrix24 plans and pricing Online Documents: Getting Started
To enable multiple employees to work on a document, you need to configure access. You can grant access:
- To an individual document, such as a text document, spreadsheet, or presentation. Configure access to Bitrix24 Boards
- To a folder or Drive. Configure access permissions to personal drive
In this article:
- Choose a document handling mode
- Manage comments and changes
- Track changes in documents
- Merge and compare document versions
Choose a document handling mode
In Bitrix24.Docs, employees can work with documents in various modes: editing, reviewing, viewing, and commenting.
Employees can use different modes at the same time. For instance, one person can edit while another adds comments.
To choose a mode, click the button in the top right corner.
Editing. Changes are instantly visible to everyone, making it ideal for quick edits without needing approval.
Reviewing. Suggest changes without applying them automatically. Edits appear in a different color, and the document author can accept or reject them.
Commenting. Leave notes and suggestions without changing the text.
To leave a comment:
1. Select a word or sentence in the text.
2. Right-click and choose Add comment .
3. Enter your comment and click Add .
Manage comments and changes
You can view changes, sort comments, or add new ones. Open the Comments section, click More options (...), and choose what you need.
To easily navigate between comments and changes, and to accept or reject them, use the Collaboration tab.
Track changes in documents
With different modes, you can decide how to view and display changes in the text.
Track changes. You can choose who sees the changes: just you or everyone. This is useful for keeping track of all edits. If there are too many changes, you can temporarily hide them.
To enable tracking mode, go to the Collaboration tab, click Track Changes , and select your preferred mode.
Enable tracking:
- ON for me: Changes are visible only to you while the document is open.
- ON for me and everyone: All employees can see the edits. If one employee enables tracking, it automatically applies to everyone.
Disable tracking:
- OFF for me: Hides edits only for you.
- OFF for me and everyone: Hides changes for everyone. If one employee disables tracking, it turns off for all.
Display mode. On the Collaboration tab, click Display Mode to choose how changes will appear in the text.
- Markup and balloons: Suitable for analyzing and discussing edits with colleagues. Shows all changes, including added, corrected, and deleted text.
- Only markup: Displays changes in the text without comment fields.
- Final: Shows the document as it will look after accepting all changes.
- Original: Displays the initial version of the document for comparison with the current one to assess the changes.
Merge and compare document versions
To manage different document versions, you have several options:
- Compare: Displays the differences between two document versions.
- Combine: Merges changes from multiple versions into one file, allowing you to choose which changes to keep.
- Mail Merge: Useful when multiple employees have edited the document at the same time. You can accept or reject each change.
Consider an example of merging two document versions.
1. Open the Collaboration tab.
2. Click Combine .
3. Select Document from URL for a document stored on the Bitrix24 Drive and accessible via a link.
4. Paste the document link, which you should request from a colleague in advance. They can send you an internal link to the document. Share files and folders using public and internal links
In brief
- Bitrix24.Docs is an integrated online editor for working with documents, allowing collaborative creation and editing directly in Bitrix24.
- Set access permissions to enable multiple employees to work on a document, whether for a specific document, folder, or the entire drive.
- Employees can work in various modes: editing, reviewing, viewing, and commenting.
- View changes, sort comments, or add new ones with ease.
- Use Track changes and Display modes to control how edits appear in the text.
- Use the Compare , Combine , and Email Merge options to manage different document versions effectively.

titre: Data security in Bitrix24.Docs
sections: Data security in Bitrix24.Docs
Bitrix24.Docs is a built-in online editor for working with documents. You can create, edit, and share files with your team directly in Bitrix24.
Your documents are secure:
- Files transfer to the Bitrix24 server in encrypted form using HTTPS. This protocol protects data between your browser and the server.
- Documents stay on the server only while you work on them. When you finish, they are removed from the server but remain in your Bitrix24 Drive.
- Bitrix24 does not share document data with third parties or external servers.
- Only users with the right access permissions can view documents.

titre: Search document content on Drive
sections: Search document content on Drive

In Bitrix24, you can search inside documents stored on Drive. This includes personal, company, and workgroup Drives. Use this feature when you have many files and don’t remember file names. Just enter a word or phrase from the document.
Check if this option is available on your plan. Bitrix24 plans and pricing
Enable document content search
1. Click the icon next to the company logo.
2. Select Settings .
3. Open the Communications tab.
4. Expand the Drive section.
5. Turn on Search document content .
6. Save the changes.
After you enable this option, Bitrix24 starts indexing all documents across Drives. Wait until indexing finishes. Search will work after that.
Search inside documents
1. Select the Drive where you want to search.
2. Enable the Search document text filter.
3. Enter the document name if you know it.
4. Click Search .
5. In the search bar, enter your query (for example, a customer’s last name) and press Enter .
Bitrix24 returns all files that contain your query. Supported formats include .docx, .doc, .xlsx, .xls, .pptx, .ppt.
You can enter multiple words in the search bar. Bitrix24 finds documents that include these words.
Add more words to narrow down results.
You can only search documents you have access to. If you are in a workgroup but don’t have permission to view its files, those documents will not appear in search results.

titre: Integration with Office 365, Google Docs, MS Office Online
sections: Integration with Office 365, Google Docs, MS Office Online
You can work with documents in Bitrix24 in several ways.
1. Go to Account Settings .
2. Open Communications .
3. Expand the Drive section.
4. Choose a service to view your documents:
1. Office 365
2. Google Docs

Open files in desktop apps or in the cloud
1. Go to the Drive section.

Edit documents online or locally
You can edit documents using Google Docs, Office 365, MS Office Online, or local apps. When you open a file preview, use the options in the bottom panel to choose how to edit it.

titre: Workflows in Bitrix24 Drive
sections: Workflows in Bitrix24 Drive
You can automate file processing in Bitrix24 Drive using workflows. Workflows help speed up document processing across your company.
Workflows are available on both the Company Drive and the Workgroup Drive.
- Enable workflows in Drive
- Create workflows
- Configure the workflow list
- Launch a workflow in Drive
- View the workflow log
Enable workflows in Drive
By default, only an administrator can enable workflows on the Company Drive. On the Workgroup Drive, both the administrator and the group owner can enable them.
Company Drive overview
To enable workflows:
1. Go to Drive > Company Drive > Settings > Configure workflows .
2. Turn on Activate workflows .
3. Click Save .
After that, workflows will appear in the Company Drive settings.
Create workflows in Drive
You can use prebuilt templates or create your own workflows: sequential or status-driven.
Standard workflows . These are ready-to-use templates for common document processes. Use them to quickly notify users about document changes or collect approvals for a project.
Standard workflows for document approval
Sequential workflows . A sequence of actions that runs step by step until the process finishes. Best for simple tasks, such as sending an invoice for approval.

Status-driven workflows . A set of connected statuses. Each status includes its own sequence of actions. You can move documents back and forth between stages for revisions. Best for complex processes, such as contract approval.
Configure the workflow list
Use the menu next to a workflow to manage it:
- Execute during creation
- Execute during modification
- Edit
- Delete
Launch a workflow in Drive
To start a workflow manually:
1. Select a file and click Menu (≡) > Business processes.
2. Select the workflow and click Start > Continue.
3. Select the employees who will take part in the workflow and click Run.
Bitrix24 administrators and employees with permission to edit files can start workflows for files on Drive.
View the workflow log
Logs automatically record all workflow actions.
You may need logs for:
- Troubleshooting with Bitrix24 support
- Checking errors on your own
To view a workflow log:
1. Click the menu icon next to a document.
2. Select Details > More > Workflows .
You can also view logs for all workflows in the Log section.
In brief
- Workflows automate file processing in Bitrix24 Drive.
- They are available on both Company Drive and Workgroup Drive .
- Only an administrator can enable workflows on the Company Drive . On the Workgroup Drive , both the administrator and group owner can enable them.
- You can use standard templates or create sequential and status-driven workflows.

titre: FAQ: Bitrix24 Drive
sections: FAQ: Bitrix24 Drive

Bitrix24 Drive is a tool for managing files. You can store and edit company documents, configure file access permissions, and sync the drive with your computer. This article answers frequently asked questions about the Drive.
In this article:
- View the revision history for all files on the Drive
- Free up space on the Drive
- There still not enough space after clearing the Drive
- Connect cloud storage to the Drive
- Move files from the Company to Personal Drive
- Upload multiple folders to the Drive
- Why does a deleted or renamed file reappear
- Restrict file downloads from the Drive
- Why do file version conflicts occur
- Why is a folder not loading or empty
- Why is a shared folder not visible on My Drive
- Sync Bitrix24 Drive with personal computer
- View a colleague's Drive content
- Why can’t an employee see a file or folder even with access permissions
- What to do if the cursor in Bitrix24 Docs appears in the wrong place?
View the revision history for all files on the Drive
