- Section parameters : allows users to update VAT settings, enable subscriptions for out-of-stock items, and manage inventory modes. This permission is typically used by supervisors or inventory managers. Inventory management settings
- Edit employee access permissions : allows users to assign roles and grant permissions. For example, a supervisor can assign the Manager role and allow product editing. Inventory access permissions

- Toggle the option "Make out-of-stock items available for purchase" on or off : allows users to enable or disable purchases for items that are not currently in stock. This lets customers place pre-orders when needed.
- View product catalog
- View Inventory management section
Save your changes. Employees with the required permissions can now manage catalog settings, inventory options, and access permissions.

titre: Configure access permissions to view the Inventory management section
sections: Configure access permissions to view the Inventory management section
Access permissions determine who can open the section and work with inventory management documents. This helps to distribute responsibilities among employees in the company.

For example, managers handle products in deals, while the warehouse manager is responsible for the inventory. In this case, only authorized employees will have access to the section. They will process stock receipts, transfers, and write-offs. Others will not see inventory documents or be able to make changes.
To configure access to the section:
1. Go to the CRM section > Settings > Inventory access permissions .
2. Enable the View Inventory Management area permission for employees.
Once you save the settings, employees will be able to open the section and view inventory documents they have access to.

The permission grants access to the section but does not allow viewing or editing specific documents. To enable an employee to work with stock receipts, transfers, or write-offs, assign separate permissions for the required document types.
Access permissions: Stock receipt Access permissions: Stock adjustment Access permissions: Stock transfer Access permissions: Write-off Access permissions: Sale

titre: Access permissions to reserve products
sections: Access permissions to reserve products

In Bitrix24, you can reserve products in deals to assign them to customers and keep your inventory accurate. Use reservations when stock is limited, when you collect prepayments, or when you ship items in parts. For example, a manager can reserve products until the shipment date to prevent selling them to another customer.
Go to CRM > Settings > Inventory access permissions .
Configure permissions so employees can reserve products and manage reservation modes:

- Reserve products in deals Allows employees to assign products to a customer. The system reduces available stock based on the reservation. This helps managers hold items until shipment and avoid overselling. Reserve products in deals

- Access to reservation settings Allows employees to configure reservation rules for the entire company, such as reservation duration and mode. Assign this permission to roles responsible for inventory management. Inventory management settings
After you save the settings, managers can reserve products in deals based on company rules. Supervisors can manage reservation modes in the main inventory settings.

titre: Sales order access permissions
sections: Sales order access permissions
A sales order records a sale and deducts products from inventory. Access permissions control who can view, create, process, cancel, and delete these documents.
In this article:
- Available permissions for sales orders
- Example: configure permissions for a sales manager
Go to CRM > Settings > Inventory access permissions .
Available permissions
You can assign five types of permissions for sales orders:
- View — Users can open and review documents. They can’t edit, process, or delete them. Use this for monitoring sales and inventory.
- Create and edit — Users can create new documents and update drafts. Assign this to employees who prepare sales orders or update data.
- Process document — Users can complete a sale. This deducts products from inventory and records revenue.
- Cancel processing — Users can undo a processed document and restore inventory. Use this for correcting errors.
- Delete document — Users can delete drafts and canceled documents. This helps keep records clean.

Example: sales in stages. A manager may sell products in batches. For example, a customer receives items in multiple shipments. The manager creates a separate sales order for each shipment and processes it when the products are shipped. This keeps inventory accurate for each batch.
How to set it up
1. Create a role, for example, “Manager,” and add employees to it.
2. Enable these permissions:
1. View product catalog
2. View Inventory management area
3. View and select warehouse — limit access to specific warehouses
4. For sales orders:
1. View
2. Create and edit
3. Process document
Leave other permissions disabled so users can’t cancel or delete processed documents.

Users also need CRM permissions for Contacts and Companies. This allows them to select a customer in the sales order. Without these permissions, they can’t complete the document. Role-based access permissions in CRM

titre: Access permissions for stock receipts
sections: Access permissions for stock receipts

A stock receipt document records products received at a warehouse. It includes product names, quantities, and vendors. Access permissions control who can view, create, process, or delete these documents.
In this article:
- Available permissions
- Example: manager and warehouse worker roles
Go to CRM > Settings > Inventory access permissions .
Available permissions
You can assign these permissions for stock receipt documents:
- View — allows users to open documents. They cannot edit or process them. Use this to review delivery details.
- Create and edit — allows users to create new documents and update drafts. Use this when preparing deliveries and coordinating with vendors.
- Process document — confirms the receipt of goods and updates inventory. Assign this to employees who receive and verify deliveries.
- Cancel processing — allows users to undo a processed document and restore inventory. Use this to fix errors.
- Delete document — allows users to delete drafts or canceled documents. Use this to keep records clean.
Example: manager and warehouse worker roles
In many teams, managers prepare documents and warehouse workers handle deliveries.
To set this up:
1. Create a Manager role and grant:
1. View product catalog
2. View Inventory management section
3. View and select warehouses
4. For documents:
1. View
2. Create and edit
2. Managers can prepare stock receipt documents and work with vendors.
3. Create a Warehouse worker role and grant:
1. View product catalog
2. View Inventory management section
3. View and select warehouses — limit access to specific warehouses
4. For documents:
1. View
2. Process document
Leave other permissions disabled. Warehouse workers will not edit or delete documents. They only process prepared ones.
After setup, warehouse workers can open prepared documents, receive goods, and process them to record the arrival.

titre: Configure "Edit inventory object view form" access permission
sections: Configure "Edit inventory object view form" access permission

The access permission allows an employee to customize the inventory document form: add and hide fields, change the display order. For example, if employees are responsible for receiving products at the warehouse, they can move the fields for the inventory document number and stock receipt date higher in the form.
Go to the CRM section > Settings > Inventory access permissions . To allow an employee to modify the inventory document form, ensure they have the following permissions enabled:
- View product catalog
- View Inventory Management area
- Edit inventory object view form
- Access specific document types
Once the settings are saved, the employee will be able to modify the set of fields in the document form.

titre: Access permissions for Inventory management reports
sections: Access permissions for Inventory management reports

Access permissions let employees view reports on inventory, product movement, and gross profit. For example, a purchasing manager can review warehouse data, track stock levels, and plan orders with vendors.
To configure access permissions:
1. Go to CRM > Settings > Inventory access permissions .
2. Grant the following permissions:
1. View product catalog.
2. View Inventory management section.
3. View and select warehouses — choose all warehouses or specific ones.
4. View reports — choose all reports or specific ones.
Save your changes. The employee can now view reports, analyze warehouse data, and manage purchases using up-to-date information.

titre: Access permissions for stock adjustment
sections: Access permissions for stock adjustment

A stock adjustment document records inventory balances and updates stock after an inventory check. It also tracks items that appear in the warehouse but were not previously recorded. Access permissions control who can view, create, process, or delete these documents.
In this article:
- Available permissions
- Example: warehouse employee without delete access
Go to CRM > Settings > Inventory access permissions .
Available permissions
You can assign these permissions for stock adjustment documents:
- View — allows users to open documents. They cannot edit, process, or delete them. Use this to review adjustments.
- Create and edit — allows users to create new documents and update drafts. Use this when adding products after inventory checks or updating data before processing.
- Process document — confirms the adjustment and updates inventory balances. Assign this to employees responsible for warehouse operations.
- Cancel processing — allows users to undo a processed document and restore previous inventory balances. Use this to fix errors.
- Delete document — allows users to delete drafts or canceled documents. Use this to keep records clean.
Example: warehouse employee without delete access
A warehouse employee may need to record products after an inventory check but should not delete or cancel documents.
To set this up:
1. Create a role and assign employees to it.
2. Grant these permissions:
1. View product catalog
2. View Inventory management section
3. View and select warehouses — limit access to specific warehouses
4. For documents:
1. View
2. Create and edit
3. Process document
Do not enable Cancel processing or Delete document . This prevents accidental changes or data loss.
After you save the settings, the employee can add and account for products but cannot delete documents or cancel processing.

titre: Configure access permissions for the transfer document
sections: Configure access permissions for the transfer document

Use this document to track product transfers between warehouses. It shows which products moved, in what quantity, and to which warehouse. Access permissions control who can view, create, process, or delete these documents.
In this article:
- Learn which permissions you can set for transfer documents
- Set up access for a manager to process product transfers
Go to CRM > Settings > Inventory Access permissions .
You can configure five types of permissions:
- View — Allows users to view documents only. They cannot edit, process, or delete them. Use this for monitoring product movement.
- Create and edit — Allows users to create new documents and edit drafts. Use this when employees prepare transfers based on a manager’s request or after an inventory check.

- Process document — Allows users to complete transfers. The system deducts products from the source warehouse and adds them to the destination warehouse. Assign this to employees responsible for transfers and inventory.
- Cancel processing — Allows users to cancel a processed document and restore stock levels to their previous state. Assign this to employees who fix accounting errors.
- Delete document — Allows users to delete drafts and canceled documents. Assign this to employees who manage document cleanup.
Scenario: A manager processes product transfers
For example, a store manager handles transfers. They specify which products to move, set quantities, choose source and destination warehouses, and process the document.
To set up this workflow:
1. Create a role, for example, Online Store Manager , and add employees to it.

2. Enable these permissions: View product catalog , View Inventory management area , and View and select warehouses . Grant access only to the required warehouses. For transfer documents, enable View , Create and edit , and Process inventory objects . Leave other permissions disabled.
After setup, the employee can process product transfers between warehouses.

Permissions apply only to warehouses the employee can access. If a document includes multiple warehouses and the employee has access to only one, they will see the document and product list. However, warehouse details and product quantities for restricted warehouses remain hidden.

titre: Access permissions for write-off documents
sections: Access permissions for write-off documents

Write-off documents track products removed from inventory due to damage, loss, or other issues. Each document shows which items were written off and why. Access permissions control who can view, create, process, or delete these documents.
In this article:
- Available permissions
- Example: manager processes write-offs
Go to CRM > Settings > Inventory access permissions .
Available permissions
You can assign the following permissions for write-off documents:
- View — allows users to open documents. They cannot edit, process, or delete them. Use this for employees who only need visibility.
- Create and edit — allows users to create new documents and update drafts. Use this when employees prepare write-offs after stock checks or when issues are found.
- Process document — confirms the write-off and removes items from inventory. Assign this to employees responsible for inventory control.
- Cancel processing — allows users to undo a processed document and restore inventory. Use this when corrections are needed.
- Delete document — allows users to delete drafts or canceled documents. Use this for employees who manage records and cleanup.
Example: manager processes write-offs
A store manager may need to record and process write-offs for damaged or expired products.
To set this up:
1. Create a role, for example, Online store manager , and assign employees to it.
2. Grant these permissions:
1. View product catalog
2. View Inventory management section
3. View and select warehouses — limit access to specific warehouses if needed
4. For write-off documents:
1. View
2. Create and edit
3. Process document
Leave other permissions disabled. The manager will not be able to cancel processed documents or delete them.
After you save the settings, the employee can process write-off documents and record damaged or expired products.

titre: Marketing in Bitrix24
sections: Marketing in Bitrix24

Campaign parameters. Set a sending time limit, enable email read tracking, and configure consent to receive campaigns.
Configure Marketing section
Access permissions. Grant access to the required employees.
How to set access permissions for Marketing
Phone number verification. To send campaigns, link and verify a phone number in Bitrix24 before creating your first campaign. This helps prevent spam and protects your account.
Bitrix24 account verification for using email campaigns and CRM forms
Create a campaign

Create email campaign

Sales boost

titre: Configure the Marketing section
sections: Configure the Marketing section
Marketing helps you work with your customer base. You can create campaigns and choose your audience. What is CRM Marketing
Set up the Marketing section before using it. Go to Marketing > More > Settings . Here you can:
- Set email sending limits
- Configure campaign settings
- Review audio call limits
Set email sending limits

Email providers may also apply their own limits. Email Marketing Tips
Configure campaign settings
Open the More tab to configure campaign options.
You can:
- Set a time window for sending emails.
- Enable email and link tracking.
- Enable the consent to receive newsletters option.
Time options. Set the start and end time for sending emails.
Enable the option, click Edit , set the time, and click Save .
Track link clicks in outgoing emails Email and link tracking and Consent to receive newsletters
Audio call limits
Bitrix24 allows up to 5 concurrent outgoing audio calls. Create campaign
In brief
- Go to Marketing > More > Settings to configure the section.
- The Outgoing emails tab shows daily and monthly limits.
- By default, you can send up to 1,000 emails per day. Emails over the limit are sent the next day.
- Use the More tab to set sending time and enable tracking and consent options.

titre: Configure access permissions for Marketing
sections: Configure access permissions for Marketing
Marketing helps you work with your customer base. Create campaigns and define audiences. Set access permissions to control who can create segments and manage ads.
By default, only the Bitrix24 account administrator can manage access permissions. Go to Marketing > More > Access permissions .
Select sales pipelines

You can set permissions for all pipelines at once or for each pipeline separately. This is useful when different employees handle different deal pipelines. For example, users can send mailings only within their assigned pipelines. Sales pipelines
To choose a pipeline, click All Pipelines . After you set permissions for one pipeline, switch to the next.
Set up roles
A role defines a set of permissions for a user. Marketing includes three default roles:
- Administrator — full access to all Marketing features
- Manager — no access to templates, blacklist, or settings
- Supervisor — no access to templates, blacklist, or settings; cannot view clients in Campaigns, Ads, or Segments
You can edit default roles or create new ones. Click Create Role and enter a name.
Assign roles to users
You can assign both default and custom roles to different user groups:
- Recent items — employees, departments, and groups you recently searched for
- Workgroups — all groups in your Bitrix24
- My groups — groups you belong to
- Employees and departments — company structure or specific users
- Search — find users, departments, or groups by name
If a user has multiple roles, the system applies the highest level of access.
Click the Plus (+) button to add users.
Configure permissions
Set access levels for each section:
- Campaigns — view, create, run, stop, pause campaigns, and view recipients
- Ads — view campaigns, run, stop, pause ads, and view recipients
- Segments — create and edit segments, view clients, edit leads, upload custom addresses
- Sales Boost — create rules, run, stop, pause, and view rules
- Templates — view and edit templates
- Blacklist — view and edit the blacklist
- Start — view the Marketing home page
- Settings — change settings, including access permissions
Enable permissions using the checkboxes next to each option. Click Save .
In brief
- Marketing helps you manage your customer base and create campaigns with target audiences.
- You can set permissions for all pipelines or configure each one separately.
- The Bitrix24 administrator manages access permissions and can grant access to other users.
- There are three default roles: Administrator, Manager, and Supervisor. You can also create custom roles.
- Assign roles to employees, departments, or groups.

titre: Verify your Bitrix24 account for email campaigns and CRM forms
sections: Verify your Bitrix24 account for email campaigns and CRM forms
To send email campaigns and create CRM forms, link and verify a phone number in your Bitrix24 account. This protects your account, prevents spam, and keeps personal data in CRM forms secure.
When verification is required
You need to verify your account in these cases:
- When you create your first email campaign in the Marketing section on any plan.
- When you create your first CRM form on the Free plan or during the trial period.
Verify your account
When you create your first email campaign or CRM form, a panel opens on the right.
Follow these steps:
1. Enter your phone number and click Send SMS .
2. You will receive a code within 10 minutes. Enter the code and click Confirm .
3. Wait for verification to complete, then click Finish .
One phone number can be used for up to five accounts.
After verification, you can send email campaigns and create CRM forms.

titre: Create customer segments for marketing campaigns
sections: Create customer segments for marketing campaigns
A segment is a group of customers who share common traits, such as age, location, or purchased products. Use segments to target marketing campaigns.
What is CRM Marketing
There are two types of segments:
- Dynamic This list updates automatically before each campaign. The number of recipients changes as your customer base changes.
- Static You create this list manually. You can upload emails or phone numbers and update the list by adding or removing recipients.
To create a segment:
1. Go to Marketing > Segments .
2. Click Create segment .
Create a dynamic segment
A dynamic segment can include leads, contacts, or companies.
Choose one of the following:
- Clients : Use contacts and companies. You can include clients with or without deals.
- Leads : Includes only leads. At least one field must be filled in (email, phone, or messenger). Empty leads are excluded.
You can build the segment using filters:
Use ready-made filters. Click Clients or Leads and select the filter. For example, you can use the With won deals filter to create a segment with successful deals in all pipelines.
Customize filters. You can filter entities using standard or custom fields.
Standard fields in CRM Custom fields in CRM
Examples of available filters:
- CRM entity — Leave this field empty. It is not used when creating segments.
- Client type – Select Contact or Company . To include both, choose Not specified (Contact, Company) .
- Lead status — Select the stages where leads should be included in the segment.
- Converted — Filter leads by status: converted or still in progress.
- Stage — Select the stages where deals should be included in the segment.
- Deal pipelines — Filter deals by pipeline. If you select Customers without deals , the segment will include customers who have no deals and never had any. Sales pipelines
- Deal status — Choose one or more statuses: in progress, won, or lost.
- Contact source — Select how the customer found your company, such as website, social media, or CRM form.
- Contact via — Select one or more communication methods: phone, email, or messenger. If you select all, only customers with all three fields filled in will be included.
- Product — Filter customers who purchased a specific product.
- Find product in — Choose where to search for the product: all records, paid orders, unpaid orders, active deals, won deals, or lost deals.
- Deal amount — Enter an exact value or a range.
- Responsible person — If you select multiple employees, the segment will include all records assigned to them.
- Responsible person (Contact) — Includes contacts assigned to the selected employees.
- Responsible person (Company) — Includes companies assigned to the selected employees.
- Responsible person (Deal) — Includes contacts and companies linked to deals assigned to the selected employees.
Create campaign
Create a dynamic segment using date fields
You can filter customers using date fields, such as the purchase date or subscription expiration date.
Choose how the system handles the year:
- Respect year — The filter uses the current year.
- Don't respect year — The filter uses only the date, not the year. For example, you can create a segment of customers with a birthday on April 16, regardless of the year.
You can also select a time frame, such as today, tomorrow, this month, in N days.
Use N-day filters
Here’s how filters work when you use an N-day range:
Previous Nth day — A specific day in the past. Example: If today is April 15 and N = 3, the filter includes April 12.
Over N days ago — Any date earlier than a specific point. Example: If today is April 15 and N = 3, the filter includes dates up to April 11.
Last N days — A range from the past up to today. Example: If today is April 15 and N = 3, the filter includes April 12–15.
In N days — A specific future date. Example: If today is April 15 and N = 3, the filter includes April 18.
Next N days — A range starting tomorrow. Example: If today is April 15 and N = 3, the filter includes April 16–18.
Next Nth day — A specific future date. Example: If today is April 15 and N = 3, the filter includes April 18.
Create a static segment
1. In the Custom recipient list field, click Import .
2. Enter a list of emails or phone numbers. You can export this data from CRM or another source and upload it.
3. Enter each email or phone number on a new line.
4. (Optional) Add a name after a semicolon.
5. Click Import .
6. Enter a name for the segment.
7. Click Save .
Export CRM data
In brief
- A segment is a group of customers with shared characteristics, such as age, location, or purchased products.
- Use segments for marketing campaigns in Bitrix24.
- There are two types of segments: dynamic and static.
- Dynamic — The list updates automatically before each campaign. The number of recipients changes as your customer base changes.
- Static — You create and manage the list manually. You can upload emails or phone numbers and update the list by adding or removing recipients.

titre: Work with your customer database
sections: Work with your customer database

You need a customer database to drive repeat sales. Without one, CRM Marketing cannot run effectively, and you may miss opportunities to bring customers back. Before you create segments or campaigns, organize your customer database first.
Prepare your customer database

CRM Marketing only works with Bitrix24 CRM. If you currently manage sales in Excel, another CRM, or a spreadsheet, move your data to the CRM first. You can add records manually or import your database from another system. Migrate data to Bitrix24 CRM

After you import your contacts, set up CRM access permissions. Choose which employees can work with the database. You can also assign different permission levels. For example, some employees can only view items, while others can edit or delete them.
Go to Settings > Access permissions > CRM . Access Permissions in CRM
Why it’s important to add all contacts to the CRM

Finding new customers takes time and costs money. Every customer matters, even if they have not made a purchase yet. Add all customers to the CRM so you can reach them later with marketing campaigns and special offers.
If a contact sends spam messages, add the contact to the blacklist.
Grow your customer database

Bitrix24 automatically saves contacts from connected channels such as social networks, email, chats, and phone calls. Employees do not need to enter contacts manually, which helps your team work faster.
Contact Center is a tool for customer communication and message handling. Connect your communication channels and social networks to save all calls, emails, and chat messages directly in the CRM.

titre: Create campaign
sections: Create campaign
After you create a client segment, choose how you want to contact those clients. Marketing includes several campaign tools:
- Email Campaigns
- SMS Campaigns
- Voice Broadcasting
- Messengers
- Sales Boost
Email Campaigns
Email is one of the most common ways to contact clients. For example, a pet store can use an email campaign to tell customers about a new brand of cat food.
Use a standard Marketing template and edit it, or create your own template in My Templates .
SMS Campaigns
You can also contact clients with SMS messages. Write a short message about a discount or promotion, then select a segment. Bitrix24 will send the messages automatically.
For example, a car service can invite customers to schedule a seasonal tire change by SMS.
To send SMS campaigns, connect an SMS provider. You can set up the built-in Twilio integration or install another SMS app from Bitrix24 Market .
The number of messages you can send per day depends on your SMS provider. To check your current limit, go to Marketing > Settings > SMS .
Voice Broadcasting
Bitrix24 can make automatic calls to clients. It converts your text into audio and calls the selected phone numbers.
Use voice broadcasting to tell customers that a product is back in stock or to remind them about an event.
Text to Speech is a paid add-on service provided by Voximplant. You can check current prices on the Voximplant pricing page .
Before you make calls, configure Telephony. You can rent a phone number or connect your PBX using the SIP connector.
Bitrix24 can make up to five calls at the same time every 15 minutes. Other scheduled calls start after the current calls end.
Test mode recipients
You can test SMS campaigns, email campaigns, and voice broadcasts before sending them to clients. Use your own phone number or email address to check how the message looks or sounds.
Messengers
Messengers and social networks are another way to reach your audience. If Open Channels are connected, you can use Marketing campaigns with all supported messengers.
For example, a cosmetology clinic can invite clients to book a follow-up visit.

The message is sent to clients who recently contacted you in the selected messenger. The chat does not need to be active when you send the campaign. If a client replies, you will get a new message notification in the Open Channel.
Sales Boost
Sales Boost creates repeat deals and leads for a selected group of clients. You can also create a task for the manager who will work with the deal.
Use this tool when a specific employee needs to contact clients directly.

titre: Create email campaigns
sections: Create email campaigns
Email campaigns let you send emails to a group of recipients. Use them to share promotions, new products, or special offers.

2. Click Email campaign .
Then complete these steps:

- Select a recipient segment

Select campaign template
You can use:
- Standard templates — edit content, images, and files.
- Custom templates — create your own or base them on standard templates. Go to Marketing > My Templates .
To rename a standard template:
1. Click the pencil icon.
2. Enter a new name.
Select recipient segment
In Bitrix24, recipients are grouped into segments based on shared traits, such as age, location, or purchase history.
Create customer segments for marketing campaigns
There are two types:
- Dynamic — updates automatically before sending.
- Static — created manually or uploaded from a file.
Select a segment. Click Select segment and choose an existing one.
Create a segment. Click Create and define your audience.
Exclude recipients. You can exclude customers from the main segment who do not need to receive the newsletter.
For example, you can send a promotion to all customers but exclude those who have already bought a product this month.
1. Click Exclusions .
2. Select a segment to exclude.
3. Click Apply .
Specify subject and sender
Subject. Recipients see this text in their inbox. Use the default subject or enter your own.
Sender. Select the email address used to send the campaign.
If the address is not listed, click Add sender .
Connect mailboxes to Bitrix24
Design newsletter
Create clear, engaging content. Add images, text, and personalization.
Work with blocks. Emails use blocks such as text, images, buttons, and separators. You can edit, copy, or delete blocks. To add a new block, drag it from the right panel into the template.
The Footer block is required. It must include an unsubscribe link.
If you use a custom HTML template, add this code:
unsubscribe link
Customize design.
1. Click Design .
2. Set background, fonts, and spacing.
Add personalization. Insert CRM data like name or birthdate.
1. Open a text block.
2. Click the variable icon.
3. Select a CRM field.
Preview and save. Click Preview to check how the email looks on different devices. Then click Apply .
Enable Save to my templates to reuse the design.
You can find the saved template in Marketing > My Templates .
Configure campaign parameters
Open the More section to configure priority, UTM tags, attachments, email tracking, and subscription confirmation.
Priority. Mark important emails.
UTM tags. Add UTM tags to track traffic sources.
1. Click UTM tags .
2. Fill in the required fields.
3. Click Apply .
Attachments. Add files like catalogs or coupons. Drag the file into the Attachments field.
Email tracking. Enable this option to track opens and clicks.
Link tracking works only if enabled in your Bitrix24 settings. Track link clicks in outgoing emails

Subscription confirmation. Enable this option to send new customers a confirmation email before sending the campaign. Then select a consent template or create your own. Email and link tracking and Consent to receive newsletters
If you enable consent but don’t select a template, the campaign won’t send.
Sending time. Set a time window for sending emails, such as business hours.
Send the campaign
To check how the email looks, send yourself a test campaign. After that, send the campaign to customers.
Send a test email. Enter your email address. You can test the final email and the subscription confirmation.
After reviewing the campaign, click Save .
Send to recipients. Choose when to send and click Save .
Now . Send immediately.
Later, manually . Send from Marketing > Campaigns .
Schedule . Set a specific date and time.
In brief
- Email campaigns help you reach groups of customers.
- Use them for promotions, updates, or feedback.
- Choose a template or create your own.
- Build emails with blocks like text, images, and buttons.
- Personalize content with CRM data.
- Configure tracking, attachments, and consent.
- Always send a test email before launching.

titre: Troubleshooting email campaign issues
sections: Troubleshooting email campaign issues
When creating and sending email campaigns in the Marketing section, you may face the issues because of your browser extensions and ad blockers, like Adblock Plus, Ghostery, and others.
This article will show you how to disable extensions in these browsers:
- Google Chrome
- Mozilla Firefox
- Microsoft Edge
- Vivaldi
- Opera
- Safari
After seeing the error notification, first check the Bitrix24 status page and try sending emails again after 5–10 minutes. Bitrix24 status page
If it doesn't help, do the following:
1. Disable the ad-blocking browser extensions.
2. Delete and recreate email templates created with the ad blockers enabled.
3. Send the campaign with extensions disabled.
Google Chrome
1. Click the three dots button (⋮).
2. Select Extensions .
3. Click Manage Extensions .
4. Find the ad-blocking extension and disable it.
Mozilla Firefox
1. Click the Menu button (≡).
2. Select Add-ons and themes
3. Click Extensions .
4. Find the ad-blocking extension and disable it.
Microsoft Edge
1. Click the three dots button (...).
2. Select Extensions .
3. Click Manage Extensions .
4. Slide the switch of the ad-blocking extension to the left to disable it.
Vivaldi
1. Click the small arrow next to V .
2. Select Tools .
3. Click Extensions .
4. Find and disable the ad-blocking extension.
Opera
1. Click the O button.
2. Select Extensions .
3. Click Extensions .
4. Find and disable the ad-blocking extension.
Safari
1. Click Safari .
2. Select Settings .
3. Uncheck the ad-blocking extension to disable it.
If the issue persists after disabling extensions and recreating templates, contact Bitrix24 support team via chat in your account. How to contact Bitrix24 Support

titre: Set up a personalized email campaign
sections: Set up a personalized email campaign
Make your emails more personal with special tags in email marketing. These tags look like #PARAMETER# . When you send the email, they automatically turn into real customer data.
Add tags to your email
1. Click the three dots next to the subject line.
2. Search for a tag or browse the list.
3. You can select fields from a lead, contact, or company.
4. Choose a parameter, such as the customer’s first name.
The selected tag appears in the subject line. Copy it and paste it into the email body where needed.
If you’re sending a birthday discount, include the customer’s name and the responsible person’s name for follow-up. Add the tags you copied to your message text.
Prepare the campaign
1. Click Select segment to choose recipients.
2. You’ll see the number of emails below the segment.
3. Review the campaign details.
4. Save the campaign and choose when to send it.
When the campaign is sent, the tags are replaced with data from your CRM. Each recipient gets a personalized email.

titre: Email and link tracking and Consent to receive newsletters
sections: Email and link tracking and Consent to receive newsletters
When you create email campaigns in Marketing , you can use these options:

- Email and link tracking : Track how many customers opened your email and clicked links. Some countries restrict email open and link click tracking. In these countries, this option is turned off by default.

- Consent to receive newsletters : Send opt-in requests to customers before you start email campaigns. Customers who have not subscribed yet receive a confirmation email first. To help prevent spam and improve customer trust, Bitrix24 uses newsletter consent requests. In some countries, local laws require this option. In these cases, it is enabled by default and cannot be turned off.
Enable email and link tracking and newsletter consent
1. Go to Marketing .
2. Open Settings .
3. Open the More tab.
4. Turn on the required options.
You can also enable Track email reads and Require newsletter consent for a specific campaign:
1. Open the email campaign settings.
2. Click More .
3. Enable the required options.
How email and link tracking works
After you enable tracking, Bitrix24 starts collecting campaign data. You can view the results in the Statistics column.
Click Views or Clicks to open detailed statistics.
On the Recipients tab, you can see who:
- received the email
- opened the email
- clicked links in the email
How newsletter consent works
After you enable Require newsletter consent , select Consent to receive the newsletter from the list. You can use a standard consent form in Bitrix24 or create your own message.
When you send your first newsletter, customers receive a confirmation email first. If they agree to receive newsletters, Bitrix24 sends the promotional email after the confirmation email.
If you enable Require newsletter consent in the campaign settings, new recipients continue to receive confirmation requests until they either:
- agree to receive newsletters
- unsubscribe from future emails

Bitrix24 sends a consent request to each email address only once. You can send future campaigns only to customers who agreed to receive emails. You can find all consent records in the Obtained consents list.
If you email the customer who never consented to receive it, the email will have a Never sent status. This customer will never receive your mailing.

titre: Make voice broadcasting and audio calls from Bitrix24
sections: Make voice broadcasting and audio calls from Bitrix24

Voice broadcasting is a campaign type that enables you to automatically reach out to customers through calls. Just provide the text, and Bitrix24 will convert it into a voice message, calling the necessary numbers for you.
Audio calls allow you to connect with customers using a pre-recorded voice message, ensuring your message is delivered clearly and consistently.
Use voice broadcasting and audio calls to effectively inform customers about promotions, news, or other significant events.
Check if voice broadcasting and audio calls are available on your plan. Bitrix24 plans and pricing
To make voice broadcasting and audio calls from Bitrix24, set up Bitrix24 telephony. You can use rented numbers or connect your PBX using SIP connector. Telephony connection options overview
In voice broadcasting, the Text to Speech option is a paid add-on service. Funds will be deducted from your Bitrix24 telephony account. Text to Speech pricing
- Create a campaign
- Add recipients
- Choose a number
- Add campaign text
- Upload an audio recording
- Set call parameters
- Send the campaign
Create a campaign
1. Go to Marketing .
2. Open the Start tab.
3. Choose a campaign type, like Voice broadcasting .
4. Select a campaign template, such as Convert a lead into a client .
To quickly find the campaign later, rename it by clicking the pencil icon and entering a new name. This name is only visible in Bitrix24 and won't be seen by customers.
Add recipients

In Bitrix24, campaign recipients are known as segments. These are groups formed based on common characteristics like age, location, purchased products, and more. Create customer segments for marketing campaigns
There are two types of segments:
- Dynamic: This list is automatically generated before the campaign starts.
- Static: This list is created manually. You can upload an existing list of customer numbers to Bitrix24.
Select a segment. Use pre-installed options or choose from previously created ones. Click Select segment .
Create a segment. If there is no suitable segment in Bitrix24, click Create and set up your recipient list.
Exclude a segment. You can remove certain customers from the main segment. For example, you might call all customers but exclude those already planning a purchase.
Choose a number
Select the service and phone number you want to use for the calls.
Add campaign text
For voice broadcasting, enter your campaign text, and Bitrix24 will convert it to speech.
To personalize the message, add information from CRM fields, like the customer's name:
1. Open the three-dot menu (...) next to the input field.
2. Select a CRM item you need.
3. Select a variable.
4. The variable will appear in the text, and during the call, it will be replaced with the actual value from the Name field in the CRM item form.
Upload an audio recording
If you're sending an Audio call campaign to customers, upload the recording in MP3 format.
Set call parameters
In the More section, customize the language and voice, adjust speech speed and volume, and set a time limit for when calls will be made.
Language and voice. Choose the language and voice for your campaign text.
Speech speed. Choose how fast Bitrix24 will play your text: very slow, slow, normal, fast, or very fast.
Speech volume. Adjust the volume for the text: very quiet, quiet, normal, loud, or very loud.
Send newsletter only within time specified. Specify the time frame, such as calling customers during non-working hours from 6:00 PM to 8:00 PM.
Send the campaign
Send a test campaign. To check how the text or audio recording sounds, send a test campaign to yourself. Once you're satisfied, you can send it to customers.
After reviewing the campaign, click Save .
Send the campaign to customers. Decide when to start calling customers:
- Now: Calls will start immediately.
- Later manually: To call customers at another time, go to Marketing > Campaigns , select the desired campaign, and click Send .
- Schedule: Set a specific date and time to call customers.
In brief
- Voice broadcasting automates customer calls by converting your text into a voice message and calling the necessary numbers.
- Audio calls use a pre-recorded voice message to communicate with customers.
- To use these features, configure Bitrix24 telephony with rented numbers or the SIP connector.
- In voice broadcasting, the Text to Speech option is a paid add-on service. Funds will be deducted from your Bitrix24 telephony account.
- Create campaigns using pre-installed templates for ease and efficiency.
- Select campaign recipients from dynamic or static segments.
- In the More section, customize language, voice, speed, volume, and call timing.
- Test your campaign by sending it to yourself before reaching out to customers.

titre: Create and send an SMS campaign
sections: Create and send an SMS campaign

titre: Send a campaign to messengers
sections: Send a campaign to messengers
Bitrix24 campaigns let you send messages to groups of customers in messengers and social networks like Telegram and WhatsApp. Use campaigns to share promotions, discounts, and product updates.

You can only send campaigns to customers who have already contacted you through a messenger. If a customer has used multiple messengers, the campaign goes to the one they used first. For example, if the first message came from Telegram, the campaign will be sent to Telegram.
You will learn:
- how to create a campaign,
- select recipients,
- add a message,
- configure a campaign,
- send a campaign.
Create a campaign
Go to Marketing > Start > Messenger and choose a template.
To make campaigns easier to find, rename them:
- Click the pencil icon
- Enter a new name
This name is only visible inside Bitrix24.
Select recipients
In Bitrix24, recipients are called segments . A segment is a group of customers with shared attributes, such as age, location, or purchase history.
Create customer segments for marketing campaigns
Select a segment. Click Select segment and choose a preset or existing segment.
If you don’t have a suitable segment, click Create and set up your recipient list.
Exclude a segment. You can exclude specific customers from the campaign.
Example: send a promotion to all customers except those already planning a purchase. Click Exclusions , choose a segment to exclude, and click Apply .
Add a message
You can use the template message or write your own.
To personalize messages, insert CRM field values:
1. Click the three dots.
2. Select Lead > Name .
3. The variable is added to the text.
When the campaign is sent, the system replaces the variable with the customer’s actual name.
Configure campaign settings
Set the delivery time in the More section.
For example, schedule messages for non-working hours when customers are more active in messengers.
Choose a time and click Apply .
Send a campaign
Choose when to send the campaign and click Save :
- Now — send immediately.
- Later, manually — send anytime from Marketing > Campaigns .
- Schedule — set a specific date and time.
In brief
- Bitrix24 campaigns let you send messages to customers in messengers and social networks.
- You can only send campaigns to customers who have already contacted you.
- If a customer used multiple messengers, the campaign goes to the first one they used.
- Use templates to create campaigns faster.
- Only dynamic segments are supported for messenger campaigns.
- Personalize messages using customer data from CRM.
- Schedule delivery time in the More section.

titre: Consent to receive newsletters
sections: Consent to receive newsletters
An email campaign is sent to a group of recipients. You can use it to promote products and services, collect feedback, or share updates.
You can only send email campaigns to customers who have agreed to receive them. To stay compliant with legal requirements, set up consent collection before sending newsletters.
Enable newsletter consent
1. Go to Marketing > More > Settings .
2. Open the More tab.
3. Enable Consent to receive newsletters .
Select a consent
1. Go to Marketing > Start tab > Email Campaign .
2. Choose a campaign template. Create email campaigns
3. Open the More section and enable the Require newsletter consent option.
4. Select a consent template from the list.
5. Click Edit settings and configure the following:
1. Enter a name.
2. Enter the consent text. To display it in HTML format, enable the Allow HTML in agreement text option.
3. Click Preview to review the consent.
4. Add your company details manually or import them from CRM.
6. Save the changes.
Create a consent
1. Click + Create new Consent .
2. Enter a name and the consent text.
3. Click View to check the consent.
4. Add your company details manually or import them from CRM.
5. Save the consent.
Send consent requests
The system automatically sends a consent request with your newsletter. New customers first receive an email with the consent form. After they agree, they receive the newsletter.

You can send up to 500 emails at a time to collect consent. If no one responds, the system sends the next 500 requests after seven days. If at least one customer responds, the system continues sending requests to the next customers who have not received them yet.
View collected consents
In the campaign template. Click Obtained consents to see customers who agreed to receive newsletters.
In the Marketing section. Go to Marketing > Recipients . To download the list, click Settings (⚙️) and select Export data .
In brief
- You can only send email campaigns to customers who have agreed to receive them.
- Send consent requests from the Marketing section.
- Use a standard template or create your own consent text.
- The system sends consent requests automatically with newsletters.
- You can send up to 500 emails at a time.

titre: Avoid sending messages to invalid emails
sections: Avoid sending messages to invalid emails
Emails may fail to reach recipients for several reasons. A common cause is an incorrect or non-existent email address. These cases are marked as errors.
Find emails with errors
1. Go to Marketing > Campaigns .
2. In the campaign statistics, click Views .
3. Filter emails with the Has errors status.
4. Check that the issue is not related to your mail server.
5. Click the error count in the statistics panel.
6. To export the list, click the settings icon in the top right and select Export data .
7. Open the file and copy the email addresses.
Prevent future errors
Use one of these options to avoid sending emails to invalid addresses again.
Option 1: Add addresses to the blacklist
1. Go to Marketing > Black List .
2. Click Add to list .
3. Paste the email addresses.
4. Click Import .
Option 2: Create an exclusion segment
1. Go to Marketing > Segments .
2. Click Create segment .
3. In Custom recipient list , click Import .
4. Paste the email addresses and click Import .
5. Save the segment.
When creating a new email campaign, open Exclusions and select this segment. Emails will not be sent to these addresses.
In brief
- Email errors often occur due to invalid addresses.
- Find affected contacts in Marketing > Campaigns using the Has errors filter.
- Prevent repeat errors by adding addresses to the blacklist or excluding them with a segment.

titre: Advertising audiences

titre: Send customer actions to Facebook

Bitrix24 offers a tool for working with ads audiences on Facebook. With this tool, you can:
- Send customer actions from CRM directly to Facebook.

titre: Facebook administrator permission required
sections: Facebook administrator permission required
You may se the Administrator permission required message when you:
- Connect CRM forms to Facebook
- Set up a Facebook connection in Marketing
- Set up a Facebook connection in CRM Analytics
This happens because your Bitrix24 account is still connected to Facebook Business Manager from a previous setup.
For example:
1. You connected a CRM form to Facebook while signed in to your Facebook account.
2. Later, you disconnected the form but did not remove the original link.
3. Then you signed in to a different Facebook account and tried to connect a new CRM form.
As a result, Facebook displays the Administrator permission required message.
How to fix it
You can fix this in one of these ways:
1. Give the new Facebook account access in Facebook Business Manager settings. For more information, see How to Add People to Your Facebook Business Manager .
2. Remove the Bitrix24 business integration from the settings of the original Facebook account .
