titre: Sales boost
sections: Sales boost
As your customer base grows, finding new clients becomes harder. That is why repeat sales matter. In Bitrix24, you can automate repeat sales for a group of customers.
Sales Boost is a tool that automatically creates repeat leads and deals. You can use it to send special offers to customers, such as birthday discounts.
How Sales Boost works
1. Go to the Marketing section in the left menu.
2. Select Repeat Deals .
You can choose one of the prebuilt templates or create your own.
3. Create a new customer segment and specify the details.
4. Click Save and start the sales boost.
Bitrix24 will automatically create repeat deals and add comments for managers.
You can track the process status in Marketing > Sales Boost .
Prebuilt templates
When you start Sales Boost, you can choose one of the prebuilt templates. Templates are available for birthdays, recent deals, and holidays.
Hover over the question mark icon to view campaign details.
Templates also include ready-to-use conversation scripts for customer communication. Select a script and start working with repeat sales.
In brief
- Sales Boost automatically creates repeat leads and deals. You can use Sales Boost to run special offers, such as birthday discounts.
- Open Marketing > Repeat Deals .
- Choose a prebuilt template or create a custom campaign.
- Bitrix24 automatically creates repeat deals and adds comments for managers.
- You can track campaign progress in Marketing > Sales Boost .

titre: FAQ: Marketing
sections: FAQ: Marketing

Marketing is a tool for managing your customer base. It allows you to create email campaigns and build advertising audiences. In this article, we've compiled answers to frequently asked questions about the Marketing section.
In this article:
- Why large email campaigns are not sent immediately
- Can I can export a campaign segment?
- How emails in campaigns get the "Sent" and "Read" statuses
- Why some emails end up on the blacklist when sending a campaign
- How to restore campaigns for unsubscribed clients
- Why images in Outlook emails are misaligned or extend beyond the edges
- How link clicks are counted in email campaigns
- Why SMS campaigns are not being sent
- Why recipients are not shown when sending messenger campaigns
- Why an email campaign has the "Has errors" status
- Why a campaign might be sent with a delay
Why large email campaigns are not sent immediately
Bitrix24 has a limit on sending emails—up to 1,000 emails per day. If you try to send more, the emails will automatically be queued and sent the next day.
The limit may change depending on the recipients' actions with emails:
- It increases if recipients do not mark emails as spam.
- It decreases if there are many complaints about the campaigns.
Set a limit on sending emails
If clients frequently report spam, email campaigns from Bitrix24 Marketing will be blocked.
Can I can export a campaign segment?
Currently, Bitrix24 does not offer the option to export campaign segments, even using REST methods.
How emails in campaigns get the "Sent" and "Read" statuses

Sent. When you send an email campaign, the emails are transferred from Bitrix24 servers to the recipients' ones. If the recipient's server successfully accepts the email, it is automatically assigned the "Sent" status.
This means the email has been delivered to the recipient's server but does not guarantee it has been read.
Read. This status indicates that the recipient has read the email.

Each email sent through Bitrix24 includes a 1×1 pixel image link. When the recipient reads the email, the service loads its elements, including the image. Bitrix24 records that the image has been loaded and assigns the email the "Read" status.
The "Read" status can be assigned:
- When the email was sent to multiple recipients, and at least one of them read it.
- If the image was loaded during an automatic check by an antivirus or an email service.
The "Read" status will not be assigned if the recipient has disabled image loading in the email service, even if the email was read.
Why some emails end up on the blacklist when sending a campaign
The Bitrix24 blacklist is a list of addresses to which emails could not be sent. This happens for three reasons:
- The recipient's address does not exist
- There are issues with the recipient's domain
- The recipient's address was blocked at the time of sending the email
If the campaign includes non-existent addresses, you will receive an error notification at the email address from which the campaign was sent.

When Bitrix24 detects errors, it automatically adds the address to the blacklist and no longer sends emails to it. This is done to prevent the Bitrix24 servers' rating from decreasing and to ensure faster email delivery. If there are many errors, sending emails from your Bitrix24 may be blocked.
1. Go to your Bitrix24 account settings.
2. Select Security tab > Blacklist .
3. Click Menu (≡) > Delete .
How to restore campaigns for unsubscribed clients

If clients unsubscribe from an email campaign, they will no longer receive it, even if their email address is in the segment. You can use other Bitrix24 tools to communicate with the clients: calls, messengers, SMS campaigns, and so on.
Telephony connection options overview Create and send an SMS campaign
Why images in Outlook emails are misaligned or extend beyond the edges
Outlook sometimes incorrectly adjusts image sizes to fit the screen width. They may be misaligned or extend beyond the edges.

The standard width of the content area of an email template is designed for screens with a resolution of 1280 pixels or more. To ensure the image displays correctly in an Outlook email, its width should not exceed 640 pixels.
Create email campaign
How link clicks are counted in email campaigns

In the Marketing > Campaigns section, you can see statistics on link clicks from emails. The click rate shows the percentage of unique recipients who clicked at least one link. For example, if a single client clicks three different links, it will count as three total clicks but only one unique click, since they came from the same person.
Why SMS campaigns are not being sent
Issue: SMS campaigns are not being sent or show errors.
Solutions:
- Check that the phone numbers for campaign recipients are correct.
- Make sure your SMS provider account has enough funds to send messages.
Why recipients are not shown when sending messenger campaigns
Issue: Recipients are not shown when adding a segment to a messenger campaign.
Reason: In Bitrix24, you can only send messages via messengers only to clients who have previously communicated with you through those channels.
Solution: Check the segment selected for the campaign. Make sure it's a dynamic segment that includes only clients who have already interacted with you via a messaging app.
Create customer segments for marketing campaigns
Why a campaign shows the "Has errors" status
Issue: Emails in the campaign are marked as "Has errors" and aren’t delivered to recipients.
Possible reasons:
- The email address is blacklisted in your Bitrix24 settings.
- The recipient's address is blacklisted in the Marketing section.
- The recipient's address is on the unsubscribe list.
- The recipient's address is on the Newsletter Abuse Complaints list.
- The recipient's address is excluded from the campaign segment.
- The sender's server blocked the email.
- The recipient's server rejected the email.
- You’ve exceeded your email sending limit.
Solutions:
- Check the blacklist in Bitrix24 settings. If an address was added by mistake, remove it. Why some emails end up on the blacklist when sending a campaign
- Make sure you haven’t exceeded your email sending limits. Set a limit on sending emails
- Review the unsubscribe list for the recipient’s email.
- If the issue persists, contact Bitrix24 Support for help. AI support agent in Bitrix24 Support chat Contact Bitrix24 Support
Why a campaign might be sent with a delay

If the "Require newsletter consent" option is enabled, the campaign could be delayed. New clients first receive an email asking for their consent to receive campaigns. This consent request is sent only once. If they agree, the campaign email is sent immediately.
The campaign will stay in the "Sending" status until all clients either agree to receive or opt out of your emails.
Consent to receive newsletters

titre: Create and configure your Bitrix24 site
sections: Create and configure your Bitrix24 site

Bitrix24 allows you to create a site without programming skills. You can start from scratch, use a ready-made template, or use the AI assistant CoPilot. Choose blocks and site design without coding or complex settings. This solution is ideal for landing pages, online stores, and multi-page websites.
- Create a site
- Customize blocks and design
- Publish your site
Create a site
Go to Sites and Stores section > Sites and click Create . The Bitrix24 Market catalog will open, where you can select the right solution for your site.

Site with CoPilot. Click Create a site to open the site editor with an integrated chat with CoPilot. Describe your idea and site requirements, then send your message. The AI assistant will generate a site based on the specified theme, selecting the design, images, and text. CoPilot: AI assistant to create websites
Ready-made template is suitable for creating landing pages, multi-page websites, and online stores.
1. Go to the Catalog > Sites and online stores and select a section.
2. Choose one of the tags and select a ready-made template from the list.
3. Alternatively, search for a template using keywords. Enter them in the search bar and select the desired template from the list.
4. Click Create a site .
Blank template helps you create a site from scratch. Select Empty template and click Create a site.
Customize your site
After creating the site, it will open in the editor. Here, you can add and modify blocks, change the design, and adjust the layout.
Add more blocks
Add a cover, divider, image with text, timer, heading, and more.
1. Click + Add block where you want to place it.
2. Select a section and template from the list.
Customize a block
Hover over the block you want to edit to see the list of available actions.
Edit. Change the block settings and content, such as the title, element captions, or timer end date. Click Save.
Design. Adjust the block's visibility on desktops, tablets, and smartphones. Visitors won't see the block on devices you mark with a cross.
By default, blocks adapt to the site's style, but you can modify the background, font, color, alignment, animation, etc. The number of options depends on the block type.

For similar elements, design settings are adjusted individually, such as for titles, buttons, and captions. Click an element to customize it. Change design in Sites and Stores CoPilot in sites: how to create an image
Superblock. Add or remove block elements like titles, icons, images, videos, and more. Save your changes. Superblock in Bitrix24 Sites
Additional actions.
Move the block up or down using the buttons.
To delete a block, click the icon.
Click Actions to open the context menu:
- Hide block — it will no longer be active or visible on the site but will remain in the editor. To restore it, click Show block .
- Cut
- Copy
- Paste — the copied or cut block will appear below.
- Leave feedback — opens a feedback form about Bitrix24 Sites.
- Save to block list — allows you to save the block as a template for future site creation. Enter a name, select a section, and click Save.
To undo or redo an action, use special buttons at the top of the screen.
Publish your site

By default, Auto-publish mode is enabled. Sites created with CoPilot or using a ready-made template are published immediately after creation, while blank templates are published after adding the first block. Any edits you make will be automatically reflected.

If auto-publish is disabled, click Preview to open the site in a new tab. Edits will only be visible to you. To check how the site appears on different devices, click the icons at the top of the screen.
Click Publish site to make your changes visible to site visitors. Auto publish and preview options and site navigation
In brief
- Bitrix24 allows you to create a site without programming skills. You can start from scratch, use a ready-made template, or use the AI assistant CoPilot.
- Choose blocks and site design without coding or complex settings.
- To create a site, go to the Sites and Stores section > Sites and click Create .
- By default, Auto-publish mode is enabled, and changes are automatically reflected on the site.
- If auto-publish is disabled, click Preview to open the site in a new tab. Edits will only be visible to you. Click Publish site to make changes visible to site visitors.

titre: Create a multi-page website
sections: Create a multi-page website
In Bitrix24, you can create a website with multiple pages. This is ideal for resources with a large amount of content, such as online stores, blogs, corporate websites, etc.
- Add pages
- Add shared blocks to all pages
- Configure site navigation
Add pages
1. Go to Sites and Stores > Sites
2. Create a new site or select an existing one. Hover over it, and click View pages.
3. Click New page . Select a blank template or a ready-made one from the Bitrix24 Market.
4. To create multiple similar pages, click Actions > Copy page .
5. Return to the Sites tab. Click the icon next to the site status and select Publish — all pages will be published automatically.
Create your site in Bitrix24
Add shared blocks
You can place shared blocks on all pages of the site, such as a header, sidebar, contacts, etc. Let’s configure the Site header block as an example.
1. Click Three dots (...) > Configure site.
2. Expand the More section in the Site settings tab and select a site template with a header. Save the changes.
A page named Area #1 will appear in the list. You don’t need to publish it. The page status doesn’t affect the block functionality.
1. Open any page and click Add block .
2. Go to the Site menu and header tab, select a suitable template — the block will automatically appear on all site pages.
Configure site navigation
To allow customers to navigate between pages, add links to menu items.
1. Hover over the block and click Edit.
2. Go to the Block elements tab.
3. Click the pencil icon next to the menu item name and change its title.
4. Configure the click action: select Go to page from the dropdown menu. Click the icon and choose the page for redirection. Only published pages will appear in the list.
5. Specify where the page will open: in the current window, a new window, or a pop-up.
You can change the number and order of menu items.
1. Click the cross icon to delete an item.
2. Drag the item to change its position in the menu.
3. Select Add to create a new item.
4. Save the changes.
In brief
- Multi-page websites are suitable for resources with a large amount of content, such as online stores, blogs, corporate websites, etc.
- Go to the Sites and Stores section > Sites. Select an existing site or create a new one. Add pages to it.
- Publish the site. The status of its pages will update automatically.
- Place shared blocks on all site pages, such as a header, sidebar, contacts, etc.
- Configure site navigation: change menu item names and add links to navigate to other pages.

titre: Create and configure a multilingual site
sections: Create and configure a multilingual site
Bitrix24 allows you to create multilingual websites, making it easier to serve customers worldwide. Visitors can choose their preferred language from the menu to view content.
In this article:
- Create additional website pages
- Translate content into other languages
- Add a common menu to all pages
- Set up language switching
Create additional website pages
To create versions of your site in other languages with the same structure, copy the existing pages. The copies will be in English at first, and you’ll need to translate them.
1. Go to Sites and stores .
2. Open the Sites tab.
3. Create a new site or select an existing one.
4. Hover over your site and click View pages .
5. Click Actions .
6. Select Copy page .
7. Click Copy to confirm.
8. Return to the Sites tab.
9. Click the arrow icon next to the site status and select Publish . All pages will be published automatically.
Create and configure your Bitrix24 site
Translate content into other languages
You can translate content manually by doing it yourself or using CoPilot to update the text on the page. Customize a site block in Bitrix24 Chat with CoPilot
To use CoPilot in Bitrix24 Sites:
1. Open the page and click the widget in the bottom-right corner.
2. Choose CoPilot to open the built-in chat.
3. Click the block you want to translate. It will be highlighted in purple. If CoPilot can't edit that block, it will let you know in the chat.
4. Type a clear request in the chat. For example: " Translate the block into French as a professional translator ".
5. Review the translation. If it needs changes, describe them in the chat or edit the text manually.
6. Once done, click the cross (X) to close the CoPilot chat.
If a block can’t be fully translated with CoPilot, you can translate sections of it instead.
1. Highlight the text you want to translate.
2. Click the CoPilot button.
3. Type your request. For example: " Translate the selected text into French with the precision and quality of a professional translator. "
4. Or, select the Translate option from the list and choose the language you need.
5. Review the translation, then click Replace selected text to apply it.
Save frequently used requests in the prompt library to avoid retyping them each time. Prompt library: Create prompt templates for CoPilot
Add a common menu to all pages
A common menu allows visitors to switch between site versions in different languages.
1. Open the three-dot menu (...).
2. Select Configure site .
3. Go to the Site settings tab.
4. Expand the More section.
5. Select a site template with a header.
6. Save the changes.
The Area #1 page will appear in the list. You don't need to publish it since the page status doesn't affect the block's functionality.
1. Open any site page and click Add block to header at the top.
2. Go to the Site menu and header tab.
3. Select a suitable template, and the block will automatically appear on all site pages.
Set up language switching
To allow customers to open a page in their preferred language, add links to the menu items.
1. Hover over the menu block and click Edit .
2. Go to the Block elements tab.
3. Click the pencil icon next to the menu item name.
4. Specify the language code, such as EN, FR, DE, etc.
5. Set up the click action by selecting Open page from the dropdown menu.
6. Click the icon .
7. Select the page for redirection. Only published pages appear in the list.
8. Set the page to open in the same window.
You can change the number and order of menu items.
1. Click the cross (X) to delete an item.
2. Drag the icon next to the item name to rearrange it in the menu.
3. Select Add to create a new item.
4. Save the changes.
In brief
- Bitrix24 allows you to create multilingual websites, making it easier to connect with customers worldwide. Visitors can choose their preferred language from the menu to view content.
- Go to Sites and Stores > Sites . Select an existing site or create a new one. For each language, create page copies and translate them as needed.
- Publish the site to make all pages available instantly.
- Translate page content manually or with the help of CoPilot.
- Add a menu in the site header to enable visitors to switch between language versions. Customize it by renaming items and linking them to pages in other languages for smooth navigation.

titre: Header tags
sections: Header tags
H1–H5 tags define the structure of a webpage. They help search engines understand page content, which can improve search visibility.
The H1 tag is the most important heading on a page. It usually describes the main topic.
Add an H1 tag
1. Open the page in the editor.
2. Click the text header inside a block.
3. Select the H1 tag.
Recommendations
- Use only one H1 tag per page.
- The H1 tag should contain text only.
- Include relevant keywords, but keep the text natural and readable.
- Do not duplicate the page title in the H1 tag. Write a unique heading instead.

titre: Webpage title
sections: Webpage title

Page titles appear in the browser tab. Search engines like Google and Bing use page titles to index content and display search results. A clear title helps visitors understand what the page is about. It also helps users recognize pages they save to bookmarks or favorites.
Create a webpage title
Use a short, clear title that describes the page content.
Set a webpage title
To set a webpage title:
1. Go to Sites and Stores > Sites .
2. Hover over the site preview image and click View pages .
3. Select a page and click Actions > Page settings .
4. Click the pencil icon.
5. Enter a new title and save the changes.

titre: Auto publish, site preview, and navigation
sections: Auto publish, site preview, and navigation
Bitrix24 Sites now includes several updates to simplify site management.
You can now:
- Create new pages and edit existing pages faster
- Organize pages into multi-level folders
- Save block templates
Auto publish option

The Auto publish option makes it easier to work with sites. When this option is enabled, all changes appear on the site immediately. Your changes are saved automatically, even if you forget to save them manually or close the browser tab.
You can disable Auto publish at the top of the page.
- You plan to update the site in several stages.
- Your advertising campaign is active, and the site has high traffic.
Site preview
Click Preview to open the published version of the site:
- On a mobile device
- In a new browser tab
- Using a direct link
Site navigation
The navigation panel shows the structure of your site.
You can:
- Search for pages by name
- View all folders and pages
- Quickly switch between pages
The current page is highlighted in blue.
Site features
Click Site features to open tools and settings for customer communication.
This section includes four blocks:
- CRM form orders Open the settings for the CRM form placed on the current page. If the page does not include a form, Bitrix24 automatically creates one at the bottom of the page.
- Customer communication Configure the widget connected to your site.
- Need help? Fill out the form to contact Bitrix24 partners. They can help you create and set up your website.
- Gear icon Click the gear icon to change site settings and design options.

titre: Optimize your site or store for mobile devices
sections: Optimize your site or store for mobile devices

In Bitrix24, you can see how your site looks on smartphones or tablets and make real-time edits. This helps you optimize your site for mobile devices, ensuring a smooth and engaging experience for your visitors.
In this article:
- View the mobile version of your site
- Check how your site looks on different devices
- Edit the mobile version of your site
View the mobile version of your site
1. Go to Sites and Stores .
2. Select Sites or Online stores .
3. Create a new site or choose an existing one.
4. Hover over your site and click View pages .
5. Click the page you want to view in mobile format, and the editor will open.
6. Click the widget in the bottom right corner.
7. Select the smartphone icon.
8. A preview of the mobile version will appear.
9. To view a different page, choose it from the menu.
Create and configure your Bitrix24 site Create an online store in Bitrix24
Check how your site looks on different devices
You can see how your site appears on different smartphone and tablet screens.
1. Click the icon next to the mobile device name.
2. Choose the model you want to preview.
3. Click the icon to switch between portrait and landscape view.
Edit the mobile version of your site
When you update blocks, backgrounds, text, or design, the changes apply to all versions of your site. Preview how everything looks on mobile devices using the window on the right.
If a block doesn’t work well on certain devices, you can adjust its visibility separately for desktops, tablets, and smartphones.
1. Click Design .
2. In the Device view section, choose where the block should appear. If you mark a device with a cross, visitors using that device won’t see the block.
3. Use the preview window to see how the mobile version looks on the selected device.
4. Hidden blocks are marked with a special icon . Hover over it to view visibility settings.

If the mobile version is your priority, click the device icon at the top of the editor. The site will adjust to fit the selected screen size. You can also rotate the preview window to see both portrait and landscape views. This will help you make better design choices.
To close the mobile preview, click the cross (X) in the bottom right corner.
In brief
- In Bitrix24, you can see how your site or store looks on smartphones and tablets and make real-time edits.
- To preview the mobile version, go to Sites and Stores > Sites or Online stores , open the site in the editor, and select the smartphone icon in the widget.
- Check how your site appears on different device models and switch between portrait and landscape views.
- Any changes to blocks, backgrounds, text, or design apply to all versions of the site.
- Adjust block visibility for desktops, tablets, and smartphones to optimize the user experience.
- For focused work on the mobile version, use the device icon at the top of the editor to adjust the site to the selected screen size.

titre: CoPilot in sites: how to create an image
sections: CoPilot in sites: how to create an image
We added image generation to Bitrix24 Sites. You no longer need to spend time searching for images or checking copyright.
To create images with CoPilot, you need a website. You can create a website from scratch or use a ready-made template from the catalog.
Create your site in Bitrix24
How to generate images
Go to Sites and Stores . Select a site with the Not Published status. Click Open > Open in editor .
Create an image with CoPilot
Open a block that contains images. Click the image, then click the CoPilot button.
Select an image style. Choose a style. CoPilot will generate an image with the matching visual effect.
Specify an image format. Choose the format that works best for your site:
- Square (1:1): for avatars.
- Portrait (3:4): for portrait images, such as posters and vertical banners.
- Landscape (4:3): for slides and standard photos.
- Wide Format (16:9): for covers and wide banners.
Enter your prompt. Describe the image you want in detail. For example, to create an image for an event, select the Movie style and the Square (1:1) format. Then press Enter.
If the image looks good, save it. To generate a new image with the same settings, click Try Again . To enter a new prompt and choose new image options, click Cancel .
Save the image. It will appear on the page.
In brief
- When you create an image, you can choose its style and format.
- If the generated image does not work for you, click Try Again to create a new one with the same settings.
- The result depends on the prompt. The more specific the prompt, the better the image.

titre: Animation in Bitrix24 Sites
sections: Animation in Bitrix24 Sites
You can now use animations in Bitrix24 Sites.
Website block animation
Open Design and select the block you want to animate. In the Fade-in animation section, choose an animation type. Depending on the block, you can apply animations to different elements.

titre: Graphics editor in Bitrix24 Sites
sections: Graphics editor in Bitrix24 Sites
In Bitrix24 Sites, you can edit images using the built-in graphics editor. Use it to crop images, apply filters, and add effects.
To open the editor:
1. Click the image in the block.
2. Upload a new image if needed.
3. Click Edit .
Use the menu on the left to adjust your image:
Crop and rotate. Change the image size or orientation. Use preset options or set custom values.
Filters. Apply a filter and adjust its intensity.
Adjustments. Change brightness, contrast, temperature, and other settings.
Blur and tilt-shift. Add blur or focus on specific areas.
Text. Add text. Customize font, size, and color.
Stickers. Add stickers to your image.
Brush. Draw on the image. Adjust brush size and color.
Frames. Add a frame around the image.
Effects. Apply visual effects to change the look of the image.
Click Apply at the top right corner to save the changes.
Save the block settings.

titre: Add Google Maps block to your website
sections: Add Google Maps block to your website
Add a Google Maps block to your site so customers can easily find your location.
To add the block:
- Click Add block > Contacts > Google Maps.
To update the location:
- Click anywhere on the map.
- Enter a Title and Text .
To use Google Maps in Bitrix24, you need an API key. Enter it in Site preferences .
Get a Google Maps API key
1. Go to the Get an API Key page and click Go to Console .
2. Create a Google payment account.
1. Select your country.
2. Accept the Terms of Service.
3. Click Continue .
4. API usage is billed separately at Google Maps Platform pricing .
3. Complete the form and add a payment method.
1. Click Start my free trial .
2. Google may charge $1 to verify your card. This amount is refunded.
4. Select the Maps service.
5. In the Enable your APIs window, click Enable .
6. Copy the API key and paste it into the Site preferences section in your Bitrix24 site.
You can manage your API keys in the Google Cloud Console .
If you already have a Google payment account
1. Go to the Get an API Key page and click Go to Console .
2. Select Maps JavaScript API .
3. Click Enable .
4. Open the menu > APIs & Services > Credentials .
5. Click Create credentials > API key .
6. Copy the API key and use it in your site.
If changes don’t appear
Changes are saved automatically. If you don’t see updates:
- Click the arrow next to the site status.
- Unpublish the site.
- Publish it again.

titre: Save blocks as templates and create folder structure
sections: Save blocks as templates and create folder structure
This article covers two additional features of Bitrix24 Sites. Explore how to save custom blocks and create an easy-to-use folder structure for your site.
Save blocks as templates

Bitrix24 offers the ability to save customized blocks. For example, you often use the same standard block but always change the font size and background image. Now, you can save such a block as a template and add it with all changes.
To save a block,
1. Expand the Actions section on the right.
2. Select Save as custom block from the drop-down list.
3. Specify the block name, select the sections to which it will belong, and adjust its previews.
4. Then click Save at the bottom.
The template has a Saved block caption. You can also see who saved the custom block. Note that only this user can delete it if needed.
Set up folder structure
If you have a complex website with many pages, create several levels of folders to organize them. Click on the folder icon on the right to add a new folder.
Note that newly created folders are empty and don't have a main page. To assign an index page, select Configure folder in the folder menu.
In the settings, specify the index page and folder address.

titre: Add a newsfeed block to your site
sections: Add a newsfeed block to your site

A newsfeed helps you share company updates, industry news, and useful content. It keeps visitors engaged and improves search visibility. You can add a newsfeed to your Bitrix24 site and update it automatically.
- Create and configure a news source
- Add a newsfeed block to your site
1. Create a workgroup for news
1. Go to Collaboration > Workgroups .
2. Open an existing workgroup or create a new one.
3. On the Features tab, click Extended parameters .
4. Enable Publishing on Bitrix24 Sites .
Create a workgroup and a project
2. Publish news in the workgroup
1. Open the workgroup and go to Feed > Message > Send message .
2. Click the icon to add a title field.
3. Enter the title and text.
4. Click File > Upload to add an image.
5. Insert the image into the text so it appears in the site newsfeed. Hover over the image and click .
6. Click Send .
1. Add the block
1. Go to Sites and stores > Sites .
2. Hover over the site and click View pages.
3. Click Add block.
4. Open the Newsfeed section and choose a block.
5. Click Edit .
2. Link the block to a workgroup
1. Enable Dynamic to publish posts automatically.
2. Click Select source > Filter .
3. Choose the workgroup and click Save .
3. Configure display settings
Set the number of items in Show elements .
Configure the detailed page:
1. Choose the target page.

titre: Superblock on Bitrix24 Sites
sections: Superblock on Bitrix24 Sites

Bitrix24 sites are made up of ready-to-use blocks. If the standard set of elements doesn’t meet your needs, you can modify it using the Superblock editing mode in the site builder. This mode allows you to add or remove text, buttons, images, and other elements within a block without programming skills.
Enable Superblock editing mode
1. Go to the Sites and Stores section > Sites .
2. Hover over the site and click View pages.
3. Select the page.
4. Hover over the block you want to modify and click Superblock .
Add or remove an item
1. Click the recycle bin icon to delete an item.
2. Click Add item and select the desired one from the list to place it in the block, such as Button or Image.
3. Click the icons at the top of the screen to preview how the block will appear on different devices.
4. Click Save to apply the changes and return to the regular site editing mode. The new elements will appear in the block structure, and you can configure them further.

Configure an element . Edit new elements to ensure they work correctly. For example, replace the default image or button text, or add a click action. Click the element, specify the parameters, and save the changes.
Action on click in site block elements CoPilot in sites: how to create an image

Configure a block . Adjust the settings, content, and design of the block using the Edit and Design buttons. For example, add new columns, change the background image, fonts, or spacing. Create and configure your Bitrix24 site
Republish the site to ensure the block displays correctly. Click the icon next to the site status, unpublish it, and then publish it again.
In brief
- Bitrix24 sites consist of ready-to-use blocks. You can modify their structure in the Superblock editing mode.
- Go to the Sites and Stores section > Sites , open the desired site, hover over the block you want to edit, and click Superblock . Add or remove elements and save the changes.
- Click an element to configure it. For example, change the button text or add a click action.
- Adjust the block’s settings, content, and design using the Edit and Design buttons.
- Republish the site to ensure the block displays correctly.

titre: Cookie processing
sections: Cookie processing
Cookies are small pieces of data that a website stores on a user’s device. A web server sends this data to the browser during a visit.

Cookies can store different types of information, such as language settings, login details, or content preferences (for example, YouTube recommendations). This helps make the browsing experience smoother and more personalized.

Each country has its own data privacy laws. If a website collects cookies without user consent, the site owner may face penalties. For this reason, you should clearly inform visitors about what data you collect through cookies.
How it works
Websites built in Bitrix24 Sites allow visitors to manage cookies. On the first visit, a cookie consent banner appears at the bottom of the page.
Visitors can:
- Accept all cookies
- Change preferences and allow or block specific cookie types
After making a selection, the visitor clicks Save and accept .
Visitors can update their preferences at any time by clicking the Cookies link at the bottom of the page.
Enable the cookie consent banner
1. Go to the Sites section.
2. Select a website.
3. Click Actions → Configure site .
4. Scroll down and open the More section.
5. Turn on Show cookie consent banner in the Cookie processing section.
User agreement
Edit the text shown to visitors in the consent banner.
Click Edit settings next to the consent selection list to update the configuration.
Checkbox and behavior
Update the initial notification text and behavior settings.
Click Edit settings next to the consent selection list and select Signature and behavior .
You can also add a link to a third-party page or file by enabling the corresponding option.
User consents
Use the filter to see all collected user consents. To access this section, click Edit settings > User consents .
Edit cookie descriptions
Click Edit cookie descriptions to manage cookie details.
Bitrix24 includes predefined descriptions for common services such as:
- Google Analytics
- Google Tag Manager
- YouTube
- Google Maps
You can edit or disable these descriptions if you don’t use these services.
If your website uses other services that collect cookies, add them manually:
1. Click New cookie type .
2. Enter the description.
Link position and appearance
You can change:
- Background color
- Icon color
- Text color
- Position of the cookie icon on the screen

titre: Site and page settings
sections: Site and page settings

Create a website and customize it for your business using the Site and page settings . All settings are conveniently gathered in a single slider, allowing you to change the design, edit blocks, and set up analytics in one place.
Go to the Sites and stores section and open the site you want to edit.
To access the settings, click Site Features in the top right corner and select Settings (⚙️).
You will see a slider with the settings for different sections.
- Site settings
- Page settings
- Site and page design
Site settings
Here, you can customize the following parameters:
- Site address : Change the subdomain on *.bitrix24.site or connect your own domain. Bitrix24 site subdomain Connect your website to your own domain
- Website widget : Choose a widget to stay in touch with customers and get their feedback. Add website widget
- Widget color : Select the widget's color to match your website's theme or keep its original design.
- "Up" button : Add this button to quickly return to the top of long pages.
- Index page : Specify the main page if your website has multiple pages.
Click More to get to advanced settings.
Here, you can configure the following parameters:
- Favicon : Add a small icon that appears in the browser tab. Only .png images can be used as a favicon.
- Ownership verification : Specify the necessary meta tags to confirm the rights to the site when connecting to Google Search Console.
- Analytics : Use your Google Analytics ID or Google Tag Manager ID to collect statistics and control the website's traffic. This option is available on commercial plans only.
- Tracking pixels : Measure ad effectiveness by understanding the actions people take on your website. Add the Facebook pixel to a website
- Map keys : Specify your Google Maps API key to be able to add a Google Maps block to your website. Add Google Maps block to your website
- Layout type : Choose the type to customize padding on the webpages.
- Site Template : Select a template and customize the additional areas.
- Site language : Choose the language for site elements.
- 404 error : Add a custom 404 error page if needed.
- robots.txt Preferences : Add a text file for indexing your website by search engine robots. Learn about robots.txt files
- Site boost : Optimize the use of CSS and JS. That's one of the Google PageSpeed Insights requirements, helping to improve the page speed.
- Custom HTML : Add custom HTML to the HEAD tag on all pages. Custom HTML is available on commercial plans only.
- Custom CSS : Adds custom CSS code to all site pages. Use it to specify custom fonts or styles.
- Disable site temporarily : Select a page that will be shown while the website is disabled.
- Cookie processing : Enable a cookie consent banner.
- "Powered by Bitrix24" Text : Hide this text at the bottom of the website if you have a commercial plan subscription.
Page settings
The following settings are available in this section:
- Page address : Specify a custom address for the page.
- Rich formatting for social media : Configure how this page will be displayed when shared on social media.
Click More to display additional settings.
Here, you can configure the following parameters:
- Page meta tags : Add page meta tags for better indexing by search engines. By default, they get formed automatically, but you can customize them.
- Layout type : Select a layout template and customize padding.
- Page Template : Include additional areas on the page.
- Analytics : Use your Google Analytics ID or Google Tag Manager ID to collect statistics and control the site's traffic.
- Tracking pixels : Use the Facebook pixel to track conversions.
- Add to search engine index : If this option is disabled, your site traffic may decrease.

- Custom HTML and Custom CSS : Add custom HTML and CSS code to the page. Use this option if you need to add some custom feature or design to the page. Note that you need to have coding skills to do that, so we advise you to entrust it to a qualified specialist.

- Sitemap : Add the page to the sitemap for better indexing. Your sitemap is available here: [website address]/sitemap.xml Sitemap - sitemap.xml Data on the sitemap presence is added automatically when you activate it in the site settings, and all user entries are added to the general robots.txt without checking for uniqueness. Therefore, we recommend you check the content of your_site/robots.txt file for duplicates.
Site and page design
Customize the site design in the second tab and the page design in the last tab. The settings are the same.
- Color theme : Change the color of buttons and some other site elements.
- Text : Specify the color, font, and size of text and headings. You can also adjust the text weight and line spacing.
- Background : Change the background of the page.
Change design in Bitrix24 sites and stores
When you edit a site, changes are saved automatically. If the updates don’t appear, click the arrow icon next to the site status, unpublish the site, and then publish it again.
In brief
- Customize your website in Bitrix24 using the Site and page settings .
- Adjust site settings like the address, widgets, and analytics, and configure individual page settings for meta tags and layout.
- Customize design elements such as colors, text, and backgrounds, with page-specific settings taking priority.

titre: Website widget: advanced settings
sections: Website widget: advanced settings
If you already use the on your website and need to identify guest sessions in Live Chat, you can use the approach below.
For unauthorized users , use Connect Bitrix24 Live Chat to your site .
For authorized users , you can use a better option that does not ask them to enter their contact details again.
2. Manual setup
If you use a third-party system, such as your billing system, add JavaScript to the page where the widget loads.
The basic code for flexible widget setup looks like this:

Exemple : <script type="text/javascript"> window.addEventListener('onBitrixLiveChat', function(event) { var widget = event.detail.widget; // 1. Set external user authorization ... // 2. Pass additional data ... // 3. Handle events ... }); </script>

Exemple : window.addEventListener('onBitrixLiveChat', function(event) { var widget = event.detail.widget; // 1. Set external user authorization ... // 2. Pass additional data ... // 3. Handle events ... });
Widget methods:
- widget.open() — Opens the widget
- widget.close() — Closes the widget
- widget.subscribe() — Subscribes to an event
- widget.setUserRegisterData() — Sets external user authorization
- widget.setCustomData() — Passes additional data
- widget.setOption() — Sets additional options
1. Set external user authorization

Exemple : <script type="text/javascript"> window.addEventListener('onBitrixLiveChat', function(event) { var widget = event.detail.widget; // Set external user authorization widget.setUserRegisterData({ 'hash': '12b42ebcec7e3c26a313272c26efddbd', 'name': 'Victor', 'lastName': 'Ivanov', 'avatar': 'http://files.shelenkov.com/images/avatar-ivanov.jpg', 'email': 'victor@ivanov.ru', 'gender': 'M', 'position': 'Ho

Exemple : window.addEventListener('onBitrixLiveChat', function(event) { var widget = event.detail.widget; // Set external user authorization widget.setUserRegisterData({ 'hash': '12b42ebcec7e3c26a313272c26efddbd', 'name': 'Victor', 'lastName': 'Ivanov', 'avatar': 'http://files.shelenkov.com/images/avatar-ivanov.jpg', 'email': 'victor@ivanov.ru', 'gender': 'M', 'position': 'Honored User' }); });
Note :

- hash is a special field that replaces authorization. It must be unique within your Bitrix24 account to avoid conflicts, and must use MD5 format . Example: md5(USER_ID + _site_address_ + _secret_code_) This value must identify the user and be impossible to guess from the outside.
2. Pass additional data
You can pass additional data by using special blocks:

Exemple : <script type="text/javascript"> window.addEventListener('onBitrixLiveChat', function(event) { var widget = event.detail.widget; // Pass additional data at the start of a new session, extended format widget.setCustomData([ { "USER": { "NAME": "Victor Ivanov", "AVATAR": "http://files.shelenkov.com/images/avatar-ivanov.jpg" } }, { "GRID": [ { "NAME": "Email", "VALUE": "victor@ivanov.ru", "DISPLAY": "

Exemple : window.addEventListener('onBitrixLiveChat', function(event) { var widget = event.detail.widget; // Pass additional data at the start of a new session, extended format widget.setCustomData([ { "USER": { "NAME": "Victor Ivanov", "AVATAR": "http://files.shelenkov.com/images/avatar-ivanov.jpg" } }, { "GRID": [ { "NAME": "Email", "VALUE": "victor@ivanov.ru", "DISPLAY": "LINE" }, { "NAME": "Client code"
To pass data as plain text, use the simplified format. You can use these tags in the text: BR , B , U , I , S , URL .

Exemple : <script type="text/javascript"> window.addEventListener('onBitrixLiveChat', function(event) { var widget = event.detail.widget; widget.setCustomData("[b]Victor Ivanov[/b] (victor@ivanov.ru)"); }); </script>
Exemple : window.addEventListener('onBitrixLiveChat', function(event) { var widget = event.detail.widget; widget.setCustomData("[b]Victor Ivanov[/b] (victor@ivanov.ru)"); });
Read more about blocks in the Bitrix24 Bot Platform course .
3. Handle events

Exemple : <script type="text/javascript"> window.addEventListener('onBitrixLiveChat', function(event) { var widget = event.detail.widget; // Handle events widget.subscribe({ type: BX.LiveChatWidget.SubscriptionType.EVENT_SUBSCRIPTION_TYPE, callback: function(data) { // any command ... } }); }); </script>

Exemple : window.addEventListener('onBitrixLiveChat', function(event) { var widget = event.detail.widget; // Handle events widget.subscribe({ type: BX.LiveChatWidget.SubscriptionType.EVENT_SUBSCRIPTION_TYPE, callback: function(data) { // any command ... } }); });
- BX.LiveChatWidget.SubscriptionType.configLoaded — Runs when Open Channels configuration data loads.
- BX.LiveChatWidget.SubscriptionType.widgetOpen — Runs when the widget opens.
- BX.LiveChatWidget.SubscriptionType.widgetClose — Runs when the widget closes.
- BX.LiveChatWidget.SubscriptionType.sessionStart — Runs when a session starts. Example: {sessionId: 123}
Exemple : {sessionId: 123}
- BX.LiveChatWidget.SubscriptionType.sessionOperatorChange — Runs when the agent changes. Example: {operator: {name: '', firstName: '', lastName: '', workPosition: '', avatar: '', online: false}}
Exemple : {operator: {name: '', firstName: '', lastName: '', workPosition: '', avatar: '', online: false}}
- BX.LiveChatWidget.SubscriptionType.sessionFinish — Runs when a session ends. Example: {sessionId: 123}
Exemple : {sessionId: 123}

- BX.LiveChatWidget.SubscriptionType.operatorMessage — Runs when an agent sends a message. Example: {id:"44609041",chatId:711773,senderId:1246,recipientId:"chat711773",date:"2018-11-22T20:17:57.000Z",text:"hello!"}
Exemple : {id:"44609041",chatId:711773,senderId:1246,recipientId:"chat711773",date:"2018-11-22T20:17:57.000Z",text:"hello!"}
- BX.LiveChatWidget.SubscriptionType.userMessage — Runs when a user sends a message. Example: {id: 123, text: ''}
Exemple : {id: 123, text: ''}
- BX.LiveChatWidget.SubscriptionType.userVote — Runs when a user submits a vote. Example: {vote: "like"} // like|dislike
Exemple : {vote: "like"} // like|dislike

- BX.LiveChatWidget.SubscriptionType.every — Runs for all events, so you can handle everything in one place. The every event uses a slightly different format: <script type="text/javascript"> window.addEventListener('onBitrixLiveChat', function(event) { var widget = event.detail.widget; widget.subscribe({ type: BX.LiveChatWidget.SubscriptionType.every, callback: function(event) { if (event.type == BX.LiveChatWidget.SubscriptionType.configLoaded) { widget.open(); } } }); }); </script> Example: {type: "userVote", data: {vote: "like"}} The type field contains the event code. The data field contains the event payload. See the examples above for each event.

Exemple : <script type="text/javascript"> window.addEventListener('onBitrixLiveChat', function(event) { var widget = event.detail.widget; widget.subscribe({ type: BX.LiveChatWidget.SubscriptionType.every, callback: function(event) { if (event.type == BX.LiveChatWidget.SubscriptionType.configLoaded) { widget.open(); } } }); }); </script>

Exemple : window.addEventListener('onBitrixLiveChat', function(event) { var widget = event.detail.widget; widget.subscribe({ type: BX.LiveChatWidget.SubscriptionType.every, callback: function(event) { if (event.type == BX.LiveChatWidget.SubscriptionType.configLoaded) { widget.open(); } } }); });
Exemple : {type: "userVote", data: {vote: "like"}}
You can combine the final JavaScript from any of the three code sections based on your needs.
Example: <script type="text/javascript">
Exemple : <script type="text/javascript">

Exemple : window.addEventListener('onBitrixLiveChat', function(event) { var widget = event.detail.widget; // Set external user authorization widget.setUserRegisterData({ 'hash': '12b42ebcec7e3c26a313272c26efddbd', 'name': 'Victor', 'lastName': 'Ivanov', 'avatar': 'http://files.shelenkov.com/images/avatar-ivanov.jpg', 'email': 'victor@ivanov.ru', 'gender': 'M', 'position': 'Honored User' }); // Pass addition
4. Change the default text in the widget window
In some cases, you may want to replace the default text shown in the widget window.
You can do this with JavaScript:

Exemple : <script> window.addEventListener('onBitrixLiveChat', function(event) { var widget = event.detail.widget; widget.subscribe({ type: BX.LiveChatWidget.SubscriptionType.configLoaded, callback: function() { widget.addLocalize({PHRASE_VARIABLE: 'Replacement text'}); } }); }); </script>

Exemple : window.addEventListener('onBitrixLiveChat', function(event) { var widget = event.detail.widget; widget.subscribe({ type: BX.LiveChatWidget.SubscriptionType.configLoaded, callback: function() { widget.addLocalize({PHRASE_VARIABLE: 'Replacement text'}); } }); });
To get the full list of phrase variables, run this command in the browser console: console.table(BXLiveChat.__privateMethods__.localize);
Exemple : console.table(BXLiveChat.__privateMethods__.localize);
You can customize any component located at: bitrix/js/imopenlines/component/widget/src/component
Keep in mind that after customization, you need to track updates to these components and maintain your changes.
5. Disable the additional multisite configuration check for the widget
To prevent authorization resets, make the required configuration changes .

By default, the multisite configuration check for the Bitrix24 widget is enabled in the Open Channels (imopenlines) module starting with version 21.400.0. If the system detects this configuration, the widget shows a notification.
Use this code to disable the check:
Exemple : <script> window.addEventListener('onBitrixLiveChat', function(event){ var widget = event.detail.widget; widget.setOption('checkSameDomain', false); }); </script>
Exemple : window.addEventListener('onBitrixLiveChat', function(event){ var widget = event.detail.widget; widget.setOption('checkSameDomain', false); });

titre: Change Bitrix24 site and store subdomain
sections: Change Bitrix24 site and store subdomain

The address for a site, a store, or a CRM form in Bitrix24 is generated automatically and consists of a set of characters. You can add keywords related to your company to the address to make a site or a form more recognizable to customers.
- example is the subdomain
- bitrix24site.com is the main domain, where bitrix24site is the second-level domain, and com is the top-level domain.
In this article:
- Change a site/store subdomain
- Change a CRM form subdomain
Change a site/store subdomain
Go to the Sites and Stores section. Сlick the pencil icon next to the address.
Enter a new subdomain. Check that it is available for registration and click Save . The Bitrix24 site/store will be accessible at the new address.
Change the subdomain of a CRM form
Go to the CRM section > Sales > Sales Channels > CRM Forms and open the desired CRM form.
Select Form features > Settings > Site Settings and click the pencil icon next to the site address.
Enter a new subdomain. Check that it is available for registration and click Save . The CRM form will be accessible at the new address, and the previous link will no longer work.

After changing the subdomain for one form, it will update for all forms. If you use your own keys for spam protection, you need to change the form's subdomain on the Google reCAPTCHA admin page. Configure reCAPTCHA V2 for CRM forms

An alternative solution is to place the form on a site and change its subdomain. The form's subdomain itself will not change, but it will be accessible at two addresses, allowing you to choose which link to send to the customer. Place CRM form on Bitrix24 website
In brief
- The address for a site, a store, or a CRM form in Bitrix24 is generated automatically and consists of a set of characters.
- You can change the subdomain to make a site or a form more recognizable to customers.
- After updating the subdomain, the CRM form will be accessible at the new address, and the previous link will no longer work.
- When you change the subdomain for one form, it changes for all forms.
- If you use your own keys for spam protection, you need to change the form's subdomain on the Google reCAPTCHA admin page.

titre: Action on click in site block elements
sections: Action on click in site block elements
You can add click actions to site elements such as buttons, images, icons, and text.
Add a link to a button . Open the button settings and choose what should happen when a user clicks it.
Also choose how the link opens: in the same window, a new window, or a pop-up.
Add a link to an image or icon . Select the element and choose an action from the list.
Insert a link into the text . Highlight the text. In the pop-up panel, click the link icon.
In the slider, choose what should happen when a user clicks the text.
Available actions . When you add a click action, you can choose from the following:
- Open page : Open any page from your sites.
- Open block : Open a specific block on any site.
- Open CRM form : Show a CRM form to the user.
- Call : Enter a phone number. On mobile devices, the call starts right away. On desktops, a separate app is required.
- Send SMS : Enter a phone number to receive text messages.
- Send email message : Enter your email. The message opens in the user’s email app.
- Call via Skype : Enter your Skype ID. The user is prompted to open Skype.
- Open external link : Enter any URL.
- Don't show link : Disable the button.
Online stores support the same actions as sites. You can also link to a product catalog or a specific item.
Knowledge bases include additional actions:
- Open file : Select a file from Bitrix24 Drive.
- Open Bitrix24 profile : Select an employee profile.
Changes are saved automatically when you edit a site. If updates don’t appear, click the arrow next to the site status. Unpublish the site, then publish it again.

titre: YouTube videos and Shorts in Bitrix24 Sites
sections: YouTube videos and Shorts in Bitrix24 Sites

In Bitrix24 Sites, you can add content from different sources, including YouTube videos and Shorts. You can control how videos appear on your page. For example, you can switch between vertical and horizontal layouts and adjust the aspect ratio and scale.
Add a YouTube video to a site block
To add a YouTube video, first open the video on YouTube and copy its URL.
Then open your site in edit mode in Bitrix24 and follow these steps:
1. Click + Add block .
2. Open the Video tab.
3. Select a block.
4. Click Edit to open block settings.
5. Paste the video URL into the Video field.
6. Adjust other settings if needed.
7. Save the changes.
Adjust settings for YouTube Shorts
You can add YouTube Shorts the same way as regular videos. To change how the video looks:
1. Click Design .
2. Click the video in the block.
3. Select Vertical, 9:16 to match the original Shorts format.
4. Adjust the scale if needed.
Changes save automatically while you edit the site.
If you don’t see updates:
1. Click the arrow next to the site status.
2. Unpublish the site.
3. Publish it again.

titre: Site access permissions
sections: Site access permissions
Configure access permissions and manage who can access and perform actions on your Bitrix24 sites.
To configure access permissions,
1. Go to the Sites and stores section.
2. Open the Sites tab.
3. Click the gear icon (⚙️) in the top right corner.
4. Select Access Permissions in the menu.
Select standard roles
Access permissions are based on roles. By default, there are three roles:
- Administrator : Full access to sites, including editing employee roles and access permissions.
- Manager : Full access to sites but cannot delete sites or edit roles and permissions.
- Access denied : No access to view the sites.
Set up custom roles
If the default roles do not suit your needs, create your own custom ones.
To add a new role, click Add .
Specify the role name and configure its access permissions.
"Sites" area . Configure permissions to view sites and edit access permissions.
Sites . Configure permissions to create and export sites.
All sites content : Configure permissions to various actions.
- View : Users can view the site content.
- Edit : Users can edit the site content.
- Edit settings : Users can edit the site settings.
- Publish : Users can publish sites.
- Delete : Users can delete sites.
Click Add site permissions to configure access permissions for a specific site.
Once done, save the role.
Assign roles to employees
After configuring and saving the role, click Add access permission .
Select an employee or department from the list.
Assign the role to the selected employee or department.
In brief
- Configure access permissions and manage who can access and perform actions on your Bitrix24 sites.
- Use the three default roles or create custom ones to suit your needs.
- Assign roles to individual users, departments, or workgroup members.

titre: Add custom CSS to website and online store
sections: Add custom CSS to website and online store
In Bitrix24, you can use custom CSS to control how your website looks.
Before you start
Publish your page first. Then select the block you want to edit, right-click it, and choose Inspect.
Change element color
Font color
Use the block ID and class:
Exemple : #block3233 .landing-block-node-title { color: #FF6347 ; }
Background color
Use the block ID and the class for the entire block. Make sure to specify the section tag:
Exemple : #block3233.block-27-3-one-col-fix-title section { background-color: #00FFFF; }
Add custom CSS
- Open the action menu.
- Select Configure site.
- On the site settings page, find Custom CSS.
- Enable the option, paste your code, and click Save.
You don’t need to publish the site again. Just refresh the page to see the changes.
Use the !important directive
You can force a style to apply by using the !important directive. It overrides standard CSS rules and gives the style higher priority.
Example:
The !important directive overrides the normal rules of the cascade and gives that style very high specificity (e.g., color: FF6347 !important;). [
Hiding block elements
You can hide elements in a block with custom CSS.
- Publish the site.
- Open developer tools and find the block class.
- Add your code in the Custom CSS field:
Exemple : .landing-block-node-price-button { display: none; }
Save your changes and refresh the page.
In the Bitrix24 On-Premise version, custom CSS is available starting from Sites module version 18.5.8. Make sure your Bitrix24 is up to date before using this feature.

titre: Automatic block transitions, FAQ blocks, and GIF images
sections: Automatic block transitions, FAQ blocks, and GIF images
We’ve added new blocks and tools to help you build more engaging websites.
Automatic transitions in blocks
You can now enable automatic transitions for images and text inside supported blocks. You can also control the transition speed and choose an animation effect.
1. Select the block you want to edit.
2. Click Design .
To open the slider settings, use the navigation controls at the bottom of the block.
In the slider settings, you can:
- Turn autoplay on or off
- Set the transition speed
- Choose an animation
- Enable pause on hover
- Set the number of visible slides
- Configure other slider options
FAQ blocks
An FAQ block helps you answer common customer questions.
To create an FAQ section, add the Accordion element to your page. Then add questions and answers to each item.
GIF images
You can add GIF images to make your website more dynamic and interactive.
1. Select the block.
2. Click the image you want to replace.
In the image panel, click Upload and choose where to upload the GIF from.
After you upload the GIF, it will appear in the selected section of the page.

titre: Change design in Sites and Stores
sections: Change design in Sites and Stores
Bitrix24 offers a tool to change the design of websites and online stores. The design settings apply to all blocks on all pages, unless you manually change a block design.
To change the design:
1. Go to Sites and stores and open the needed tab.
2. Select the site, open the three-dot menu (...), and choose Configure site .
3. Click Site design on the left. On this page, you'll see a small block with the text, header, and button. The elements will change according to the design settings you apply.
Color theme : Change the color of buttons and some other elements, like the text delimiter, depending on the block.
Note that some blocks have a preset color style that the design settings won't affect.
You can add your custom color only on commercial plans. Bitrix24 pricing page
Text properties : Configure text and headings. Customize their color, font, and weight. For the main text, you can also set up the size and line spacing.

Custom page background : Set the default site background by checking this option and uploading your image. Alternatively, you can generate an image using CoPilot. CoPilot in sites: how to create an image
Transition settings : Select a color to display when transitioning to another site page.
When you edit a site, changes are saved automatically. If the updates don’t appear, click the arrow icon next to the site status, unpublish the site, and then publish it again.

titre: Transfer sites and online stores to another Bitrix24 account
sections: Transfer sites and online stores to another Bitrix24 account
To transfer a site or online store to another Bitrix24 account, you need to export, import, and publish it.
You might need this transfer if you are:
- A Bitrix24 partner who creates a site in your account and needs to import it into a client's account.
- An account administrator whose company decides to manage the site in a different Bitrix24 account.
Export a site or online store
1. Go to Sites and stores .
2. Select whether you will export a site or an online store.
3. Click the three dots (...) button.
4. Select Export and the panel will slide out on the right.
5. Click Export to create a ZIP archive.
6. Click Download to save the ZIP archive to your computer.
Open Channels, widgets, CRM forms, and Market apps are not exported. Reconnect and reconfigure them after transferring the site.
Import a site or online store
1. Go to Sites and stores .
2. Import the site on the Sites tab or the store on the Online stores tab.
3. Click Settings (⚙️) in the top right corner.
4. Select Import site and the panel will slide out on the right.
5. Click Upload .
6. Select the ZIP archive and wait for the upload to complete.
The site is automatically assigned an address when you import it into a new Bitrix24 account. To use your own domain:
1. Unlink the domain from the exported site.
2. Connect it to the imported site.
Unlink your domain from website or online store Connect your site or store to your own domain
Publish a site or online store
Click Not published and select Publish to make the site available to users.
In brief

To transfer a site or online store to another Bitrix24 account, you need to export, import, and publish it. Exporting sites and online stores is exclusive to commercial plans, but importing is available on any plan.
To export a site,
1. Go to Sites and stores and select the desired one.
2. Click the three dots (...) > Export > Export .
3. Click Download to save the ZIP archive to your computer.
To import a site,
1. Go to Sites and stores .
2. Click Settings (⚙️) > Import site .
3. In the Import site window, click Upload and select the ZIP archive.
4. Once the archive is uploaded, click Not published > Publish .

titre: Website favicon
sections: Website favicon
A favicon is a small icon that appears in the browser tab and bookmarks bar of a website. It represents your brand and website and makes them more recognizable.

You may have multiple tabs open in a single browser window. In this case, favicons help you identify the sites, even if the name is not visible. For example, in the screenshot on the right, it is easy to understand which tabs lead to YouTube, Google, Yahoo, and Apple sites. When you create a site in Bitrix24, it uses a default favicon. You can replace it with a custom PNG file. To change a favicon for your site in Bitrix24,
1. Go to the Sites and stores section and open the Sites tab.
2. Then click the three dots button on your site and select Configure site .
3. Expand the More section, click edit next to Favicon , and select your image. The image must be in PNG format. The standard sizes are 16×16 , 32×32 , and 48×48 pixels.
4. Click Save at the bottom.
5. Publish your website to apply the changes. If you use the Auto publish option, just reload the page. Learn more about the Auto publish option
That's it! The new favicon should appear on the browser tab.

titre: Site boost
sections: Site boost

The loading speed of a website or online store affects user convenience and is considered by search engines. Faster page loading increases the likelihood that users will stay on the site and complete a target action, such as placing an order or filling out a CRM form.

Bitrix24 offers settings to speed up page loading without modifying the code. These settings can be configured by the Bitrix24 administrator or employees with access permissions to edit site settings. Site access permissions
In this article:
- Speed up page loading
- Evaluate site performance
Speed up page loading
Bitrix24 provides two settings to help pages load faster for users. These settings affect content loading differently, so they can be used together or separately.
Optimize page loading time . Displays text first while other elements load later. Users can start interacting with the page even if the design is not fully displayed yet.
Defer image loading . Images not visible on the user's screen load only when the page is scrolled. This reduces the load when opening the site, especially if the page contains many images.

1. Go to the Sites and Stores section and select the Sites or Stores tab. 2. Choose the desired site and click Three dots (...) > Configure site or Settings. 3. Click More in the Site settings tab. 4. In the Site boost section, enable the Optimize page load time and Use lazy image loading options. 5. Save the changes. 6. Republish the site to apply the settings. Click the site status, unpublish it, and then publish it again.
Evaluate site performance
Open the site in a browser and check:
- How quickly the first page loads
- How smoothly content loads when scrolling

For a more detailed analysis, use online tools to measure site loading speed, such as PageSpeed Insights, Pingdom Tools, or Uptrends. These tools allow you to compare performance before and after enabling the settings. For accurate results, test on different platforms.
1. Select the desired site and click Open > Copy link . 2. Enter the site URL on the online tool's page and start the test.
In brief
- Site loading speed affects user experience and is considered by search engines.
- In Bitrix24, you can optimize page loading time and enable deferred image loading. These settings can be used together or separately.

- To speed up your site, go to Sites and Stores > Sites , select the desired site, and click Three dots (...) > Site settings > More. In the Site boost section, enable the Optimize page load time and Use lazy image loading options. Save the changes.
- You can check site loading speed manually or using online tools.

titre: Unpublish or delete a site
sections: Unpublish or delete a site
If you don’t want your clients to see your website, you can either delete or unpublish it. Deleting removes the site completely, while unpublishing hides it and keeps it available for later use.
Delete a site
Delete a site if you no longer need it or want to remove all its pages permanently.
1. Go to the Sites and stores section.
2. Open the three-dot menu (...) next to the site you want to delete.
3. Click Delete .
When you delete a site, it’s first moved to the Recycle bin . You can restore it within 30 days. After that, it’s permanently deleted.
Unpublish a site
Unpublish a site if you want to hide it from visitors but keep all content and settings intact. You can republish it at any time with the same address.
1. Go to the Sites and stores section.
2. Click the arrow next to the Published satus.
3. Select Unpublish .
You can unpublish both the entire site and individual pages.
In brief
- Delete a site if you want to remove it completely. It goes to the Recycle Bin for 30 days before permanent deletion.
- Unpublish a site if you just want to hide it temporarily—you can publish it again later at any time.

titre: Connect your site or store to your own domain
sections: Connect your site or store to your own domain

A domain is a unique website name that people use to open your site online. In Bitrix24, you can connect your own domain to a site or online store on any plan. First, buy a domain from a domain registrar.
Check domain availability
1. Go to Sites and stores .
2. Select your site.
3. Click Configure site .
4. Click Connect your domain .
5. Enter the domain in the Site address field.
Do not include http , https , or www .
Do not use bitrix in the domain name. You cannot connect domains that include this word.
After you enter the domain, Bitrix24 shows the required DNS records: A and CNAME. Keep this page open, then go to your domain registrar settings.
Configure DNS records
DNS records help browsers find your site. In most cases, you only need to add A and CNAME records.
Update or remove A and CNAME records only for the domain you want to connect. If the domain has an AAAA record, delete or replace it.
Resource record fields depend on the domain level. Domains include parts separated by dots. For example, in for.example.com :
- com is the first-level domain
- example is the second-level domain
- for is the third-level domain
A record
Specify these values:
- Subdomain : The part of the domain to the left of the higher-level domain. For example, test in test.forexample24.com is a subdomain of the main domain. For forexample24.com , enter @ .
- IP address : A unique numeric address that identifies devices on the internet. Copy the address from the Record Value field in Bitrix24.
CNAME record
Specify these values:
- Subdomain : Enter www for a site with a second-level domain. For a third-level domain, enter the subdomain.
- Canonical name : A record that links subdomains. Copy lb.bitrix24.site from the Record Value field in Bitrix24.
TTL
TTL sets the time, in seconds, after which DNS changes take effect. We recommend setting TTL to 3600 seconds. This way, servers check whether the records are up to date every hour.

Bitrix24 sites and stores do not work with domains that use DNS proxying from Cloudflare . If you use Cloudflare, turn off DNS proxying before you connect the domain to Bitrix24. The Proxy status column should show DNS only .

After you add the DNS records, return to Bitrix24 and save the domain connection settings. Switching to a new domain can take up to three days. When the domain is active, publish the site. It will be available at the new address.
In brief
- Buy a domain from a registrar.
- Connect it in Sites and stores .
- Add A and CNAME records using the values from Bitrix24.
- Turn off Cloudflare proxying if you use Cloudflare.
- Wait for DNS propagation, then publish the site.

titre: "Deceptive site ahead" error
sections: "Deceptive site ahead" error
Some browsers, including Google Chrome, may show a “Deceptive site ahead” warning when you open a site built with Bitrix24 BI Builder or when you open Bitrix24.
What this means
The code used in Sites24 and Bitrix24 is safe and does not include malware.
Google uses automated systems to check website safety. Because these checks run automatically, they can sometimes flag safe sites by mistake.

In some cases, if a website is blocked, Bitrix24 may also be blocked. This can happen when both your website and your Bitrix24 account use subdomains of the same domain. If Google blocks one part of the domain, it may block the entire domain based on its security policies.
What to do
If your site does not contain malicious content and you only use standard Bitrix24 BI Builder templates and blocks, follow these steps:
1. Check your site status on the Safe Browsing: site status page.
2. Verify ownership of your website. View Add your website to Google .
3. Review the results for your website in the Manual actions or Security issues sections.
4. After you fix any issues, use the Request a review option in each report to ask Google to review your site again.
5. If your site was flagged for phishing by mistake, you can report an incorrect phishing warning .
If Google confirms that your site is safe, the warning will be removed from browsers and search results within 72 hours.

titre: FAQ: Connecting your own domain
sections: FAQ: Connecting your own domain
This article answers the most frequently asked questions and explains common issues when connecting your own domain to a site or online store in Bitrix24.
"Your connection is not secure" error
You may see the Your connection is not secure warning in some browsers. This happens when your website doesn’t have an SSL certificate.

An SSL certificate is issued and renewed automatically when you connect your own domain to a Bitrix24 Site. The process usually takes between 30 minutes and 3 hours, depending on the workload of the Let's Encrypt certificate authority. Once the certificate is ready, it will be applied to your site, and the warning will no longer appear.
"This domain already exists" error
You may see this error if the domain name you’re trying to use is already connected to another Bitrix24 Site.
You’ll also get this error if your domain name includes the word bitrix . To fix it, choose a domain name that doesn’t include this word.
"This domain already exists, but it was assigned to a site currently in the Recycle Bin" error
You may see this error if the domain name you’re trying to use is still assigned to a website that’s in the Recycle Bin.
When you delete a website, it's moved to the Recycle Bin . The domain name assigned to this website doesn’t become available automatically.
To fix this:
1. Restore the deleted site.
2. Change its domain name in the site settings.
3. Save your changes.
After that, you can assign the original domain name to a new website without seeing this error.
Using CloudFlare DNS proxying
Bitrix24 Sites and Online Stores do not support domains that use CloudFlare DNS proxying.
You need to disable DNS proxying in your CloudFlare account. A gray icon in the Status column labeled DNS only means proxying is disabled. An orange icon labeled Proxied means proxying is enabled.

If you connect a proxied domain and don’t disable proxying within 7 days, the domain will be automatically disabled. It will revert to the default *.bitrix24.site or *.bitrix24.shop address, and you'll need to reconnect it.
"Deceptive site ahead" error
In some browsers, such as Google Chrome, you may see the Deceptive site ahead warning when trying to access your Bitrix24 account or website created in Bitrix24.
If you are sure that your website doesn't contain any malware, follow the recommendations from this article to fix it: "Deceptive site ahead" error .
"DNS_PROBE_FINISHED_NXDOMAIN" error
The DNS_PROBE_FINISHED_NXDOMAIN error can happen for several reasons:

- Incorrect domain resource records. Check the A- and CNAME- records you entered when connecting your domain in Bitrix24. Also verify the records in your domain registrar’s settings. Your domain should only have the A-, AAAA-, and CNAME-records provided by Bitrix24. When entering a CNAME-record, make sure to include a dot at the end: lb.bitrix24.site.
- Changes were not saved in your domain settings. Some DNS hosting services save changes automatically, while others require you to save them manually.
- Propagation delay. It can take up to 48 hours for DNS changes to take effect. This delay isn’t caused by Bitrix24.

titre: Microsoft Edge: “Unsafe Site” warning
sections: Microsoft Edge: “Unsafe Site” warning
When you open Bitrix24 or a site built with Bitrix24 Sites in Microsoft Edge, you may see a warning that the site is unsafe.
What this means
Bitrix24 and Sites24 code is verified and does not contain malware.
Microsoft uses its own automated systems to evaluate website safety. These checks can sometimes produce false positives.

In some cases, an entire domain may be blocked. For example, if your Bitrix24 account and your website use subdomains of the same domain, and one of those sites is flagged, Microsoft may block the whole domain.
What you can do
If you believe the site is safe and you are using only standard Bitrix24 templates and blocks:
1. Click More information on the warning page.
2. Select the option to report that the site does not contain phishing threats.
3. Choose whether you are a visitor or the site owner.
4. Fill out the form and submit it to Microsoft.
If Microsoft confirms that the site is safe, the warning will be removed from browsers and search results.
