Use the mobile app to send documents to clients, stay in touch with your team, and keep up with company updates when you’re away from your desk.

titre: Login error in the Bitrix24 mobile app on Android
sections: Login error in the Bitrix24 mobile app on Android
If the SSL certificate on your server is not configured correctly, Android users may see an authorization error when they try to sign in to the Bitrix24 mobile app.
If you see the error The application is trying to access a server with an untrusted certificate , check the server certificate chain configuration.
You can use an online SSL/TLS diagnostic tool, such as SSL Labs , to check the server configuration. Enter your server address and click Submit .

Check the Additional Certificates (if supplied) section. If you see the Chain issues warning, the server is missing an intermediate certificate in the certificate chain. Most certificate authorities provide setup instructions for common web servers. For more information, contact your SSL certificate provider.

titre: Invite new users to Bitrix24
sections: Invite new users to Bitrix24
Invite employees to Bitrix24 so they can collaborate with your team.
By default, all employees can invite new users. The account administrators can disable this option under Employees > Company structure > Access permissions .
Ways to invite employees
You can invite employees in the web version or the mobile app.
Open the Invite widget and choose one of the following methods:
- Invite via link
- Invite via email
- Invite via SMS
- Invite in bulk
- Create user
- Invite to workgroup
- Invite Bitrix24 partner
Invite via link
1. Open the Invite widget.
2. Select Invite via Link .
3. Choose the department. When the employees accept the invitation, Bitrix24 automatically adds them to the selected department.

4. Click Link parameters . Enable Allow registration via link if it is disabled. Enable Request administrator confirmation to join if needed. Employees cannot sign in until an administrator approves their request.
1. Enable Allow registration via link if it is disabled.
2. Enable Request administrator confirmation to join if needed. Employees cannot sign in until an administrator approves their request.
5. Save the settings.
6. Click Copy link and send it to the employee.
If you disable registration via link after sending the invitation, users will not be able to sign in.
Invite via email
1. Click Invite button.
2. Edit the invitation text.
3. Enter email addresses of the person you want to invite to your Bitrix24.
4. Send the invitation.
Invite via SMS
1. Enter the employee's phone number, which will be used as their Bitrix24 login.
2. Specify their first and last name.
3. Select a department, and the employees will be instantly added to it after signing in.
4. Click Invite .
If you need to invite multiple employees at once, click Invite in bulk . Specify phone numbers, separating them with a space.
Create user
Select the department or workgroup to which you want to add the user. Fill in the employee's details (name, email, position, department). An invitation will be sent to the specified email.

If you need to add an employee to the company structure but they do not need access to Bitrix24, select Do not send invitation . For example, you can add a driver to the company structure without giving them access to the account.
Invite to workgroup
Add users directly to a specific department or workgroup. Use this method if you have already created departments and workgroups in Bitrix24.
Invite Bitrix24 partner
Bitrix24 partner is a special user who helps you customize Bitrix24 for your company.
Specify the partner email and click Invite . We will check to see if the email address belongs to a real partner. After that, they can access your account. Invite Bitrix24 Partner
To add new employees, tap More and select Invite . In the mobile app, you can use these methods:
- Link
- SMS
- Email
- QR code
Invite via link
1. Select a department where you want to add your employee.
2. Tap Invite by link .
3. Choose who and where to send the invitation link, such as via messenger.
4. Tap Send .
5. The invitation message will appear in the chat.
Invite via SMS
1. Select a department where you want to add your employee.
2. Tap Other methods .
3. Choose SMS , and Bitrix24 will open your contacts.
4. Select the necessary contacts or enter new phone numbers. Check the box.
5. Tap Continue .
6. Verify that the contact name is written correctly. Employees will see this name in Bitrix24.
7. Tap Invite .
Invite via QR code
1. Select a department where you want to add your employee.
2. Tap Other methods .
3. Choose QR code .
4. Show the QR code to the employee or send it in any convenient way.
Invitation counters
The Employees section has two counters: Invited and Pending confirmation . These help you track who hasn’t accepted the invitation yet and quickly approve new users joining Bitrix24.
Invited . The counter shows the number of users who haven't accepted the invitation yet. It is displayed in the employee list and the Invite widget.
Only administrators and employees who sent the invitations can see this counter. Administrators can see all the invitations, while regular users can view only the ones they sent.

Click the counter to see the list of invited users. If a person hasn’t seen the invitation, you can resend it. If you entered an incorrect email, delete the invited user and send the invitation to the correct email. To do this, open the Menu (≡) and select Delete .
Pending confirmation . The counter shows the number of users who have accepted the invitation but need admin approval.
Only administrators can see this counter.
The administrator can confirm or decline the login. Open the Menu (≡) and select an action:
- Confirm log in: The user will be able to log in to Bitrix24.
- Decline log in: Use this option if you invited the wrong person. The invited user will be deleted from Bitrix24.
If you add an employee to a task, but they haven't accepted the invitation, you can't decline their login or delete them from Bitrix24. Such a user can only be dismissed. Dismiss users
The Employees section has two counters: Invited and Pending confirmation . These help you track who hasn’t accepted the invitation yet and quickly approve new users joining Bitrix24.
To open filters, tap the magnifying glass icon.

Invited . The counter shows the number of users who haven’t accepted the invitation yet. You can resend the invitation, change the email or department, or delete the employee. Tap the three dots (...) and select the action you need.
Pending confirmation . The counter shows the number of users who have accepted the invitation but need admin approval.
To approve access, tap the checkmark. To decline, tap the cross.
In brief
- To organize teamwork in your company, invite employees to Bitrix24.
- You can invite employees using both Bitrix24 desktop and mobile apps.
- On the web, there are several invitation methods: by link, email, phone number, bulk invitation, or assigning to a department or group.
- In the mobile app, employees can be invited via link, email, SMS, or QR code.
- Check invitation status using the Invited and Pending confirmation counters.

- The Invited counter shows the number of users who haven’t accepted the invitation yet. Only administrators and employees who sent the invitations can see this counter. Administrators can see all the invitations, while regular users can view only the ones they sent.
- The Pending confirmation counter shows the number of users who accepted the invitation but need admin approval. Only account administrators can see this counter.

titre: Invite employees by email
sections: Invite employees by email
Invite your team to Bitrix24 by email. You can send invitations in two ways:
- Use an email app installed on your computer, such as Outlook or Apple Mail.
- Use the Bitrix24 mailing service if you don’t have an email app set up.
By default, all users can invite employees. An administrator can restrict this in Employees > Company structure > Access permissions.
Invite via the email app
1. Open the Invite widget and click Invite.
2. Select Invite by email.
3. Choose a department. New users will be added there after they accept the invite.
4. Click Invite again to open your email app.
5. Enter the recipients’ email addresses. You can edit the message.
6. Send the email.
Invite via the Bitrix24 mailing service
If you do not have an email app set up on your computer, use a different invite method or send invitations with the Bitrix24 mail service.
1. Open the Invite widget and click Invite.
2. Select Invite by email.
3. Choose a department.
4. Click Bitrix24 mailing service.
5. Enter email addresses.
6. Click Send.
You can track invitation status in the Employees section.
1. Go to Employees.
2. Select the Invited filter.
Invite via the email app
1. Go to Menu and tap Plus (+).
2. Select a department.
3. Tap Other methods > Email.
4. Tap Invite to open your email app.
5. Enter email addresses.
6. Send the email.
Invite via the Bitrix24 mailing service
1. Tap I don't have an email on this device.
2. Enter one or more email addresses (separate with spaces). Tap Next.
3. Enter names and tap Invite.
You can track the status of invitations in the Employees section.
1. Go to Menu > Employees.
2. Select the Invited filter.
In brief
- You can invite employees by email using your email app or the Bitrix24 mailing service.
- Invitations are available in both the web version and the mobile app.
- Open the Invite widget, choose Invite by email, enter email addresses, and send the invite.
- Use the Bitrix24 mailing service if no email app is configured.
- Check invitation status in the Employees section.

titre: Bitrix24 Network profile
sections: Bitrix24 Network profile
The Bitrix24 Network profile lets you access all your Bitrix24 accounts from one place, including accounts you created and those you were invited to.
With this profile, you can:
- Use one login and password for all Bitrix24 accounts.
- Quickly switch between different accounts.
- Manage profile settings.
- Connect a phone number, email, and social login for easier access.
- Rename or create new Bitrix24 accounts.
In this article:
- Log in to your Bitrix24 Network profile
- Manage your Bitrix24 Network profile
- Delete your Bitrix24 Network profile
Log in to your Bitrix24 Network profile
You can log in to the Bitrix24 Network profile in two ways: from your personal profile or using a direct link.
Option 1: From your personal profile
1. Click your profile photo in the top right.
2. Select Change account .
- Go to bitrix24.net
- Or visit bitrix24.com
Option 2: Using a direct link
1. Open the Bitrix24 login page .
2. Enter your login and password.
Manage your Bitrix24 Network profile
In your profile, you can update personal details, link a phone number and email, change your password, and manage Bitrix24 accounts.
Edit your profile.
1. Click the pencil icon next to your name.
2. Enter your first and last name, and upload a photo. Click the checkmark to save your changes.
3. Check the box to apply updates to all accounts linked to your Bitrix24 Network profile.
Connect a phone number and email. Add a phone number and email to use them as your login for Bitrix24. Set login and password when using social network login
Change your password.
1. Click Change next to the password field.
2. Enter your current password and then set a new one.
3. Click Save to confirm.
Change Bitrix24 login or password
You'll need to use the new password to log in to all accounts linked to your Bitrix24 Network profile.
Connect social media accounts. Link Facebook, Gmail, or other social networks for easier login.
1. Click Connect social media .
2. Turn on the toggle next to the platform you want to use.
3. Log in to that account to complete the connection.
Rename Bitrix24. Only account administrators can rename Bitrix24 accounts.
- Each account can be renamed once on any plan.
- On the Standard, Professional, and Enterprise plans, additional renames are available through Bitrix24 Support.
To make changes, click Rename under the account URL. Change Bitrix24 address and connect your domain
Create a Bitrix24 account. Click Create Bitrix24 under the list of your accounts. You can create up to seven accounts under one Bitrix24 Network profile.
Make sure you're logged into the correct Bitrix24 Network profile before creating a new account. Bitrix24 accounts cannot be moved between profiles.
Delete your Bitrix24 Network profile
You can delete your Bitrix24 Network profile only if no accounts are linked to it. To do this:
1. Click the arrow next to your name.
2. Select Delete profile .
In brief

- The Bitrix24 Network profile provides one login for all your Bitrix24 accounts. It lets you manage your personal information, add login methods, create or rename accounts, and switch between them easily.
- There are two ways to log in to your Bitrix24 Network profile: from your personal profile or using a direct link.
- If you no longer need the profile and no accounts are linked to it, you can delete it at any time.

titre: Set a password to log in to Bitrix24
sections: Set a password to log in to Bitrix24
After you register a Bitrix24 account, you’ll be logged in automatically. For future logins, you need to set a password. There are two ways to do this:
- Confirm your email
- Reset your password
If you registered using a social network, log in to Bitrix24 with the same credentials from that service. Set login and password when using social network login
Confirm your email
1. Check the inbox of the email address you used to register. If you don’t see a message from us, check the Spam folder. Open the email and click Confirm your email .
2. Create a password and click Save and log in . You can now use this password to access your account.
You can't use Bitrix24 until you confirm your email.
Reset your password
1. Click Forgot password on the login page .
2. Click Continue .

3. Check the inbox of the email address you used to register. Open the email and click Reset password . If you don’t see a message from us, check the Spam folder or request a new password recovery email.
4. Create a new password and click Continue .
5. Click Log in . You can now use this password to access your account.
In brief
- After you register a Bitrix24 account, you’ll be logged in automatically. For future logins, you need to set a password.
- You can create a password by confirming your email or resetting your password.
- If you registered using a social network, log in to Bitrix24 with the same credentials from that service.

titre: Change Bitrix24 login or password
sections: Change Bitrix24 login or password
Update your login, password, or social account in Bitrix24

You can update your login, change your password, or connect a different social network to your Bitrix24 account. This is useful if your contact details have changed or you no longer use a specific email or phone number.
Make all changes on the Bitrix24 Network profile page: Bitrix24 Network profile
Only the profile owner can change the login and password.
In this article:
- Change your login
- Change your social network account
- Change your password
Change your login
You can use an email address or phone number as your login.
1. Click your profile photo in the top-right corner.
2. Select Change account to open your Bitrix24 Network profile.
3. Click Change in the Email or Phone section.
4. Enter a new email address or phone number and your current password. If you forgot your password, use the recovery option. Recover your Bitrix24 password
5. Optional: Select the checkbox to update this login across all linked Bitrix24 accounts.
6. Click Save .
7. Confirm the change using the link sent by email or the code sent via SMS.
8. After confirmation, the new login appears in your profile.
If you see the error “A user with this email already exists,” use a different email or unlink it from another account.
Change your social network account
You can connect a different social account to your Bitrix24 profile.
1. Click your profile photo in the top-right corner.
2. Select Change account .
3. Click Connect other social media .
4. Turn on the switch for the social network you want.
5. Click Continue as or sign in with another account.
Change your password
1. Click your profile photo in the top-right corner.
2. Select Change account .
3. Click Change in the Password section.
4. Enter your current password and the new password twice. If needed, recover your password. Recover your Bitrix24 password
5. Save the changes.
To verify the new password, open an incognito window and sign in again.
For security, sign out from all devices:
1. Open your profile and go to the Security tab.
2. Click Log out on all devices .
In brief
- You can update your login, password, and connected social accounts in the Bitrix24 Network profile.
- Only the profile owner can change login and password.
- After changing your password, test it in an incognito window.
- Sign out from all devices to keep your account secure.

titre: Set login and password when using social network login
sections: Set login and password when using social network login

There are several ways to log into Bitrix24: with your login and password, through social networks, or using a QR code. If you log in via social networks, we recommend setting up access with a login and password to ensure you can still access your account if there are issues with social network login.
To log in using your login and password, connect an email or phone number to your profile.
Connect email
1. Go to the login page and log into Bitrix24 through a social network.
2. Click your profile photo in the top right corner, open the three-dot menu (...), and select Bitrix24 Network .
3. Click Connect email .
4. Enter your email address and create a password, then click Save . Check the box if you want the email to update for all Bitrix24 accounts linked to your Network profile.
5. Check your email to confirm it. If this email is linked to a social network account, confirmation isn't needed.
6. Click Confirm email .
7. Your email is now linked to your profile, and you can now log into Bitrix24 using your login and password.
If you see the "User with this email already exists" error, use a different email address or unlink it from another employee's profile. Why the "User with this email already exists" error occurs
Connect phone number
1. Go to the login page and log into Bitrix24 through a social network.
2. Click your profile photo in the top right corner, open the three-dot menu (...), and select Bitrix24 Network .
3. Click Connect phone number .
4. Enter your phone number and click Get the code . Check the box if you want the phone number to update for all Bitrix24 accounts linked to your Network profile.
5. Enter the code from the SMS.
6. Create a password and click Save .
7. Your phone number is now linked, and you can log into Bitrix24 using your login and password.
If the code doesn't arrive, it might be an issue with the operator. Try requesting the code again or contact the Bitrix24 Support team. Contact Bitrix24 Support
In brief
- There are several ways to log into Bitrix24: with your login and password, through social networks, or using a QR code.
- If you log in via social networks, we recommend setting up access with a login and password to ensure you can still access your account if there are issues with social network login.
- To log in using your login and password, connect an email or phone number to your Bitrix24 Network profile.

titre: What to do if you forgot your Bitrix24 login or password
sections: What to do if you forgot your Bitrix24 login or password
If you've forgotten your Bitrix24 login or password, don't worry—you can easily restore access. This article will guide you through the process.
If you forgot your login
Your login is the email address or phone number you used when registering with Bitrix24.
There are two ways to restore access:
- Ask your Bitrix24 administrator to provide your login.
- Log in with the QR code using the Bitrix24 mobile app.
Contact your Bitrix24 administrator to restore access. Bitrix24 administrators can check an employee's login details. Here's how:
1. Go to the employee's profile.
2. Open the Passwords > Authentication section.
3. View the linked email and phone number.
Log in with the QR code. If you're logged into the mobile app, open the web version of your Bitrix24 using the QR code.
1. Go to the Bitrix24 login page and scan the QR code with your smartphone camera.
2. Click the Bitrix24 link, and the mobile app will automatically open.
3. In the app, tap Yes, proceed . You'll be logged into Bitrix24 in the web version. Log in to your Bitrix24 account by QR code
If you forgot your password
You can easily recover your password to restore access to Bitrix24.
1. Go to the Bitrix24 login page and click Forgot password .
2. Enter your login and click Continue .
3. You'll receive an email with a password recovery link or an SMS with a code. Recover your Bitrix24 password
If these recommendations don't help, contact Bitrix24 Support. How to contact Bitrix24 Support
In brief
- Restore access to Bitrix24 if you've forgotten your login or password.
- Your login is the email address or phone number you used during registration.
- If you forgot your login, ask the Bitrix24 administrator for help or log in with the QR code using the mobile app.
- You can log in with the QR code only if you're already logged into the Bitrix24 mobile app.
- If you forgot your Bitrix24 password, recover it by clicking Forgot password on the login page.

titre: Recover Bitrix24 password
sections: Recover Bitrix24 password
If you forgot your Bitrix24 password, you can reset it in a few steps. This guide covers both Cloud and On-Premise versions so you can regain access quickly.
Reset your password in Bitrix24 Cloud
Choose a method based on how you created your account:
- Email
- Phone number
- Social network
- Contact your Bitrix24 administrator
Recover password via email
1. Go to the Bitrix24 login page and click Forgot password .
2. Enter your login and click Continue . If you don't remember your login, contact the Bitrix24 administrator. How to find a user login
3. Check your email inbox. You’ll receive an email from noreply@bitrix24.net with the password reset link.
4. Open the email and click Change password .
5. Enter a new password and click Continue.
6. Click Log in next to your Bitrix24 account.
Recover password via phone number
1. Go to the Bitrix24 login page and click Forgot password .
2. Enter your phone number and click Continue .
3. You will receive an SMS with a 6-digit code. Enter it into the special field. The code is valid for 60 seconds. If it expires, request a new code and click Continue .
4. Create a new password and click Continue .
If you don’t receive the code, try again. If the issue continues, contact Bitrix24 Support. How to contact Bitrix24 Support
If you signed up with Facebook, Google, or another service, reset your password through that provider.
Recover password by contacting administrator. A Bitrix24 administrator can send you a password reset link:
1. Open your profile.
2. Go to Security.
3. Click Recover password.
The password recovery link and registration details will be sent to your email or phone number. Follow the link to regain access to Bitrix24.
Recover your password in Bitrix24 On-Premise version
You can reset your password in two ways:
- Via email
- Contact your administrator
Recover password via email
1. Click Forgot your password on the login page.
2. Enter your login or email and click Reset password.
3. Open the email and follow the link.
4. Enter your login and new password, then click Change password.
Recover password by contacting administrator. An administrator can manually set a new password:
1. Open Settings.
2. Go to Users > User list.
3. Click Menu (≡) next to the user.
4. Select Edit.
5. Enter and confirm the new password, then save.
In brief
- You can quickly reset a forgotten Bitrix24 password.
- Use a password manager to store credentials securely.
- In the Cloud version, reset via email, phone, social login, or admin help.
- In the On-Premise version, reset via email or ask your administrator.

titre: Login history in the Bitrix24 mobile app
sections: Login history in the Bitrix24 mobile app

If you think someone signed in to your account from another device, use Login history to check. It shows all devices and IP addresses used to sign in to Bitrix24, so you can spot suspicious activity in time.
Each time you open the mobile app, it counts as a login. This is true even if the app remembers you and does not ask for your password.
To view Login history, go to Menu > Security.
In the Log in section, select Login history .
The list shows:
- Device type, such as computer or phone
- Operating system, such as iOS or Android
- Browser, such as Chrome or Safari
- City
- IP address
- Date
The date format depends on when the login happened:
- Today: time only, such as 12:33
- Earlier this year: date without the year, such as March 3
- Last year: full date, such as March 3, 2026

If you see suspicious activity in your account, sign out of Bitrix24 on all devices except the current one. Then change your password and turn on two-factor authentication to protect your account. New two-factor authentication in Bitrix24 Login history

titre: Configure Single Sign-On (SSO) for Bitrix24
sections: Configure Single Sign-On (SSO) for Bitrix24
Single Sign-On (SSO) is available on Bitrix24 Enterprise plans. It lets employees sign in with their Microsoft Azure Active Directory account without entering a password.
With SSO and SCIM, you can manage access in one place and automate user provisioning.
Before you start
To set up SSO:
1. An administrator must configure SSO and SCIM in Bitrix24.
2. You need to register an application in Azure Active Directory.
3. After setup, employees can sign in using their Azure AD accounts.
Key concepts
- Microsoft Azure Active Directory (Azure AD) A cloud service for managing user access to apps and services. What is Microsoft Entra ID
- Single sign-on (SSO) Lets users access multiple apps with one set of credentials. What is single sign-on in Microsoft Entra ID
- System for Cross-domain Identity Management (SCIM) A protocol for automatically creating, updating, and removing user accounts. What is SCIM
In this article:
- Set up SSO in Bitrix24
- Create a SAML application in Microsoft Azure
- Enter the service URL and run validation
- Check employee email domains
- Configure the mobile app (iOS and Android)
- Test SSO and enable it for your team
Follow each step carefully to avoid locking users out. Test SSO in a separate Bitrix24 account before enabling it for your team.
Set up SSO in Bitrix24
1. Open your Bitrix24 profile.
2. Go to Security > SSO and SCIM .
3. Click Configure now .
Note:
- Deactivating a user removes their access.
- Reactivating restores access but not admin rights. You must grant them again.
Create a SAML application in Microsoft Azure
1. Sign in to your Microsoft Azure account. If you don’t have one, create it . Open Azure Active Directory .
2. Go to Enterprise applications > New application .
3. Select Create your own application . Enter a name, select Non-gallery application , and click Create .
4. After the app is created, open Assign users and groups .
5. Click Add user/group and add yourself.
6. Open your profile and make sure your email is listed under Contact info . If it’s missing, you may not be able to sign in. Add or delete users using Azure Active Directory
7. Open the Single Sign-On section.
8. Select SAML as the sign-on method.
9. In SAML Basic Configuration , click Edit .
10. In Bitrix24, copy:
- ACS URL
- SP Entity ID
11. Go back to Azure and paste:
- ACS URL into Reply URL (Assertion Consumer Service URL).
- SP Entity ID into Identifier (Entity ID).
Click Save .
12. Return to Bitrix24 and click Continue .
Enter the service URL and run validation
1. Copy the App Federation Metadata URL in Azure.
2. Paste it into Bitrix24.
3. Click Check now .
If the setup is correct, you’ll see the message Connection established .
If you set up SSO in an incognito window or a different browser, you may need to sign in to Microsoft Azure again.
If you can’t log in: Make sure you added yourself as a user in the Azure application.
Check employee email domains
Set up user provisioning from Microsoft Azure to sync users with Bitrix24.
1. In Bitrix24, copy the Microsoft Azure service link and Unique Token .
2. In Azure, open your app and go to Provision User Accounts .
3. Select Automatic provisioning and enter admin credentials:
- Tenant URL (from Bitrix24)
- Secret token (from Bitrix24)
4. Click Test Connection , then click Save .
5. In Manage provisioning , click Edit attribute mappings .
6. In Mappings :
- Turn off Provision Azure Active Directory Groups .
- Turn on Provision Azure Active Directory Users .
7. Remove any fields you don’t need.
8. Click Add New Mapping to add the objectId field.
9. Save your changes.
10. Go back to Provision User Accounts and click Start Provisioning to enable synchronization and automatically add new users to the account.
Azure syncs users about every 40 minutes. To add a user right away, use Provision on Demand .
Verify domains
Return to Bitrix24. Enter your domains and run the check.

Use corporate domains only, and make sure all employees are linked to them. You can find your primary domain in Microsoft Azure on the main service page. If a user’s email does not match the corporate domain, they won’t be able to sign in after you enable single sign-on.

titre: Reasons to enable two-factor authentication in Bitrix24
sections: Reasons to enable two-factor authentication in Bitrix24

Two-factor authentication adds a second step to your sign-in. It helps protect company data if someone steals, guesses, or captures a password on a fake page. A username and password alone are not enough to access the account.
In Bitrix24, two-factor authentication is one of several security measures. Others include encrypted connections, file protection, and proactive security. Restrict access to Bitrix24 by IP address
Why a password alone is not enough
Even a strong password cannot fully protect an account. Attackers use brute-force attacks, credential stuffing, and social engineering. Here are three common cases.

Phishing and social engineering. A user gets an email or message with a link to a page that looks like a trusted corporate service. The user enters their username and password, and the attacker captures them. Phishing: How to protect your company FAQ: Phishing
Password reuse. If someone uses the same username and password for several services, attackers can test stolen credentials on other websites, including a work account.
Malware. An infostealer An infostealer is malware that collects data from a device and sends it to an attacker. can steal passwords saved in a browser, session data, and other identifiers.
In all of these cases, the issue is not always password strength. If someone else learns the password, one verification step is no longer enough.
How a second factor protects your account
With a standard sign-in, the correct username and password are enough. If an attacker gets these credentials, they can try to sign in as the employee.
When two-factor authentication is on, sign-in includes two steps:
1. The user enters their username and password.
2. Bitrix24 asks for confirmation in the mobile app, by SMS, or by email.

Without this second confirmation, the account stays protected. For example, if an employee enters their password on a fake page, the attacker can try to sign in. Bitrix24 then sends a request to the employee's trusted device. If the employee does not approve it, the sign-in fails. New two-factor authentication in Bitrix24 FAQ: Security
Two-factor authentication helps protect accounts from phishing, brute-force attacks, and credential stuffing. A password alone is no longer enough to sign in.

titre: Disable Single Sign-On (SSO)
sections: Disable Single Sign-On (SSO)
Single Sign-On (SSO) lets employees access Bitrix24 with one set of credentials. The account administrator manages all accounts in one place, so users don’t need multiple passwords.
Single sign-on (SSO)
Follow these steps to disconnect SSO:

1. Check account details . Open the SSO settings page and verify the information. Make sure both the administrator and employees can access this page. Confirm that each user has a valid email address and phone number.
Bitrix24 Network profile
2. Contact Bitrix24 Support . Ask a support specialist to disable SSO.
1. Click the Helpdesk button in the top-right corner.
2. Click Start chat .
3. Log in to your account . After support disables SSO, your Bitrix24 account will no longer be connected to Microsoft Azure Active Directory.
Employees will receive a password reset link at the email address listed in their Bitrix24 Network profile.

titre: System user in Bitrix24
sections: System user in Bitrix24
A system user is a service account that Bitrix24 creates automatically.
Bitrix24 creates a system user in these cases:
- When you install an app from Bitrix24 Market
- When an employee with active webhooks is dismissed and the administrator decides to keep the webhooks
Apps and integrations continue to work even when employees change or collaboration with a partner ends.
A system user does not have a login or password. You do not need to set it up, add it to subdepartments, or delete it.
- When a system user is created
- How to identify a system user
When a system user is created

When you install an app from Bitrix24 Market. Bitrix24 creates a system user so the app can access Bitrix24 data, such as CRM, Tasks, and other sections you approved during installation. The app continues to work even if the employee who installed it is dismissed.

When an employee with active webhooks is dismissed. The administrator chooses whether to keep or disable the employee's webhooks. If the administrator keeps them, Bitrix24 automatically creates a system user with the necessary permissions, and the webhooks continue to work after the employee is dismissed. If the administrator disables them, the webhooks stop working. Dismiss an employee with active webhooks
How to identify a system user
A system user is different from a regular employee account in a few ways:
- It has no profile photo
- It uses a technical address like dn3qusuumhbxtqdk06prx62l55d41c@bitrix.rest instead of a regular email address
- It has no job title
To see which integrations run through a system user, go to Developer resources > Integrations .
In brief

- A system user is a service account. It appears automatically when you install an app from Bitrix24 Market or when an employee with active webhooks is dismissed and the administrator decides to keep the webhooks.
- A system user has no login or password. You do not need to configure it, add it to subdepartments, or delete it.
- To see which integrations run through a system user, go to Developer resources > Integrations .

titre: GDPR compliance
sections: GDPR compliance
The General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) (EU) 2016/679 is a European Union law that protects personal data and privacy for individuals in the EU and the European Economic Area (EEA).
Data Processing Agreement

Bitrix24 works with many customers in the European Union, so we follow GDPR compliance rules and maintain a GDPR section on our website. Your Data Processing Agreement is accepted as part of our main Terms of Service .
Enter your GDPR compliance details.
To add your compliance information:
- Click the toggles icon in the top-right corner.
- Select Settings.
- Open the GDPR compliance tab.
- Enter the required details.
Data hosting inside and outside the EU
GDPR allows personal data to be processed outside the EEA if appropriate safeguards (Articles 45–49) are in place. However, we recommend that EU customers use these regional accounts:
- Bitrix24.eu
- Bitrix24.de
- Bitrix24.pl
- Bitrix.it
- Bitrix24.fr
These accounts are hosted in AWS data centers in Frankfurt, Germany, and are fully GDPR compliant.

Data for Bitrix24.com, Bitrix24.es, and Bitrix24.com.br is stored in the United States. Personal data processing for customers in Spain and Portugal is covered under the EU–US Privacy Shield framework. See the Data Processing Agreement for details.
GDPR compliance for employees and CRM data
If you work with employees or customers in the EU, they have specific rights under GDPR. To stay compliant:
- Enable consent for personal data processing in CRM forms and the live chat widget.
- Individuals can request a copy of their personal data stored in your Bitrix24 account. They can also request that you delete or anonymize their data.
To handle these requests automatically, you can use apps from the Bitrix24 Market.
- GDPR for employees
- GDPR for CRM

titre: Event log
sections: Event log

The Event log page shows a list of employees who logged into your Bitrix24 account. It helps you check user authorizations and their corresponding IP addresses. Note that only account administrators can use this tool.
To access the event log:

titre: Protect data in the Bitrix24 mobile app
sections: Protect data in the Bitrix24 mobile app
In the Bitrix24 mobile app, you can restrict employees from taking screenshots, recording the screen, or copying text. This helps protect confidential information from being leaked.

Enable information protection
Only a Bitrix24 administrator can enable this protection.
1. Click the icon next to your Bitrix24 name and select Settings .

3. Enable the options: Disable screenshots in the mobile app and Disable copy functionality in the mobile app . Select the employees or departments for whom the restriction will apply.

The restriction applies to the entire mobile app interface, not to specific documents or sections.
1. Tap Menu .
2. Select Security .

Disable screenshots. When employees try to take a screenshot or record the screen, they will see a message about the restriction. The screenshot or video will not be saved.
Disable text copying. Employees can send messages to each other within the app but cannot copy and send text outside Bitrix24.

titre: Phishing: How to protect your company
sections: Phishing: How to protect your company
Phishing is a type of fraud used to steal sensitive data from individuals or companies.
Standard phishing targets a broad audience. Attackers send mass emails to collect passwords, credit card details, or access to personal accounts.
Corporate phishing focuses on employees who have access to important data. The goal is to break into internal systems or disrupt business operations.
How attackers trick users
Research the company Attackers study social media, company structure, and communication style.
Impersonate employees or executives They send emails from fake or lookalike domains that appear legitimate.
Send fake messages Messages may include profile photos or even AI-generated voice recordings to appear real.
Distribute malicious files For example, files that prompt you to update software.
Create fake login pages These pages look real but are designed to steal your credentials.
How to protect against phishing
Follow these guidelines to reduce risk:
Check links and sender addresses Don’t click links right away. Hover over them to see the actual URL and domain.
Avoid suspicious attachments Do not open files that ask you to update software or enable macros. Be cautious with files in exe , js , scr formats or password-protected archives.
Verify urgent requests Do not act on messages marked “Urgent” without confirmation. Double-check requests for money or data through a trusted channel, such as a call or internal chat.
Keep software up to date Install updates regularly to fix security vulnerabilities.
Use email filtering Set up filters to detect and move suspicious emails to spam.
Define a security policy Create clear rules for handling email, browsing, and responding to security incidents.
Enable antivirus and two-step authentication Use antivirus tools and add an extra layer of security with two-step verification.
Enable two-step authentication for Bitrix24 login
Train employees Run regular training sessions and test awareness of phishing risks.
Check website domains carefully Always confirm the domain before logging in. For example, Bitrix24 cloud addresses use the bitrix24 domain only.
Report any suspicious emails or websites to your security team. Stay alert and verify anything that looks unusual.
In brief
- Phishing is a fraud method used to steal sensitive data.
- Standard phishing targets large groups through spam.
- Corporate phishing targets employees with access to critical systems.
- To stay safe, verify senders, avoid suspicious files, keep software updated, use antivirus and two-step authentication, and follow your company’s security policy.

titre: FAQ: Security
sections: FAQ: Security

Bitrix24 includes multiple layers of protection to keep your data secure. These include encrypted connections, two-step authentication, IP restrictions, and more. This article answers common questions about security in Bitrix24.
In this article:
- Data protection
- Data hosting
- Login history
- Restrict access by IP address
- Forget login or password
- Protection against DDoS attacks
Data protection
Bitrix24 uses multiple layers of security to protect your data and maintain stable performance.
Connection encryption . All data transfers use SSL encryption. This keeps your information secure, even on public Wi-Fi networks.

Two-step authentication . Use one-time codes from the Bitrix24 OTP or Google Authenticator apps. Even if someone gets your password, they won’t be able to access your account. Enable two-step authentication for Bitrix24 login
File protection . Bitrix24 automatically backs up your files in the cloud. You can restore them if there is hardware failure or a virus.
Proactive protection . Bitrix24 uses a built-in web application firewall (WAF). It blocks most common web attacks and is based on years of security experience.
Security in Bitrix24
Data hosting
Bitrix24 stores data on Amazon Web Services (AWS) servers in:
- United States (Virginia)
- European Union (Frankfurt, Germany)
You can also use an on-premise version to host data on your own server.
AWS meets major compliance standards, including HIPAA, GDPR, ISO 27001, SOC 1/2/3, and PCI DSS Level 1.
Login history
You can track login activity in Employees > Time and Reports > Login History .
- Administrators can view all employee logins.
- Employees can view only their own activity
Employee login history in Bitrix24
Restrict access by IP address
Admins can allow access to Bitrix24 only from specific IP addresses. This helps prevent access from unknown devices or public networks. Restrict access to Bitrix24 by IP address
To set up IP restrictions:
1. Go to Settings (⚙️) > Security .
2. Select IP address access restrictions .
3. Add allowed IP addresses.
4. Choose which employees the rule applies to.
5. Save the settings.
After that, users can only log in from the listed IP addresses.
Forget login or password
If you can’t access your account, you can restore it.
If you forgot your login: There are two ways to recover access:
- Ask your Bitrix24 administrator for your login.
- Use a QR code from the mobile app (if already logged in there). What to do if you forgot your Bitrix24 login or password
If you forgot your password:
1. Open the Bitrix24 login page .
2. Click Forgot password .
3. Enter your login.
4. Follow the link sent to your email. Recover Bitrix24 password
If you still can’t sign in, contact Bitrix24 support. Contact Bitrix24 Support
Protection against DDoS attacks
Bitrix24 uses a web application firewall (WAF) to monitor and filter traffic.

It applies protection across all OSI layers, up to Layer 7. This helps stop DDoS attacks quickly without slowing down the system. False positives are rare and stay minimal even during attacks. Security in Bitrix24

titre: Browser requirements for stable Bitrix24 performance
sections: Browser requirements for stable Bitrix24 performance

titre: Free 15-day trial
sections: Free 15-day trial
The trial mode gives you access to the features of the Professional Vibe+ plan for 15 days. It helps you try various Bitrix24 tools before purchasing a plan. You will have access to:
- Unlimited AI: Use CoPilot without limits across Bitrix24. Create content, generate ideas, turn calls and meetings into tasks and follow-ups, and automate routine work.
- Unlimited apps: Connect any number of apps from Bitrix24 Market, including messengers, payment systems, and telephony.
- Cloud storage: Use 50 GB for file storage and sharing.
- Time tracking and work reports: Set up work schedules and monitor employee tasks.
- Automation rules and triggers: Automate work processes like sending messages, updating deal stages, or setting tasks.
- Workflows: Set up document approvals, invoice processing, or vacation confirmations.
- Online document collaboration: View and edit documents with colleagues.
- Powerful CRM: Manage leads and invoices, and connect email, telephony, and messaging.
- Recurring deals and invoices: Automatically create recurring deals.
- Sales pipelines in CRM: Set up different pipelines for working with customers and suppliers.
- Telephony: Rent a number and make calls from Bitrix24.
Activating the trial
Any user can start the trial. Here's how:
1. Open the My plan widget in the top right. If you're on the Free plan, click Buy Now .
2. In the 15-day trial section, click Activate .
3. In the slider panel, click Activate Trial Mode .
You can enable the trial mode only once. If you use it for 10 days and then turn it off, you cannot use the remaining 5 days later.
To see how many days are left, click Trial mode in the top right, or go to Subscription > Trial mode .
If you already use a commercial plan, your subscription won't be suspended during the free trial period. You will be using days from both plans simultaneously.
You can deactivate trial mode. Click Buy now > Trial mode > Deactivate .
Limitations of the trial
There are several limitations in the trial mode:
- Email campaigns via Marketing are not available.
- Publishing sites is not available on commercial plans.
- Custom HTML and JS are not available in the site editor.
- Dynamic blocks are not available in the site editor.
- CRM forms are not available.
- BI Builder is not available.
- You cannot change the text of the invitation to Bitrix24 or remove "Powered by Bitrix24" on items like CRM forms and Live chat.
- The number of CRM items for analytics is limited to 1,000 items.
- Each user can connect only one mailbox and grant access to three other users.
- You can create only one online store with a maximum of 100 items in the product catalog.
- You can rename the account address only once.
- Telephony can be used in trial mode, but it must be paid separately. It is not available on the Free plan.
- Only commercial plan subscribers can access Bitrix24 Support. It is not provided to the Free plan users with an active trial mode.
What happens when your trial ends

When your trial ends, tools not included in your plan will be disabled and become completely inaccessible, but the data will be saved. Access to this data will be restored if you switch to a plan that includes these tools.

Cloud storage . If you used more space during the trial than your current plan allows, the data will remain in view-only mode. To remove the limitation, switch to a suitable commercial plan or clean up space. Cloud storage

Telephony . Bitrix24 Telephony is available on any commercial plan. Free plan users can test calls during the trial. After the trial, you cannot make or receive calls, even if you have money left on your balance. Rented numbers will remain with you and can be used again when you upgrade to a commercial plan. Telephony connection options overview

Automation rules and triggers . All configured rules and triggers will be saved, but they will stop working on the Free plan. They will start working with the same settings if you upgrade to a commercial plan. Interface for adding automation rules and triggers
In brief
- Activate your free 15-day trial mode to try all the features of the Professional Vibe+ plan.
- You can enable the trial mode only once, and your plan subscription is not suspended during this period.
- In trial mode, you get access to the tools of the commercial plan with some limitations.
- When your trial ends, tools not included in your plan will be disabled, but the data will be saved.
- After the trial, the administrator needs to check and disable incompatible tools using the Plan compatibility check tool.

titre: Number of users on Bitrix24 Cloud plans
sections: Number of users on Bitrix24 Cloud plans
The number of users in your Bitrix24 account depends on your subscription plan.
If you need more than 10,000 users, contact us at sales@bitrix24.com .

Most companies start with the Free plan. It includes all core Bitrix24 tools and supports an unlimited number of users. One of the main benefits of the Free plan is that you can invite as many users as you need. Free plan features and limitations
What the maximum number of users means

For example, the Basic plan allows up to five users. If you invite 10 users to your Bitrix24 account, only the first five users can sign in. The remaining users will see a notification that the maximum number of users has been reached.
Bitrix24 remembers the first five active users. They keep access to the account until the user counter updates.
Until the counter updates, other invited users cannot sign in to Bitrix24. Account administrators will receive a notification and can:
- Remove employees who no longer use the account.
- Upgrade to a higher plan with more user slots.
How to check the number of users on your plan
To see how many users your current plan supports:
1. Open Subscription .
2. Select View limits .
3. Open the Users section.
In brief
- The number of users in your Bitrix24 account depends on your subscription plan.
- If you exceed the user limit on a commercial plan, some users will not be able to sign in.
- Employees and administrators receive a notification when the limit is reached.
- The allowed user counter updates every 30 days.
- Upgrade your plan to add more users and stay within the limit.

titre: New Vibe+ lineup — What Changes for Paid Customers
sections: New Vibe+ lineup — What Changes for Paid Customers

As of September 1, 2026, Bitrix24 has a new plan lineup, including the new Vibe+ tier. This article explains exactly what’s new, what changes, and — most importantly — what it means for your account, based on your current subscription type.
Find your situation:
- I’m on an annual plan
- I’m on a monthly or quarterly plan
- I’m in a grace period
- Trying Vibe+ with a free demo
- What do I need to do?
- Can I buy through a partner?
The new lineup
There are now two versions of every plan (Basic, Standard, Professional, Enterprise):

Essentials — the standard version of each plan. It keeps the core CRM, collaboration, and project management tools, but REST API, unlimited Market apps, unlimited AI, and the MCP server are no longer part of it — see below for details.
Vibe+ — a new, higher tier of the same plan. It adds AI-building tools and keeps API, Market, AI usage, and the MCP server unlimited.
What’s added in Vibe+
Vibe+ plans also come with increased storage, email sending, and admin seat limits compared to their Essentials counterparts.
What changes in Essentials (compared to the previous plans)
Essentials keeps all the core CRM, collaboration, and project management tools. Four things are different from the plans available before September 1, 2026:
If your work depends on custom integrations, many installed apps, heavy AI use, or connecting external AI tools via MCP, Vibe+ is the option that keeps all of that unlimited.
If you’re on an annual plan

Your rule: if you purchased or renewed your annual plan before September 1, 2026, your plan terms are locked in as of that date. You keep those exact terms — unlimited REST API, unlimited Market apps, unlimited AI, and the MCP server — until your paid period ends. This applies no matter how long ago you bought it: last year, last month, or on August 31.
This is true even if your paid period ends after November 30, 2026 . The date your subscription ends is what matters, not the transition period below.
Example: annual plan bought in January 2026, ending January 2027 → full access until January 2027 . Your next renewal will follow the new lineup.

If your annual plan expires between September 1 and November 30, 2026, and you renew it, you keep everything as-is, but only until November 30, 2026 (end of transition period). After that date, Essentials limits apply, unless you choose Vibe+.

Example: your annual plan ends October 1, 2026, and you renew on that date. You keep full REST API, Market, AI, and MCP server access until November 30, 2026. From November 30, Essentials limits apply — or you can choose Vibe+ to keep everything unlimited.
If you’re on a monthly or quarterly plan
Your rule: you keep your current features until November 30, 2026 , as long as you keep renewing.
- You can continue renewing at your current price through November 30, 2026, with full functionality — unlimited REST API, unlimited Market apps, unlimited AI, and the MCP server.
- On November 30, 2026, Essentials limits will apply — REST API turned off, Market apps capped at your plan’s number, AI usage limits applied, and the MCP server turned off.
- To keep unlimited access after November 30, you need to switch to Vibe+.
If your account is in a grace period
When a paid subscription expires, your account gets a 15-day grace period to renew before it drops to Free.
- If you renew within your 15-day grace period, between September 1 and November 30, 2026: you keep your previous terms — full REST API, Market, AI, and MCP server access — until November 30, 2026.
- If you don’t renew within your 15-day grace period: your account drops to Free, and Free plan limits apply immediately.
Trying Vibe+ with a free demo

You can activate a free 15-day Vibe+ demo without pausing your plan. During the demo, you get full Vibe+ functionality: VibeCode, unlimited REST API, unlimited Market apps, unlimited AI, and the MCP server.
When the demo ends:

- If the demo ends before November 30, 2026 (or you’re on an annual plan and your features remain unlimited past November 30, 2026): only VibeCode stops working. Your REST API and Market apps, and MCP server keep working as before — they’re still protected by the transition period, independently of the demo.

- If the demo ends on or after November 30, 2026: VibeCode stops working, and your Essentials limits apply immediately — REST API and the MCP server are no longer available, and Market apps are limited to your plan’s number.
In both cases, you can upgrade to Vibe+ to keep everything unlimited, or continue on Essentials within its limits. The demo can be activated only once.

Please note: the demo is based on Vibe+ Professional/Enterprise. If your own plan is a lower tier, some tools activated during the demo will be disabled once it ends, and your plan’s usual limits will apply.
What do I need to do?
No decision is needed right away — you have time until November 30, 2026, or later if you’re on an annual plan with a paid period that runs past that date. We will send reminders before the deadline.
When it’s time to decide, choose between:
- Staying on Essentials — review your Market apps and integrations, and make sure they fit within your plan’s new limits.
- Moving to Vibe+ — if you want to keep REST API, unlimited Market apps, and unlimited AI.
Buying through a partner

Both Essentials and Vibe+ plans are also available through official Bitrix24 partners, in addition to purchasing directly. If you already work with a Bitrix24 partner, you can arrange your upgrade or renewal through them the same way as before.
Have a question about your specific account? Contact support and we’ll help you check what applies to your case.

titre: Free plan features
sections: Free plan features

Bitrix24 includes a free plan for small teams that want to try the service or start organizing their work. The free plan is enabled by default, so you can start using Bitrix24 right after you sign up.
You can use Bitrix24 in a web browser or in the mobile app. Your data is stored in data centers. Create a Bitrix24 account
In this article:
- Tools included in the free plan
- What happens after 50 days of inactivity
What's included in the free plan
The free plan includes the core tools your team needs.
Messenger and video calls . Chat with your team and start video calls with up to 300 participants. There are no time limits.
Tasks . Create tasks, assign responsible people, and track deadlines in the view that works best for you: List, Kanban, or Gantt.
CRM . Manage your customer base, move unlimited deals through your pipeline, and create unlimited invoices.
CoPilot . Work with an AI assistant in chat, manage Bitrix24 from chat, and work with files and images.
Drive . Store work files in shared storage with up to 5 GB of space.
Sites and online stores . Create websites and landing pages with the built-in builder and publish them with free hosting.

What happens if you do not sign in for a long time

This rule does not apply to accounts with an active paid plan.
In brief
- Bitrix24 offers a free plan for small teams that want to try the service or start setting up their workflows.
- The free plan is enabled by default, so you can start working right after registration.
- Bitrix24 is a cloud service. Your data is stored in data centers, and you can access Bitrix24 in a browser or in the mobile app.
- The free plan includes core tools such as chat and calls, tasks, CRM, Drive, sites and online stores, and Sign.
- If no one signs in for 50 consecutive days, the account is deleted automatically and cannot be restored.

titre: Cloud storage
sections: Cloud storage
Cloud storage limits depend on your Bitrix24 plan. When your storage is full, you cannot upload new files to Bitrix24.
To check available space, go to Subscription > Plan limits > View limits > Cloud storage space .
Database size
Every action in Bitrix24 creates or updates data. This data is stored in the database.
The sections below usually take up the most database space:
- CRM : leads, contacts, companies, deals, invoices, and smart processes. This also includes history, activities, and the recycle bin.
- Automation : automation rules, workflows, and logs.
- Mail : incoming and outgoing emails and CRM marketing campaigns.
- Chats : messages from internal chats and open channel conversations.
The easiest way to free up database space is to clean up CRM data. Delete old records, irrelevant activities, change history, and items in the recycle bin. CRM Cleanup
If the database size does not decrease significantly after cleanup, contact Bitrix24 Support. Support specialists can check which data uses the most space in the database. Contact Bitrix24 Support
Drive space used
This section includes all files employees use in Bitrix24:
- Drive files : files employees upload to My Drive, Company Drive, and project or workgroup drives.
- Files from tasks, events, and Feed : these files are stored in My Drive > Uploaded Files . Each employee has a personal folder that stores only the files uploaded by that user.
- Files from chats : chat attachments are stored in Drive > Drive Cleanup > Expert mode > Instant Messenger storage .
- Recordings of phone conversations with customers : recordings of customer phone calls are stored in Company Drive > Telephony - recorded calls . Call recordings storage
- Files from emails : if mailboxes are connected to the CRM, email attachments are stored in Company Drive > Files from emails .
- Files from custom fields : attachments added to File-type fields in CRM, lists, and workflows.
To free up drive space, delete unnecessary files and empty the recycle bin. Ways to clean up Bitrix24 Drive Drive Cleanup
In brief
- You can check cloud storage usage in Subscription > Plan limits > View limits > Cloud storage space .
- Database size shows the size of all account data except files.
- Drive space used shows the total size of all files stored in the account.
- To free up cloud storage space, delete unnecessary records and files.

titre: Rules for subscription purchase
sections: Rules for subscription purchase
Starting June 1, 2023, new rules apply to subscription purchases. These rules affect subscription renewals, upgrades, and downgrades.
Renew a subscription
If you want to renew your current plan, keep these rules in mind:
- You can manually renew your subscription no earlier than 30 days before the expiration date. If auto-renewal is enabled, the subscription renews automatically.
- You can renew a subscription only once for a period of up to one year: either 1 or 12 months.
- Only one renewal purchase can be active at a time.
Downgrade a subscription
If you want to switch to a lower-tier plan:
- You can purchase a downgrade no earlier than 1 day before your current plan expires.
- Only one downgrade purchase can be active at a time.
Upgrade a subscription
If you want to switch to a higher-tier plan:
- You can upgrade at any time.
- The new subscription starts immediately after purchase.
Important
- Auto-renewal is enabled by default when you purchase a subscription for the first time. Your subscription renews automatically every 1 or 12 months, based on the selected billing cycle.
- You can check the auto-renewal status on the Subscription page under Purchase history . The status appears as Active or Cancelled .
If you have questions, contact the Sales team in the support chat or email sales@bitrix24.com .

titre: Enterprise plan features
sections: Enterprise plan features
In August 2022, we launched cloud-based Enterprise plans for mid-size and large companies with 250, 500, 1,000, or more employees.

These plans deliver high performance, stronger security, and better reliability. They run on a dedicated server infrastructure built for demanding workloads. Each customer is hosted in dedicated clusters across two independent data centers (master-master) on fully isolated hardware. The system adds resources based on the number of employees.
Multi branches
Use multi-branch management if your company includes a head office and multiple branches, such as subsidiaries, regional offices, dealer networks, retail locations, or franchises.
Each branch works in its own Bitrix24 environment. It has its own employees, access permissions, and separate CRM. There is no limit to the number of branches.
By default, employees do not see the full company or branch structure. You can grant access to all branches or only specific ones when needed.
Bitrix24 branch network
Employee Login History
Monitoring access is key to keeping your data secure. Unauthorized logins can lead to financial and reputational risks.

The Employee Login History feature helps you control access from different devices. If someone signs in from an unknown device, users can log out of all other sessions with one click and stay signed in on the current device.
Administrators can track employee login activity and force logout from all devices when needed.
Login history

titre: Create a Bitrix24 account for a branch network

titre: Security

titre: Bitrix24 branch network
sections: Bitrix24 branch network

In Bitrix24, you can connect multiple companies into a single branch network. This is useful for businesses with regional offices, subsidiaries, dealers, or franchisees that each have their own Bitrix24 account but need centralized management.
To use a branch network, the following requirements must be met:
- The primary Bitrix24 account must be on the Enterprise plan.
- Each branch must have a paid plan.
- All accounts in the network must be in the same domain zone, such as com or eu.
In this article:
- How a branch network works
- What you need to know about plans
How a branch network works
A branch network consists of one primary Bitrix24 account and branches connected to it. Each branch must be on a paid plan. The number of branches is unlimited.

Each branch is an independent Bitrix24 account with its own structure, CRM, tasks, chats, and integrations. Data isn't shared between accounts. You can switch between accounts in the network using the widget.

Only an administrator can connect a branch to the primary Bitrix24 account. You can connect a new or existing Bitrix24 account as a branch. Configure Bitrix24 for a branch network Connect an existing Bitrix24 account to a branch network
Each branch has a menu with the following actions:
- Open the branch account.
- Copy the branch address.
- Invite new employees.
- View the list of employees.
- View the branch structure.
- Disconnect the branch account from the network.

By default, the administrator of the primary Bitrix24 account can see all branches in the network, while other employees can see only their own branch. To give an employee access to multiple accounts, invite them to each of those accounts separately.
What you need to know about plans
If a branch uses the Free plan. A 15-day trial starts automatically when you connect the branch.
- If the account has already used the trial but has never been connected to a branch network, the trial starts again.
- If the account was previously part of a branch network, you can't connect it again until you upgrade it to a paid plan.
If a branch switches to the Free plan. The account is automatically disconnected from the network and turns red in the widget.

You have 15 days to switch back to a paid plan or disconnect the account from the network. Otherwise, the Plan compatibility check blocks the Bitrix24 account. Once you switch back to a paid plan, the branch returns to the list of connected accounts.

If the primary Bitrix24 account's plan changes. If you switch from the Enterprise plan to the Free plan, the widget disappears from all accounts in the network. To resume work, switch back to the Enterprise plan. If you don't pay for the Enterprise plan within 15 days, the Plan compatibility check blocks the primary Bitrix24 account.
If multiple accounts in the network use the Enterprise plan. Only one Bitrix24 account can be primary. Any other account on the Enterprise plan that joins the network becomes a branch.
If you need to change the primary account. First, disconnect all branches from the current primary account, then connect them to the new one.
If you need to move a branch to another network. A branch can belong to only one network at a time. First, disconnect it from the current network, then connect it to the new one.
In brief
- A branch network connects multiple Bitrix24 accounts in a single network: a primary account on the Enterprise plan and branches on any paid plan.
- Each branch is an independent Bitrix24 account with its own data and employees. You can switch between accounts using the widget.
- Only an administrator can connect a branch to the primary Bitrix24 account.
- If a branch switches to the Free plan, it disconnects from the network. Switch the branch to any paid plan within 15 days, or the Plan compatibility check blocks its Bitrix24 account.
- To switch from the Enterprise plan to another paid plan, disconnect all branches.

titre: Automatic renewal
sections: Automatic renewal

To avoid service interruptions, turn on automatic renewal for your cloud account. At the end of each billing cycle (every 1 or 12 months), Bitrix24 charges your credit card, debit card, or PayPal account automatically. After a successful payment, your subscription renews for the same period.
Enable automatic renewal
Automatic renewal is enabled by default when you buy a 1-month or 12-month commercial subscription. Your Bitrix24 subscription renews automatically at the end of each billing period.
If you purchased your subscription with a discount, the discount may apply only to the first billing cycle. Future renewals may renew at the regular price.
Cancel automatic renewal
A Bitrix24 administrator and other users can disable auto-renewal if they have permission to create orders. Integrators and implementation specialists cannot cancel auto-renewal.
Go to Subscription > Order history > Cancel Subscription .
If automatic renewal failed
Automatic renewal may fail for several reasons:
- The renewal date has not arrived yet.
- Your payment method is no longer valid.
- Your account has insufficient funds, or your credit limit has been reached.
- Your bank or payment provider is temporarily unavailable.
- Automatic renewal was canceled.
To check the renewal status, go to Subscription > Order history .
- Active : Your renewal date has not arrived yet. No action is required.
- Past Due : Click Retry Now . This sends a request to our Sales team to retry the payment manually. You will receive an email with the result and next steps, if needed.
- Cancelled : The system has already tried to process the payment several times without success. To continue using your subscription, purchase a new plan under Subscription > Upgrade .

titre: Grace period for cloud accounts
sections: Grace period for cloud accounts
If your Bitrix24 Cloud subscription cannot be renewed (for example, due to an expired card, updated payment details, or a pending bank transfer), your account enters a 15-day grace period.
During this time:
- Your Bitrix24 account remains fully active.
- Your subscription does not revert to the Free plan.
- You can update payment details and renew your subscription without losing access.
The grace period starts automatically when your commercial subscription expires.

titre: Cloud subscription upgrades and downgrades
sections: Cloud subscription upgrades and downgrades
You can upgrade or downgrade from any subscription plan to any subscription plan inside your Bitrix24 account. Go to the Subscription section > Upgrade plan and select a new subscription plan.
The way an upgrade or downgrade will be done may differ depending on:
- your cloud account's domain zone
- billing country
- your subscription's automatic renewal status
- the way you make payment: through a partner or directly from the vendor
There are two possible scenarios:
1. The amount already paid for an existing subscription is being credited towards a new subscription plan purchase. Thus, the new subscription’s cost is being prorated.

2. A new plan purchase is made as a separate subscription purchase. In this case, the existing subscription's remaining period is being recalculated into a newly purchased plan and added to its expiration date.
Additional information on downgrades

You won't lose any data when downgrading. However, if a new plan's limitations are incompatible with your account in its current state, it may become locked by the Plan compatibility check tool. Learn how to prevent it in this article: Plan compatibility check .
Note that a downgrade purchase can only be made no sooner than 1 day before the current plan's expiration date. For more information, see the article: Rules for subscription purchase .

If you wish to downgrade your commercial subscription to the Free plan, you’ll need to cancel your commercial subscription. For this, disable the automatic subscription renewal option. After that, the account will be rolled down to the Free plan. For detailed help, refer to the article: Cancel subscription .

titre: Plan compatibility check
sections: Plan compatibility check

When your plan expires, you have 15 days to renew it or choose a different one that better suits your needs. If you decide to upgrade or downgrade, the Plan compatibility check will suggest options based on the tools you require.
If the check finds tools that aren't compatible with your current plan, a notification will be shown to all users. Click Got it and open the Plan compatibility check to proceed.
1. Open the My plan widget and click on your plan.
2. Select Plan compatibility check .
After analyzing your Bitrix24 account, a detailed page will open, comparing the options of your current plan with other plans. The table includes the following action blocks:
- Must be disabled or deleted manually
- Will be disabled automatically
Must be disabled or deleted manually
This section shows the options your Bitrix24 administrator needs to change. These changes can't be made automatically because they impact your company operations.
Click the red block to see a brief description of the issue and ways to solve it.
Here are the functions that need the Bitrix24 owner's attention:

- Own domain . This option is available only on Professional and Enterprise plans. If you are switching to lower plan, disable your own domain and return to a regular domain in the *.bitrix24.* zone. The administrator should contact Bitrix24 Support. Return to previous Bitrix24 domain
- Number of employees . Check the number of employees in your company. You may need to dismiss users or switch to a plan providing the required number of employees. Dismiss users
- Administrators . If you have more administrators than your plan allows, you can revoke admin permissions or switch to a different plan. Revoke admin permissions
- Drive space . Clean up Bitrix24 Drive or choose a plan with more storage space. Drive Cleanup tool
- Flows . You can disable or delete flows, or choose a plan that offers this tool. Disable or delete flows
- Deal pipelines . If you have too many deal pipelines, delete some or switch to a plan that supports the desired number of pipelines. Delete deal pipelines

- Sites . If you have more published sites than your plan allows, unpublish and delete some sites or switch to another plan. Unpublish and delete sites Also, disable the Custom HTML option in the site settings if it's enabled, and remove any HTML code blocks. Site settings

- Manage branches . Bitrix24 branch network is only available for the Enterprise plan users. Disconnect all branches from the main Bitrix24 account or switch to the Enterprise plan. Disconnect branches

- High performance Enterprise cluster . When you activate the Enterprise plan, your Bitrix24 is transferred to a special dedicated infrastructure. To change your plan, contact Bitrix24 Support in advance to transfer your account to a regular server. How to contact Bitrix24 Support
- BI Builder . If you switch to the Basic or Free plan, manually disable BI Builder to ensure compatibility. Disable BI Builder
Will be disabled automatically
This section shows the options that will be disabled automatically based on the chosen plan.

The Plan compatibility check won't delete any of your data. You can downgrade to a plan that doesn't provide some of the options listed above, and those options will be automatically disabled. When you switch to a suitable plan, those options will become available again.
What happens if incompatible options aren't disabled

If you don't disable options that aren't compatible with your plan within 15 days, your Bitrix24 access will be suspended. You won't be able to use Bitrix24 until you adjust your settings to match your current plan or switch to a different one.
When logging in, all users will see a notification. You can either switch to the appropriate plan or contact Bitrix24 Support using the widget.
What happens when the trial mode ends

Free plan + trial : If there are options that require Bitrix24 owner's actions, you'll need to change them within 15 days after the trial mode ends. Otherwise, your Bitrix24 will be suspended until you switch to another plan.
Commercial plan + trial : During the trial mode, your commercial plan days continue to count down.

If your commercial plan ends before the trial period, Bitrix24 will switch to the Free plan. The Plan compatibility check will notify you of any changes. If there are any incompatible options, Bitrix24 will be suspended right after the trial ends.

If the trial ends before your commercial plan expires, you'll get a 15-day grace period after the commercial plan ends. After these 15 days, the account will switch to a Free plan. If there are any incompatible options, Bitrix24 will be suspended until you choose an appropriate plan.
In brief
- When your Bitrix24 plan expires, you have 15 days to renew it or choose a new one. The Plan compatibility check will show you which tools are compatible with your chosen plan and which aren't.
- Bitrix24 administrator needs to manually adjust and disable some options, while others will be automatically disabled if they're not compatible with the new plan.
- If you don't disable incompatible options within 15 days, your Bitrix24 access will be suspended until you make the necessary changes.

titre: Cancel subscription

Automatic subscription renewal is not applicable if you have purchased a commercial subscription directly from a Bitrix Partner in your region. You should inform your Bitrix24 Partner that you don't want to renew your commercial plan at least one week before the subscription expiration date .

titre: What happens if I stop using my Bitrix24?
sections: What happens if I stop using my Bitrix24?
If you stop using Bitrix24, what happens next depends on your plan.
If you have a paid plan and do not renew your subscription, your account switches to the Free plan .
For free Bitrix24 accounts, we automatically delete inactive accounts if no users log in for 40 to 50 days. This rule does not apply to paid subscriptions.
What happens to inactive accounts on the Free plan
1. We send a warning email that your account may be deleted because of inactivity.
2. After about 40 days without activity, your Bitrix24 account is deactivated. You can no longer access it.
3. You receive another email confirming that your Bitrix24 account is unavailable.
4. About 2 days later, we permanently delete the account. During this time, you can still restore access by contacting Bitrix24 Support immediately.
Deleting a Bitrix24 account on the Free plan does not remove your Bitrix24 Network profile .

If you use the free plan, Bitrix24 may delete your account after 50 days of inactivity. You will receive several warning emails before deletion.
To keep your account active, make sure at least one employee logs in regularly.
How to check if your account was deleted

Enter your Bitrix24 account address in the browser. Bitrix24 address is a unique domain that was created during registration in the format of https://*******.bitrix24.com/ . If you see a 404 error page, it means your Bitrix24 has already been deleted.
Make sure you entered the address correctly. A typo can also cause a 404 error.
You cannot restore a deleted Bitrix24 account. You can create a new one instead.

titre: Bitrix24 Cloud plans

Bitrix24 is an online service for business management and work automation. It contains tools for companies of all sizes and industries. Bitrix24 has several plans with different sets of tools that are suitable for different types of business.
Free plan

- plan meetings and events
- work with a small customer base
The free plan has limitations, for example, the history of messages in chats and channels is stored only for 30 days. You can see all limitations in the plan comparison table.
