This plan is suitable for small teams that want to grow. The plan includes an extended version of CRM and tools for companies that need:
- automate sales
- set tasks and monitor their fulfillment
- set up communications with customers
- create an online store
The Basic plan has limitations, for example, it has a maximum of five users. Check whether the plan meets your company's needs.
Bitrix24 plans

This plan is for the whole company or individual groups that need to work with collaboration tools and manage complex projects. The standard plan is suitable if the company needs to:
- manage large projects and divide them into tasks

- promote the company goods and services through mailings, advertising, etc.
A maximum of 50 users can work on the Standard plan.
Bitrix24 plans

You can automate your company's work and manage tasks. Managers can calculate deadlines and see the efficiency. The plan is suitable for companies that need to:

- invite external users to the meetings

Bitrix24 plan

titre: FAQ: Plans and payment
sections: FAQ: Plans and payment

Bitrix24 is a collaborative workspace where tasks, chats, calls, calendars, and other tools are interconnected. You don’t need to switch between different apps. Everything you need for work is in one place.
In this article:
- Which plan to start with when exploring Bitrix24
- How to purchase Bitrix24
- How to place an order and get an invoice
- Available payment methods

- How to change a plan
- What happens if you don’t renew your plan

Which plan to start with when exploring Bitrix24
Start with the free plan. It is automatically activated when you create a Bitrix24 account and includes basic tools:
- Tasks and projects
- Chat and video calls
- News feed
- Company structure
- Bitrix24 Drive
- Calendar
- Knowledge base
- CRM
- Contact center
- Website builder
- Mobile app
The free plan helps you evaluate Bitrix24’s core features and understand which tools your company needs. Bitrix24 plans and pricing
How to purchase a Bitrix24 plan
There are several ways to purchase a plan.
In the My Plan section. Click Upgrade to select a new plan or renew the current one, or Buy if you are currently using the free version of Bitrix24.
With the help of Bitrix24 partners. These are certified companies that help clients choose a plan, implement, and configure Bitrix24. Find a partner on the Bitrix24 website
How to place an order in Bitrix24 and get an invoice
You can place an order directly in your Bitrix24 account. This is done by the Bitrix24 administrator, but they can grant this right to other employees.
1. Go to the My Plan widget and click Upgrade. On the free plan, click Buy > Buy plan .
2. Select the appropriate plan and click Buy .
3. Specify who is placing the order — an individual, legal entity, or sole proprietor.
4. Choose the term — month or year. A 20% discount applies for annual payments.
5. Check or fill in the payment details depending on the payer type.
6. Click Next step .
After that, a payment page will open, or an invoice will be generated. You can pay it immediately or later in the My Plan > Orders and invoices section.
Available payment methods
You can pay for your order using a method convenient for you — bank transfer, electronic money, or card.
Bank transfer. Legal entities, individuals, and sole proprietors can pay by invoice, which is generated automatically.
Electronic money. This payment method is only available to individuals.
Card. This payment method is available to individuals, legal entities, and sole proprietors.
Is VAT included in Bitrix24 pricing?
Only telephony payments are subject to VAT.
How to get payment documents for a plan
Accounting documents for license and SIP connector payments are only available in electronic form.
In your Bitrix24. Documents appear in the Order details section within five days after payment.
To view and download a document:
1. Open My Plan > Orders and Invoices . 2. Find the required order and click Order details . 3. Click License in the Payment and Delivery section to download the document.
How to get payment documents for telephony

To receive closing documents for telephony services in Bitrix24, wait for the operator to generate a universal transfer document (UTD). This will happen within ten business days after the reporting period ends. Originals will be sent to the address specified during payment.
If the documents do not arrive, you can request them again through the Voximplant account or write to finance@voximplant.com.
Is a paper license issued for plan payments?

After paying for a plan, you receive an electronic version of the license document—a PDF file signed with a qualified electronic signature (QES). This signature is certified by an accredited certification center, giving the document the same legal force as a paper one.
If you need a paper copy of the document, you can print it and certify it on your end.
What rights do I get after purchasing Bitrix24?
After purchasing a license, you gain the right to use Bitrix24 under the terms of the license agreement.
What is auto-renewal and how does it work?
Auto-renewal is an option that automatically renews your Bitrix24 plan and charges your card.
The first attempt to charge occurs one day before the plan expires. If the payment fails, Bitrix24 will make two more attempts:
- On the day the plan expires.
- Two days after expiration, if previous attempts were unsuccessful.
How to change a plan
When changing a plan, the remaining paid days are not lost. Bitrix24 automatically recalculates the remaining paid days on your current plan and transfers them to the new one.
The cost of the new plan does not change: the remaining days on the previous plan are credited as additional days of Bitrix24 usage.
What happens if you don’t renew your plan?
When your plan expires, Bitrix24 automatically switches to the free plan. Some features will become unavailable, and some tools will need to be disabled manually using the plan compatibility check.
If you don’t disable some tools within two weeks, you won’t be able to work in Bitrix24. To continue, renew your current Bitrix24 plan or choose a new one.
Can I pay extra for a specific tool without upgrading the plan?
You cannot purchase individual tools. All Bitrix24 features are available only within the plans.
Can I purchase the Professional plan for fewer users at a lower price?
No. The Professional plan is only available in its current configuration.
Does Bitrix24 have a plan constructor?
Bitrix24 does not have a plan constructor—you cannot select only specific features or a certain number of users. Check the available plans on the official Bitrix24 website. Bitrix24 plans and pricing

titre: Tax Information for Bitrix24 products
sections: Tax Information for Bitrix24 products

Taxation plays a vital role in sustaining a well-functioning society. In regions where our products are subject to taxation, we responsibly gather and transmit consumption tax to governmental bodies at local, state, and/or federal levels. In regions where we are not directly registered for tax purposes, our intermediary partners collect and remit applicable consumption taxes to the relevant authorities in accordance with local regulations. Please peruse the fundamental tax queries outlined below.
Why am I being charged VAT?

If you reside in a country that charges a value-added tax on services provided, Bitrix24 will require a VAT/GST ID that states that you are tax exempt. Without this exemption in place, it is our duty to comply with tax codes around the world. In some jurisdictions, you may be charged tax even if you provide a valid VAT/GST ID However, in accordance with local legislation, you may be eligible for a deduction. Please consult with your local consultants for further guidance.
If you cannot provide/or we cannot verify a VAT/GST ID you will be charged taxes as required by your country’s tax code.
How do I enter my VAT/GST ID?
Whenever you purchase a Bitrix24 subscription, you have the option to add your VAT/GST ID on the checkout page prior to the payment.
If you need to change your VAT/GST ID after the purchase, please contact our sales team via support chat on the Subscription page.
What if I have a VAT/GST ID and forget to enter it?

You can add your VAT/GST ID in the Billing Info section ( Subscription > Payment details > Billing Info ) to apply to future purchases. Please note that in some cases a cancellation of the current subscription renewal may be required. For consultation and assistance please contact our sales team via support chat on the Subscription page.

Prices on the website do not include VAT/GST. Depending on the client's billing country, tax may be added to the selling price. The full price, including any applicable taxes, will be displayed at checkout and this will also be reflected in your invoice. You can find the tax calculation criteria for India at the following link: Indian GST on digital services .

titre: CoPilot in CRM: Call transcription and automatic field updates
sections: CoPilot in CRM: Call transcription and automatic field updates
CoPilot is an AI-powered assistant built into CRM. It helps your team handle calls faster and reduces manual work.
Without CoPilot, you typically need to:
1. Listen to the full call recording.
2. Identify key details (for example, payment method or delivery address).
3. Manually enter data into the deal.
With CoPilot, you can:
1. Read a full call transcript instead of listening to the recording.
2. Review a short call summary.
3. Automatically fill in CRM fields based on the call.
CoPilot works with leads and deals.
Call processing with CoPilot
CoPilot processes calls in three steps:
1. Call transcription
2. Call summary
3. Automatic field updates
Open the CRM item form and find the call in the timeline. In the Call section, you can start analysis in three ways:
- Complete fields — CoPilot fills the form fields with data from the call.
- Rate call — CoPilot checks the conversation against the script.
- Icon — starts transcription of the call recording
Call transcription
CoPilot records the call and converts speech to text. Open the transcript to review the full conversation. Use search to quickly find key details.
This is helpful for managers who need to review calls and confirm that employees ask the right questions.
CoPilot transcribes calls in the same language used during the conversation.
Call summary
CoPilot creates a short summary with the main points. You don’t need to listen to the full call.
Review the summary to quickly recall what you discussed with the customer.
You can choose a different language for summaries and CRM field values. Select summary language for CoPilot in CRM
To open a call summary, click CoPilot created a customer call summary in the timeline on the right.
Automatic field updates
CoPilot fills in empty fields in the CRM form using data from the call. Updated fields are marked with the icon.
CoPilot works with these field types: String, List, Number, and Integer.
If a field already has a value, CoPilot suggests a change instead of replacing it.

Example: A customer calls to update the delivery date. CoPilot detects the change and suggests a new value. You’ll see the Action required status in the timeline. Click Confirm fields to review and confirm.
If you’re not sure which value to keep, check the transcript or summary before deciding.
Switch to Kanban view to check field status:
- Fields completed : CoPilot filled in the fields. You can continue working.
- Action required : CoPilot suggests updates. Open the record and confirm the values.
CoPilot activity menu
CoPilot can process the entire call or run specific actions. For example, it can create only a summary or fill in fields only.
1. In the CRM form timeline, open the call menu — click Three dots (...) > CoPilot . 2. Select the action you need.
Available actions:
- Transcribe recording: It converts the call audio into text.
- Call summary: It creates a short summary of the conversation. CoPilot first transcribes the recording, then creates the summary.
- Complete fields: It adds data from the call to empty fields in the CRM form.
- Assess call: It gives the conversation a quality score.
- Create activity from call: It creates a follow-up activity based on the call.
- Process call: It runs all actions at once: transcription, summary, field filling, and activity creation.
After an action is complete, it no longer appears in the menu.
Activity from conversation
CoPilot can create an activity based on the call in two ways.
1. In the CRM form timeline, open the call menu — click Three dots (...) > CoPilot . 2. Select Process call .
CoPilot automatically transcribes the recording, creates a summary, fills in the form fields, and creates an activity.
Manually
1. In the CRM form timeline, open the call menu — click Three dots (...) > CoPilot . 2. Select Create activity from call .
CoPilot analyzes the call and creates an activity.
The type of activity depends on how relevant the conversation is.
Purple activity . If the conversation is meaningful, CoPilot creates an activity with a short description of the call outcome.
When the work is complete, click Completed to close the activity. To change the activity content, click Edit .

Yellow activity . If the conversation is not relevant, such as spam, an accidental call, or a meaningless call, CoPilot creates an activity marked Needs attention and suggests adding the contact to the stop list.
The yellow activity has two options:
- Yes: Adds the contact to the stop list and deletes the lead. If the contact does not have a phone number or email address, Bitrix24 cannot add it to the stop list.
- No: Closes the activity and keeps the lead. If a new call comes in, you can run processing again.
Call requirements
CoPilot can transcribe calls that:
1. Last from 10 seconds to 1 hour.
2. Have a file size of at least 60 KB.
To use CoPilot in CRM:
1. Enable CoPilot in CRM in the Bitrix24 settings.
2. Give the employee permission to edit the relevant CRM items. For example, to process calls in leads, the employee needs permission to edit leads.
In brief
- CoPilot is an AI assistant in CRM. It helps teams handle calls faster and reduces manual work.
- Available in leads and deals.
- Start CoPilot from the call in the timeline using the Rate call button.
- Fills in empty fields with data from the call.
- Suggests updates if a field already has a value.
- Transcribes calls in the same language used during the conversation.
- Lets you choose a different language for summaries and field values.

titre: CoPilot in CRM: Chat summary and automatic field updates

If a field already has a value, CoPilot suggests a change instead of replacing it.

Example: A customer contacts you to update the delivery address. CoPilot reviews the chat and suggests saving the new address to the field. In the timeline, you'll see the Action required status. Click Confirm fields to review the change and confirm the replacement.
If you’re not sure which value to keep, open the chat summary. It can help you remember the details of the conversation and update the fields correctly.
Chat processing modes

titre: Manage Bitrix24 using external AI systems
sections: Manage Bitrix24 using external AI systems
Bitrix24 lets you connect to external AI systems like ChatGPT or Manus AI using the MCP server. This setup allows you to manage CRM, tasks, and other tools directly from a chat with an AI assistant.

For example, you can create a work plan in ChatGPT and immediately ask the assistant to create tasks in Bitrix24 with names, deadlines, and assignees. You don’t need to switch between apps: the tasks are created in Bitrix24 automatically.
This integration helps you move faster and work in the tool that’s most convenient for you.
In this article:
- Enable or disable integration with external AI systems
- Connect Bitrix24 to an external AI system
- Use the integration
- Disconnect your Bitrix24 from an external AI system
Enable or disable integration with external AI systems
By default, Bitrix24 does not allow access from external AI tools. An administrator can turn this option on.
To enable integration:
1. Open the menu next to your account name.
2. Go to Settings (⚙️) > MCP servers .
3. Turn on Allow connection of external AIs to Bitrix24 .
4. Click Save .
After you enable the option, employees can connect their AI assistants and manage Bitrix24 tools directly from an AI assistant chat.
Keep in mind that MCP servers allow data exchange between Bitrix24 and third-party systems. These connections may introduce security and data processing risks outside of Bitrix24’s control.

To disable integration, turn off the same option. Existing connections will stay in place, but employees will not be able to use them until you enable access again. Items that were already created will remain in Bitrix24.
Connect Bitrix24 to an external AI system

You can manage CRM, tasks, company structure, invitations, and emails in Bitrix24 directly from a chat with tools like ChatGPT or Manus AI. More integrations, features, and supported actions will become available over time.
The setup depends on the AI tool. Some assistants use OAuth, while others require a connection token.
Connect using OAuth
This example shows how to connect Bitrix24 to ChatGPT. This option is available for ChatGPT Plus and Pro plans.
Step 1. Enable developer mode
1. Open ChatGPT and go to your profile.
2. Click Settings (⚙️) > Apps and connectors > Advanced settings .
3. Turn on Developer mode .
4. Click Back to return to the connector list.
Step 2. Create a connector
1. Click Create app .
2. Enter the connection details:
1. Name — include your Bitrix24 account if you use more than one.
2. MCP server URL — https://mcp.bitrix24.com/mcp/ .
3. Authorization type — OAuth .
3. Accept the security terms.
4. Click Create .
A Bitrix24 authorization window will open.
Step 3. Authorize in Bitrix24
Log in to your Bitrix24 account. After you log in, ChatGPT will connect to Bitrix24, and you can manage Bitrix24 tools from the chat.
Connect using a token
This example shows how to connect Bitrix24 to Manus AI.
Step 1. Get a connection token
1. Go to Applications > MCP connections .
2. Click Get connection token .
3. If the button is inactive, the administrator has disabled integration.
4. Click Copy token and save it.
You will need this token in the next step.
Step 2. Add the connection in the AI tool
1. Open the external AI system and go to Settings > Connectors .
2. Click Add connectors .
3. Select Custom MCP > Add custom MCP .
4. Choose Direct configuration .
5. Enter the following:
1. Transport type — HTTP .
2. URL — https://mcp.bitrix24.com/mcp/ .
3. Authorization type — access token .
4. Header value — paste the copied token.
6. Save the changes.
After setup, you can manage Bitrix24 directly from the AI assistant chat.
How the integration works
The Bitrix24 MCP server connects your AI assistant to Bitrix24. This lets you manage CRM, tasks, company structure, invitations, and emails directly from chat.
The assistant performs actions only when you request them. It also follows your access permissions, so you stay in control.
Here’s how it works in ChatGPT:
1. In the message field, click ➕ > More (...) .
2. Select the Bitrix24 integration.
3. Enter your request.
ChatGPT will process your request, ask for confirmation, and then complete the action. It will also show the result in the chat.
For example, you can ask the AI assistant to:
- Find, create, or edit a task
- Move a deal to another stage
- Create a sales pipeline
- Add a stage or edit an existing one
- View or update a subdepartment or cross-functional team
- Invite an employee or change their invitation status
- Find, read, or send an email
- Create an event, chat, or post in Feed from an email
Disconnect Bitrix24 from an external AI system
You can remove the connection at any time. Items created through the integration will remain in Bitrix24.
To disconnect:
1. Go to Applications > MCP connections > Get connection token > My tokens .
2. Open your Bitrix24 Network profile .
3. In the MCP connections section, find the integration.
4. Click Close access .
In brief

- You can connect Bitrix24 to external AI tools like ChatGPT or Manus AI using the MCP server. This lets you manage CRM, tasks, company structure, invitations, and email right from an AI assistant chat. Available actions depend on the Bitrix24 tool, and more actions will become available over time.
- By default, this feature is turned off. An administrator must enable it in Settings (⚙️) > MCP servers by turning on Allow connection of external AIs to Bitrix24 .
- The setup depends on the AI tool:
- Use OAuth by creating a connector and entering the MCP server URL: https://mcp.bitrix24.com/mcp/ .
- Or use a token from Applications > MCP connections > Get connection token .
- After setup, select the Bitrix24 integration in your AI assistant and enter a request. The assistant will ask for confirmation, complete the action, and show the result in chat.
- To disconnect an AI system, go to Applications > MCP connections > Get connection token > My tokens , find the connection, and click Close access .

titre: MCP in Bitrix24
sections: MCP in Bitrix24

titre: CoPilot in CRM: Set up call, chat, and email processing
sections: CoPilot in CRM: Set up call, chat, and email processing
CoPilot in CRM analyzes calls, chats, and emails. It helps sales teams spend less time on routine work.
CoPilot can help you:
- Recall conversation details. It transcribes call recordings and creates summaries for calls, chats, and emails. You do not need to replay recordings or scroll through message history.
- Fill in CRM item forms. After analysis, CoPilot adds details from the conversation to lead or deal fields.
- Catch important inquiries. It creates an activity based on the conversation or marks an inquiry as irrelevant.
In this article:
- How CoPilot processes CRM data
- Enable CoPilot in CRM
- Configure CoPilot in CRM
How CoPilot processes data in CRM

CoPilot analyzes client communication across calls, chats, and email. Depending on the channel, it can complete three or four steps. CoPilot in CRM: Call transcription and automatic field updates CoPilot in CRM: Chat summary and automatic field updates CoPilot in CRM: How to process an email
- Call transcription. CoPilot converts the conversation into text. Managers can open the transcript and search for specific details without listening to the full recording.
- Call, chat, or email summary. CoPilot highlights the key points and creates a short summary of the conversation. Managers can open the summary to quickly see what was discussed.
- CRM field fill. CoPilot adds data from the call, chat, or email to empty fields. If a field already has a value, CoPilot lets you keep it or replace it.

- Activity creation. CoPilot analyzes the call, chat, or email and creates an activity with a short summary and rating. For relevant inquiries, it suggests the next step. For irrelevant inquiries, such as spam, it offers to add the contact to exceptions.
Enable CoPilot in CRM
Enable CoPilot in CRM in Bitrix24 settings so employees can process client inquiries with AI.
1. Click the settings icon next to your Bitrix24 logo or name and select Settings (⚙️). 2. Open CoPilot preferences > CoPilot in CRM and enable the scenarios you want to use. 3. Save your changes.
Configure CoPilot in CRM
You can set the CoPilot response language in a separate settings panel.
Open CoPilot in CRM settings.

1. In the left menu, go to CRM. 2. Open the Leads or Deals tab. 3. For deals, select a pipeline at the top of the page. 4. In the upper-right corner, click Settings (⚙️) and select CoPilot in CRM. 5. The settings panel opens for the current section: leads or the selected deal pipeline.
Leads and each deal pipeline have separate settings. Changes to one pipeline don't affect the others.

Select the response language. Choose the language CoPilot uses for call, chat, or email summaries and for CRM fields. This setting does not affect call transcripts. Transcripts always use the language spoken during the call.
This is useful when your clients and employees speak different languages. For example, a sales rep can speak with a client in English while CoPilot fills in CRM fields in another language.
1. In the upper-right corner of the panel, click the current language setting, for example, Summary language: English . 2. Search for a language or select one from the list.
Each user who has access to CoPilot in CRM settings selects their own response language.
In brief
- CoPilot in CRM analyzes calls, chats, and emails. It transcribes calls, creates summaries, fills in CRM fields, and creates activities.
- To let employees process client inquiries with CoPilot, the administrator must enable this in Bitrix24 settings.
- To configure CoPilot in CRM, go to CRM > Leads or Deals > Settings (⚙️) > CoPilot in CRM .
- Each user with access to CoPilot settings chooses their own language for summaries and CRM fields. Call transcripts stay in the language spoken during the call.

titre: CoPilot Follow-Up: AI-powered speech analytics for video calls

titre: FAQ: CoPilot
sections: FAQ: CoPilot

CoPilot is a Bitrix24 assistant powered by AI and built into everyday work scenarios. It can write texts, evaluate ideas, help formulate thoughts, and highlight the key points from long messages. This article answers frequently asked questions about CoPilot.
Does CoPilot store data for model training?

titre: AI Speech analytics and Sales scripts in CRM
sections: AI Speech analytics and Sales scripts in CRM
Bitrix24 now offers new CoPilot features in CRM: AI Speech analytics and Sales scripts. With CoPilot, you can analyze your agents' customer calls, compare them to scripts, and get improvement tips.

CRM has ready-made sales scripts for various situations, such as talking to new customers, handling complaints, presenting new products, and more. You can use these scripts or create your own to quickly train your agents and improve service quality.
CoPilot helps supervisors by:
- Creating sales scripts
- Analyzing agent calls to find areas for improving customer communication
- Tracking each employee's performance without listening to calls or asking for reports
CoPilot supports agents by:
- Improving customer communication quality through feedback on each call
- Providing specific recommendations to improve customer communication skills
In this article:
- Create a sales script
- Select a script during a call
- Run call analysis using CoPilot
- View call analysis
- Check agent rating
- Adjust a call assessment
- Configure access permissions for AI Speech analytics and Sales scripts
Create a sales script
Bitrix24 has ready-made sales scripts. You can use them, edit them, or create your own.
To create a script :
1. Go to CRM .
2. Expand the Sales tab.
3. Select AI Speech analytics and Sales scripts .
4. Click Create .
Name your script . Click the pencil icon and enter the desired name.

Enter the script text . Describe in detail how agents should communicate with customers. CoPilot will use these guidelines to assess calls based on your criteria. For example, the Initial contact script implies introducing yourself, stating your position, asking clarifying questions, and explaining your products or services.
You can also use CoPilot to create a script text. Just click the CoPilot icon and enter your query.
Select customer categories . Choose customer categories for which the script applies:
- New: Customers not registered in CRM yet or added less than an hour ago.
- In progress: Customers in CRM who haven't purchased anything yet but have active leads or deals.
- Repeat contact: Customers who have contacted you before but haven't purchased anything, with lost deals.
- Returning customer: Customers who have already made a purchase, with won deals.
Select call categories . On the Settings tab, choose which calls CoPilot will check using the script:
- All calls
- Outbound only
- Inbound only
Once you set up the sales script, click Done .
To edit a script :
- Click Edit in the Script column.
- Or, open the Menu (≡) and select Edit .
Select a script during a call

In the call window, the system automatically selects a script that matches the customer's category. If a customer is contacting you for the first time, the agent will see a script for new customers. You can choose a different script if an existing customer calls from a new number.
To change the script, click on its name and select another one.

If there are multiple scripts for a specific customer category, the system will automatically choose the one that was last modified or created. The script's activity status is shown in the Status column, and the date of the last change is displayed under Modified on .
Run call analysis using CoPilot
Open the CRM item form and find the call in the timeline. In the Call section, you can start analysis in three ways:
- Complete fields — CoPilot fills the form fields with data from the call.
- Rate call — CoPilot checks the conversation against the script.
- Icon — starts transcription of the call recording
After CoPilot analyzes a call, an activity labeled Processed by CoPilot appears in the timeline. You can use it to view the score, see the selected script, and open the detailed call analysis.
View call analysis
In the call activity, click Details .
Call recording . You can listen to the call recording to understand CoPilot recommendations better.
Script match score . CoPilot checks how well the call follows the script.

CoPilot recommendations . CoPilot highlights parts of the call that match the script and points out any mistakes. For example, the agent might use the client's name but forget to introduce themselves. CoPilot gives tips on how to avoid these mistakes in future calls.

Sales script . CoPilot reviews the call using the chosen script. You can assess the same call with different scripts. To do this, select another script in the call analysis window and restart the assessment.
Agent rating . This is the average score of an agent's calls for all scripts. An arrow shows how the rating is changing. If CoPilot checks a call with different scripts, only the latest score counts.
Recent calls affect the agent rating more than older ones. If an agent follows CoPilot recommendations and avoids mistakes, their rating improves.
Adjust a call assessment

An agent may receive a low score even if the call was handled correctly. This usually happens when the conversation goes beyond the standard script. For example, a customer may interrupt, raise objections, or ask about topics not covered in the script. In these cases, the manager may need to go off script, and CoPilot may lower the score.
You can’t delete a call assessment, but you can run it again.
Update the script and reassess the call
Use this option if the script needs changes. For example, you may want to add a missing step or remove something unnecessary.
1. In the call activity, click Details .
2. Click Edit script .
3. Make your changes.
4. Click Save .
5. Open Call analysis .
6. Click Show new text .
7. Click Start .
CoPilot will analyze the call again and recalculate the score.
Use a different script for the call assessment
If the default script doesn’t match the situation, choose a different one.

For example, if the customer is upset and the conversation shifts away from a sales script, use the Communication style script. This script evaluates general communication skills, such as tone, clarity, and professionalism.
1. In the call activity, click Details .
2. Click the current script name.
3. Select a different script.
4. Click Assess phone call .
After the new analysis is complete, only the latest result counts toward the agent's overall score.
Configure access permissions for AI Speech analytics and Sales scripts

Access permissions for sales scripts and AI-powered speech analytics can be configured by a Bitrix24 administrator or an employee with the editing permission in CRM. Role-based access permissions in CRM
1. Go to CRM > More > Settings (⚙️) > CRM access permissions . 2. In the list of items, find AI Speech analytics and Sales scripts . 3. Configure permissions for the required roles:
- Allow viewing settings — employees can view the list of scripts and their settings but cannot edit them.
- Allow editing settings — employees can create, edit, and delete sales scripts.
4. To assign permissions to specific employees, click Plus (+) under the role name and add employees, groups, or departments. 5. Save the changes.
In brief
- Bitrix24 now offers new CoPilot features in CRM: AI Speech analytics and Sales scripts. With CoPilot, you can analyze your agents' customer calls, compare them to scripts, and get improvement tips.
- CRM has ready-made sales scripts for various situations. You can use these scripts or create your own to quickly train your agents and improve service quality.
- You can start the call analysis using CoPilot manually in the CRM item form.
- Once CoPilot analyzes the call, a new activity will appear in the timeline. It shows the call score, selected script, responsible person, and a detailed call analysis.
- For each agent, you can see the rating based on call scores for all scripts.
- Access permissions for AI Speech analytics and Sales scripts can be configured by a Bitrix24 administrator or an employee with the Allow editing settings permission in CRM.

titre: Prompt library: Create prompt templates for CoPilot
sections: Prompt library: Create prompt templates for CoPilot

The prompt library is a central place to store CoPilot prompts A prompt is a query you give to the AI to get a specific response. The more detailed the prompt, the better the results. and share them with your team.
Create templates for common tasks such as job descriptions, event plans, or marketing ideas. Select a prompt from the library to save time and avoid rewriting queries.
You can use the prompt library in all tools where CoPilot is available, except chat:
- Feed

- Sites
- Webmail
- Calendar

Each employee can view their own prompts and any prompts shared with them.
Add a prompt to the library
1. Open the prompt library. Go to any section where CoPilot is available and click CoPilot > Prompt library > Add .
2. Select the prompt type.
- Simple: A fixed prompt that CoPilot runs as is. Example: Create a text for a flower shop landing page. The text length is 4,000 characters. Keywords: flowers, flower delivery, bouquets to order.

- Extended: A template with placeholders. Fill in the fields before running the prompt. Example: Create a text for a [insert your text] landing page. The text length is [specify the number] characters. Keywords: [insert your text].
3. Enter the prompt text (up to 2,500 characters).
For a simple prompt, enter the full text. More detail usually improves results.
For an extended prompt, add placeholders:
1. Place the cursor where needed or highlight text.
2. Click Make placeholder .
3. Edit the default text in brackets, for example, change [insert your text] to [specify the number] .
Click Next when done.
4. Configure the prompt.
- Name and icon – how the prompt appears in the list.
- Make available to – choose employees or departments who can use the prompt. By default, only you can access it.
- Make available in – select the Bitrix24 tools where the prompt will appear.
Click Save .
Use a prompt from the library
Open any Bitrix24 tool with CoPilot and click the CoPilot button. In the User prompts section, select a prompt from the list.
If you select an extended prompt, fill in the placeholders. CoPilot will then generate the content.
Manage the prompt library
By default, employees see all active prompts, including shared ones. You can adjust the list to fit your needs.
Add to Favorites . Mark frequently used prompts to keep them at the top of the list.
Don't show in CoPilot menu . Turn off Show in CoPilot menu to remove a prompt from your list. Others can still use it.
Deactivate . Turn off the Active option to hide a prompt for all users. You can reactivate it anytime. Use filters to find inactive prompts.
Edit a prompt
Go to any section with CoPilot and open CoPilot > Prompt library . Select a prompt, click Menu (≡), and choose Edit .
In brief
The prompt library stores and organizes CoPilot prompts. It helps you reuse queries and share them with your team.
- Open CoPilot > Prompt library > Add to create a prompt.
- Choose a simple or extended prompt type.
- Enter the text, set access permissions, and select where the prompt will be available.
- Users with access can edit prompts, and changes are visible to everyone.
- You can manage visibility with favorites, menu settings, and activation status.

titre: CoPilot: AI assistant to create websites
sections: CoPilot: AI assistant to create websites

In this article:

Create a site with CoPilot

To create or edit an image, open the block with the picture, click on it, and select CoPilot. CoPilot in Bitrix24 Sites CoPilot in sites: how to create an image
Edit blocks with CoPilot

You can edit blocks in both your sites and ready-made templates from the Bitrix24 Market. For example, select a landing page template for bouquet orders and update its text and images with AI. This helps you adapt a template or update your site without a designer.
1. Open the site and click the icon in the lower-right corner.
2. Open the CoPilot chat.
3. Select a block, describe the changes, and send your request.
CoPilot updates text and images in the selected block. It adapts the content to match the site’s theme. For example, on a flower shop site, it uses relevant wording and visuals.

- CoPilot creates websites from a description. You define the theme, colors, and style.

- Use CoPilot to edit blocks. You can update text, replace images, and adjust styles.
- CoPilot works with both your sites and templates from the Bitrix24 Market.

titre: How to write effective prompts for CoPilot
sections: How to write effective prompts for CoPilot
CoPilot generates text based on your prompt and the available context. If your prompt is too vague, the results may be inaccurate or incomplete.
CoPilot does not search the internet in real time. Its responses rely on training data, which may not reflect the latest information.
Write effective prompts
Clear and detailed prompts produce better results. Use the structure below as a guide.
1. Define a role . Tell CoPilot what perspective to use. This helps it focus on the right area. Imagine that you are a marketing director at an Italian restaurant.

2. Describe the task . Explain what CoPilot should do. Use simple and direct language. Include all important details. Write a creative script for a restaurant commercial. The theme is pizza cooking workshops for children.
3. Provide context . Add background information. Include the target audience, product details, and how you will use the text. The target audience of the video – couples with children.
4. Set the response format . Specify how the output should look. Write a detailed step-by-step script for a video commercial.
5. Set limits . Define length, tone, style, and any constraints. There should be at least four scenes in the video, you can add a little humor.
6. Add examples . Provide a reference if you want a specific style or approach. In the video, focus on the superhero universe.
7. Refine your prompt . If the result is not what you need, update your prompt and try again. Adjust details until you get the desired output. Chat with CoPilot
You do not need to use every step each time. For simple tasks, a short prompt is enough. For complex tasks, include more details and context.
In brief
- CoPilot generates text based on your prompt and the available context. If your prompt is too vague, the results may be inaccurate or incomplete.
- Always review the output before using it.
- To get an accurate response, provide a clear prompt for CoPilot. Define a role, describe the task, provide context, set the response format, add limits, and give examples.

titre: Role library: Create new roles for CoPilot
sections: Role library: Create new roles for CoPilot

CoPilot can serve as an expert in various areas. Bitrix24 offers over 30 roles, including sales manager, lawyer, marketing specialist, and poet. For example, as a lawyer, CoPilot can help with legal risks or regulations.

Bitrix24 now has the role library, allowing you to create custom roles for CoPilot and share them with colleagues. Add roles for different areas like architect, designer, career coach, editor, and more.
You can use the role library in all tools where CoPilot is available. Each employee can view their own roles and those shared by colleagues.
Add a role to the library
1. Open the role library . Go to any section where CoPilot is available, click CoPilot > Change role > Role library > Add .
2. Add a prompt for the role . Specify which role CoPilot should perform. Describe the goals and objectives, conditions and limitations, and set the response format.

You're a career coach. Your role is to help users looking for jobs or career growth. Career Assessment: Offer advice for career growth based on user's experience and goals. CV Preparation: Suggest ways to improve CV to fit job needs. Interview Preparation: Create possible interview questions for specific jobs and guide on how to answer them. Your response should include practical tips and recommendations.
3. Set up the role .
- Name and icon: Specify the role name and upload an image as its icon. They'll be displayed in the list of roles.
- Make available to: Select employees or departments who can access and use the role. By default, it's only available to the creator.
- Description: Specify who and how can use this role. For example, I can help with job searches, career growth, CV tips, and interview prep .
After entering all the information, click Save . A new role will appear in the library, ready to be used by employees.
Select a role from the library
1. Go to any section where CoPilot is available and click CoPilot .
2. Select Change role and go to My roles .
3. Pick the desired role from the list.
4. Enter your query for this role.
Set up the role library
By default, employees can see all active roles in the library, including shared ones. However, they can customize the list to keep only the roles they need.
Add to Favorites . Open the role library and click the bookmark icon next to the desired role. It will appear in the Favorites section in the list of roles.
Don't show in My roles . If you are no longer using a role, you can disable the Show in My roles option. It will disappear from your list, but others can still access it.

Deactivate . If you and your colleagues no longer need a role, turn off the Active option. This hides the role for everyone, but you can reactivate it anytime. Deactivated roles can be found using a filter.
Edit a role in the library
Go to any section where there is a CoPilot, click CoPilot > Change role > Role library . Select the desired role and click Menu (≡) > Edit .
Any employee with access to the role can edit it, and all changes will be visible to everyone with access to this role.
In brief
- Bitrix24 now has the role library, allowing you to create custom roles for CoPilot and share them with colleagues.
- Add roles for different areas like architect, designer, career coach, editor, and more.
- You can use the role library in all tools where CoPilot is available.
- To create a new role, go to any section where CoPilot is available, click CoPilot > Change role > Role library > Add .
- Specify which role CoPilot should perform. Describe the goals and objectives, conditions and limitations, and set the response format.
- Decide who and how can use your custom role.
- Any employee with access to the role can edit it, and all changes will be visible to everyone with access to this role.
- By default, employees can see all active roles in the library, including shared ones. However, they can customize the list to keep only the roles they need.

titre: What is vibe coding
sections: What is vibe coding

Vibe coding is a way to build programs and apps by describing a task to AI in plain language instead of writing code by hand. An AI agent creates the program. The person sets the goal, reviews the result, and adjusts it if needed.
This approach appeared with large language models. Before that, people had to build software manually. Now you can describe the result you want, and AI can generate the application.

The term vibe coding became common in the global AI community in 2025. The word vibe refers to the overall sense of the task. Instead of giving exact commands, the developer gives AI a general vision of the result. The AI breaks the task into steps, writes the code, and runs it.
In this article:
- How vibe coding works in Bitrix24
- How vibe coding differs from traditional development
- What you need to know to vibe code
How vibe coding works in Bitrix24

Alaio Vibecode is a platform for building apps in Bitrix24 with AI. If there is no ready-made app for your task, you do not need to hire a developer. An AI agent can build and launch the app on its own.
You do not need programming skills to use Vibecode. You just need to explain the task clearly, the same way you would explain it to a person doing the work.

How vibe coding differs from traditional development
The main difference is who writes the code and what the person is responsible for.
Traditional development. Programmers write the code themselves. They know the language syntax, libraries, and protocols. Even simple tasks take time because they must handle technical details.

Vibe coding. An AI agent writes the code. The person defines the task, reviews the result, and fixes issues if needed. The AI handles the technical side. The person spends time on setting the task and checking the output, not on manual coding.
What you need to know to vibe code
You do not need programming skills to use vibe coding. It lets you build apps and integrations on your own without a developer.
To work effectively with vibe coding, it helps to:
- Know exactly what you need, including the result and interface you expect
- Explain the task clearly, as if you were briefing a coworker

In brief
- Vibe coding means building programs by describing a task to AI instead of writing code by hand.
- Alaio Vibecode is a platform for building apps in Bitrix24 with AI.
- An AI agent writes the program. The person sets the task and reviews the result.
- You do not need programming skills. You need to understand the result you want and explain it clearly to AI.

titre: What tasks can be solved with Alaio Vibecode
sections: What tasks can be solved with Alaio Vibecode

Bitrix24 comes with built-in tools for CRM, tasks, marketing, analytics, and automation. You can use them to manage customers, assign tasks, run automation rules, approve documents, and track company performance.

If you need a tool for a specific use case, such as a custom report, an integration with an industry-specific system, a calculator with complex logic, or an AI assistant for a team, use Alaio Vibecode. Describe what you need in plain language, and the AI model will help you create an app or chatbot.
In this article:
- Use cases for Alaio Vibecode
- When to use built-in Bitrix24 tools
- Compare Vibecode, automation rules, workflows, and Market apps
When to use Vibecode
Alaio Vibecode works best for tasks that standard Bitrix24 tools or existing Market apps cannot handle.

Integration with an industry-specific system. Your company may use a medical records system, a service request tracker, an internal customer database, or another specialized platform. If Bitrix24 Market does not have a ready-made app for it, you can use Vibecode to build a custom integration, as long as the external service supports data exchange.

Example: A clinic stores patient data in a medical records system, while managers work with inquiries in CRM. With Vibecode, you can build a solution that transfers relevant patient data to CRM if the medical records system supports data exchange.
A form or calculator with custom logic. Standard forms are a good fit for simple lead capture. If your form needs many conditions, calculations, or validation rules, you may need a separate solution.

Example: A construction company calculates project costs based on square footage, materials, timelines, delivery, and extra work. The customer fills out a form, and the calculator shows an estimated price.
An AI assistant for a specific task. You can use Vibecode to create an assistant that works with Bitrix24 data and helps employees complete repetitive tasks faster.
Example: A bot sends a supervisor a daily summary of team activity, including how many deals are in progress, which tasks are overdue, and which customers have not been contacted recently.
Another example: An assistant finds duplicate customer records and suggests merging them. The employee reviews the matches and decides whether to merge the records or keep them separate.
Test an idea before full development. Before you commit to a project, you can build a simple working version to see if it is useful.

Example: The sales team needs a separate screen with deal prompts. You can create a prototype in Vibecode, show it to the team, and see if it helps managers. If it does, you can improve the solution and share it.
When to use built-in Bitrix24 tools
Not every task needs Vibecode. If you can solve it with standard Bitrix24 tools, use those first. It is faster and does not require custom development.
Routine actions in CRM. To automatically create an activity, send an email, move a deal to another stage, or assign a task to the responsible person, use CRM automation rules and triggers.

Example: When a deal moves to the "Invoice sent" stage, an automation rule can create a "Call the customer in two days" activity. The manager sees the reminder in the deal form and does not miss the follow-up. Automation rules and triggers in Bitrix24

Internal approvals. For document approvals, requests, and internal processes, use workflow automation in CRM. It lets you define each step, including who creates the request, who approves it, and who gets notified.
Example: An employee submits a vacation request, the supervisor approves it, and the HR team gets a notification and prepares the documents.
A ready-made app in the Market. Before you build a custom solution, check Bitrix24 Market. A ready-made app may already solve your task without any development.

Example: If your company needs an integration with a popular delivery service or telephony provider, a ready-made app may be faster and more cost-effective than custom development. Find and install Bitrix24 Market applications
The task can be solved with a simple setting. If one standard setting solves the task, you do not need a separate app.
Example: To add a field to a deal form, use the CRM settings. Vibecode will not make this easier. It will only add unnecessary setup. CRM overview
How to choose the tool
The choice depends on the task: what you need to do, whether a ready-made solution exists, and how much your scenario differs from standard Bitrix24 capabilities.
Tool | Use case | Best when

CRM automation rules and triggers | Routine automated actions in CRM | You have a condition and an action: create an activity or send an email. For example, when a deal moves to the "Invoice sent" stage, an automation rule creates a "Call the customer in two days" activity
Workflow automation | Approvals and multi-step processes | You have stages, participants, and transition rules. For example, an employee submits a vacation request and the supervisor approves it

Market | Ready-made solutions for common tasks | The task is common and an app may already be available in the Market. For example, an integration with a popular delivery service or telephony provider
Vibecode | A custom solution for a specific scenario | Standard settings are not enough and there is no ready-made app. For example, a clinic transferring data from a medical records system to CRM

The logic is: first check standard settings, automation rules, triggers, workflow automation, and ready-made apps. If they cover your task, you do not need a custom solution. If nothing fits, you can build your own solution with Vibecode.
In brief
- Alaio Vibecode helps you build solutions for tasks that cannot be handled with standard tools or ready-made Market apps.
- Vibecode is useful for custom reports, integrations with industry-specific systems, complex forms, calculators, and AI assistants.
- For routine automation, use CRM automation rules and triggers. For approvals, use workflow automation. For common integrations, check ready-made Market apps first.
- If no ready-made tool exists, describe your task in plain language and build a solution with Vibecode.

Vibecode lets you use AI tools entirely inside Bitrix24. You can use built-in models in your apps without setting up an external provider.
When to involve developers

You may still need developers for projects with complex architecture, heavy workloads, multiple external integrations, strict security requirements, or deeply customized business logic. For example, a department can first build a prototype in Alaio Vibeсode and test it in a real process. If the tool becomes part of everyday work, developers can take over full integration and long-term support.

titre: Alaio Vibecode: How to get a custom solution from a partner
sections: Alaio Vibecode: How to get a custom solution from a partner

Alaio Vibecode lets you build apps and AI tools without traditional development. If your team does not have the time to learn the platform and build a working solution, you can work with a Bitrix24 partner.
A partner can help you define the task, build the app in Alaio Vibecode, test the scenario, and deliver a ready-to-use tool for your team.
In this article:
- When to work with a partner
- How to prepare a task description for a partner
When to work with a partner
Consider working with a partner when you know what you need, but your team does not have enough time or experience to build the solution on its own.

For example, a manager may need a daily report, sales reps may need a price calculator, and a support team may need an AI assistant to handle requests. You can build these tools in Vibecode, but you first need to define the logic, test the result, and fine-tune the details.
A partner helps you move faster. They can clarify the task, suggest the scenario, build the app, and confirm that it solves the team's problem.
Working with a partner makes sense when:
- You need to connect Bitrix24 to an industry-specific app
- The solution needs ongoing support after launch
- You need a working result without a long trial-and-error process

If the task is simple and someone on your team can describe it clearly and review the result, you can start on your own. If time is limited, a partner can help you turn your idea into a working tool faster.
Here are some common scenarios where a partner can help. These examples show what you can delegate and what results you can expect in Bitrix24.

Build a custom report for a manager. Bitrix24 includes standard analytics, but managers sometimes need a report that matches their process. This can include specific fields, filters, conditions, and formats. A partner can build an app in Vibecode that generates the report based on set conditions and sends it to the manager in Bitrix24 Chat. The scenario can include deal amount, stage, date of last contact, responsible person, and other parameters.

Connect an industry-specific app. A company may use Bitrix24 along with another app, such as a warehouse management system, a booking tool, or an internal database. A ready-made integration may not be available in Bitrix24 Market, and building one through REST API can take a lot of time. A partner can build an app in Vibecode to show vehicle status, route, or other operational data directly in the deal card.

Build a price calculator. When managers calculate prices manually in spreadsheets, errors and version issues can appear. A partner can build a calculator in Vibecode. A manager opens it from the deal form, enters the data, gets the result, and saves it in Bitrix24. This helps your team use the same calculation rules and reduces the risk of errors in quotes.

Build an AI assistant for a specific task. If your company needs an assistant for a specific scenario, such as handling requests, routing cases, or classifying messages, a partner can build an AI assistant in Vibecode. It can identify the topic and urgency of a request, assign a task to the right employee, and send the client a confirmation. This helps process requests faster and reduces manual work.

Set up approvals with external participants. You can set up internal approvals with standard Bitrix24 tools. When external participants are involved, such as clients, vendors, or lawyers, the scenario can become more complex. A partner can build an app in Vibecode that sends notifications to participants, records decisions, shows approval status, and sends reminders for overdue items. This helps employees see the document status in Bitrix24 and understand who needs to take the next step.
Prepare a task description for a partner
Before you contact a partner, write a short description of your task. This helps the partner understand the scenario, estimate the scope of work, and decide whether Alaio Vibecode is the right fit.
Prepare answers to these questions:
- What problem needs to be solved
- Who will use the app
- Where manual work happens now
- What data the scenario needs
- What result the user should get
- How you will check that the app works correctly

For example, if you need a report for a manager, list the fields, filter conditions, and output format. If you need a calculator, prepare the calculation rules and an example of the expected result. When you are ready, find a partner on the official partner page.
Bitrix24 partners
In brief
- Consider working with a partner when you need a solution in Alaio Vibecode, but your team does not have the time or experience to build it on their own.
- A partner can help with custom reports, integrations with industry-specific apps, calculators, AI assistants, and approval flows with external participants.

titre: Alaio Vibecode: Create and set up an app
sections: Alaio Vibecode: Create and set up an app

Alaio Vibecode is a platform for building apps and chatbots that work with your Bitrix24 data. Any employee, such as a manager, marketer, or HR specialist, can describe a task in plain language. An AI model then writes the code and deploys the solution on a secure server. This helps you get a working business tool without coding skills or long development cycles.

Solutions built in Vibecode connect to Bitrix24 automatically. The app can access CRM, Tasks, Chat, Drive, and other tools. You do not need to set up syncing or transfer data manually. Everything works through a single API key.
In this article:
- Sign in to Alaio Vibecode
- Create an AI solution for Bitrix24
- Restrict AI solution creation
Sign in to Alaio Vibecode
Use your Bitrix24 account credentials to sign in to Alaio Vibecode.
1. Open the Alaio Vibecode website and click Sign in . 2. Sign in with any available method. Log in to your Bitrix24 account 3. Select the Bitrix24 account where you want to build the app.
Create an AI solution for Bitrix24
Alaio Vibecode lets you build and connect an app or bot to your Bitrix24 in three steps.
Create a key . It connects the app or bot to your Bitrix24. There are two key types:

- API key. This key acts on behalf of the person who created it, so all app users see the same data. Use it when you do not need personal user data. For example, an app that shows monthly deal statistics for the whole team.

- Authorization key. This key acts on behalf of the current user, so each person sees only the data they are allowed to access. Use it when access permissions matter. For example, a manager sees only their own deals, while a supervisor sees deals for the entire subdepartment.
1. Open the Platform section or the API Keys section, depending on the key type, and click + Create API key or + Create key at the top of the page. 2. Fill in the key details:
- Key name — this name appears in the key list on the Alaio Vibecode website.
- Access mode and Access scopes — select which Bitrix24 tools the app can use and what permissions it gets. All permissions are selected by default.
- Key expiration: no limit, 30 days, 90 days, 180 days, or 1 year. If the key expires, the app stops working. You can renew the key in advance from your account.

- Request limit per minute sets the maximum number of requests the app can send with this key each minute. It helps prevent excessive API load. For example, it protects against repeated requests caused by an integration error. This field is optional. The default limit is 300 requests per minute. For your first app, you can leave it empty.

- Advanced settings — enter comma-separated IP addresses that are allowed to send requests to the app. This adds protection. Even if someone gets the link or key, they will not be able to call the app from unauthorized addresses.

3. Click Create . A window opens with the key and a ready-to-use prompt for the AI model. 4. Copy the API key and store it in a safe place. You will need it to build, update, and connect the AI solution.
The full API key appears only once. If you close the window without saving it, you cannot restore the key.

We recommend creating a separate key for each app and granting only the permissions it needs. For example, give CRM access for deal-related work and Tasks access for task-related work. If needed, one key can be used for multiple bots and apps.
Pass the prompt to the AI model . It contains everything needed: your API key, a link to the Alaio Vibecode documentation, and instructions for the AI model.
For each solution, the AI model will create a separate server and deploy the app or bot on it.

1. Click Copy prompt in the key window. 2. Paste the prompt into Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, or another AI model and add a description of your task — what exactly needs to be built. For example: "Create a bot that sends a summary of open tasks to a chat every morning."
Ready-made prompts for AI solutions
The Ready-made solutions section on the Alaio Vibecode website contains prompt templates for various tasks. You can use them as-is or adapt them for your business.
1. On the Alaio Vibecode website, go to the Ready-made solutions section. 2. Select a suitable solution and click on it. 3. Review the description and click Copy in the prompt window.
Run the app or bot . The method depends on the type of solution.
- App. Go back to the Alaio Vibecode website and open the Black Hole Servers section. Find the server hosting the app and click Open . The solution opens in a new browser tab.
- Bot. Open your Bitrix24 and go to the Messenger . Find the bot's chat in the chat list.
Using the app or bot consumes Vibe credits, which are the internal currency of Alaio Vibecode.
To update an AI solution, go back to the conversation with the AI model where you created the app and make your changes.
Restrict AI solution creation in Bitrix24
By default, all employees can create apps, bots, and set up integrations with agents on the Alaio Vibecode site. Administrators can limit access and set rules for creating solutions.
Open the Alaio Vibecode site, go to the Settings , and configure these options:
Platform access control. Three modes are available:
- Open: all authenticated users can create solutions.
- Whitelist: only selected users can create solutions.
- Blacklist: all users except blocked users can create solutions.
User limits. You can set limits of up to 100 API keys, 50 servers, and 50 bots.
Creation rules for apps, servers, and bots. Set who can create each type of object: all users, administrators only, or no one.
Server settings:
- Server infrastructure. Turn on this option to let users create and manage cloud servers.

- Enable Open mode. This option is still in development. When it becomes available, users will be able to switch servers to Open mode with a public IP address and direct SSH access. By default, all servers are created in Black Hole mode.
Save your changes.
In brief
- Alaio Vibecode lets you create Bitrix24 apps and bots with AI. No programming skills required.
- Sign in to Alaio Vibecode with your Bitrix24 account.

- To create an AI solution for Bitrix24, generate an API key. Then copy and send a prompt that describes the task to an AI model with API access. The AI model writes the code and deploys the solution to a secure server.
- The finished app appears in the Black Hole Servers section. The bot appears in the Bitrix24 Messenger .
- Administrators can limit platform access and set solution creation rules in the Settings section on the Alaio Vibecode site.

titre: Update or remove an AI solution in Alaio Vibecode
sections: Update or remove an AI solution in Alaio Vibecode
You can continue working on AI solutions created in Alaio Vibecode. Change how they work, add new features, or update their interface. Delete an application or bot when you no longer need it.
In this article:
