Update an AI solution
You can update an application in the same AI chat where you created it or start a new chat. Alaio Vibecode: Create and set up an app

Update the application in the same chat. Open the chat in the AI service where you created the application and describe the changes. For example: “Add a phone number field to the form” or “Fix the error when sending an order.”
This chat already contains the application code, the full API key, and the server data. The AI model will make the changes and update the application, so you do not need to send the key again.
Update the application in a new chat. If the chat where you created the application no longer exists, start a new chat in the AI service.
1. In the Alaio Vibecode personal account , open Hosting > Black Hole Servers .
2. Find the server with the application and click AI Prompt .
3. Copy the prompt. The ready-made prompt already contains the address and ID of the server you need.
4. Add the full value of the API key you saved when you created it to the prompt. Alaio Vibecode displays an existing key only partially, so you cannot view its full value again.

5. Open a chat with an AI model, such as Claude Code, Codex, or Cursor, and paste the copied prompt into your message. Describe what you need, such as an interface update or new features. Send the request to the AI model.
6. The agent will rewrite the code and rebuild the AI solution. Continue the conversation until you get the result you want.
Delete an AI solution

Delete an application or bot when you no longer need it. Before deleting it, decide whether to keep the application’s server and keys. Deleting a server is irreversible: the application will stop working, and the server data will be deleted.
1. Go to Apps > Applications .
2. Select the application you want to delete.
3. In the application form, click Three dots (...) > Delete .
4. Alaio Vibecode will display the resources linked to the application. Clear the checkboxes for resources you want to keep:
1. Server — the application will stop working, and the server data will be permanently deleted. Save important files and backups before deleting it.
2. API key — keep the key if you use it on another server or in another application.
3. Authentication key — after you delete this key, the application’s integration with Bitrix24 will stop working.
5. Review the selected resources and click Delete .
In brief
- To update an application, continue the conversation where you created it. The AI model already knows the application’s context and API key.
- To work in a new conversation, copy the AI Prompt from the server form and add the saved full value of the API key.
- To delete an application, in the Applications section, click Three dots (...) > Delete . Before confirming, clear the checkboxes for the server and keys you want to keep.
- Deleting a server and its data is irreversible.

titre: How Alaio Vibecode ensures security
sections: How Alaio Vibecode ensures security
Alaio Vibecode works with your Bitrix24 data, including deals, customers, documents, and messages. It uses several security layers to protect that data.
- Servers are not exposed to the public internet
- Authentication works only through Bitrix24
- Different access keys are used for different tasks
- You can revoke access at any time
In this article:
- How Alaio Vibecode protects data
- What to do if a key is compromised
How Alaio Vibecode protects data
Servers are not exposed to the public internet. Apps run on BlackHole servers. These are private servers with no public IP address. They do not accept incoming connections from the internet.
This helps prevent risks such as:
- Brute-force attacks
- Attempts to connect to admin ports
- Key exposure on public pages
Authentication through Bitrix24. To access Alaio Vibecode and its apps, users must sign in with a Bitrix24 account.
In practice, this means:
- There are no separate usernames or passwords for Alaio Vibecode. Employees do not need to manage extra credentials.
- If an employee leaves the company, a Bitrix24 administrator can remove their access, which also blocks access to Vibecode.
- If two-factor authentication is enabled in Bitrix24, it also applies to Vibecode.
- App permissions follow Bitrix24 permissions, so employees can only see the data they already have access to.

Separate access keys for different tasks. Apps need access keys to work with Bitrix24 data. Vibecode uses different key types for different tasks. If one key is compromised, the others keep working. Each key has only the permissions it needs.
Main key types:
- Personal automation key: works only inside your Bitrix24
- App key: issued when you share an app with coworkers or another Bitrix24 account
- Platform service key: hidden from the user and used by Vibecode to manage apps.
Revoke keys and remove access at any time. You can revoke a key, remove an employee's access, or delete an app at any time. This is useful if:
- A key was exposed in a public place or message
- An employee left the company or changed roles
- You no longer need an app and want to free up resources.
After you revoke a key, it stops working right away. Apps that use that key stay unavailable until you create and add a new one.

Data stays in Bitrix24. Customer data, deals, and messages stay in your Bitrix24. An app accesses this data through a secure channel and does not copy it. Only the data needed for a specific app is sent to BlackHole servers, and it is not stored longer than needed to generate a response.
What to do if a key is compromised
If you think someone got access to a key, delete it right away.
1. Open the API keys section. 2. Click the Three dots (...) next to the key you want to revoke. 3. Select Delete . You cannot restore a deleted key.
Then create a new key and update it in every app where the old key was used.
In brief
- Alaio Vibecode works with your Bitrix24 data, including deals, customers, documents, and messages. It uses several security layers at the same time.
- Apps run on BlackHole servers. These are private servers with no public IP address and no incoming internet access.
- Access to Alaio Vibecode and its apps requires a Bitrix24 account.
- Apps need access keys to work with Bitrix24 data. Vibecode uses different key types for different tasks. If one key is compromised, the others keep working.
- Customer data, deals, and messages stay in your Bitrix24. Apps access this data through a secure channel and do not copy it.
- If you think a key has been compromised, delete it in the API keys section.

titre: What are access keys in Alaio Vibecode
sections: What are access keys in Alaio Vibecode

An access key is a string that Bitrix24 uses to identify your app. Without a key, an app cannot read deals, create tasks, or send messages. If you revoke a key, the app loses access to data right away.
In this article:
- Key types in Alaio Vibecode
- API key
- Auth key
- Management key
- Reissue a key
Key types in Alaio Vibecode
Choose a key based on what your application needs to do. Each key type has its own purpose:
- API key — lets an application, bot, or server integration work with Bitrix24. This is the main key type. Create it when you need to connect an application to Bitrix24.
- Auth key — use it for applications that employees sign in to. The application works with the permissions of the employee who signed in, rather than the application owner's permissions.
- Management key — use it for service scripts that create, view, replace, or disable API keys. It does not give the application access to deals, tasks, messages, or other account data.

How to choose a key. For a bot, application, or integration, create an API key. If the application needs to identify an employee after login and work with that employee's permissions, use an authentication key. Create a management key only for scripts that manage API keys automatically.
API key
Use an API key for the application to work with Bitrix24. For example, to receive requests from a site and add them to the CRM.
Create an API key when you:
- Connect a new application or bot
- Set up a server integration
- Want to give a separate script access to the application
- Replace a key that may have been exposed to third parties
Use separate keys for different applications and environments, such as test and production. This way, replacing one key won't affect the others.
Create an API key.
1. Open the Access > API Keys section.
2. Click Create Key .
3. Enter a name that clearly describes the key's purpose. For example, CRM dashboard or Site-CRM integration .
4. Choose an access mode:
1. Read only — the application can only retrieve data. For example, for a CRM dashboard.
2. Read and write — the application can create or modify data. For example, to add requests to the CRM.
5. In the Access permissions block, select only the sections you need. For a CRM dashboard, CRM access is enough. You don't need permissions for tasks, chat, or other sections.
6. Choose the key's expiration date. If needed, also set a request limit per minute.
7. Click Create .
8. Copy the key and save it in a secure location. The full value is shown only once.
The API keys section shows the key name, available permissions, number of requests, date of last use, and status. This helps you see which key an application uses and whether you still need it.

Use the API key. After you create the key, Alaio Vibecode shows the API key and a ready-made prompt for an AI agent. The prompt includes the key, a link to the documentation, and instructions for creating the application or bot.
1. In the key window, click Copy prompt .
2. Paste the prompt into Claude Code, Codex, or Cursor.
3. Add a task description. For example, Build a CRM dashboard with sales department metrics for the month .
4. The AI agent creates the application and deploys it to a server.
If the key has Read only access to the CRM, the AI agent can create a dashboard that retrieves deal data and generates a report. Such an application won't be able to modify or create deals.
Auth key
Use an authentication key when the application needs to identify who signed in and display data based on that employee's permissions.
For example, suppose you create an application for employees to sign up for a company party. Each employee can create and view their own request, while the host can view requests from all employees.
Create an authentication key.
1. Open the Access > Auth Keys section.
2. Click Create Key .
3. Enter a name. For example, Company party sign-ups .
4. Choose an access mode: Read only or Read and write .
5. If the application needs to open in the Bitrix24 mobile app, enable Supports the Bitrix24 mobile app . You can't change this parameter after creation.
6. In the Access permissions block, select only the sections you need.
7. Click Create .
8. Copy the key and the ready-made prompt for the AI agent. You can see the full key only once.
Use the authentication key.
1. In the key window, click Copy prompt .
2. Paste the prompt into Claude Code, Codex, or Cursor.
3. Add a task description. For example, Create an application for employees to sign up for a company party .
4. The AI agent creates the application and deploys it to a server.
The AI agent creates the application. If you need to open it inside Bitrix24, click Embed into Bitrix24 in the list of authentication keys. Alaio Vibecode: Choose integration points for an app
Management key
Use a management key for a script that manages API keys through the REST API. If you create and replace API keys manually in the admin panel, you don't need one.

For example, suppose each new project needs its own API key. A script with a management key calls the key management API, creates an API key, and passes it to the project setup process. This way, you don't have to create a key manually every time.
Don't use a management key in an application instead of an API key. It doesn't grant access to CRM, tasks, chats, or other account data. To work with this data, the application needs an API key.
Create a management key.
1. Click the avatar in the top-right corner.
2. Select Management Keys .
3. Click Create Key .
4. Enter a clear name. For example, Scheduled key rotation .
5. Choose a mode:
1. Read only — the script can only view the list of keys.
2. Read and write — the script can create, modify, or disable keys.
6. Select the permissions you need:
1. API keys management — create, replace, and delete API keys.
2. Bitrix24 account read — retrieve the list of available accounts.
3. Tickets review — work with tickets. This permission is available to users with the platform-admin role.
7. Click Create .
8. Copy the key. You can see the full key only once.

Use the management key. Pass the management key in the X-Api-Key header when the script calls the key management API /v1/keys/* . There is no ready-made AI agent prompt when you create a management key.
1. Create a separate management key for each script.
2. Store the key in CI/CD secrets or a secrets manager. Don't add it to the script's code.
3. Select only the permissions you need. If the script only checks the list of keys, Read only mode is enough.
4. Add the key to the script's settings. When it runs, the script will pass the key to the API and can perform the allowed actions with API keys.
5. When you no longer need the script, disable or delete its management key.
Reissue a key

Reissue a key when you need to replace its value without creating a new application. For example, you can reissue a key as part of a scheduled rotation, when you transfer an application to another employee, or if the key may have been exposed.
When you reissue a key, Alaio Vibecode creates a new one. The application, server, embeddings, deployments, and access permissions remain the same.
1. Open the Applications section.
2. Select the application you need.
3. In the Key row, click Reissue key .

4. Leave Update the key on the server and restart the app enabled if the key is stored in the application's environment variables. Alaio Vibecode replaces the key value and restarts the application. Any open connections are interrupted during the restart.
5. Click Replace key .
6. Copy the new key and save it in a secure location. You can see the full key only once.
7. Update the key in any external integrations that use the old value.
During a regular reissue, the old active key keeps working for another 24 hours. Use this time to update external integrations. After 24 hours, the old key stops working.
If a key is blocked. Alaio Vibecode can block a key if it is publicly exposed. The application form shows the key as Blocked , and the application can no longer access Bitrix24 data.
Reissue the key using the same steps. The 24-hour transition period doesn't apply to blocked keys.
If Alaio Vibecode can't update the key on the server. After you replace a key, Alaio Vibecode shows the result in the same window. Follow the steps for the message you see:
- Key updated on server, application restarted — no action needed.

- Application server unavailable — key not updated in its environment — open the application server's form in the Black Hole Servers section. If the server is stopped, click Wake up . Once the server starts, return to the application form and replace the key again.

- Key not found in server environment variables or Failed to update key on server — Alaio Vibecode couldn't replace the value automatically. Copy the new key and open the AI tool you used to create the application. Ask it to replace the old API key with the new one in the application settings and redeploy it.
- Key updated on server, but failed to restart application — restart the application manually.

For an active key, the old value keeps working for another 24 hours. If the old key is blocked, update the environment variable and restart the application immediately. The blocked key no longer works.
In brief
- An access key lets an application or service script work with Alaio Vibecode and Bitrix24 features.
- Create an API key for an application that works on behalf of the key's author.
- Create an authentication key for an application where different employees sign in through Bitrix24 and work with their own permissions.
- Create a management key for scripts that manage API keys through the API. It doesn't grant access to Bitrix24 data.
- You can see the full value of a key only once. Save it immediately and keep it secure.

titre: Restrict access to a server in Alaio Vibeсode
sections: Restrict access to a server in Alaio Vibeсode

If a key falls into the wrong hands or an employee leaves the company, revoke access permissions away. In Vibeсode, you can deactivate a specific API key, remove a user from a server, or revoke an access link. Changes apply immediately.
In this article:
- Deactivate an API key
- Remove a user's server access
- Revoke an access link
- Delete an app from the catalog
- Check access after revoking it
- Respond to a stolen key
Deactivate an API key
Use this option when a key is compromised, shared with the wrong person, or no longer needed. After you deactivate it, all requests that use this key are rejected immediately.
1. Open the API Keys section. Find the key by name, username, or prefix. 2. Click the Three dots (...) menu next to the key and select Deactivate .
If the key was linked to an active server, create a new key. Click Create key at the top of the section, then link the new key to the server instead of the old one.
You can reactivate a deactivated key. To do this, click the Three dots (...) menu next to it and select Activate .

If the key is compromised and you do not want to restore it, delete it permanently. Click the Three dots (...) menu and select Delete . If the key is linked to active servers, unlink them first. Otherwise, you will not be able to delete the key.
Remove a user's server access
Use this option when an employee leaves the company or changes roles. After you remove access, the employee can no longer see the server or send requests to it.
1. Open the Black Hole Servers section. 2. Click Access on the relevant server. 3. Find the employee in the list and click Delete .
If the employee has left the company, also deactivate the Bitrix24 account. This removes access not only to this server, but to the entire account. Dismiss users
Revoke an access link
Revoke an access link if it was shared with unauthorized users or is no longer needed. After you revoke it, the link stops working and can no longer be used to access the server.
Users who already got access through the link will keep it. To remove them, use the Access tab separately. Remove a user's server access

1. Open the Black Hole Servers section. 2. Click any tab on the relevant server, such as Access . 3. In the window that opens, go to the Links tab. 4. Find the link in the list and click the delete icon next to it.
Delete an app from the catalog
Use this option when you no longer need the app at all. Deletion is permanent. If you need the app again, you must create it again. When you delete an app:
- All API keys for the app are deactivated immediately
- The app is removed from the catalog for all users
- Logs and build history are deleted
1. Open the App Catalog section. 2. Click the Three dots (...) menu on the app form. 3. Select Delete .
Check access after revoking it

After any of these actions, make sure access is actually blocked. The server log shows who accessed the server and when. If you see new requests after revocation, the key or link is still active somewhere. Vibe Code blocks these requests, but you should still confirm it.

1. Open the Black Hole Servers section. 2. Click Journal on the relevant server. 3. Review recent server requests to see who made them, when, and what result they got. If you see new requests after revocation, the key or link is still active somewhere. Find it and revoke it.
Respond to a stolen key
If you think a key has fallen into the wrong hands, act fast.

1. Deactivate the key in the API Keys section. 2. Open the Journal tab on the server and review activity from the last few hours. 3. If the log shows suspicious requests, pause the entire app. 4. Contact Bitrix24 Support. They can help you check whether someone used the stolen key.
In brief
- Deactivate an API key in the API Keys section through the Three dots (...) menu. The key stops working immediately.
- Remove a user's access in the Black Hole Servers section on the Access tab. Click Delete next to the name.
- Revoke a link in the Black Hole Servers section on the Links tab. Users who already connected through it keep access and must be removed separately.
- Delete an app in the App Catalog section. All keys are deactivated and the app disappears for all users. Deletion is permanent.
- After any of these actions, check the server log on the Journal tab.

titre: Alaio Vibecode: Vibe plans and packages
sections: Alaio Vibecode: Vibe plans and packages
In Alaio Vibecode, you pay for individual services with Vibe credits — the platform's internal currency. Your vibe balance covers app servers, paid AI models, AI search, and other services.
In this article:
- What Vibe credits are
- How Vibe credits are used
- Available Vibe packages
- Buy a Vibe package
- Track your balance
- What happens if your balance runs out
What Vibe credits are
Vibe credits (Ꝟ) are the internal balance used on the Vibecode platform. They are charged when you use platform features such as running servers, AI models, and AI agent commands. 1 Ꝟ equals 1 USD.

Vibe credits stay active for 365 days from the purchase date. The oldest Vibe credits are used first. Any unused balance expires after 365 days. You can check your current balance and spending history in your account.
Vibe credits belong to the Bitrix24 account, not to a specific user. Any employee who has access to the Alaio Vibecode platform can use them.
New companies automatically get a welcome bonus of 10 Ꝟ and 14 days of trial access. This is enough to explore the platform and build a simple app.
How Vibe credits are used
Vibe credits are used for:
- Black Hole servers — isolated servers that run apps you build in Alaio Vibecode. When an app is idle, its server goes to sleep and is billed at a reduced rate.
- Paid built-in AI models — resource-intensive models in Alaio Vibecode. Vibe credits are charged when an app calls an AI model, for example, to generate a response or analyze a document.
- AI web search — Vibe credits are spent when apps and bots search the web for up-to-date information. In the Billing section, this expense category is called Web search.

- The Hermes AI agent — a ready-made AI agent that connects to Bitrix24 as a chatbot. The cost depends on where the agent is hosted and which model it uses. Create the Hermes AI agent in Alaio Vibecode
- File storage — you can see these costs in the Billing section, in the Storage line.
Available Vibe packages
You can buy Vibe credits as ready-made packages or in a custom amount. There are three ready-made packages:
- Starter: 20 Ꝟ. For one Bitrix24 account. Good for trying the platform and building your first app.
- Team: 50 Ꝟ. For a team or department that uses apps regularly. This is the most popular package.
- Pro: 100 Ꝟ. For heavy use, including dozens of apps, active AI scenarios, and always-on servers.
Buy a Vibe package
1-2. In the Vibecode platform, open the Billing section and click + Top Up . 3-4. Choose how many Vibe credits to buy:
- To buy a ready-made package, click Select under the package you want.
- To enter a different amount, type it in the Custom amount field and click Top Up .
After payment, Vibe credits are added to your balance automatically. The timing depends on the payment method. You can track the order status in the Billing section on the Top-up history tab.
Track your balance

The Billing section shows how many Vibe credits you have left, when top-ups expire, and what you spent Vibe credits on. To open the section, select Billing from the menu on the left in your Alaio Vibecode account. The section has three tabs.
Overview. This tab brings together the key balance information:
- Your remaining Vibe credits and an estimate of how many days they'll last at your current spending rate
- Top-ups along with the expiration date of each
- The amount of Vibe credits already spent
- Spending broken down by category and by employee

Transactions. This tab lists every deduction from your balance, including the date, amount, remaining balance, and what the Vibe credits were spent on. To find a specific transaction, filter the list by type, source, or period, or use the search.
Top-up history. This tab shows all top-up orders and their statuses. If you paid for a package but haven't received the credits, check the order status on this tab.
What happens if your balance runs out

When your Vibe credits run out, scenarios that rely on Vibe credits become unavailable and app servers stop. Your data, projects, agents, and bots remain intact. Once you top up your balance, work resumes.
To keep apps running without interruption, monitor the spending forecast on the Overview tab and top up your balance before your credits run out.
In brief
- Vibe credits (Ꝟ) are the platform's internal balance. 1 Ꝟ equals 1 USD. They stay active for up to 12 months.
- Vibe credits pay for Black Hole servers, paid AI models, AI web search, the Hermes AI agent, and file storage.
- Three packages are available: Starter (20 Ꝟ), Team (50 Ꝟ), and Pro (100 Ꝟ). You can also top up your balance with a custom amount.
- Each new company automatically gets 10 Ꝟ and 14 days of trial access.
- You can see your remaining balance, top-up expiration dates, and all deductions in the Billing section.
- If your balance stays at zero for more than 33 days, the servers are deleted and the data cannot be recovered.

titre: Alaio Vibecode: App development costs
sections: Alaio Vibecode: App development costs

Alaio Vibecode lets you build apps for Bitrix24 without a long development cycle. Describe the app to an AI agent in plain language, then refine it through a conversation. This helps you launch a working tool quickly or decide right away whether your team actually needs it.
In this article:
- What affects the cost
- App cost examples
What affects the cost
Alaio Vibecode uses its own payment unit called Vibe credits (Ꝟ). New accounts get a welcome bonus of 10 Ꝟ. That is enough to run a small app for several weeks. Available Vibe packages

Apps are created with a third-party AI agent such as Claude Code, Codex, or Cursor. These tools have their own subscriptions. You use them to create an app from a text prompt and publish it to Bitrix24 through Vibecode. This step does not use Vibe credits. Alaio Vibecode: Create and set up an app
Vibe credits are used only when the app is running. When the app is in sleep mode, usage drops a lot. When the app is stopped, no Vibe credits are charged.
What does not use Vibe credits:
- Creating and updating an app through an AI agent
- API requests to Bitrix24 through the platform
- Free built-in AI models on the platform
- Connecting your own API key from OpenAI, Anthropic, or another provider. In this case, you pay the provider directly.
What uses Vibe credits:

- Black Hole server rental. Vibe credits are used while the app is running. In sleep mode, charges drop about ten times. The cost ranges from 24 Ꝟ to 202 Ꝟ per month while running, depending on server size. Black Hole servers
- Paid built-in AI models, only if the app uses them.
- AI web search, only if the app performs web searches. Pricing starts at 0.02 Ꝟ per request.
Simple app: morning summary
A sales team supervisor gets a daily digest of open deals above a set amount. The summary arrives every morning in Bitrix24 Messenger.

How it works. The app does one task. Once a day, it reads deals from CRM, filters and formats the list, and sends it to chat. It does not use AI models. The server runs for about 15 minutes a day. It wakes up to process the request and then goes back to sleep.
Cost:
- Build: 0 Ꝟ. An AI agent can write the app in minutes.
- Per month: about 3 Ꝟ. The Small server stays in sleep mode almost all the time.
- Per year: about 36 Ꝟ
Medium app: estimate calculator

A manager opens a deal form, clicks Calculate estimate , and fills in 25 parameters. The app calculates the cost based on company rules, attaches the result to the deal, and generates a commercial proposal in PDF format.
How it works. The app accepts parameters through a form, calculates the cost, generates a PDF with the proposal, and saves everything in the deal form. An AI model writes the accompanying text.
Cost:
- Build: 0 Ꝟ
- Per month (at an average load of 200 calculations): about 12–18 Ꝟ
- Small server with daytime activity: 12 Ꝟ

- AI model for writing proposal text: 0–6 Ꝟ depending on the model chosen. Free AI models do not use Vibe credits, while paid ones are billed based on actual usage. If you connect your own key from OpenAI, Anthropic, or another provider, you pay them directly without spending Vibe credits.
- Per year: about 144–216 Ꝟ
Complex app: AI assistant for lead processing

The AI assistant automatically processes all incoming emails, website requests, and messenger messages. It identifies the client profile, researches company data from public sources, creates a deal in CRM, assigns a task to the right manager, and sends the client an initial response.

How it works. The app monitors and reads messages from three channels, searches for client company data online, generates a response, and updates CRM. On average, it processes 50 incoming messages per day. Each one requires several calls to an AI model and one AI search request.
Cost:
- Build: 0 Ꝟ
- Per month (50 requests/day): about 115 Ꝟ
- Medium server, actively running throughout the day: 25 Ꝟ
- AI model for processing messages: 60 Ꝟ (or 0 Ꝟ when connecting your own key, see the example above for details)
- AI search for client company information online: 30 Ꝟ
- Per year: about 1,380 Ꝟ
In brief
- Alaio Vibecode uses its own payment unit called Vibe credits (Ꝟ).
- Apps are created through a third-party AI agent — Claude Code, Codex, or Cursor. This step does not use Vibe credits.
- Vibe credits are used only when the app is running. The main cost is Black Hole server rental. In sleep mode, usage drops significantly. When the app is stopped, no Vibe credits are charged.
- Simple app — morning summary — costs about 36 Ꝟ per year.
- Medium app — estimate calculator — costs about 144–216 Ꝟ per year.
- Complex app — AI assistant for leads — costs about 1,380 Ꝟ per year.

titre: Employee widget
sections: Employee widget

The employee widget in Bitrix24 is your go-to menu for managing your account. Access essential settings and data in just a few clicks: change your password, check vacation days, send HR documents, and more.

titre: Profile page
sections: Profile page

An employee profile in Bitrix24 works like a business card inside your company. Colleagues can quickly see which department a person belongs to, contact them, view shared interests, and access other useful information.
- How to open the profile
- What information is available in the profile
- How to edit and customize the profile
How to open the profile
To open an employee profile, click the employee photo in a chat, task, or any other Bitrix24 tool.

The employee profile now has a cleaner and more user-friendly design. View colleague information such as contact details, job title, and department in one place. Update your own profile information in just a few minutes.
To open an employee profile, tap the employee name in a chat, Feed, or any other Bitrix24 tool.
What information is available in the profile
Contact information. The profile shows the employee’s first name, last name, phone number, email address, job title, and other contact details.
Photo. A profile photo helps colleagues recognize employees faster. The photo appears in chats, calls, tasks, and other Bitrix24 tools.
Employee role. An icon in the profile shows the employee’s role in the company. Assign admin permissions Invite Bitrix24 Partner
Status. The status shows whether the employee is available. Colleagues can use it to decide the best time to contact the person.
Absences. The profile displays upcoming vacations and business trips. Bitrix24 automatically pulls this information from the absence schedule. Absence chart
Personal details. This section contains HR information and other documents. Only users with the required permissions can view it. Configure access permissions to e-Signature for HR

Additional information. This section shows the employee’s supervisor and direct reports. Bitrix24 automatically pulls the data from the company structure. This information helps employees find the right person for work-related questions and understand the team structure faster. Company structure: New interface and features
About me. Employees can share personal information with colleagues here, such as hobbies or travel photos.
My interests. Employees can add hashtags for topics they enjoy, such as #movies , #travel , or #sports . To find colleagues with similar interests, click a hashtag.

Appreciations. This section stores appreciation posts from colleagues. Each appreciation appears as an icon, such as a like, star, or trophy. All employees can see the icons and the total number of appreciations. Only recipients can open the related posts. Create an appreciation post in Feed
Bitrix24 tools. The profile provides quick access to Tasks, Calendar, Drive, and other Bitrix24 tools.
Employees only see tasks and files they already have permission to access.
Some profile sections are visible only to the profile owner.
Extensions. Install apps from the Bitrix24 Market or create a knowledge base for employees. Knowledge base Bitrix24 Market overview
Security. Set up two-step authentication to protect your account. Enable two-step authentication for Bitrix24 login

Installed apps. Check whether the Bitrix24 desktop and mobile apps are installed. If they are not installed, you can download them directly from the profile. Download the Bitrix24 app Bitrix24 mobile app
Bitrix24 Drive. This section shows when Bitrix24 Drive synchronization was connected.
Change background. Choose a background image for your profile. Other employees will see it when they open your profile page. Change account theme
Contact information. The profile shows the employee’s first name, last name, phone number, email address, job title, and other contact details.
Photo . A profile photo helps colleagues recognize employees faster. The photo appears in chats, calls, tasks, and other Bitrix24 tools.
Status . The status shows whether the employee is available. Colleagues can use it to decide the best time to contact the person.
Notes. Notes is a personal chat in Bitrix24 that is visible only to you. Use it to save important information, messages, and files. Notes in Bitrix24 chats
Bitrix24 tools. The profile provides quick access to Tasks, Calendar, Drive, and other Bitrix24 tools.
Employees only see tasks and files they already have permission to access.

Company structure. This section shows the employee’s place in the company structure, including the department, supervisor, direct reports, and team members. It helps employees understand the department structure and quickly open a colleague’s profile. Company structure: New interface and features
Appreciations. This section displays appreciation badges such as stars and trophies. These badges show recognition from colleagues. To open the appreciation post, click the badge.
All employees can see the badges and their total number. Only recipients can open the related posts. Create an appreciation post in Feed
Efficiency. Shows the percentage of tasks the employee completed on time as an assignee or participant. Task efficiency
Interests. Employees can add hashtags for topics they enjoy, such as #movies , #travel , #sports , and find colleagues with similar interests.
How to edit and customize the profile
You can update profile information at any time. Employees and Bitrix24 administrators can both edit the profile.
Edit. If your phone number, email address, job title, or city changes, update the information in your profile.
To edit your profile, click Edit in the top-right corner. Change profile details and layout in Bitrix24
Customize the form layout. You can choose which fields appear in the profile and change their order.
- To create your own layout, select Use custom layout .
- To use the default layout configured by the administrator, select Use standard layout .
Change profile details and layout in Bitrix24
To update your phone number, email address, job title, or profile photo, tap the pencil icon in the top-right corner.
In brief

- An employee profile in Bitrix24 works like a business card inside your company. It helps colleagues quickly find contact details, department information, shared interests, and other employee information.
- You can open an employee profile from any Bitrix24 tool by clicking the employee photo.
- The profile displays contact information, the employee's photo, the role in the company, status, interests, etc.
- Employees and Bitrix24 administrators can edit profile information at any time.
- You can also customize the profile layout by choosing which fields to display and changing their order. If needed, you can switch back to the standard layout configured by the administrator.

titre: Change profile details and layout in Bitrix24
sections: Change profile details and layout in Bitrix24
In Bitrix24, every employee has a personal profile page with key details such as their name, contact information, department, position, and more.
Update your profile at any time—for example, if your phone number, job title, or photo changes. Keeping your information current helps colleagues find and contact you quickly. Profile page
Employees can edit only their own profiles, while Bitrix24 administrators can update any employee’s profile if needed.
In this article:
- Update contact information
- Change profile photo
- Customize profile layout
Update contact information
If your phone number, email, position, or city changes, make sure to update your profile. This way, your colleagues always have the right details to contact you and know your current role.
1. Click Edit .
2. Enter or update the information. For example, add a new job title or city.
3. Click Save .
Change profile photo
Your profile photo makes it easier for colleagues to recognize you. It appears in chats, calls, tasks, and other Bitrix24 tools. If you update your look, you can upload a new photo.
Hover over your current photo and choose an option: take a photo or upload one from your computer.
Upload a photo.
1. Click Upload from drive or drag the photo into the upload area. Supported formats are JPG, PNG, and GIF.
2. Use the slider to adjust the size of the photo. A preview on the right shows how it will look in your profile.
3. Click Save .
Take a photo.
1. Click the camera icon.
2. Use the slider to adjust the size of the photo. A preview on the right shows how it will look in your profile.
3. To retake the photo, click Take a photo again.
4. Click the arrow icon to go back to the previous photo.
5. Select the photo you want and click Save .
Customize profile layout
Bitrix24 offers two profile layouts:
- Custom layout: Each employee decides which fields to show and their order.
- Standard layout: The account administrator sets the same profile layout for all employees.
Employees can switch between layouts at any time.

Custom layout. On your profile page, you can hide the fields you don't need, add new ones from the list, and rearrange them. For example, if you work in an international company, display the Country field to see where your colleagues are located.
To add a field to your profile:
1. Click Select field .
2. Check the fields you want to add.
3. Click Select .
You can customize how fields appear in your profile. Click Settings (⚙️) and choose an action:
- Hide: Remove the field from your profile. You can add it back at any time.
- Configure: Rename the field.
- Show always: Display the field in your profile, even if it's empty.
To change the order of fields, click and drag next to a field to a new position.

Standard layout. Bitrix24 administrators can set a standard layout so all employee profiles look the same. For example, you might add fields like Key customer and Work schedule . This information appears for all employees and makes it easy to see who is responsible for what.
1. Select Standard layout .
2. Create new fields or add existing ones. Create custom fields on the profile page
3. To change the order of fields, click and drag next to a field to a new position.
4. Click Standard layout > Set as standard layout for all users .
In brief
- In Bitrix24, every employee has a personal profile page with key details such as their name, contact information, department, position, and more.
- Employees can edit only their own profiles, while Bitrix24 administrators can update any employee’s profile if needed.
- You can update your profile information and change your photo.
- Bitrix24 offers two profile layouts: Custom layout and Standard layout.
- Custom layout lets employees choose which fields to display and their order. Standard layout is set by account administrators so all profiles look the same.
- Employees can switch between layouts at any time.

titre: Receive email notifications from Bitrix24
sections: Receive email notifications from Bitrix24
Enable automatic email notifications to stay informed about important updates when you can't access Bitrix24.
- How email notifications work
- Set up email notifications
- Fix email delivery issues
How email notifications work
Not all notifications in Bitrix24 are sent by email. Here’s what you need to know:
- Email notifications are sent only once, about 5–10 minutes after an event.
- You'll only receive an email if you haven’t viewed the notification in Bitrix24. Unread notifications appear with a yellow background.
- Emails come from no‑reply@your_bitrix24_domain.bitrix24.com .
- Messages are sent to the email address saved in your profile under Email address . Profile page
Set up email notifications
1. Go to Messenger .
2. Click More .
3. Select Settings .
4. Open the Notifications tab.
5. Choose Simple mode to turn on notifications.
Fix email delivery issues
If you’re not receiving email notifications, check the following:
Incorrect email address. Check that the email address in your profile is correct.
Emails going to spam. Add no‑reply@your_bitrix24_domain.bitrix24.com as a contact in your email service provider.
Notification already viewed in Bitrix24. If a notification is marked as read, no email will be sent. To prevent this, turn off automatic read marking:
1. Go to Messenger .
2. Click More .
3. Select Settings .
4. Open the Notifications tab.
5. Uncheck Auto mark notifications as read .
This ensures notifications stay unread, even if you open the notification list in Bitrix24.
If this doesn't resolve the issue, contact your email service provider's support.
In brief
- Enable automatic email notifications to stay informed about important updates when you can't access Bitrix24.
- Unread notifications in Bitrix24 are sent to the email address specified in your profile within 5–10 minutes after an event.

- To set up email notifications, go to Messenger > More > Settings > Notifications . In Simple mode , check the boxes for Web version and desktop application and Email . In Advanced mode , select specific notifications to receive by email.

- If emails are not delivered, check the email address in your profile, turn off the option to automatically mark notifications as read, and add no‑reply@your_bitrix24_domain.bitrix24.com to your email contacts.

titre: Change account theme
sections: Change account theme
In Bitrix24, you can change the theme to match your corporate style or employees' preferences. You can select a standard theme or upload your own image.
Employees can change the theme for themselves, while the Bitrix24 administrator can set a unified theme for all employees.
- Select a standard theme
- Add your own image
Select a standard theme
1. Click your profile picture in the top-right corner.
2. Select Change background .
3. Click on a theme to preview.
4. Click Save or choose another theme.
5. Enable the Default theme for all users option if needed. Set account theme for all users
You can change the theme as many times as you like.
Add your own image
1. Click Custom theme .
2. Upload an image in png, jpg, or gif format. You can add as many images as you like.
3. Set a background color if the image is transparent.
4. Choose a text color to ensure it contrasts with the background.
The image should be no larger than 20 MB with a resolution of up to 5000×5000 pixels.
You can delete an uploaded image by hovering over it and clicking the trash icon.
In brief
- In Bitrix24, you can change the theme to match your corporate style or employees' preferences.
- Employees can change the theme for themselves, while the Bitrix24 administrator can set a unified theme for all employees.
- Click your profile picture in the top-right corner and select Change background .
- You can choose a standard theme or upload your own image.
- The image should be no larger than 20 MB with a resolution of up to 5000×5000 pixels.

titre: How search works in Bitrix24
sections: How search works in Bitrix24

The search in Bitrix24 helps you quickly find tasks, deals, employees, and other items. It works across all major tools like Projects, CRM, Drive, Workflows, and more. This saves time and allows you to find information without navigating to a specific section.
1. Click the magnifying glass icon at the top bar.
2. Enter a keyword or part of it, such as an employee's name, a workgroup or a deal title.
Search results are divided into sections:
Employees — searches for colleagues by first name, last name, or department. Dismissed employees are not displayed.
Tools — displays sections and items where the specified keyword appears. For example, you can find a project or a task by its name.
Menu items — helps you quickly navigate to the desired section of the left menu.

Search in — select a specific section to search for items using a keyword. For instance, if you choose the Tasks section, the list will display tasks where the keyword appears in the title or description.
In brief
- The search in Bitrix24 helps you quickly find tasks, deals, employees, and other items. It works across all major tools like Projects, CRM, Drive, Workflows, and more.
- Click the magnifying glass icon at the top panel, enter a keyword or part of it.
- Search results are divided into sections: employees, Bitrix24 tools, menu items, and search within a specific section.

titre: Application passwords
sections: Application passwords
Application passwords let you connect external services and devices to Bitrix24. Use them to sync calendars, contacts, and other data with tools like Outlook or mobile apps.
Instead of using your main Bitrix24 password, you create a separate password for each connection. This keeps your account secure and simplifies setup.
Application passwords help you:
- Connect external services to Bitrix24 automatically
- Avoid entering your main password during each sync
- Keep your main password private and secure
In this article:
- Generate application passwords
- Delete them
Generate application passwords
Create passwords in your personal profile:
1. Open your profile by clicking your photo.
2. Go to Security .
3. Click Application passwords and choose what you want to sync, such as Contacts .
4. Select the service or device, for example, a mobile phone.
5. Add a comment if needed. For example, specify the device and program where the password will be used.
6. Click Get password . Copy it and paste it into the external service settings instead of your regular password.
The service will connect to your Bitrix24 account automatically.
Do not close the window until you copy the password. You won’t be able to see it again.
Each password works for one service or device only.
In some cases, Bitrix24 creates application passwords automatically, such as when you sign in from a mobile app or desktop. No setup is required.
Delete an application password
Delete a password if you no longer use a service or lost a device:
1. Open your profile and go to Security .
2. Click Application passwords .
3. Select the service.
4. Click Delete .
In brief
- Application passwords connect external services and devices to Bitrix24.
- They are required if two-step authentication is enabled.
- You create them in your profile under Security .
- Each password is valid for one service or device.
- You can delete them at any time to stop synchronization.

titre: Create custom fields on the profile page
sections: Create custom fields on the profile page

The employee profile in Bitrix24 is a form containing key information like name, contacts, position, department, etc. Custom fields allow you to add extra information to the profile, such as work format, schedule, or car number.
In this article:
- Create a custom field
- Edit a custom field
Create a custom field
1. Click on the photo in the top right corner to open a profile and click the name.
2. Click Create field and select the field type:
- String — enter any information like text, numbers, special characters, etc. For example, an employee's car number.
- List — select one or multiple options. For example, work format: office, remote, or hybrid.
- Date/Time — specify an exact date and time. For example, the date of the next work shift.
- Date — specify a date without time. For example, the next evaluation day.
- Address — select a location on the map. For example, a document delivery address.
- Link — add any links. For example, an employee's social media profile.
- File — upload documents. For example, diplomas or certificates.
- Money — specify an amount and currency. For example, a budget for colleague gifts.
- Yes/No — choose "Yes" or "No". For example, whether the employee uses corporate transport.
- Number — enter any number. For example, an office number.
Enter the field name and configure its settings:
- Multiple — allows adding several values to the field.
- Always show — displays the field in the profile even if it is empty.
Click Save . The field will appear in the profile.
Edit a custom field
Click Settings (⚙️) next to the field and choose an action:
- Hide — remove the field from all employee profiles.
- Configure — change the field settings.
- Always show — display the field in the profile even if it is empty.
To restore a hidden field in the profile:
1. Click Select field .
2. Check the one from the list and click Select .
To change the order of fields, hold the field and drag it to a new position.
In brief
- Custom fields in the employee profile can store any information like work format, schedule, or car number.
- Go to the profile and click Create field .
- To edit a field, click Settings (⚙️) next to it and select an action: hide, configure, or always show.
- Only a Bitrix24 administrator can create and edit fields in the profile.

titre: Company Pulse
sections: Company Pulse

Company Pulse is an overall activity of users in your account. It helps you see how well Bitrix24 is being used in your company’s daily work. The statistics cover overall activity and break it down by tools. The data is calculated based on the selected period, user, and feature.
To access the Company Pulse:
1. Click your photo in the top right corner.
2. Select Company Pulse .
Learn what indicators the chart provides and how to interpret the Company Pulse statistics.
Main Bitrix24 tools
The bottom section shows seven main tools of Bitrix24:
- Social Network : Posts and comments in Feed.
- Likes : Likes for posts, comments, and other items.
- Tasks : Actions applied in tasks, such as creating new tasks, adding comments, or changing deadline.
- Chat and video : Messages and calls in Messenger.
- Drive : Files uploaded to Bitrix24 Drive using the Bitrix24 Messenger app.
- Mobile app : Actions applied in the mobile app. Any changes are counted, like sending messages or applying changes in tasks or CRM.
- CRM : Actions applied in CRM, like modifying leads, deals, or contacts.

By default, the chart displays general data, but you can view the rating for each tool. Just select a tool at the bottom, and the chart will show its usage statistics. For a detailed explanation of the indicator, click the question mark next to the tool name.
Date range
Select a time period to view the data: today, week, month, or year. In Week or Month view, you can hover the cursor over a specific date in the chart to see detailed statistics for that day.
Key indicators
Company Pulse uses the concepts of rating, activity, and feature usage. Each of these can be calculated depending on the selected tool, user, and period.

Rating . This is based on the activity of employees who have used Bitrix24 tools at least once during the selected period. You can view each employee's overall rating or their rating for a specific tool.
Click General rating to see the following:

- The General rating tab shows a list of the most active users and how many tools each of them uses in Bitrix24. This helps you analyze team activity and understand how well the main tools are being adopted.
A user will appear on this list if they’ve performed at least three actions with one of the main tools, like creating a task and adding two comments to it.
- The Not involved tab shows the list of employees who use less than four tools. If you check this tab for a specific tool, it will show users who don't use this tool at all.
Activity . This is the total number of actions employees performed in the account using any tools during the selected period. It reflects how actively employees use the tools.
Feature usage . This shows how well the account features are integrated into your company's work. It calculates the percentage of employees who use at least four tools.
People and Company modes
By default, Company Pulse shows data for the entire company. To view individual ratings:
1. Turn on People mode using the toggle switch.
2. Click the arrow and select an employee from the list.
3. Check their rating, activity index, and their department's and company average index.
The chart includes four lines showing different trends:
- Blue : The selected employee’s activity rating.
- Orange : Your activity rating.
- Green : The company's average rating.
- Gray : The average rating for the employee’s department.
Hover over the chart to see specific data points.
Data updates happen at different times depending on the selected mode and date range. In People mode, an employee’s rating updates instantly. In Company mode, it updates based on the selected period:
- Today: Updates every minute
- Week: Updates every hour
- Month: Updates every hour
In brief
- Company Pulse provides an overview of user activity in your Bitrix24 account, helping you track how well the tools are integrated into your company’s work.
- It offers statistics on overall activity, tool usage, and feature adoption, with data calculated based on the selected period, user, and tool.
- The chart displays general data by default, but you can also view detailed statistics for individual tools or employees.
- Switch between Company and People modes to view either company-wide trends or individual employee performance.

titre: FAQ: Employee profile
sections: FAQ: Employee profile

In Bitrix24, each employee has a personal profile and widget. The profile displays key information about the employee, such as department, position, contacts, and interests. The widget allows employees to manage their account—change their password, check vacation balance, switch themes, and more.
In this article:
- How to find an employee's ID
- Why a new field is not displayed in an employee's profile in the Bitrix24 On-Premise
- Why an employee does not have the "Start workday" button
- Why the Bitrix24 theme has changed
- How to hide the "My plan" widget from employees
- Whether it is possible to hide part of the profile information from other employees
How to find an employee's ID
You can find a user's ID in their profile or the employee list.
In the employee's profile. If you are using Bitrix24 in a browser, open the employee's profile. The ID will be displayed in the address bar after /user/ .
If you are using the Bitrix24 desktop app, open the employee's profile and click the paperclip icon next to the avatar. Paste the link into any text editor to see the ID.
In the employee list. Go to the Employees section. The ID of each user is displayed in the ID column.
If the ID column is hidden, add it:
1. Click Settings (⚙️) in the top-left corner of the table.
2. Check the box next to the ID field.
3. Save the changes.
Why a new field is not displayed in an employee's profile in the Bitrix24 On-Premise
If a new custom field is not displayed in an employee's profile, it needs to be enabled in the field display settings. Only the Bitrix24 administrator can do this.
1. Go to the personal profile.
2. Click General form view > Field display settings .
3. Open the field list for viewing and check the box next to the required field. Save the changes.
4. Click Select field and add the field. Save the changes.
Why an employee does not have the "Clock in" button
Possible reasons:
- The employee's work time tracking is not enabled.
- The employee does not have permissions to use the Work time tracking tool. Worktime tracking in Bitrix24
Solution. Check if work time tracking is enabled for the employee and if they have permissions to use the tool.
Enable work time tracking for the employee.
1. Go to Employees > Time and Reports > Worktime.
2. Click the icon next to the employee's name who does not have the Clock in button.
3. Select an option:
- Inherit department settings . The employee will use the work time settings of their department. This is suitable if tracking is already enabled for the entire department.
- Enabled — enable work time tracking only for this employee. Use this option for selective tracking.
Save the changes.
Check access permissions. To check the work time tracking permissions for a department or an employee:
1. Go to Employees > Time and Reports > Access permissions .
2. Select Add access permission.
3. Click Users to select an employee.
4. Find employees and click on their name.
5. Click Select.
6. Choose the Employee or department supervisor permission. It works differently depending on the user's role in the company structure:
- Regular employee — can view and edit only their own workday and report.
- Department supervisor — in addition to their own data, can view and edit the workday and reports of subordinates.
Save the changes.
Why the Bitrix24 theme has changed
The Bitrix24 theme may change for two reasons:
Bitrix24 update. Twice a year, we release major updates. Along with them, the theme changes automatically. This makes it easy to notice new features in Bitrix24.
Company theme. The Bitrix24 administrator can enable a common background for all employees. If the administrator updates the theme, it will change for everyone automatically.
You can restore the previous theme or set a new one for yourself. Go to the employee widget and select Theme. Change account theme
Hide the "My plan" widget from employees
Currently, it is not possible to hide the My plan widget from employees in Bitrix24, but you can restrict access to plan payments. This can be done by the Bitrix24 administrator.
1. Go to the company widget and click Settings.
2. Select Other > Miscellaneous .
3. Toggle the switch next to All users can buy Bitrix24 subscription .
Whether it is possible to hide part of the profile information from other employees

In Bitrix24, it is not possible to hide individual profile fields from only some employees. Display settings are universal for everyone. The administrator determines which fields are visible in the profile. These rules apply equally to all employees. Change profile details and layout in Bitrix24

titre: Booking: Getting started
sections: Booking: Getting started
Bitrix24 Booking is a tool for customers to make appointments with specialists, rent rooms and equipment.
- Medical practitioners — doctor appointments, cosmetologists, and health diagnostics.
- Equipment rental — construction, sports, event equipment, etc.
- Expert services — all types of counseling, repair work, beauty salon services.
- Car rental — cars and special vehicles.
- Property rental — banquet halls, apartments, houses, photo studios, etc.
- Other — select this option if you don't have the desired business area in the list.
Online booking helps you automate the reservation process, track the workload of specialists, send reminders to the clients about the visit, and save data in CRM.
Add a resource
Resources are the people, equipment, and facilities that are needed to provide services.
To start using the booking option, add resources. Any employee can do this. Go to the Booking section and click Add a resource .
Add a resource to Booking section
Configure reminders
Configure automated messages for customers to remind them about the visit and confirm the appointment. This will help customers not to forget about a scheduled visit.
Booking: Customer message templates
Add a client to the booking form
Select a resource, day, and time in the Booking section, then click Create . Enter the customer's details and add the deal. You can book a client for several appointments at once.
Add a client to the booking form
All entries are color-coded for easy identification:
- Green: The customer has confirmed the appointment.
- Blue: The appointment is not yet confirmed.
- Orange: The customer is late.
Red counters indicate how many customers have not confirmed their visit or are late. This allows you to quickly assess appointment statuses and contact customers for confirmation.
Track resource workload
The Booking section has several tools to help you keep track of resource workload.

Statistics . You can view the number of new customers, the revenue for each resource, and the total revenue for the day. The revenue comes from the Amount field in linked deals and shows data for the current day.
Filter . Select which resources to show on the schedule board. For example, you can display the records of a specific doctor.

Resource availability . Click the battery icon next to a resource to see how many slots are occupied on the selected day and the percentage of its availability. This helps staff find less busy resources and add clients.
Resource bundle . Use this option if you need to book multiple resources for an appointment, such as a main resource and an additional one. Add a resource to Booking section
To allow a separate additional resource to be booked for each main resource, disable the Apply bundle restrictions to all option.
If the additional resource is shared by all main resources, enable the Apply bundle restrictions to all option.
Schedule display .
- Enlarge the schedule window: Use this if you have many resources and records to view.
- Show all: Displays all resources on the schedule board.
- Zoom: Adjust this if all records do not fit on the screen.
In brief
- Bitrix24 Booking is a tool for customers to make appointments with specialists, rent rooms and equipment.
- To get started, you need to create and configure resources. This can be done by any employee.
- Enable automatic messages for clients to remind them about the visit and confirm the appointment.
- To create a new booking, select a resource, day, time, and click Create . Enter the customer's details and add a deal.
- You can view the number of new customers, the revenue for each resource, and the total revenue for the day.
- Use the filter to select which resources to show on the schedule board.
- Use the resource bundle option if you need to book multiple resources for an appointment, such as a main resource and an additional one.

titre: Add a resource to the Booking section
sections: Add a resource to the Booking section
Bitrix24 Booking is a tool for customers to make appointments with specialists, rent rooms, equipment, etc.
Go to the Booking section and click Add a resource .
- Select your industry
- Configure the resource
- Set up booking notifications
Select your industry
Choose the option that fits your business area:
- Medical practitioners — doctor appointments, cosmetologists, and health diagnostics.
- Equipment rental — construction, sports, event equipment, etc.
- Expert services — all types of counseling, repair work, beauty salon services.
- Car rental — cars and special vehicles.
- Property rental — banquet halls, apartments, houses, photo studios, etc.
- Other — select this option if you don't have the desired business area in the list.
Configure the resource
Name . Enter an expert's first and last name or any important information for the customer.
Type . Select it from the list or create a new one by entering its name and clicking Create custom type .

Information for customers . You can add an image and a brief description to help them learn more about the resource before booking. For example, upload photos of the specialists and include details about their education.

Services . Create or select services to associate with this resource like endocrinologist consultation. Customers will see the service when booking an appointment. The manager will see it in the booking form. Services created in the Booking section automatically appear in the CRM product catalog.
View mode . Select how the resource is displayed:
- Show in grid column header — the resource is always visible on the schedule board. Ideal for the main resources that customers book, like experts or rental cars.

- Show as an auxiliary resource — the resource isn't shown on the schedule board. It can only be used as part of a resource bundle, serving as an additional resource to the main one. For example, if the main resource is a doctor, the auxiliary resource could be a room.

Bookings . Enable the Calendar option to link bookings with the Bitrix24 calendar. This way, all bookings will automatically appear in employees’ personal calendars. Specialists can instantly see their schedules without having to check in multiple places. Configure the following settings:

- Users and calendars : Select the employees whose calendars will display the events. The booking will always appear in the calendar of the specialist providing the service, but you can also add other employees if needed. For example, add a supervisor to help track the team’s schedule and workload.

- Location : Choose a meeting room from the list if the specialist meets clients only there. The meeting room will be automatically added to the event to avoid any confusion about the location. Create and reserve meeting rooms
- Reminder : Set reminders so the employee doesn’t miss the booking. Decide how early to send the reminder, such as a day or an hour before the meeting.
If another event is already scheduled for that time, the new booking will still be added to the calendar.

Resource schedule . Specify the resource's availability for booking. To make the resource available only during the company's working hours, enable the Use company's business hours option. If you need to set a specific schedule for a resource, disable the option and specify the working days and hours.

Default booking duration . Define how long an appointment will last by default. Select a preset option—1 hour, 2 hours, 24 hours, or 7 days—or enter your own, then click Next . You can also adjust the duration when making a booking for a customer.
Set up booking notifications
Enable and configure reminders for both customers and booking agents. Customers will receive messages via WhatsApp, while an activity will be created for the agent in the CRM item form.
- New booking: Notifies the customer with the booking date, time, and resource name.

- Booking confirmation: Sends the customer a message with a link to confirm their appointment. If the customer doesn’t confirm, an activity is automatically created in the deal form for the agent to follow up.
- Booking reminder: Sends the customer a notification on the day of their booking.

- Reminder if the customer is late: If the customer is late, they receive a message asking them to confirm their appointment. If they don’t confirm, an activity is automatically created and assigned to the agent to follow up and free up the slot if needed.
Click Create Resource .
After adding resources, you can use them for customer bookings and track their availability. Add a client to a booking form
Edit or delete a resource

Select a resource on the schedule board and click the three dots next to its name. You can delete the resource or change its settings, for example, adjust the doctor's schedule. If the resource is temporarily unavailable, hide it. For example, if the doctor is on vacation.
In brief
- Bitrix24 Booking is a tool for customers to make appointments with specialists, rent rooms, equipment, etc.
- To get started, create and configure resources.
- All employees of your Bitrix24 account can create and edit resources.
- Select the resource type, customize its settings, and enable notifications for customers.
- After adding resources, you can use them for customer bookings and track their availability.

titre: Add a customer booking
sections: Add a customer booking
Bitrix24 Booking is a tool for customers to make appointments with specialists, rent rooms and equipment.
Check if this option is available on your plan. Bitrix24 plans and pricing
All employees can book services for clients. To do this, go to the Booking section.
In this article:
- Create a booking entry
- Add a customer to the booking
- Select resources
- Select services
- Link a deal to the booking
- Set up reminders for the customer
- Confirm the booking
- Confirm the appointment
- Edit or delete a booking
- Schedule multiple customers at the same time
Add an entry
You can create an entry for one day or for several days. For example, you can book a doctor's appointment for one day or reserve a guest house for several days.

Single-day entry 1. Switch to Day view in the top-right corner. 2. Click a time slot under the resource and select Create . 3. To create multiple entries for one client, select several slots, check the boxes, choose the customer, and click Create .

Multi-day entry 1. Switch to Week view in the top-right corner. Resources appear in rows, and days appear in columns. 2. Click the needed day in the schedule and select Create . 3. To change the booking time, click the entry date. 4. Enter the number of days and the booking time, then click Save .
Add a customer to the booking
You can create a new customer or select an existing one. New customers are automatically saved in CRM.
1. Click + Add or select in the booking form.
2. Enter a name, phone number, email, or company name to find a customer in CRM.
3. If the customer is not in CRM, click Create a new contact .
4. To specify additional details about the customer, click Add note .
5. Enter the note and save your changes.
Select resources
If a service requires multiple resources, you can add them to the booking form. For example, if service is a photoshoot, a photographer and a studio can be resources.
Select services

You can choose one or more services the customer is booking. The total amount is immediately displayed in the form. It allows the manager to add the necessary items and provide the final cost during the conversation with the customer.
1. Click Add and select the required items.
2. All selected services will automatically appear in the booking and deal forms.
Link a deal to the booking
You can link a booking entry to a specific deal in CRM or create a new one.
1. To create a new deal, click the plus icon (+), fill in the form, and save it.
2. To link an existing deal, click Select and choose a deal from CRM.
Create a deal
To edit or delete a deal linked to the booking, click the three dots (...) and choose the desired action.
Set up reminders for the customer
You can remind customers of an appointment via WhatsApp .
When you book a service, a message with the appointment details is automatically sent to the customer. You can manually choose and send a different message type, such as a booking confirmation.
Confirm the booking
If the client confirms the booking using the link in the message, it will be automatically updated in Bitrix24.
If the client doesn’t confirm the booking, you can call them and manually update the status.
Confirmed bookings are shown in green, and unconfirmed ones in blue. This allows you to quickly check the status and contact customers for confirmation if needed.
Confirm the appointment
To track attendance, mark whether the client showed up in each entry.
1. Click the arrow in the entry block.
2. In the Appointment section, click Select .
3. Choose the status: Visited or No-show .
Edit or delete a booking
You can reschedule an entry to another time. To do this, click on the time in the entry block and set a new time.
To delete an accidental booking, click the trash bin icon.
Schedule multiple customers at the same time
Overbooking allows you to schedule two customers for the same time slot. If one cancels or reschedules, the other keeps the slot.
You can add two customers to one slot in two ways:
1. Add a customer to the appointment . Click the arrow in the existing entry block and select Overbooking . Fill out the form by adding another customer and linking a deal.
2. Reschedule the appointment . Drag an existing appointment to an occupied slot.
Overbooking entries are highlighted in mustard color in the schedule.
Using overbooking may result in both customers arriving simultaneously. To avoid inconvenience, inform customers in advance about possible schedule changes or offer alternative appointment times.
In brief
- Bitrix24 Booking is a tool for customers to make appointments with specialists, rent rooms and equipment.
- All employees can book services for customers.
- To book services for customers, at least one resource should be created.
- Select a time slot under the desired resource and click Create . You can create several bookings for one customer at once.
- Add a customer, link a deal from CRM, and leave a note with important details in the entry.
- You can remind customers about their appointments via WhatsApp.
- When the client confirms the booking using a link from the message, it will be automatically updated in Bitrix24.

titre: Create a resource booking form
sections: Create a resource booking form
Use a booking form in Bitrix24 to let customers choose a time and book services. This helps you:
- Reduce manager workload. Customers book without calls or messages.
- Increase bookings. The form is available 24/7.
- Avoid errors. Data is saved automatically in CRM and the Booking section.
- Collect complete details. Customers fill in all required information.
In this article:
- Create a form
- Configure a form
- Work with the form
Create a form
1. Go to Booking.
2. Click Booking extensions.
3. Select a form type:
- Auto select resource The form suggests available times and specialists. Customers can change the date or time if needed.
- Select from available resources Customers see all open time slots for a selected date and choose one. Use this when time matters more than the specialist.
- Select from all resources Customers choose a specialist, date, and time. Use this when a specific specialist is important.
Configure the form
After you select a form type, set it up:
1. Open the form settings.
2. In the Fields tab, click the pencil icon next to Select resource.
3. Click Select.
4. Choose a resource.
5. Click Save.
6. Add the fields customers need to complete.
Create and configure CRM form
Work with the form
1. Go to Booking > Booking extensions > All forms.
2. Click the menu (≡) and select Edit.
You can share the form in several ways:
- Add it to your website
- Post it on social media
- Send it to customers via messenger
Place CRM form on Bitrix24 website Place CRM form on site created not in Bitrix24
In brief
- Use booking forms to let customers choose a time and book services.
- Choose from three form types based on your workflow.
- Create a form in Booking > Booking extensions.
