1. Type @ in the text and start entering the user’s name or the title of the task, article, space, or Drive folder in the search field.
2. You can also open the relevant tab next to the search field.
3. Select an employee or item — a link to it appears in the text.

4. If you mention another article, Bitrix24 creates a link between the two articles. A hyperlink icon with a counter appears below the title of the referenced article. Click the icon to see which articles link to it and open any of them.
In the mobile app, you can add links to employees, articles, spaces, tasks, or Drive folders. When you mention another article, Bitrix24 creates links between the articles just as it does on the web.
1. Type @ in the text and start entering the user’s name or the title of the task, article, space, or Drive folder in the search field.
2. You can also open the relevant tab next to the search field.
3. Select an employee or item — a link to it appears in the text. A Drive folder opens when you tap the link.
4. If you mention another article, a counter appears below its title. Tap the hyperlink icon to see related articles and open them.
In brief
- In Knowledge base 2.0, you can format an article manually using the formatting panel and built-in features, or with the CoPilot Agent.
- To edit an article manually, open it and click Edit . All changes are saved automatically. Click Done to exit editing mode.
- The formatting panel offers text styles, lists, tables, quotes, code blocks, callouts, indents, text and background colors, and options to insert links, files, videos, and images.
- Built-in features help you quickly resize media files and add mentions of employees, articles, spaces, tasks, and Drive folders.

titre: Knowledge base
sections: Knowledge base
A knowledge base helps you store and share important company information, such as internal policies, work schedules, and report templates. It also makes employee onboarding and training easier.

Creating a knowledge base in Bitrix24 is similar to creating a Bitrix24 site. Choose a template, edit the content blocks, and add images or videos. You can also create pages and categories from the main menu.
To view existing knowledge bases or create a new one:
1. Go to Employees .
2. Open the Knowledge base tab.
Company knowledge bases
Create separate knowledge bases for different departments to keep essential information organized and easy to access.
You can also add a knowledge base to a workgroup or project. Use it to:
- Document communication rules
- Store report templates
Workgroup and project knowledge bases
Each knowledge base includes view statistics:
- Man icon : Number of unique visitors. Multiple visits from the same employee count as one unique view.
- Eye icon : Total number of page views.

titre: Company knowledge base
sections: Company knowledge base
Every company has information employees need to access. Use a company knowledge base to keep everyone aligned and informed.
To create a company knowledge base:
1. Go to Employees > Knowledge base .
2. Click Create .
3. Choose how to start:
1. Select a template,
3. Create a blank knowledge base.
4. Enter a name and description. Choose a color theme, then click Create .
5. Update the menu structure. Click the settings icon to edit sections.
6. Add content to pages. Use blocks for text, images, and videos.
7. Open Knowledge base settings (top right). Set the URL, choose the main page, and adjust the design.
By default, all employees have full access to company knowledge bases. You can change access for all knowledge bases or for a specific one in the permissions settings.

titre: Workgroup and project knowledge base
sections: Workgroup and project knowledge base
A company knowledge base gives all employees access to shared information. You can also create separate knowledge bases for specific workgroups or projects.
To create a workgroup or project knowledge base:
1. Go to a workgroup or a project.
2. Click More and select Knowledge base .
If you cannot find the Knowledge base section
If the Knowledge base option does not appear in the workgroup or project menu, check the workgroup settings:
1. Click About workgroup in the top-right corner.
2. Under Actions , select Edit Workgroup or Edit Project .
3. Open Extended parameters .
4. Enable the Knowledge base option in the feature list.
3. Select one of the standard templates, download a template from the Market, or choose an empty template.
4. Click Create knowledge base in the top-right corner.
Your knowledge base is ready to use. You can:
- Create and edit pages
- Configure the navigation menu
- Add text, images, and videos
- Edit content blocks
Fill in your knowledge base
You can also create or select a company knowledge base directly from a workgroup or project:
1. Click the three-dot menu in the top-right corner.
2. Select Extensions .
3. Choose a knowledge base.
For quick access, move the knowledge base to the top menu.
Any member of a workgroup or project can edit its knowledge base. Access permissions are available only for company knowledge bases. Configure access permissions to a company knowledge base

titre: Build a knowledge base structure
sections: Build a knowledge base structure
Before you start building your knowledge base, plan the structure. All pages are organized into sections and subsections that appear in the menu.
Create a section in the menu
To add a new section, click New page and enter a name in the dialog. You can also add sections using the Edit button. In the editor, you can delete default sections and create new ones.
To rename a section, click its name and update it in the field below.
When you add menu items this way, the system automatically creates a new page.
Edit the menu
To move a section, hover over the left edge of the section block and drag it to a new position.
You can also add or delete menu items in the editor.
Create subsections
To create a subsection, drag a section to the right.
The section will be nested under another section and appear as a subsection in the menu.
Change the knowledge base menu image
You can also update the header image for your knowledge base. Open the menu next to the image and click Edit.
Upload a new image or create it using ImageAssistant AI. Then save the changes. ImageAssistant AI
Your sections are ready. You can now start adding content to your pages.

titre: Fill a knowledge base
sections: Fill a knowledge base
A knowledge base is made up of multiple connected pages, similar to Bitrix24 Sites. You can create pages and customize them with text, images, and content blocks.
Add new pages
1. Go to Employees > Knowledge base .
2. Click Actions > View pages .
3. Click New page .
4. Choose a template or start with a blank page.
Add the content you need using the tools described below.
Edit text
Click any text block to edit it. Replace the default text with your own. Use the pop-up toolbar to change the formatting.
When editing your text, you can select a part of it and add a link to another page of your knowledge base or any other external page.
Replace images
Click the image you want to replace. Then click the Upload button in the slider. Or, click Create to generate an image with the help of the ImageAssistance AI. ImageAssistant AI
After that, you can edit the uploaded image: crop it, apply filters, add stickers, etc. Graphics editor in Bitrix24 Sites
Manage blocks with quick actions
Use the actions panel on the right side of the page to manage blocks. Click arrows to move blocks up or down, click the trash bin button to delete the block.
Click the Actions button to expand the menu.
You can also save a block as a template using Save as custom block . This lets you reuse the block later. Save blocks as templates and create folder structure
Change block design
Click Design to adjust the appearance of a block. New interface for working with site design
Add new blocks
To add a new block, click the Add block button.
Select a block type you want to add in the menu on the left.

titre: Add a knowledge base to a section
sections: Add a knowledge base to a section

Use knowledge bases in Bitrix24 to guide users through common tasks. For example, show how to manage tasks or complete an employee profile. You can connect a knowledge base to different Bitrix24 tools so users can access help where they work.
Where you can add a knowledge base
Some sections include an Extensions button. Use it to attach a knowledge base.
Here are a few examples:
Profile : Add a knowledge base with instructions for filling out an employee profile. Profile page
User widget : Open the widget and choose a knowledge base under Extensions . User widget
Workgroup or project : Click the three dots in the top-right corner. Select an existing knowledge base or create a new one for that group only. Workgroup (project) knowledge base
Tasks automation : Go to Tasks > Automation rules > Extensions to add guidance for automation rules.
CRM : You can add a knowledge base to any CRM section.
Add a knowledge base to a section
Here’s an example for the Tasks section:
1. Go to Tasks and Projects .
2. Open the Tasks tab.
3. Click Extensions next to the gear icon.
4. If you don’t see it, click the three dots instead.
5. Choose one option:
1. Create a new knowledge base
2. Select an existing one
Create a knowledge base
After you add it, the knowledge base name replaces the Extensions button in the section.
To view all knowledge bases, go to Company > Knowledge base .
If you want to attach a different knowledge base to the same section, first hide the current one. Then repeat the steps above.

titre: Tables in Bitrix24 Sites, Stores, and Knowledge bases
sections: Tables in Bitrix24 Sites, Stores, and Knowledge bases
Create tables for sites, stores, and knowledge bases to display various structured data.
- Add a table
- Customize a table
- Copy a table
- Delete a table
Add a table
Open the site or article page in edit mode and choose where you want to put the table. In the Actions panel, click on the table icon.
The default table consists of four columns and four rows. Customize it however you like.
Customize a table
Add rows and columns . To add a row or column, click the plus (+) sign. Then adjust their size.
Move rows and columns . To change the position of columns and rows, drag them with the mouse to the desired place.
Delete rows and columns . To delete a row or column, select an item and click on the bin icon on the pop-up panel.
Change table style . Tables have several preset styles that change their appearance. You can also customize the background and text color individually.
To change the style,
1. Click on the tick in the corner of the table. The panel will pop up above.
2. Click Table style and select the appropriate one from the drop-down list.
To change the color of a row or column, click on it. Then pick a color from the palette.
To change the text color in a particular cell, select it and click the Color button.
If you want to select a text color for the row or column, click on the row or column, select the items, and then click the Color button.
Undo changes . To reverse the last action, click on the arrow in the top-right corner of the page. Alternatively, press Ctrl/Cmd + Z on the keyboard.
Copy a table
You can also copy tables to use in other blocks of your site.
1. Select the entire table by clicking on the tick.
2. Then click Copy table on the pop-up panel.
Insert the copied table into another block. Select the desired position and click the special icon on the panel.
Delete a table
Delete a table in a couple of clicks if you don't need it anymore.
1. Select the entire table by clicking on the tick.
2. Then click the bin icon on the pop-up panel.

titre: Add a file from Bitrix24 Drive to Knowledge base
sections: Add a file from Bitrix24 Drive to Knowledge base
Add files to the knowledge base so colleagues can view and download them anytime. For example, you might include a leave request template or a company video.
To do this, open the desired knowledge base page, select and add a button, and upload your file. When a colleague clicks the button, the file will open.
Add a button
1. Go to Company .
2. Open the Knowledge base section.
3. Open the knowledge base where you want to add your file.
4. Click Edit article in the top right corner.
5. In edit mode, click Add block .
6. Open the Buttons and links tab.
7. Select a suitable block, such as Text arranged in two rows; button on the right .
Upload a file
You can add a file from the personal, company, or group drive. Supported file types include DOCX, XLSX, PPTX, PDF, JPG, GIF, PNG, and MP4.
1. Click Contact .
2. Under Action on click , click the arrow icon.
3. Choose Open file from the list.
4. Click Select file .
5. Find the document you want to add and click on it.
6. Click Select document .
7. Change the button name.
8. Save the changes.
Done! When an employee clicks this button, the file will open.
File upload issues and solutions
On the first attempt to open a file, Bitrix24 may take some time to load it. When you see the Conversion in progress notification, please wait. The loading time depends on the file size.
If you try to open an unsupported file type, you will see a notification. Download the file to view it.
In brief
- Add files to the knowledge base so colleagues can view and download them anytime. For example, you might include a leave request template or a company video.
- Open the desired knowledge base page, select and add a button, and upload the file. When a colleague clicks the button, the file will open.
- You can add a file from the personal, company, or group drive. Supported file types include DOCX, XLSX, PPTX, PDF, JPG, GIF, PNG, and MP4.
- On the first attempt to open a file, Bitrix24 may take some time to load it. When you see the Conversion in progress notification, please wait. The loading time depends on the file size.
- If you try to open an unsupported file type, you will see a notification. Download the file to view it.

titre: Company knowledge bases: Access permissions
sections: Company knowledge bases: Access permissions

By default, all your employees have full access to the company knowledge bases. You can adjust access permissions for all or specific knowledge bases of this type. Only administrators can configure these settings.
Check if your plan allows editing access permissions for company knowledge bases. Bitrix24 plans and pricing
Step 1: Open access settings
1. Go to the Employees section.
2. Open the Knowledge base tab.
3. Click Settings (⚙️).
4. Select Access Permissions .
Step 2: Create a role
1. Click Add in the roles block and name the role.
2. Configure general access permissions, such as whether the knowledge base can be placed in different sections. Add a knowledge base to a section
3. Click Add knowledge base permissions and select a specific knowledge base.
4. Customize permissions for the selected knowledge base.
5. Save the role.
Step 3: Assign the role
Assign the added role to employees or departments.

Permissions set in the Knowledge base section take priority over individual knowledge base permissions. If an employee has full access to the section, they can see all knowledge bases, even if some are restricted.
To configure access permissions for workgroup (project) knowledge bases, see this article: Workgroup knowledge base: Access permissions .
In brief
- By default, all employees have full access to the company knowledge bases.
- Only administrators can configure access permissions for knowledge bases.
- Permissions set in the Knowledge base section override individual knowledge base permissions.
- You can create custom roles and assign them to employees or departments.

titre: Workgroup knowledge base: Access permissions
sections: Workgroup knowledge base: Access permissions
Configure access permissions to knowledge bases in your workgroups and projects. Decide which users have editing privileges and which users cannot view a knowledge base within a specific workgroup.
Click About workgroup and select Roles and permissions to open the settings.
Scroll down to the bottom and configure access to view, edit, and delete the knowledge base. You can also manage access to edit the knowledge base settings.
There are four default user groups you can select under each action:
- workgroup owner
- owner and moderators
- all workgroup members
- authorized users
For example, you allow all authorized users to view a knowledge base in a specific workgroup. The way of accessing it depends on the workgroup privacy type.
If it is private or hidden, send a link to the workgroup knowledge base to a user who is not a member of this workgroup.
If your workgroup is public, any user can open it and access its knowledge base. They don't have to join the workgroup in this case.

titre: Transfer knowledge bases
sections: Transfer knowledge bases
Transfer your knowledge bases from one Bitrix24 account to another.
Export your knowledge base
1. Go to the Employees section > Knowledge base tab.
2. Select the knowledge base you want to transfer, click Actions > Export .
3. Click the Export button to create an archive file.
4. Click Download to save the zip file on your computer.
Import your knowledge base
Log in to another Bitrix24 account and follow these steps:
1. Go to Employees section > Knowledge base tab.
2. Open the Settings > Import knowledge base .
3. Then click Upload and select the downloaded file.
4. Wait until the loading is complete and use the transferred knowledge base.

titre: Delete a knowledge base
sections: Delete a knowledge base
To delete a knowledge base:
1. Go to Employees > Knowledge base tab.
2. Select the knowledge base you want to remove.
3. Click Actions > Delete knowledge base .
The system moves the deleted knowledge base to the recycle bin. It stays there for 30 days.
To view deleted knowledge bases:
1. Open the Recycle bin .
2. Use the filter to find knowledge bases.
Each item shows how many days remain before permanent deletion.
To restore a knowledge base:
1. Open the Recycle bin .
2. Find the knowledge base.
3. Click Actions > Recover knowledge base .

titre: FAQ: Knowledge base
sections: FAQ: Knowledge base

In Bitrix24, you can create a knowledge base, which is an online resource with clear navigation and built-in search. Use it to store instructions, policies, and other important information. It helps new employees get up to speed faster and keeps your team aligned on shared processes.
In this article:
- Which plans include knowledge bases
- Add a video to a knowledge base
- Add a search bar to a knowledge base
- Change the cover of a knowledge base
- Create a custom knowledge base template
- Hide a specific knowledge base from an employee
Which plans include knowledge bases
Knowledge bases are available on all Bitrix24 plans. Available features depend on your plan. Bitrix24 plans and pricing
Number of company knowledge bases:
- Free — 1
- Basic — 3
- Standard — 3
- Professional and Enterprise — unlimited
Group and project knowledge bases are available on Standard, Professional, and Enterprise plans.
Import and export are available on all plans.
Access permissions are available on Standard, Professional, and Enterprise plans.
Add a video to a knowledge base
You can add videos from YouTube or Bitrix24 Drive. Videos help explain processes and improve training materials.
Open a knowledge base:
- Company-wide: go to Employees > Knowledge base .
- Workgroup: go to Workgroups , open a group, then click More > Knowledge base in the top menu.
Add a video:
1. Open the knowledge base.
2. Click Edit article .
3. Choose where to place the video and click Add block .
Add a video from an external service:
1. Open the Video tab and choose a template.
2. Click Edit .
3. Copy the video URL.
4. Paste it into the Video link field.
5. Choose autoplay or click-to-play .
6. Save.
Add a video from Bitrix24 Drive:
1. Go to Buttons and links .
2. Select a template and click the button.
3. Enter a label.
4. Choose Open file as the action.
5. Click Select file and choose the video.
6. Save.
Add a file from Bitrix24 Drive to Knowledge base
Add a search bar to a knowledge base
You can add or replace a search bar in your knowledge base.
Open a knowledge base:
- Company-wide: go to Employees > Knowledge base .
- Workgroup: go to Workgroups , open a group, then click More > Knowledge base in the top menu.
Add a search bar:
1. Open the knowledge base.
2. Click Edit article .
3. Go to the Sidebar tab.
4. Select Search bar or Search field .
5. Click Design to customize it.
Change the cover of a knowledge base
A custom cover helps your knowledge base stand out.
1. Go to Employees > Knowledge base .
2. Open the knowledge base.
3. Click Edit article > Settings (⚙️) > Page settings .
4. Click the pencil icon on the cover.
5. Upload or generate an image.
6. Save.
Create a custom knowledge base template
You cannot save a knowledge base as a reusable template. Instead, use export and import.
Export:
1. Go to Employees > Knowledge base .
2. Select a knowledge base.
3. Click Actions > Export > Download .
Import:
1. Click Settings (⚙️) > Import Knowledge base > Upload .
2. Select the archive.
3. Open it and click Edit article if needed.
Hide a knowledge base from an employee

In Bitrix24, you can create roles with different access levels for knowledge bases and assign them to employees, groups, or departments. Users only see the knowledge bases included in their permissions. If a role does not include access to a specific knowledge base, the employee will not see it.
1. Go to Employees > Knowledge base > Settings (⚙️) > Access permissions .
2. Click Add > Add specific permissions for a knowledge base .
3. Select the knowledge base.
4. Enter a role name and configure permissions.
Knowledge base section
- View allowed: The employee can open the section and see the list of knowledge bases.
- View not allowed: The Knowledge base section is hidden from the menu. The employee can only open available knowledge bases using direct links.
- Full access: Set to No access . If a user has full access to the section, they will see all knowledge bases, including restricted ones.
Knowledge base list
- Set all actions to No access . This prevents users from exporting restricted knowledge bases or sharing them.
Content of all knowledge bases
- Set all actions to No access . This hides all knowledge bases except those with specific permissions.
Specific permissions for a knowledge base
Choose an option for each action:
- View: Required to open the knowledge base.
- Edit: Allows the user to update content.
- Change settings: Allows updates to settings and design, such as name, colors, background, and fonts.
- Delete: Allows the user to delete the knowledge base.
5. Save the changes.
Assign roles to employees:
1. Click Add .
2. Select users, groups, or departments.
3. Assign a role and save.
Users will only see knowledge bases allowed by their roles. If they open a restricted link, they will see an access error.

titre: Copy knowledge base pages
sections: Copy knowledge base pages
When you build a knowledge base, you often need multiple pages with the same layout. Instead of starting from scratch, copy an existing page and update its content.
1. Go to Employees > Knowledge base .
2. Open the knowledge base and click Actions > View pages .
3. Find the page you want to reuse. Click Actions > Copy page .
4. Choose where to save the copy:
1. Keep it in the same knowledge base, or
2. Move it to another one.
5. Select the destination and click Copy .
After you copy the page, replace the content with your own. Fill a knowledge base

titre: Telephony connection options overview
sections: Telephony connection options overview

Bitrix24 Telephony gives you reliable call quality and a full set of tools, including inbound and outbound calls, call recording, and CRM integration. To start making calls, connect a phone number. This guide explains all available connection options.
Go to the CRM section > Sales > Sales channels > Telephony .
Available telephony connection options
Rent a number Get a virtual phone number from the built-in telephony provider.
Connect SIP PBX using a SIP connector Link your office or cloud PBX using the built-in SIP connector.
Connect SIP PBX using REST API Connect your PBX through a Market app.
If you don’t have a business number, rent one in Bitrix24. If you already have a number, connect it using a SIP connector or REST API.
You can use multiple connection options in one account. However, avoid using both a SIP connection and an app from the same provider at the same time, as this may cause errors.
Rent a number
1. Go to CRM > Sales > Sales channels > Telephony Payments for Telephony
2. Click Rent a number .
3. Choose the country, region, and number type. The system assigns a number automatically.
4. Upload documents if required. Some regions need identity or address verification. Processing usually takes up to two business days.
Connect SIP PBX using a SIP connector
If you use a number from another provider, connect it as a cloud or office PBX. Make sure your PBX supports the SIP protocol.
To connect:
1. Go to CRM > Sales > Sales channels > Telephony .
2. Select Cloud PBX or Office PBX .
3. Enter the server address, login, and password. Get these details from your PBX provider.
Your provider handles call charges. You don’t need to top up your Bitrix24 balance.
You get 60 free minutes to test outbound calls. After that, purchase the SIP connector to continue using outbound calling.
SIP connector
Connect SIP PBX using REST API
1. Go to CRM > Sales > Sales channels > Telephony .
2. Open the Telephony integrations section.
3. Click Total apps and choose an app in Catalog > Communication channels > Telephony .
With this option, call routing and traffic are managed on your PBX side. This can reduce connection time and improve call quality compared to the SIP connector.
You can’t make calls from the browser, Bitrix24 Messenger, or the mobile app. Use a softphone app or a SIP phone instead.
Differences between the SIP connector and REST API

titre: Make and answer calls in Bitrix24
sections: Make and answer calls in Bitrix24
Use Bitrix24 Telephony to manage incoming and outgoing calls. The call form opens automatically when you make or receive a call.
Make calls in the browser and Bitrix24 Messenger
You can make calls in three ways:
1. From CRM
2. Using the dialer in the chat panel
3. From chats with call notifications
Make calls from CRM
Click a phone number in the customer form, the phone icon, or the Call button in the activity form on the timeline.
To call without opening the CRM form, click the phone icon in the Kanban view.
Use the dialer
Click the phone icon in the chat panel to open the dialer. Enter a phone number and click Call .
Make calls from chats
You can call customers directly from chats with call notifications. If you miss a call, a missed call notification appears in the chat. Click the customer’s phone number in the chat to call back.
How to call from the mobile app
You can make calls in three ways:
1. from CRM
2. using the dialer
3. from chat rooms with call notifications
Make calls from CRM
Open the customer form in the mobile app. Go to Menu > CRM > Call > Call using Bitrix24 .
To call without opening the contact form, tap the phone icon in the Kanban view and select Call using Bitrix24 .
Use the dialer
To call a new number, go to Menu > Call , enter the number, and tap the phone icon.
Make calls from chats
Open the chat with the customer you want to call. Tap the phone number and select Using Bitrix24 .
Receive incoming calls in the browser and Bitrix24 Messenger
To answer a call, click Answer in the call form. To reject the call, click Ignore .
How to receive incoming calls in the mobile app

The call form on the mobile device has two views. If the Bitrix24 mobile app is closed during the call, you will see a regular call form. If you are working in the mobile app at the moment of the call, the Bitrix24 call form will be displayed.
How to handle calls on the phone
You can make calls from a phone in Bitrix24, receive incoming calls and transfer calls to other employees.
Outbound calls

If you are calling from a browser or the Bitrix24 Messenger application, the call goes through the phone by default. Click the phone button to switch the call to the browser. If the button is blue, the call goes from the phone, and if the button is green, the call goes from the browser or the Bitrix24 Messenger app. To end the call on the phone, click Hang up.
The left form: the call goes through the phone. The right form: the call goes through the browser.
Incoming calls. An incoming call is going to the browser, Bitrix24 Messenger, mobile application and the phone at the same time. To answer the call, pick up the phone.
In brief
- The call form is a built-in tool for managing calls. It opens automatically for incoming and outgoing calls.
- You can make calls from CRM, the mobile app, Bitrix24 Messenger, the dialer, and chats with call notifications.
- If you miss a call, a notification appears in the chat. You can call the customer back directly from the chat.
- The mobile app supports two calling methods:
- through your mobile operator using Call
- through Bitrix24 Telephony using Call using Bitrix24
- The incoming call screen in the mobile app depends on whether the app is open or running in the background.
- If a phone is connected, calls use the phone by default. You can switch the call to the browser using the phone icon.

titre: Active call form
sections: Active call form

The active call form appears during inbound and outbound calls in Bitrix24. In the web version, it opens as a call window in your browser or Bitrix24 Messenger. In the mobile app, it appears as a dedicated call screen.
Use the active call form to manage calls and work with CRM records during a conversation.
Active call form features
During an inbound call, the call window shows the caller’s and recipient’s phone numbers. If you cannot answer the call, click Ignore to send it to the queue.
During an outbound call, the window only shows the client’s phone number.
If you connected a SIP phone, Bitrix24 routes outbound calls through that device by default. To switch the call to the browser, click the blue phone icon.
Learn more:
- Make and answer calls in Bitrix24
- Route an outgoing call from the phone to the browser
The screenshot on the left shows an inbound call. The screenshot on the right shows an outbound call window.

If you use a REST application, the call window only includes the Close button. You cannot make calls from the browser, Bitrix24 Messenger, or the mobile app. Use a separate softphone app or SIP phone instead.
Learn more about the difference between SIP connection and REST applications
After you answer a call, these options become available:
- Hold : Put the call on hold.
- Mute : Turn your microphone on or off.
- Arrow : Transfer the call to another user. Learn more about call transfer
- Keyboard : Enter an extension number.
You can also add a comment during the call. Click Comment , enter your text, and save it before the call ends. Bitrix24 saves the comment in the related activity and under Call Details.
You can minimize the call window and continue working in Bitrix24 during the call. To restore the full window, click the small arrow on the right.
In the Bitrix24 mobile app, the active call form looks similar to the standard call screen on a smartphone.
The screenshot on the left shows an inbound call. The screenshot on the right shows an outbound call screen.
The mobile call form includes these options:
- Mute : Turn your microphone on or off.
- Keyboard : Enter an extension number.
- Hold : Put the call on hold.
- Speaker : Turn on speaker mode.
Create CRM records from the active call form
You can create CRM records manually from the call window or set up automatic lead or deal creation.
Go to Telephony > Configure numbers > CRM integration . Under If the number is not registered with CRM , select the option you want.
Learn how to configure CRM integration
If you select offer to create a new record in the call window , Bitrix24 does not automatically save calls from new clients as leads.
To create a CRM record manually:
1. Click Add new lead or Add new contact in the call window.
2. Bitrix24 opens a new browser tab.
3. Create the CRM record.
You can also select create a new lead automatically . In this case, Bitrix24 automatically creates a new lead with the client’s phone number.

When you call an existing client, the related CRM record appears in the call window. Before the call ends, click Deal or Invoice to create a new deal or invoice. Bitrix24 opens a new browser tab where you can create the record.
If you use Simple CRM mode (without leads) and enable automatically create a new lead , Bitrix24 creates a new deal and contact instead.
You can also create a new deal or invoice directly from the call window.

If you select offer to create a new record in the call window , you can create a lead or contact during the call. If you create a lead, Bitrix24 automatically converts it into a contact after you save the changes.
Learn more about CRM modes
If you select offer to create a new record in the call window :
1. Tap Open CRM .
2. Select Create lead or Add contact .
3. Fill out the form.
4. Tap Create in the top-right corner.
If you use Simple CRM mode (without leads) and enable automatically create a new lead , Bitrix24 creates a new deal and contact instead.
You can also create a new deal or invoice directly from the call window.

If you select offer to create a new record in the call window , you can create a lead or contact during the call. If you create a lead, Bitrix24 automatically converts it into a contact after you save the changes.
Learn more about CRM modes
In brief
- The active call form appears during inbound and outbound calls.
- Use it to put calls on hold, manage the speaker and microphone, and enter extension numbers.
- Call transfer is only available in the web version.
- Minimize the call form to continue working in CRM during a call.
- Create CRM records manually from the call window or configure automatic lead or deal creation in the number settings.

titre: Tech requirements for using Telephony
sections: Tech requirements for using Telephony
If you have any problems with Bitrix24 Telephony, please check the following requirements:
1. Internet connection speed - no less than 128 Kbps (Kilobits per second) for each conversation.
2. Supported Internet browsers:
1. Google Chrome (recommended);
2. Mozilla Firefox;
3. Edge;
4. Safari.

3. If you're using Bitrix24 Messenger for calls, it should be version 7 or newer. WebRTC technology uses HTTPS protocol. Thus, you need to get a trusted SSL certificate to make voice calls and video calls via Bitrix24 Messenger. A self-signed certificate may cause incorrect work. This applies to Bitrix24 Cloud version with own domain and Bitrix24 Self-hosted version.
4. To make calls, you need a headset or configured SIP phone connected.
5. If you use SIP phones and To everybody type of call distribution, incoming calls cannot be transferred to more than 10 phones (devices). This is Voximplant's limitation.
6. Local network settings must be done. You can get a list of settings from Bitrix24 Support .
7. Voximplant supports G711 (u-law and a-law) , Opus , ILBC , H.264 , VP8 codecs.
8. Call quality test
1. Browser version;
2. SDK Load;
3. Access to the microphone;
4. Authorization;
5. Connection quality.
9. Ad-blocking software used in your browser or antivirus can also block calls. Just add your Bitrix24 account address and the call quality test website to exceptions in this software.

titre: Redirect calls to other employees
sections: Redirect calls to other employees
In Bitrix24, you can transfer incoming calls to other employees or departments. Call forwarding works in the browser, Bitrix24 Messenger, and on SIP phones.
Redirect incoming calls in the browser and Bitrix24 Messenger
In the call window, click the arrow icon to open the call forwarding menu. From there, you can transfer the call to an employee or a telephony user group. Configure queue groups
Transfer a call to an employee. Use one of these tabs in the call window:
- Recent : Search for an employee by first or last name.
- Departments : Find an employee in the company structure.
Click the employee’s name and choose one of these options:
- Internal call : Transfer the call inside Bitrix24.
- Mobile phone forwarding : Transfer the call to the employee’s mobile number.
Transfer a call to a telephony user group. Select the group you want to transfer the call to.
After you choose an employee or a group, click Redirect . You can use one of these transfer modes:
Blind forwarding. The call transfers directly to another employee.
- Your call ends when the second employee answers.
- To leave the call immediately, click Redirect again.
- The customer hears a ringtone while waiting.
- If the second employee does not answer, the call ends.
Forwarding with prior consultation. You can speak with another employee before connecting them to the customer.
- The customer hears a ringtone during the consultation.
- Click Redirect again to connect the customer to the second employee.
Redirect incoming calls on a phone
If you use a SIP phone, you can transfer calls by using an employee’s extension number. Make sure the extension number is added to the employee’s profile. Calls to extension numbers
General steps for call forwarding:
1. Start call forwarding on the phone. Each device uses different button combinations.
2. Enter the employee’s extension number.
3. Speak with the employee before the transfer. The customer cannot hear this conversation.
4. Confirm the transfer.
5. Hang up the phone.
Bitrix24 Support does not configure phones, so there is no universal setup guide. Check your phone manual or contact the manufacturer for instructions on call transfer and hold functions.
Example: Call forwarding on Grandstream GXP2160
1. Start a conversation with the customer.
2. Press the transfer button.
3. Enter the extension number.
4. Speak with the employee.
5. Press the transfer button again.
6. Hang up.
In brief
- You can transfer incoming calls to employees or telephony user groups.
- You can transfer a call to another employee, an employee’s mobile number, or a telephony user group.
- Each phone model uses different transfer button combinations. Check the device manual or contact the manufacturer for details.

titre: Test your telephony connection quality
sections: Test your telephony connection quality
Make sure you can make and receive calls in your browser. Run a call quality test in your telephony settings.
Connect your headphones before you start the test. You won’t hear the test audio without headphones or speakers. You also need a microphone to complete the test.
Ad blockers or antivirus software may block calls. Add your Bitrix24 account address and the test page to the exception list.
Take the test
To check your connection quality, open: https://echo.voximplant.com/iframe.html Then click Get started .
The test checks:
- Browser version
- SDK load
- Media access
- Authorization
- Test call
- Connection quality (audio clarity and packet loss)
When the test finishes, you’ll see the results. If there’s an issue, the page will show how to fix it.
If everything is working, the test will pass successfully.
Allow microphone access in your browser
A common issue is a missing or blocked microphone.
Browsers usually ask for microphone access in a pop-up. If you don’t see it and the test says no microphone is found, allow access in your browser settings.
Apple Safari
Right-click the address bar and select Settings for this site .
Set Microphone to Allow or Ask .
Reload the test page.
Google Chrome
Or click the microphone icon in the address bar > allow https://echo.voximplant.com to access your microphone > click Done .
Reload the page.
Mozilla Firefox
Click the crossed-out microphone icon in the address bar.
Remove the restriction in Permissions .
Reload the page and click Allow in the pop-up.
Opera
Click the crossed-out microphone icon in the address bar.
Click Clear this setting and reload .
Then click Allow in the pop-up.
Vivaldi
Click the crossed-out microphone icon > Change .
In the site settings window, click Delete next to the website.
Reload the page and click Allow .
Microsoft Edge (Chromium)
Click the lock icon > set Microphone to Allow .
Or click the crossed-out microphone icon > allow https://echo.voximplant.com to access your microphone > click Done .
Reload the page.
You can use the same steps for your Bitrix24 account address.

titre: Fix incoming call issues in the Bitrix24 mobile app
sections: Fix incoming call issues in the Bitrix24 mobile app

If an incoming call through Bitrix24 telephony does not reach the mobile app or arrives without sound, the issue is usually related to your phone settings. Your mobile operating system may restrict background activity or block notifications. To fix this, check the Bitrix24 app permissions in your phone settings.
In this article:
- Check permissions on Android
- Check permissions on iPhone
Check permissions on Android
Review these permissions for the Bitrix24 app. Menu names and permission labels may vary by device model and Android version. If you do not see the exact option, look for a similar setting.
Notifications. Make sure notifications are turned on for the app. Also confirm that sound and vibration are enabled for Bitrix24 notifications. On some devices, these are separate settings.

Lock screen. Allow the Bitrix24 mobile app to show notifications on the lock screen. Without this permission, calls may not show when your phone is locked. This setting may appear as On lock screen , Show content on lock screen , or something similar.

Pop-up windows and display over other apps. These permissions allow Bitrix24 to show the incoming call screen while you use another app. Without them, the call may arrive, but the Bitrix24 app will not open. To find it, search your phone settings for keywords such as “over” or “pop-up windows.”

Background activity. Make sure the app can run in the background. Otherwise, Android may restrict the app, which can delay calls or block them completely. In your phone settings, open the battery or power management section and remove any restrictions for Bitrix24. Depending on the device, this setting may appear as Don't optimize , Allow background activity , Unrestricted , or something similar.
Autostart. On some devices, you also need to allow the app to start in the background. This setting may appear as Autostart , Background activity , App launch , or something similar.

Example: Xiaomi devices running HyperOS. Additional permissions are available in the Other permissions section. Go to Settings > Apps > Bitrix24 > Other permissions and make sure these options are enabled:
- Show on Lock screen: Allows the call screen to show over the lock screen.
- Open new windows while running in the background: Allows the call screen to open when the app is not active.
- Display pop-up windows: Allows the incoming call screen to show over other apps.
Check permissions on iPhone
Compared to Android, iOS requires fewer additional permissions. Check the notification settings for the Bitrix24 app.
Go to Settings > Apps > Bitrix24 > Notifications and enable:
- Allow Notifications
- Lock Screen
- Notification Center
- Banners
- Sounds
After checking the permissions, restart the Bitrix24 mobile app. If calls still do not arrive, contact Bitrix24 Support. Contact Bitrix24 Support

titre: SIP connector subscription
sections: SIP connector subscription
The SIP connector subscription lets you handle calls through your PBX. You can receive incoming calls and make outgoing calls directly in Bitrix24.
SIP connector
Place your order:
1. Log in to your Bitrix24 account.
2. Go to CRM > Sales > Sales channels > Telephony .
3. In the Balance and Statistics section, select SIP connector .
4. Click Connect .

titre: Low telephony balance notification
sections: Low telephony balance notification
Bitrix24 automatically alerts administrators when the telephony balance is low. Notifications differ based on the administrator role.

- First administrator Bitrix24 tracks your average spending over the last seven days. If your current balance won’t cover two more days at that rate, the first administrator receives an email notification. Example message: Hello, Thank you for using Bitrix24 telephony. At your current spending rate, your balance may run out in two days. You won’t be able to make calls or use telephony features. To avoid interruptions, add funds to your account at accountaddress.bitrix24.com/telephony/. You can review detailed call costs on the Balance and statistics page. Best regards, Bitrix24 Team

- Other administrators If you have rented phone numbers or made calls within the last five days and your balance drops below $6, Bitrix24 shows a red warning bar at the top of the page for all administrators. All administrators also receive a chat notification prompting them to add funds. If the red warning bar remains after you top up your balance, open the Telephony section. The notification will disappear.

titre: Check and top up the telephony balance in Bitrix24
sections: Check and top up the telephony balance in Bitrix24

To ensure uninterrupted telephony in Bitrix24, it is important to monitor the balance and top it up on time. If the funds run out, calls will stop working, and employees won’t be able to contact customers.
In this article:
- When the low telephony balance notification appears
- How to check and top up the telephony balance
- How to check call costs
When the low telephony balance notification appears
Bitrix24 sends a low telephony balance notification if the funds might not be enough to cover phone numbers and calls for the next few days. When checking the balance, Bitrix24 considers:
- Payments for phone numbers that need to be renewed within three days.
- Call expenses for the next four days, calculated based on the average spending over the last seven days.
If the balance is below this amount, Bitrix24 administrators will see a notification at the top of the screen and in the Notifications section of the Messenger.
How to check and top up the telephony balance
You can check and top up the telephony balance directly in Bitrix24.

1. Go to CRM > Customers > Contact Center > Telephony > Connection . 2. In the Balance and statistics block, you will see the current account balance. Click Top up to open the telephony operator’s Voximplant account. 3. Click Payment methods and choose a suitable option: card payment or bank transfer.
Bank transfer is available only for legal entities.
When paying by bank card, you must enter your phone number in the Mobile number field. Without providing a number, you cannot top up the balance.
How to check call costs
To understand how much the company spends on calls, use the call details section.
1. Open the Call details section. 2. Click Settings (⚙️). 3. Select the Cost column and click Apply . 4. Now the list will show the cost of each call.
For convenience, you can set up filters, for example, to view expenses for a specific employee over a period.
1. Click Filter and Search > Add fields and check the necessary fields. 2. Fill in the fields in the filter. For example, to view an employee’s expenses for the current week:
- Call date — select This week .
- Employee — choose the required user.
- Call type — specify if you want to view only certain calls, such as outgoing.
- Status — select Successful call to see only completed calls.
3. Click Search to display the list of calls matching the criteria.
In brief
- To ensure uninterrupted telephony in Bitrix24, monitor the balance and top it up on time.

- Bitrix24 sends a low telephony balance notification if funds might not be enough to cover phone numbers and calls for the next few days. Administrators will see the notification at the top of the screen and in the Notifications section of the Messenger.
- You can check the telephony balance in the CRM > Customers > Contact Center > Telephony > Connection section. Click Top up to pay for telephony.
- To understand call expenses, open the Call details > Settings (⚙️) section. Add the Cost column and click Apply .

titre: Rent a number
sections: Rent a number

Set up telephony to make and answer calls in Bitrix24. If you have a number, install the SIP connection or connect it using REST API. If you don't have a number, rent a virtual one in Bitrix24. The phone number provider is Voximplant Inc.
To rent a number, go to the CRM > Add-ons > Telephony . On the Connection page, do the following:

1. Top up your balance . The monthly payment for renting a phone number is made from your telephony balance. To fill it up, click Top up in the Bitrix24 Telephony block. Payment for Bitrix24 Telephony
2. Click Rent a number , and the panel will slide from the right of the page.
3. Select a country, state, and region where you want to rent a number.
4. Then choose the type of number: local, mobile, or toll-free.
The next steps depend on the chosen country. If no additional details appear on the page, click Rent at the bottom to finish. Otherwise, see the next step.

5. Upload documentation . The system may request that you upload verification documents for some regions or countries. It may include proof of address, a passport, or an ID copy. Some countries also require proof of residence. This implies a passport or national ID and a utility bill with the residence address clearly visible. To proceed, click Upload verification documentation and complete the form. Submitted documents are usually processed by Voximplant Inc. within two business days. You can check the approval status in the Upload documentation block.
That's it! The number will appear under My numbers .

The rental period starts immediately after the payment is made from your telephony balance. The rent is charged monthly, and the renewal is automatic. For example, you've rented a number on February 1, 2024. Then the next write-off will be on March 1, 2024.
In brief
- Rent a number in Bitrix24 to make and answer calls.
- To rent a number, top up your telephony balance and upload verification documents if required.
- The rent is charged monthly from your telephony balance.

titre: Rent a toll-free number
sections: Rent a toll-free number
A toll-free number lets customers call your company at no cost. Businesses that use toll-free numbers often receive more inbound calls.
To rent a number, go to CRM > Sales > Sales channels > Telephony > Connection > Rent a number .
Choose a toll-free number
Select:
- Country
- Number type
- Category
After you select the options, complete the rental.
Connection features
Toll-free numbers include the same features as local numbers. You can:
- Set up call routing
- Configure working hours
- Manage call handling rules
- Track call activity
Monthly fee
Toll-free numbers cost more than local numbers.
Example (USA):
- Local number: $4 per month
- Toll-free number: $6 per month
Charges for incoming calls
With a toll-free number, you pay for incoming calls because customers are not charged for dialing the number.
Outbound calls
Outbound calls from toll-free numbers are not available in most countries. Use a local number if you need to make outgoing calls.
For country-specific details, contact Voximplant support: support@voximplant.com .
Call forwarding costs
If you enable call forwarding, charges apply for:
- the incoming call to the toll-free number
- the forwarded outgoing call
Call forwarding works only if outbound calls are supported for the number.
Country restrictions
In most countries, toll-free numbers can only be called from within the same country.
Example: A toll-free number registered in Australia can usually be called only from Australia.
U.S. toll-free numbers are an exception. Calls from other countries are usually allowed but may be charged to the caller.
Reduce costs for after-hours calls
You are charged for incoming calls even outside business hours, regardless of whether the call is answered.
To reduce costs, use the options below.
Adjust your phone availability settings
- Set business hours for the number Working time settings for phone numbers
- Inform callers that support is unavailable outside working hours
Use the blacklist
You can also block unwanted calls.
Go to CRM > Sales > Sales channels > Telephony > Configure telephony > Blacklist .
Add phone numbers to prevent them from calling your toll-free number. Blacklist
Auto block repeated calls
Enable the Auto block phone numbers outside office hours option. If the same number calls repeatedly within a short time, it will be automatically added to the blacklist. Call details
In brief
- Customers can call your toll-free number at no cost.
- You pay for incoming calls. Outbound calls are usually not available for toll-free numbers.
- Call forwarding adds extra charges.
- Configure working hours or use the blacklist to avoid unnecessary costs.

titre: Disconnect a rented phone number in Bitrix24
sections: Disconnect a rented phone number in Bitrix24

If you no longer use a rented phone number, disconnect the number to stop paying for a service you no longer need. For example, you may have changed your company phone number or finished an advertising campaign.
In this article:
- How to disconnect a phone number
- What happens after you disconnect a phone number
How to disconnect a phone number
You can disconnect a number from the list of phone numbers or from that number's settings. Use whichever method works best for you.
From the number list.

1–4. Open CRM > Customers > Contact Center > Telephony . 5. In the My numbers section, click Set up — this opens the number list. 6–7. Next to the number you need, click Menu (≡) > Disconnect number .
From the settings of a specific number.

1–4. Open CRM > Customers > Contact Center > Telephony . 5–7. On the Connection tab, click Set up numbers and select the number you need from the list. 8. The number settings open. Go to the Disconnect number tab. 9. Click Disconnect number .
What happens after you disconnect a phone number
After you click Disconnect number , a confirmation pop-up appears. Choose an option:
- Click OK to confirm the disconnection.
- Click Cancel to keep the number connected.

The account administrator will receive an email about the number disconnection, along with a link to cancel it. If you disconnected the number by mistake or changed your mind, follow the link in the email within 24 hours.

If you don't cancel the disconnection, the number will be disconnected permanently after 24 hours. You can use this time to update your contact information if needed. After the number is disconnected, it won't be available for a new rental for three months. After that, it may be assigned to another user.
In brief
- You can disconnect a rented phone number if you no longer need it.
- If you cancel the rental, you won't receive a refund for the current paid month.
- You can disconnect a number from the list of phone numbers or from that number's settings.
- After you click Disconnect number , confirm the disconnection by clicking OK , or click Cancel to keep the number connected.
- The account administrator will receive an email with a link to cancel the disconnection. If you change your mind, follow the link within 24 hours.

titre: Choose a PBX type and connect it to Bitrix24
sections: Choose a PBX type and connect it to Bitrix24
Bitrix24 supports three telephony connection options:
- Rent a number
- Connect a SIP PBX using the REST API
- Connect a SIP PBX using a SIP connector
You can connect both cloud and office PBXs using the SIP connector. This article explains how to choose the right option and set it up.
What is a SIP PBX
A SIP PBX lets you make calls over the internet. After you buy a number from a telephony provider, you can connect it to Bitrix24.
There are two main types:
- Cloud PBX
- Office (on-premise) PBX
To start:
1. Go to CRM > Sales > Sales channels > Telephony .
2. On the Connection page, choose Cloud PBX or Office PBX .
Cloud PBX
A cloud PBX (virtual PBX) runs on your provider’s servers. It does not require hardware.
You can use it on computers, desk phones, or mobile devices. No extra equipment is needed.
To connect your cloud PBX to Bitrix24, do the following:
Connect a cloud PBX
1. Buy a number from a telephony provider.
2. If you already have one, request your connection details: server , login , and password .
3. Go to Telephony > Connection > Cloud PBX .
4. Click Connect cloud PBX and enter your details.
Office PBX
An office PBX runs on hardware or software in your environment. It gives you more control over call routing and internal communication.
This setup usually requires installation and maintenance by your team or a vendor.
Connect an office PBX
1. Buy a number from a telephony provider.
2. If you already have one, request your connection details: server , login , and password .
3. Install and configure your PBX system.
4. Go to Telephony > Connection > Office PBX .
5. Click Connect office PBX and enter:
1. Connection name
2. Server address
3. Login
4. Password
6. Set up incoming calls:
1. Open Connection parameters > Incoming calls .
2. Copy the server address, login, and password.
3. Add them to your PBX configuration.
Connection limits
- Up to 10 cloud PBXs per account
- No limit for office PBXs
Call charges
- You do not need to add funds in Bitrix24.
- Your PBX provider charges for calls.
- You get 60 free minutes for testing outbound calls.

After the free minutes, you need a SIP connector SIP connector is a special software module of Bitrix24. It allows you to direct all outbound and forwarded calls from Bitrix24 to your SIP PBX. license to continue making outbound calls. What is SIP connector?
Technical requirements
- Your PBX must support the SIP protocol.
- Check with your PBX provider.
Compatibility
You can use multiple connection types at once. Avoid using a REST app and a SIP connection from the same provider. This can cause errors.
Outgoing call settings
To make calls through your PBX:
1. Open Telephony settings.
2. Set your SIP PBX as the default number.
Do not use a rented number here if you want to avoid extra charges. Specify a number for outgoing calls for a user
In brief
- Bitrix24 supports three options: rent a number, REST API, or SIP PBX via SIP connector.
- A cloud PBX is easy to set up and does not require hardware.
- An office PBX gives more control but requires setup and maintenance.
- To connect your cloud PBX to Bitrix24, you need connection details (server, login, password) from your provider.
- Cloud PBX connections are limited to 10. Office PBXs are unlimited.
- Your provider charges for calls. A SIP connector license is required for outbound calls after the trial period.

titre: Connect your cloud PBX
sections: Connect your cloud PBX
You can connect a cloud PBX to Bitrix24 using either the REST API or the SIP connector.
For REST API connections, install an app from the Bitrix24 Market. Check the app documentation or contact the developer if you need help. Bitrix24 Market
This article explains how to connect a cloud PBX using the SIP connector.
Before you start
Keep these points in mind:
- Make sure your PBX supports the SIP protocol.
- You can receive incoming calls for free through the Bitrix24 SIP PBX. You need the SIP connector for outgoing calls and call forwarding. SIP connector
- Bitrix24 provides free minutes to test outbound calls and the SIP connection. Check your available minutes and license status under Connection > Balance and Statistics .
- You only need one SIP connector, even if you connect multiple PBXs.
- The SIP connector is a separate purchase and is not tied to your telephony balance.
- Do not use both a Market app and a SIP connection from the same provider at the same time. This can cause issues such as duplicate calls or a missing Answer button.
Connect a cloud PBX
1. Go to the CRM section > Sales > Sales channels > Telephony .
2. Click Cloud PBX .
3. Select Connect cloud PBX .
4. Fill in the connection details:
1. Connection name : Set a connection name (optional).
2. Server Address : Specify the IP address of your PBX.
3. Login and Password : Enter your PBX access data.
Some PBXs require additional settings:
- Log in as user : Use the value from the auth user field in your PBX settings.
- Proxy server : Use the value from the SIP outbound proxy field.
Click Save . Bitrix24 will create the connection and show its status.
Connection statuses
After you connect a PBX, you may see these statuses:
- In progress : The system is setting up the connection. You can receive incoming calls in a few minutes.
- Getting data : Bitrix24 is checking the connection status.
- Error : The connection failed. Check your settings and try again.
- Connected : The PBX is ready. You can configure phone numbers. Configure numbers
Firewall settings
By default, Bitrix24 uses these ports:
- For browser calls: 443 TCP, 3478 TCP/UDP, 8000-48000 UDP.
- For SIP devices: 5060 TCP/UDP, 3478 TCP/UDP, 8000-48000 UDP.
Allow outbound traffic from your PBX. Inbound traffic usually works automatically.
RTP typically uses UDP. Some packet loss is acceptable and does not block transmission.
If you change ports in your PBX settings, open the same ports in your firewall.

titre: Connect your office PBX
sections: Connect your office PBX
Connect your office PBX to Bitrix24 using the REST API or the SIP connector. You can connect any number of PBXs to your account.
For REST API connections, install an app from the Bitrix24 Market. Check the app description or contact the developer if you need help. Bitrix24 Market
This article explains how to connect a PBX using the SIP connector.
What you can do with the SIP connector
Outgoing calls . Bitrix24 connects to the server you set in the Outgoing calls section and establishes the connection after authentication.
Incoming calls . To receive calls, configure your IP-PBX and create a trunk using the settings from the Incoming calls section.
You can receive incoming calls for free through the Bitrix24 SIP PBX. You need the SIP connector for outgoing calls or call forwarding. SIP connector
You also get free minutes to test outbound calls. Check your available minutes and license period in Connection > Balance and Statistics .
Connect your office PBX
1. Go to CRM .
2. Click Sales .
3. Open Sales channels .
4. Select Telephony .
5. Click Office PBX .
6. Select Connect office PBX .
7. Fill out the form: Connection name : Enter a name (optional). Server Address : Enter your PBX IP address. Login and Password : Enter your PBX credentials.
8. Click Save . A page with connection settings will open. Configure numbers
In the phone number list, you will see a dash instead of the connection status. This is expected. The PBX connects to telephony servers only during a call.
Configure your office PBX
Here is an example using Asterisk. Use the data from the Incoming calls section.
Create a trunk . Add this entry to the sip.conf file:

Exemple : [voximplant] dtmfmode=rfc2833 ; instead of your_account, use the account name from the Server field fromdomain=your_account type=friend host=your_account ; use the value of the Login field fromuser=asterisk username=asterisk ; use the value from the Password field secret=mypass insecure=port,invite conext=contex-internal disallow=all nat=yes allow=ulaw&alaw
Replace the domain and password with your values. Set the nat parameter to yes or no based on your network setup.
Example:

Exemple : [voximplant] dtmfmode=rfc2833 fromdomain=ip.b24-2729-1386056980.voximplant.com type=friend host=ip.b24-2729-1386056980.voximplant.com fromuser=sip1 username=sip1 secret=e349429f63f7e4d7025fcd32d477ea05 insecure=port,invite conext=contex-internal disallow=all nat=yes allow=ulaw&alaw
Older setups used incoming instead of ip in the Server field (e.g., incoming.b24-6864-1386141129.bitrixphone.com ). This still works, but performance is slower. Use ip instead.
Apply the settings in the Asterisk console:
Exemple : sip reload
Set up calls from Asterisk to Voximplant . Configure your Dialplan in the extensions.conf file:
Exemple : Dial(SIP/voximplant/${EXTEN})
Calls will be sent to Bitrix24 as if they were originally dialed in Asterisk. Asterisk documentation: Dialplan
Apply the changes in the Asterisk console:
Exemple : dialplan reload
Configure firewall settings . Open these ports:
- For browser calls: 443 TCP, 3478 TCP/UDP, 8000-48000 UDP.
- For SIP device calls: 5060 TCP/UDP, 3478 TCP/UDP, 8000-48000 UDP.
Allow outbound traffic from your PBX. In most cases, inbound connections will work automatically. RTP usually uses UDP, so data can still be transmitted even if some packets are lost.
You can configure ports in your PBX settings. Make sure to open the same ports in your firewall.

titre: SIP connector
sections: SIP connector
The SIP connector routes outgoing calls and handles call forwarding from Bitrix24 to your SIP PBX.
Incoming calls work automatically and do not require setup. To make outgoing calls or forward calls, you need an active SIP connector license.
You can use the SIP connector to connect both cloud and office PBXs.
Connect a PBX
1. Go to CRM > Sales > Sales channels > Telephony .
2. Click Connect .
3. Choose your PBX type and complete the setup:
Choose the type of PBX and connect it to Bitrix24
You get 60 free minutes to test the connection and configure your equipment. After the free minutes expire, Bitrix24 disables SIP numbers until you purchase a license.
Buy a license
1. Agree with the Voximplant Privacy Policy and Voximplant Data Processing Addendum.
2. Purchase the SIP Telephony subscription (1 month).
How licensing works
One license covers all SIP numbers in your Bitrix24 account. You do not need separate licenses for multiple connections.
The SIP connector is a separate product. It is not tied to your Bitrix24 telephony balance. You cannot use telephony balance funds to pay for the SIP connector.
For Bitrix24 On-Premise, you must activate a valid license key for the SIP connector to work. Bitrix24 On-Premise with an expired maintenance subscription
In brief
- The SIP connector handles outgoing calls and call forwarding.
- Incoming calls work without additional setup.
- You need a license for outbound calls and forwarding.
- You get 60 free minutes to test the connection.
- The license is separate from your telephony balance and covers all SIP connections.

titre: Connect a SIP PBX using the REST API
sections: Connect a SIP PBX using the REST API
You can connect a phone number to Bitrix24 in two ways:
- Use a cloud or office SIP PBX
- Use the REST API
With the REST API, your PBX handles call routing and voice traffic. This setup reduces connection time and improves call quality. Difference between SIP connection and REST applications
REST apps are prebuilt integrations for telephony. You can install them from the Bitrix24 Market.
To install a telephony app:
1. Go to CRM > Sales > Sales channels > Telephony .
2. On the Connection page, scroll to Telephony integrations .
3. Click View all .
4. In the Bitrix24 Market , browse apps or search the catalog.
5. Select an app and click Install .
Install Bitrix24 Market apps
REST API telephony: key details
Bitrix24 supports multiple telephony connection types at the same time. However, avoid using both a REST app and a SIP connection from the same provider. This can cause errors.
If you want a custom setup, build your own app with the REST API. Telephony Integration Tips
When you connect a number through the REST API, the call window does not include an Answer button. You only see Close .
You cannot make calls from:
- A browser
- Bitrix24 Messenger
- The mobile app
To make calls, use a separate softphone app or a SIP phone.
In brief
- You can connect a number using a SIP PBX or the REST API.
- REST apps are ready-made integrations available in the Bitrix24 Market, or you can build your own.
- The PBX handles call routing and voice traffic, which improves speed and quality.
- REST API connections do not support calling from Bitrix24 interfaces. Use a softphone or SIP phone instead.

titre: Differences between the SIP connector and REST API
sections: Differences between the SIP connector and REST API
There are two ways to connect a phone number to Bitrix24:
- SIP connector
- REST API
The SIP connector is a software module that routes outgoing calls and forwards calls from Bitrix24 to a SIP PBX. Use it to connect a cloud or on-premise PBX.
The Telephony REST API is a ready-made integration with a third-party calling service.
SIP PBXs connected through the SIP connector work differently from REST applications. Learn more below.
SIP connector
Get the following connection details from your PBX provider:
- server address
- login
- password
To connect your PBX, go to Telephony > Connection in Bitrix24.
Choose the type of PBX and connect it to Bitrix24
REST application
A REST application is a ready-made integration with a third-party calling service.
To install an app, go to Telephony > Connection > Telephony integrations and choose an app from the Bitrix24 Market.
After installation, follow the developer’s instructions to configure the app.
Connect SIP PBX using REST API
SIP connector
Your telephony provider charges you for inbound and outbound calls. You do not need to top up your Bitrix24 balance.
Bitrix24 includes 60 free minutes to test outgoing calls and call forwarding. After that, you need to purchase a SIP connector license to continue using these features.
SIP connector
REST application
REST applications may include in-app purchases.
Your telephony provider charges you for inbound and outbound calls. You do not need to top up your Bitrix24 balance.
Bitrix24 Market overview
SIP connector
The SIP connector gives you access to all Bitrix24 telephony features, including:
- call recording
- call routing
- and more
You can make and answer calls using:
- a browser
- Bitrix24 Messenger
- the Bitrix24 mobile app
- a SIP phone
Configure numbers
REST application
With REST applications, the PBX handles call routing and voice traffic. This reduces connection time and can improve call quality.
Most REST applications support these features:
- call recording
- callback
- call rating

- linking a phone number to the CRM lead source Sources are the values of the Source system field in leads, deals, contacts, and companies. Sources show where the customer learned about your company. For example, if a contact is created after a call, the source will be Call. field

To make calls, use a separate softphone app or a SIP phone. Contact the app support team for connection details.
Convert Text to Speech in Bitrix24 Record calls

Compatibility

However, we do not recommend using a REST application and a SIP connection from the same provider at the same time. This can cause issues such as:

- To connect a SIP PBX, enter the login, password, and server address from your PBX provider.

- Your telephony provider charges you for inbound and outbound calls.
- To use outgoing calls and call forwarding with the SIP connector, you need a SIP connector license.

- All Bitrix24 telephony features are available with the SIP connector.

titre: Configure numbers
sections: Configure numbers

After you connect phone numbers to Bitrix24, configure them to match your business workflows. Bitrix24 supports different call handling scenarios. For example, you can choose how to route inbound calls, save calls to CRM, or process calls outside business hours.
By default, only Bitrix24 administrators can access these settings. You can also grant access to other employees. Learn how to configure access permissions to Telephony
Configure phone numbers
To configure a rented number or SIP PBX:
1. Go to CRM > Add-ons > Telephony .
2. On the Connection page, click Configure numbers .
3. Select a rented number or PBX from the drop-down list.
Some tabs and settings are different for rented numbers and SIP PBX connections.
Connection parameters
In this section, configure the settings required to make and receive calls through your SIP PBX.
Connect office PBX Connect cloud hosted PBX
Inbound call routing
Inbound call routing automatically distributes inbound calls based on your settings. You can route calls to:
- an employee extension
- a voice menu (IVR)
- the responsible person in CRM
- a specific queue
Configure inbound call routing
SIP PBX numbers

Transmit your SIP PBX numbers using headers and use them in call tracking Call tracking is a technology that links marketing channels to inbound phone calls using unique phone numbers. by editing the settings in this section. Call tracking: SIP PBX numbers
CRM integration
Use this tab to configure how calls are processed in CRM. You can:
- create CRM items automatically or manually during a call
- configure sources
- choose how customer calls are saved in CRM
Telephony with CRM integration
Recording and rating
In this section, you can enable:
- call recording
- call transcription
- service quality rating
Record calls
Working hours
Set working hours for your phone number so employees can receive inbound calls during business hours.
You can also choose how to process calls outside business hours:
- voice mail
- call forwarding
- automatic call completion
Working time settings for phone numbers
Other settings
In this section, you can:
- change the forwarding channel for your SIP PBX connection
- show the caller ID when forwarding calls from a rented number
- configure repeated callbacks
- add a backup phone number
- allow employees to make calls from a specific number
Other phone number settings
Music and sound
Configure audio files for different call scenarios. For example, you can:
- choose a greeting message
- set waiting music
- configure sounds for service quality evaluation
